article.articleHeadline: مخاوف من تمدد "إيبولا" إلى 10 دول إفريقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns About Ebola Spreading to 10 African Countries.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: The Democratic Republic of Congo's Ministry of Health reports more than 200 deaths among 867 suspected Ebola cases across three provinces, with WHO data noting rising fatalities as the outbreak persists in multiple areas. Africa CDC warns the virus could spread to about 10 African countries, including neighboring Uganda, South Sudan and Rwanda, and other East/Central African nations. Ebola is highly infectious and spreads through body fluids such as blood and vomit, causing a severe illness with a notable case-fatality risk. The report underscores cross-border transmission risks and ongoing concerns about the scale of the outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱が10のアフリカ諸国に拡大することへの懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率と感染性を持ち、DRCでの流行が確認され、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ルワンダなど周辺国への国際的拡大リスクが顕著。公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的な懸念が明白。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはウガンダ、スーダン、ルワンダも発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国への拡大リスク・懸念として言及されており、実際の発生確認（cases reported）ではなく潜在的な拡大リスクの言及である。verified_locationsではDRCのみを含める。ウガンダ・ルワンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOおよびアフリカCDCの警告により国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Tanda Penyakit Tuberkulosis, Batuk Lebih dari 2 Minggu : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 Signs of Tuberculosis, Cough Lasting More Than 2 Weeks: Okezone Women
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin posted an Instagram education spot on tuberculosis (TB), warning of its ongoing seriousness in Indonesia. He notes that TB deaths occur roughly every four minutes in the country and that Indonesia ranks second worldwide in total TB cases, a statistic framed as a call for intensified detection and treatment. The video references five principal TB symptoms, with the article’s title highlighting a cough lasting more than two weeks as a key warning sign. The message aims to raise public awareness and prompt timely medical evaluation and treatment for TB, centering Jakarta as the location for this public health outreach.

triage.headline_ja: 結核の5つの兆候、2週間以上続く咳：Okezone Women
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核は公衆衛生上の重要な課題であり、厚生労働大臣による公式な啓発活動が記事の主題。ただし、本記事は新規の疾患発生や異常な流行を報告するものではなく、既知の結核対策に関する教育的コンテンツであるため、現段階ではWATCH判定として続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシアにおける結核の既知の流行に対する公式な啓発活動であり、新規の異常事象ではない。結核は既知の風土病であり、記事は公衆衛生教育を目的とした内容。IHR基準では重篤な公衆衛生影響が認められるが、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。WPRO基準では重症度（4分ごとの死亡）と長期曝露が認識されるが、新規のアウトブレイクではないため、現段階ではWATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: مستشفيات بدائية ومخاوف متصاعدة في "بؤرة إيبولا" بالكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Primitive hospitals and escalating fears in the Ebola epicenter in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Mongbawulo, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a city of about 130,000. As of reporting, 867 people are suspected cases with 204 deaths in the country; in Mongbawulo, 322 suspected cases and 88 deaths. The outbreak has rapidly spread to two neighboring provinces and crossed borders to Uganda (roughly 100 km by air from Ituri) and South Sudan about 200 km away. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo; the article notes there is no vaccine or treatment for this variant. Health facilities are primitive; handwashing stations, PPE, and MSF tents for isolation are in use. The initial suspicion traces to a man who died in Bunia, whose body was transported 80 km to Mongbawulo with a damaged coffin, fueling fear. Samples were awaiting confirmation in Kinshasa.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴのエボラ中心地における初歩的な病院と増幅する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) 宣言済みのエボラ(Bundibugyo株)大規模集団発生で、国際的な拡大とハイリスク環境が確認されている。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済みの第17次DRCエボラ大規模集団発生(Bundibugyo株)。Ituri州Mongbawuloを中心に867人の疑い例、204人の死亡が報告。隣接2州への波及、ウガンダ・南スーダンへの国際的越境事例あり。ワクチン・治療法がない株であり、医療施設の劣悪さが懸念。記事はArabic言語のモロッコメディア発信だが、大規模国際保健危機の報道。

article.articleHeadline: '완치 없음'... 민주콩고 에볼라 의심 환자 어느새 904명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'No cure'... 904 Ebola-suspected patients in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains severe, centered in Ituri province. As of May 23, cumulative suspected cases reached 904, with 119 suspected deaths and 101 confirmed cases (10 confirmed deaths); no recoveries have been reported. By May 22, 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths were recorded, down from 21 May figures of 746 suspected cases and 176 suspected deaths; authorities gave no explanation for the apparent drop in deaths, suggesting possible non-Ebola deaths or undetected cases. WHO assesses domestic risk as 'very high,' while global spread remains low. The response is hindered by conflict, displacement, and aid cuts: two Ebola treatment centers in Ituri—Lewampala and Mongbalu—were torched by locals. About 1 million refugees have fled Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: 『完治なし』...コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い患者904名に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模疑い患者発生（904名、死亡119名）、紛争・医療施設破壊による対応困難、WHOが国内リスク『極めて高い』と評価。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国東部Ituri州に集中している。WHOの公式リスク評価『domestic risk very high, global spread low』が記載されている。医療施設破壊（Lewampala, Mongbalu処置センター）、100万人の難民流出、治療困難な状況が確認される。101確認症例、10死亡確認、119疑い死亡、回復者ゼロという極めて深刻な疫学指標。

article.articleHeadline: Jóvenes irrumpen en hospital de tratamiento del ébola en el Congo para exigir cuerpos de familiares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young people storm an Ebola treatment hospital in the Congo to demand the bodies of relatives.
article.articleSummary: Angry youths stormed the Monbgwalu General Hospital in Mongbwalu, at the epicenter of the latest Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, forcing staff to evacuate patients after gunfire was heard. The assault underscores security and resource challenges of the outbreak, which the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In Ituri, authorities reported 904 suspected Ebola cases, up from about 700 earlier, and 119 suspected deaths, though regional tallies separately listed 220 deaths, a discrepancy not explained. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no vaccine, and was first detected after a death in Bunia; tests for a more common Ebola virus were negative. Three MSF health workers reportedly died from Ebola, potentially linked to infections acquired when handling corpses. Authorities restricted funerals and large gatherings. An attack burned a treatment tent in Mongbwalu and another in Rwampara.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療病院に若者が乱入し、親族の遺体の引き渡しを要求
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的に重要な公衆衛生事象であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当、WHO（PHEIC）宣言済み、国際支援必要性あり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain（ワクチンなし）、904疑似症例、119疑似死亡例（別源では220死亡），MSF職員3名死亡報告あり。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。セキュリティリスク（銃撃、病院スタッフ避難）と資源不足が深刻。ルワンダとの境界近接（Kigali Province言及）により国際拡大リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ổ dịch Ebola ở Ituri đẩy cả khu vực vào trình trạng cảnh giác cao độ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Ituri pushes the entire region into a state of high alert.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak centers on Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia city as the focal point. The WHO has raised risk to highest level, signaling cross-border spread into Central and East Africa. DR Congo reports 82 confirmed Ebola cases and 7 deaths, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths under surveillance; Uganda has 5 cases linked to Congo. The African Union warns at least 10 countries—including Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda and South Sudan—could be affected if not controlled. Ituri’s response is strained by ongoing conflict, security instability, and humanitarian crisis, challenging local and international efforts. Africa CDC and WHO are calling for emergency funding over $314 million, mainly for DR Congo and Uganda to support treatment, surveillance, containment, and Bundibugyo strain vaccine research, rapid response teams, and stockpiles. Ebola is deadly but not as easily transmitted as COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラアウトブレイク、地域全体を高度な警戒状態に押し上げる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高致死性で国際的拡大リスクが顕著であり、既に複数国への越境感染が確認されている。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア市）での発生が主題。ウガンダへの越境感染（5例）も記載されているが、DRCのみが対象国リスト内。エチオピア、ケニア、ルワンダ、南スーダンはアフリカ連合の警告対象だが記事では発症事例が報告されていないため除外。高度に時間的緊急性が高い事例。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola resucita el macrocentro de aislamiento de Hong Kong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola resurges at Hong Kong's isolation center.
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurges as Hong Kong reopens Penny's Bay isolation center amid a Central African outbreak. The Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri region) and neighboring Uganda report rapid spread; the World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). Global tallies show hundreds of suspected Ebola infections and more than 200 deaths under investigation. Hong Kong raises its travel alert for the DRC to Red and adopts a preventive shield to protect its health system. Penny's Bay, on Lantau Island, is being readied to host up to 10,000 standardized housing units across 80 hectares, with 18-square-meter modules designed for contactless isolation—no interior corridors, rations delivered to doors by staff in PPE. Hospitals will be reserved for severe cases. A November drill by the Centre for Health Protection tested import detection, hermetic transfer, contact tracing, and environmental disinfection, informing current perimeter-based containment and movement controls.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがホンコンの隔離センターで再発生
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率を持つ重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、WHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言されている。中部アフリカからの国際的拡大リスクが確認されており、旅行制限や貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ地域およびウガンダでのエボラ発生、そしてホンコンでの隔離センター再開に関するもの。対象国リストではDRC（203312）とChina（香港は中国に含める、1814991）が該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、200人以上の死亡が報告されており、極めて重大な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Gold Fields Commits GH¢320k to Malaria Fight
article.articleSummary: Gold Fields Ghana Foundation (GFGF) commits GH¢320,000 toward 2026 World Malaria Day activities in Tarkwa Nsuaem and Prestea Huni-Valley municipalities, Ghana, partnering with municipal assemblies and health directorates. The funds support the commemoration held in Tarkwa under the theme Drive to End Malaria: Now We Can. Now We Must. and a program including expanded radio awareness, follow-up donations, and ongoing education sessions through the year. GFGF also donated weed slashers to WATSAN committees to reduce mosquito breeding by clearing vegetation. Tarkwa Nsuaem Municipal Health Director Wilhemina Tiwaah Duah Morttey noted collaboration with the Ghana Health Service and the directorate, adding larval source management and other environmental interventions. Residents were urged to keep surroundings clean to break transmission; the foundation’s sustained support aims to lower malaria prevalence in both municipalities.

triage.headline_ja: Gold Fields、マラリア対策に32万ガーナセディ（GH¢320k）をコミット
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はガーナのマラリア対策への民間企業による寄付と啓発活動に関する報道であり、疾患の異常発生や公衆衛生危機を報告するものではない。確立された感染症イベント（アウトブレイク、流行拡大、新興感染症）の検出ではなく、既存の地風土病に対する支援活動の報道である。
triage.notes: ガーナでのマラリア対策活動（世界マラリアデー記念）の報道。記事は疾患の流行、アウトブレイク、異常な発生パターンの報告ではなく、既知の風土病に対する企業財団による支援・啓発活動の情報提供である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 mistenkte ebola-tilfeller i Kongo, ifølge WHO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo, according to WHO.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, concentrated in Ituri Province, with 101 laboratory-confirmed, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak, which began in April in Ituri, is driven by the Bundibugyo filovirus variant and has been detected in Ituri, the city of Goma, and neighboring Uganda. WHO characterizes the situation as an international public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. As of the latest tally, 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases have been reported. Case fatality is estimated at 25-40%; transmission occurs through touch and contact with bodily fluids. Bundibugyo is a rare variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ongoing conflict in Ituri hampers contact tracing, fueling fear and distrust. Norway announced a 50 million NOK contribution to WHO for Ebola response in Congo and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで900件以上の疑い例を含むエボラ患者、WHOによると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。稀なBundibugyo亜種による大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、WHO公式確認、国際的支援開始により、フルリスク評価（RRA）に進む必要がある。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは隣国として言及されているのみで、実際のエボラ発症がウガンダで確認されたか明示されていない。主要なアウトブレイク地はDRC（イトゥリ州、ゴマ）であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ノルウェーは支援国のため含めない。稀なBundibugyo亜種（ワクチンなし）、高い致命率（25-40%）、紛争地域での接触追跡困難、国際公衆衛生上の懸念事項として最高レベルの評価が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Zahl der Verdachtsfälle in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo steigt auf über 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Number of suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rises to over 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. On 2026-05-25, the World Health Organization raised the risk of national spread to 'very high', with regional risk 'high' and global risk 'low'. Official figures in the DRC show 82 infections and 7 deaths confirmed by Friday, with 177 deaths still under investigation possibly linked to Ebola. The DR Congo Ministry of Health reported over 200 deaths in the weekend. Suspected Ebola cases in the country exceed 900. Diagnostic capacity is limited and reports vary widely. The data indicate an ongoing, expanding Ebola outbreak in the DRC with significant testing and reporting gaps.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：コンゴ民主共和国の疑似患者数が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確である。WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルス病の発生。確認患者82名・死亡7名、疑似患者900名超、調査中の死亡177名。WHOが国内リスク『非常に高い』、地域リスク『高い』と評価。診断能力の限界と報告の不一貫性が指摘されており、実際の規模はさらに大きい可能性がある。国際的な公衆衛生緊急事態として対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola lan rộng nhanh chóng tại châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly in Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly in Africa; WHO warning on 24 May 2026 as the Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or treatment. Congo and Uganda are the epicenters with reported cases and deaths; the crisis risks expanding to about 10 African countries. Transmission is accelerating, especially in densely populated urban areas, straining already burdened health systems and leading to high healthcare worker fatalities. The virus is no longer confined to old foci and is crossing borders, driven by cross-border movement and weak regional health infrastructure. WHO urges intensified surveillance, border controls, and rapid response/logistical planning, including contact tracing; neighboring countries with open borders face high risk. Calls for intensified international support—funding, PPE, medical supplies, vaccines—and local measures to raise symptom awareness (fever, hemorrhagic signs, fatigue) and enforce safe burial procedures to curb cross-community spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がアフリカで急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラの急速な拡大、複数国での越境感染、ワクチン・治療薬なしのBundibugyo株、死亡報告、国際支援要請が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、エボラがコンゴとウガンダを中心に拡大し、約10のアフリカ国への拡大リスクが述べられている。ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはコンゴのみを列挙。WHO公式警告（2026年5月24日）、治療薬・ワクチンなしのBundibugyo株、医療従事者の高い死亡率、都市部での加速的な伝播、越境感染、地域保健インフラの脆弱性が報告されており、世界的公衆衛生上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: Sejarah Rumah Mewah Menteng yang Lahir gegara Serangan Wabah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The History of Menteng's Luxury House Born in the Wake of an Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Malaria outbreaks in Batavia (Jakarta) in the mid-18th century sparked a center-city relocation to Weltevreden, laying the groundwork for Menteng’s emergence as Jakarta’s elite district. Deaths in Batavia rose to about 2,000–3,000 per year after 1733, with colonial health records attributing endemic malaria to rampant Anopheles mosquito breeding in fish ponds along the northern coast. Other factors—river silting after the 1699 eruption of Mount Salak, the 1740 Chinese massacre, and VOC financial decline—also pushed administration south to Weltevreden. Dutch officials’ housing demand spurred the development of Nieuw Gondangdia into Menteng, guided by NV de Bouwploeg. By 1942 Menteng covered roughly 69 hectares (295 Rijnlandsche roeden). Land ownership included Moor Arab holders (e.g., Assan Nina Daut, Pieter J. du Chene de Vienne); Bouwploeg bought the land in 1908 for 238,870 guilders. Development slowed under Japanese occupation, with few large houses built thereafter.

triage.headline_ja: ジャカルタのメンテン地区の高級住宅地の誕生 - マラリア流行がきっかけ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は18世紀のマラリア流行の歴史的背景を記述した不動産・都市開発の歴史記事であり、現在の感染症イベントではない。現在の公衆衛生上のリスク評価対象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は1700年代のバタヴィア（ジャカルタ）のマラリア流行の歴史的記述であり、現在の感染症イベント（active outbreak）ではない。18世紀の歴史的背景として言及されているマラリアは、現在の公衆衛生リスク評価の対象外。Bluedot APIによる自動分類の誤分類と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 의심 900건 넘어..."글로벌 확산위험 아직 낮아"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases... Global spread risk remains low
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, centered in Ituri province. As of May 23, cumulative suspected Ebola cases reached 904 and suspected deaths 119; confirmed cases total 101 with 10 confirmed deaths; no recoveries reported. The jump in reported deaths earlier (May 21–22) did not hold on May 23; authorities offered no explanation, but some cases may have been ruled non-Ebola or misclassified. The World Health Organization classifies the outbreak risk as 'very high' for the DRC, though global spread risk remains low. Ongoing challenges include armed groups, aid cuts, and community anger, complicating response. Ituri hosts about 1 million displaced people. Two Ebola treatment centers in Ituri were set ablaze by locals, underscoring local tensions and security concerns affecting outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴ エボラ疑い例900件超える...「グローバル拡散リスクはまだ低い」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。確定症例101、疑い例904、死亡119と重症度高く、WHOが地域リスク「非常に高い」と分類。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRC南東部Ituri州での進行中のエボラ流行。確定症例101例・疑い例904例・死亡119例。治療センターの焼失、武装勢力による妨害、支援削減など対応困難性が高い。WHO地域リスク評価『非常に高い』だが全球拡散リスクは『低い』との公式評価。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ponad 900 podejrzanych przypadków wirusa Ebola w Demokratycznej Republice Konga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola virus cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola virus disease outbreak driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Ituri Province, centered on Bunia. The Ministry of Communications reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, up from just over 700 previously announced, with 119 suspected deaths; AP regional tallies list 220 deaths. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The virus has circulated undetected for weeks in Ituri after a first death in late April in Bunia, while tests for a more common Ebola virus were negative. WHO has elevated Congo’s outbreak risk to “very high,” though global risk remains low. An attack on a hospital treating Ebola patients and family demand for bodies underscored transmission risks at funerals, with authorities directing state-run funerals to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い症例が900例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また WPRO スクリーニング基準も全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus によるエボラ出血熱の発生。疑い症例904例、死亡119例（地域情報では220例）。ワクチンがない亜種。Ituri州Bunia中心。数週間検出されなかった。病院への攻撃やキャリアリスク増加。WHO が地域レベルリスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げ。グローバルリスクは低いとされているが、発症から検査確認までの遅延と感染経路の複雑性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: عدد الإصابات المحتملة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية تجاوز الـ 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The number of probable Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: Probable Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 900, with 101 confirmed cases, as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, eastern DRC, where about a quarter of roughly 5 million residents need humanitarian aid and around 20% have left their homes. Ongoing fighting in the region hampers contact tracing and early detection of Ebola. The first case was detected in Ituri on April 24, believed to involve miners in the area. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the Democratic Republic of the Congo and neighboring Uganda due to the outbreak in both countries. The article does not provide death counts or detailed laboratory confirmation beyond the 101 confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス感染の可能性のある症例数が900を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な保健上の緊急事態宣言が発令されており、複数国での確認と国際的な懸念が明確である。
triage.notes: WHOが5月17日に国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。DRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした流行であり、ウガンダへの言及もあるが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。確認症例101例、疑い症例を含めて900例以上。同地域の紛争により接触者追跡が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch in Kongo: Über 900 Verdachtsfälle und internationale Ausbreitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: Over 900 suspected cases and international spread.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with more than 900 suspected cases and reports of international spread. The World Health Organization notes that the number of infected people is rising. There is no vaccine for the current Ebola virus strain. Aid workers on the ground are contending with mistrust from local communities, hindering response efforts. The report underscores the challenge of outbreak control amid distrust and limited vaccine options, emphasizing the need for surveillance, case finding, and community engagement to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：900件以上の疑い例と国際的な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは最高リスク病原体であり、900件以上の疑い例、国際的拡大の報告、ワクチンの不在、コミュニティの不信による対応の阻害など、深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念が複合的に存在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは致命的なリスク病原体。記事は900件以上の疑い例、国際的拡大の報告、利用可能なワクチンの不在、現地コミュニティの不信による対応の困難性を報告。DRCでの発生が確認され、対象国リストに該当。フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Brotes de ébola en Congo: Multitudes asaltan hospital con pacientes en estado crítico - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreaks in Congo: Crowds storm a hospital with patients in critical condition - Notiulti
article.articleSummary: Angry crowds storm a hospital in the Democratic Republic of the Congo where Ebola patients are treated, amid an ongoing outbreak. The incident highlights fear of contagion, distrust of containment measures, and social tensions in the region. Health authorities and international organizations are coordinating to contain the epidemic and prevent spread, intensifying vaccination campaigns and public-awareness efforts. The World Health Organization and partners have urged calm and adherence to safety protocols to protect patients and staff. Local authorities are working to restore normal health services and assess damages at the facility. Further details and containment measures are expected in the coming hours.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行: 重篤患者が入院している病院に群衆が押し寄せる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、国際拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と国際的な拡大リスクを有する。群衆による病院への押し寄せは感染制御の破綻を示唆し、社会的混乱が感染拡大を助長する懸念がある。WHO及び国際機関による対応が進行中だが、地域的な不信感と対策の困難性が指摘されている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 视频丨刚果（金）埃博拉疫情恶化 重灾区布尼亚民生受影响
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | Ebola outbreak worsens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; livelihoods in the hard-hit Bunia are affected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus worsens in Bunia, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, as of May 25, 2026. Transmission risk and shortages of protective equipment and supplies hinder containment; there are no approved virus-specific therapies or vaccines for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Emphasis is on masking, handwashing, and disinfection. Bunia’s logistics and PPE supply are strained, pressuring local public health response. Cross-border risk rises with Rwanda and Uganda tightening controls; Uganda has imposed a two-week public transport ban, curtailing movement and trade. Local livelihoods deteriorate, with vendor Mami Ulungu reporting substantial business losses amid disrupted supply chains. The article underscores ongoing outbreak dynamics and the urgent need for improved logistics and public health resources in Bunia, highlighting the daily challenges residents face in maintaining protection and livelihoods during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 動画｜コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が悪化、被害地域ブニアの生活に影響
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生で、IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。ウガンダによる公共交通禁止措置など政治的対応も顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのブニアにおけるエボラウイルス病の悪化を主要イベントとしている。ウガンダとルワンダは隣接国として言及されているが、サマリー上では主なイベント発生地ではなく、国境管理強化の背景として記述されているため、verified_locationsからは除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチンなし）による感染拡大、物資不足、国際的な移動制限による生活への影響が記述されており、緊急の公衆衛生対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Terancam Gagal Dikendalikan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Kongo is at risk of failing to be contained.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases are reported in eastern Kongo's Ituri Province, centered around Bunia and Mongbwalu, as of May 25, 2026, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak worsened after a May 24 attack on a hospital in Mongbwalu, raising concerns amid ongoing armed conflict. About one million people are displaced in Ituri, increasing transmission risk in crowded camps near Bunia. Donor funding cuts, including from the United States, have left facilities short of PPE, testing kits, and safe-burial supplies, compounding operational challenges for health workers. Authorities have banned large funeral gatherings and deployed security to enforce rules. There is no vaccine or officially approved treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; containment relies on strict infection prevention, case management, and fragile health systems in a conflict-affected humanitarian context.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が制御に失敗する危機に直面している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。900例超の疑い患者、高い致死性、国際的拡大リスク、医療体制の崩壊の危機により、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）の流行。武装紛争による医療施設への攻撃、約100万人の避難民、国際的資金援助の削減が状況を悪化させている。米国等からの寄付金削減により、個人防護具・検査キット・安全埋葬供給品が不足。ワクチンと正式承認治療薬が存在しないため、感染予防・症例管理・脆弱な医療体制への依存が重要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC y la OMS elevan a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola y a...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC and WHO raise the number of suspected Ebola cases to more than 900 and to....
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) has recorded over 900 suspected cases and more than 100 confirmed cases. As of May 23, 101 cases have been laboratory-confirmed and 904 suspected across 11 health zones; 10 confirmed deaths and 119 suspected deaths. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus raised concerns, noting ongoing conflict in Ituri—home to nearly five million people—and widespread humanitarian needs, with significant barriers to contact tracing and timely care due to violence and displacement. CDC Africa reports higher figures of Ebola-related deaths under suspicion (around 204) across DRC and Uganda, though Uganda is less affected. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no licensed vaccines or antibody treatments. WHO emphasizes a comprehensive health package and sustained health worker presence despite insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とWHOがエボラ疑い例を900件以上、確認例を100件以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な感染症イベント。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の大規模流行で、確認例100件超、疑い例900件以上、死亡者多数が報告されており、紛争地域での対応困難性も深刻。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（ワクチンなし、抗体治療法なし）による大規模流行。記事ではUgandaも地名に含まれているが、サマリー本文では「Uganda is less affected」と明記されており、主要発生地はDRCのみ。紛争下での感染制御困難性、大規模避難民、多数の死亡者が報告され、極めて懸念が高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情嚴峻 世衛組織宣布國際緊急狀態 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is severe; WHO declares international emergency
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, centered in Mongbwalu, has prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo virus strain has caused at least 204 deaths, with Mongbwalu reporting 322 suspected cases and 88 deaths. Testing capacity is severely limited, and official counts are likely underreported. The Bundibugyo strain, seen in 2007 and 2012, has no available vaccine or approved treatment. Humanitarian groups, including Doctors Without Borders (MSF), are urgently delivering supplies as the outbreak spreads to neighboring provinces and to Uganda within weeks. Hospitals such as Sofepadi Hospital are overwhelmed, and basic infection control is constrained by weak infrastructure. Initial confirmation only occurred after samples were sent about 1,800 kilometers to Kinshasa’s Biomedical Research Laboratory, delaying response. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が深刻化 世界保健機関が国際緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病による大規模流行で200名以上の死亡、国際緊急事態宣言、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチン/治療法がない株系という極めて深刻な状況
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事サマリー内で「neighboring provinces and to Uganda within weeks」と記載されており、数週間以内の拡大予想として言及されているが、確定的な発生地域ではないため verified_locations に含めない。発生地域としては DRC（イトゥリ州モングバル地域）が確定。Bundibugyo株は2007年・2012年の流行株で、現在のワクチン・治療法がないことが重大な懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: US Response to the DRC Ebola Outbreak: A Policy Analysis - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in the northeast, prompted WHO to declare a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026, with cross-border spread into Uganda. By May 21, 2026 authorities reported roughly 746 suspected cases and over 176 suspected deaths, marking one of the largest Ebola outbreaks to date. The outbreak involves a viral species different from those in prior major outbreaks, and there are no available vaccines or treatments for this strain. Diagnostic capacity is limited: testing can only be performed at specialized laboratories rather than standard facilities. The crisis tests the global response framework amid funding and cooperation challenges influenced by policy changes cited by KFF, representing the first major outbreak response under restricted conditions. U.S. government response is under scrutiny as the region escalates, amid lessons from West Africa (2014–2015) and the DRC (2018–2020).

triage.headline_ja: US Response to the DRC Ebola Outbreak: A Policy Analysis - News Directory 3
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱のDRC発生・ウガンダへの越境感染、746疑い患者・176疑い死亡、ワクチン・治療法なし、診断能力限定、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言。フルRRA進行推奨。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題である。ウガンダへの越境拡大が記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーに具体的な記載がないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。大規模アウトブレイク（746疑い患者、176疑い死亡）で過去最大級。新規ウイルス種でワクチン・治療法なし、診断能力限定という重大リスク要因がある。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में ईबोला का कहर: 904 संदिग्ध मामले, 119 मौतें, WHO का अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola ravages Congo: 904 suspected cases, 119 deaths, WHO alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths; earlier counts exceeded 700 cases and 170 deaths. WHO notes very high risk for the DRC, though global spread risk remains low, and the outbreak is a declared public health emergency of international concern. Health facilities are overwhelmed as security clashes—attacks on treatment centers—drive health workers to flee. About 1 million people are displaced in Ituri, with camps near Bunia at risk. Burial practices and traditional rites are contested, prompting authorities and aid agencies to manage funerals to curb transmission. Critical gaps include lack of PPE, testing kits, body bags, and other supplies. The Bundibugyo strain is involved, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists; rebel groups including M23 and ADF complicate response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが猛威：904の疑い患者、119人の死亡、WHOのアラート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。公式なPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されており、WHOの高リスク警告を伴う。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain involved; no approved vaccine/treatment available. Security situation (M23, ADF rebel groups) hampering response efforts. 100万人が国内避難民状態。WHO既に高リスク評価を発令。記事がIturi州Bunia近郊での発生を主題としており、DRCでの実際の発生を確認。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ് വ്യാപനം മൂ​​​ന്ന് ആ​​​ഫ്രി​​​ക്ക​​​ൻ രാ​​​ജ്യ​​​ങ്ങ​​​ളി​​​ലേ​​​ക്ക് യാ​​​ത്ര ഒ​​​ഴി​​​വാ​​​ക്കാ​​​ൻ നി​​​ർ​​​ദേ​​​ശം | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Directive to avoid travel to three African countries due to Ebola virus spread.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, India’s Health Ministry advised avoiding nonessential travel to three African nations amid an Ebola outbreak: Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The Bundibugyo strain is circulating; Congo reports 204 deaths and 867 symptomatic cases. Neighboring Uganda and South Sudan have also reported cases. The outbreak prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. No transmission has been reported outside Africa. Travelers from affected areas should contact health authorities at airports if they develop symptoms, even before immigration clearance. Protective kits and medical assistance have been handed to the Africa CDC for outbreak response. There is currently no effective vaccine for this strain. The guidance underscores heightened precautions and adherence to local health advice for residents returning from the affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの拡大により3つのアフリカ諸国への渡航を避けるよう指示 | Deepika
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイク（ブンディブギョ株）がDRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンで確認され、WHOがPHEIC宣言。IHR基準3つ以上該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: インドの保健省による渡航勧告が発令されており、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンでの確認が記載されている。対象国リストではDRCとIndiaのみ該当。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象外のため除外。PHEI宣言済みで国際的な関心が非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Врач описала первые симптомы лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor described the first symptoms of Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Novosibirsk, May 25 — An infectious-disease specialist, Dr. Yulia Minakova of Siberian State Medical University, notes that the first symptoms of Ebola fever resemble influenza, with fever and flu-like illness, before a hemorrhagic syndrome develops. Subcutaneous bleeding precedes internal bleeding (gastrointestinal) and uterine bleeding, signaling disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC). The disease course is typically severe and often fatal. Transmission occurs via contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person. On May 24, the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) under international health regulations. The report underscores Ebola’s seriousness and the international health risk posed by the Bundibugyo lineage in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がエボラ出血熱の初期症状について説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月24日）済みのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の発生であり、DRCおよびウガンダでの確認事例は国際的な公衆衛生上の危機。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言は国際保健規則(IHR2005)の最高レベルの警告。記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでの発生が確認されているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを記載。ロシアの医学者による臨床的解説はシグナル拡大の文脈を提供。

article.articleHeadline: Kes ebola di DR Congo melebihi 100 susulan peningkatan jangkitan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in DR Congo exceed 100 following an increase in infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) exceed 100 confirmed cases as of May 23, with transmission spanning 11 health zones since detection on May 15 in Ituri. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with more than 900 suspected cases and at least seven deaths confirmed in Congo. In neighboring Uganda, three new cases were reported on Saturday, bringing total confirmed infections there to five. Congo authorities have suspended social activities in Ituri, including sports events, to blunt spread. Africa CDC lists 10 at-risk countries: Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, South Sudan, and Zambia. WHO has raised the alert level to very high, while neighboring nations tighten prevention measures and restrict travel from Congo. Health authorities continue monitoring, screening, and risk communication as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoのエボラ症例が100例を超える感染増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認患者100例超、複数地域での活発な伝播、死亡確認、地域的拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、WHOが最高警戒レベル引き上げ。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として認識される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが多くの周辺国を発生地域として付与しているが、サマリーより実際の確認イベント発生地はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）及びウガンダ（隣国への波及）。対象国リストではDRCとザンビアのみが該当。ウガンダは対象外のため除外。Africa CDCが列挙した10の危機言及国は「リスク国」であり、確認患者発生地ではない。WHOが最高警戒レベル（very high）を宣言し、複数の周辺国が渡航制限を開始している状況から、フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Sinh phẩm xét nghiệm đặc hiệu vi rút Ebola đang được chuyển đến Việt Nam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus-specific diagnostic test kits are being shipped to Vietnam.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam is receiving Ebola virus–specific diagnostic test kits as part of preparedness. On May 24, 2026, Health Minister Dao Hong Lan briefed top leaders on Ebola risk and control measures. Ebola is a highly dangerous acute disease with up to 90% case-fatality, transmitted from wildlife (fruit bats, hyrax, primates) to humans and via contact with blood, secretions, or contaminated surfaces. Vaccines and specific treatments exist for Ebola virus (Zaire ebolavirus), but no licensed vaccines or therapies for Sudan or Bundibugyo strains. Vietnam has intensified border and health facility surveillance, including 21‑day health monitoring for travelers returning from the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology and Pasteur Institute (Ho Chi Minh City) now have BSL-3 labs for genome sequencing; WHO-listed diagnostic reagents are being shipped. Hospitals have been ordered to strengthen infection control, screening, isolation, and PPE readiness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス特異的診断検査キットがベトナムに輸送されている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの高い危険性と国境監視強化により WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）が複数該当するが、ベトナムでの実際の患者発生ではなく準備活動であり、IHR基準該当数は1以下であるため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは、ベトナムにおけるエボラウイルス準備対応活動（検査キット導入、国境監視強化、検査体制整備）を報道している。実際の患者発生は記載されていない。DRCとウガンダでの発生地域言及は、監視対象国との接触によるリスク管理の文脈であり、記事主題はベトナムの準備活動。IHR基準では該当2項目に対し、WPROスクリーニングでは異常性・重症度・流行性・管理難度の観点から複数該当。政治的関心（保健相による閣僚説明）も確認されるが、実発症例がないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline:
21新健康
                                刚果（金）埃博拉疫情持续恶化；我国首个太空人体研究计划将实施
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 21 New Health: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) continues to worsen; China's first human spaceflight research program will be implemented.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) worsens: as of May 23, 2026, the DRC reports 867 suspected Ebola cases and 204 deaths, with Bunia airport in Ituri province suspending all passenger flights. The World Health Organization raised national-level risk from high to very high, and regional risk to high as of May 22. In neighboring Uganda, three additional confirmed Ebola cases were reported on May 23, bringing cumulative confirmed cases to five and marking the first locally transmitted infections, prompting tightened border and transport controls to prevent cross-border spread. The situation indicates sustained transmission in eastern DRC and rising spillover risk to neighboring countries, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が継続的に悪化；中国初の有人宇宙飛行研究計画が実施予定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて重篤で、DRCでの死亡者204名を含む867人の疑い患者、ウガンダでの初の地域内感染事例、国境および輸送制限の実施から、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダも報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国（ID: 203312）に該当。エボラの国境越え事例（ウガンダ）があり、国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: شبان يقتحمون مستشفى بالكونغو يعالج مرضى الإيبولا للمطالبة بجثث ذويهم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young men storm a hospital in Congo that treats Ebola patients to demand the bodies of their relatives.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues as angry youths storm Mongabalo General Hospital in Mongabalo town on Sunday, prompting evacuation of patients amid gunfire; no injuries confirmed. The attack marks the third assault on healthcare facilities in a week as clinicians contend with scarce resources to treat suspected Ebola cases. In Ramabara town, another treatment center was burned on Thursday after relatives were blocked from retrieving a body. On Saturday, residents also set fire to a Doctors Without Borders (MSF) tent housing suspected/confirmed Ebola cases. Authorities tightened infection-control by centralizing burials for suspected victims and banning wakes and gatherings of more than 50 people in northeast Congo. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, highlighting the infection risks posed by handling corpses and during funerals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの若者がエボラ患者を治療する病院に乱入し、親族の遺体の引き渡しを要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。医療施設への複数の暴力的攻撃と感染対策の困難により管理可能性が低い。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。医療施設への連続的な暴力的攻撃（3件/1週間）と感染対策の重大な障害が報告されている。葬儀時の死体処理に伴う感染リスクが強調されており、社会的混乱が深刻。記事は対象国DRCのみに関連。

article.articleHeadline: 疑似病例大幅增加，非洲多國加強埃博拉病毒防控
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected cases surge as several African countries strengthen Ebola virus prevention and control.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri and North Kivu, with South Kivu reporting new cases. WHO raised risk to very high on May 22. As of May 23, CDC reports 83 confirmed cases and 746 suspected, with 9 confirmed deaths and 176 suspected deaths. Uganda has 5 cases and 1 death; Africa CDC warns the outbreak could spread to Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Congo (Brazzaville), Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. In response, Kampala hosted a ministerial meeting; WHO dispatched 22 international experts; UN pledged $60 million. DRC banned flights from Bunia, limited gatherings to 50, suspended football leagues, and restricted funeral logistics; Uganda halted cross-border flights, ferries, and buses. Attacks on a Bunia hospital and misinformation highlight trust issues; China CDC requests 21-day self-monitoring for travelers from risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: 疑似病例大幅増加，非洲多國加強埃博拉病毒防控
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模アウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、高い死亡率、国際的な対応が進行中。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク。DRCのイツリ州とカサイ地域を中心に83確認例、746疑似例。ウガンダで5例。WHO、アフリカCDC、国連が高レベルの対応を実施中。記事では複数国（アンゴラ、ブルンジ等）への拡大リスクが指摘されているが、確認された感染例は対象国ではDRCとザンビア（警告地域のみ）に限定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Plus de 900 cas suspects détectés en RDC, où la surveillance s'intensifie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - More than 900 suspected cases detected in the DRC, where surveillance is intensifying.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 confirmed, are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 25, 2026, as surveillance intensifies. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus is implicated, triggering Ebola in Ituri province, a northeastern area bordering Uganda and South Sudan. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figures on X. Ituri, one of the country’s most troubled provinces, is home to nearly five million people living amid an ongoing conflict. Violence is forcing health teams to flee, and the region’s poor road networks hinder intensive contact tracing and early infection identification, complicating outbreak control and patient care. The prior tallies stood at 867 suspected (750 a day earlier), underscoring rapid case assessment and reporting challenges in this security-compromised setting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - RDCで900例以上の疑似症例が検出、監視が強化されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。確認例101例を含む900例以上の疑似症例、Bundibugyo ebolavirus、紛争地域での管理困難さ、WHOによる公式発表から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州）を主要発生地として述べており、ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境近接性は提及されるが、これらの国での確認例の記載はない。したがってDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。紛争下での感染制御困難性、WHOの公式発表、急速な症例増加（867→900+）が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 900 cas suspects en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 900 suspected cases in the DRC
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), including 101 confirmed cases, with 204 deaths among 867 suspected per the latest health ministry update. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, with a case fatality rate up to 50%. The World Health Organization (WHO) has triggered an international health alert. Counts reflect intensified surveillance as of May 25, 2026. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with mortality estimates ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: DRCで900件以上の疑似症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべてで満たす。エボラウイルス病による大規模集団発生で、確認症例101件、死亡204件、Bundibugyo型ワクチン・特異的治療なし。WHOが国際保健警報を発令。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたDRCでのエボラウイルス病大規模集団発生。Bundibugyo ebolavirus型で、致命率最大50%、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。WHO国際保健警報発令済み。フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Red Cross volunteers die from suspected Ebola in DR Congo - The Ghanaian Chronicle
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo died from suspected Ebola likely contracted on 27 March while handling dead bodies in Mongwalu, Ituri province, now an epicentre of the outbreak. As of 25 May 2026, the DR Congo outbreak has >200 suspected deaths and >850 suspected cases. The volunteers—Alikana Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo and Ajiko Chandiru Viviane—died between 5 and 16 May. Ebola transmission can occur via infectious bodily fluids after death. The outbreak involves the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, which has no proven vaccine and kills about a third of those infected. The World Health Organization raised the public health risk level from high to very high in DR Congo. This incident underscores ongoing transmission and risks facing frontline responders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱により赤十字ボランティアが死亡 - ガーナ・クロニクル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱による死亡・重症例（深刻な公衆衛生影響）、200名以上の死亡・850名以上の疑い患者（異常・重度の重症度）、国際的拡大リスク（WHOが非常に高いレベルに指定）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性あり。WPRO基準も5項目すべて該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain、ワクチン未開発、致命率約33%。WHOが公衆衛生リスクレベルを高から非常に高に引き上げ。前線対応職員への継続的リスク。2026年5月25日時点で200名以上の死亡、850名以上の疑い患者。

article.articleHeadline: 'الصحة العالمية': أكثر من 900 حالة اشتباه إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'World Health Organization': More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, which WHO has previously designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and the national risk in the DRC is described as very high. Delayed case detection, the absence of vaccines or specific therapies for the virus, ongoing armed conflict, and high population mobility are cited as factors heightening the threat. The situation underscores ongoing danger and the need for enhanced surveillance and response as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い症例900件超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で、WHO公式報告による確定患者多数、稀少株（Bundibugyo）による重篤な国際的健康脅威であり、フルRRA実施必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による大規模集団発生。WHO既報の国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）。確定患者101名を含む疑い患者900名超。武装紛争、ワクチン/特異的治療薬の欠如、高い人口移動性などリスク要因多数。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 视频｜非政府组织警告：不应低估埃博拉疫情严重程度
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: NGOs warn not to underestimate the severity of the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri Province continues to worsen. Official data show suspected Ebola cases exceed 860 nationwide, with Bunia airport in Ituri suspending all passenger flights. On May 24, MSF emergency coordinator Florent Uzzeni warned the outbreak is unusually severe, reporting over 700 suspected cases in Ituri. The spread extends across multiple districts in a densely populated urban center, complicating containment. Testing capacity is extremely limited, data are sparse, and many people stay within communities as isolation wards fill; consequently, people are not seeking hospital care, and the true scale of infection is likely undercounted. The article underscores ongoing, major transmission driven by high mobility and urban density, and provides no details on laboratory-confirmed counts, deaths, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ビデオ｜非政府組織が警告：エボラ疫情の深刻さを過小評価すべきではない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRCのエボラ発生は国際的関心が高く、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州でのエボラ発生。疑い例860例以上、Ituri州では700例以上。検査能力が極度に限定的で実際の感染規模は過小報告されている可能性が高い。都市密集地での多地区への広がりと高い移動性により封じ込めが困難。MSFを含むNGOが深刻度を警告。Bunia空港の旅客便停止により地域的な移動制限が生じている。

article.articleHeadline: My experience working on the Ebola epidemic in Liberia
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda is linked to Bundibugyo virus disease, with more than 500 suspected cases and 130 deaths; no approved vaccines or specific therapeutics. WHO has not classified it as a pandemic emergency, but neighbouring countries remain at high risk. The West Africa 2013–2016 outbreak, the largest in history, primarily affected Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone, recording 28,616 infections and 11,310 deaths (≈40% CFR). In Liberia, the MoD1 Ebola Treatment Unit in Monrovia initially saw mortality >80%, later ~52% after infection-control improvements, intravenous fluids, potassium supplementation, and more frequent rounds. A rural Sinoe County cluster involved five family infections; one child remained uninfected. A rapid mini-ETU in Greenville, aided by MSB, improved isolation and care. Lessons emphasize faster international response and stronger local readiness. As of 2026-05-25.

triage.headline_ja: リベリアでのエボラ流行への対応経験
triage.triage_reason: 記事は過去の西アフリカ2013-2016年のエボラ流行と現在のDRC・ウガンダの発生に関する回顧的な論評であり、現在進行中のイベントは対象国内での新規発生ではなく、歴史的記録と地域的背景情報の提供である。ただしDRCでの現在の発生が言及されているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にリベリア・シエラレオネ・ギニアの過去のエボラ流行についての回顧的論評ですが、冒頭でDRCとウガンダの現在の発生（500+疑似症例、130死亡、Bundibugyo virus）が言及されています。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めました。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外しました。記事の主な焦点が過去の流行のため PICKUP ではなく WATCH と判定しましたが、DRCでの現在進行中の発生情報の続報を注視する必要があります。

article.articleHeadline: Violent Protests Erupt at Congo Hospital Over Ebola Victim's Body - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: On May 24, 2026, an angry mob stormed an Ebola treatment center in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, after a dispute over releasing the body of a relative who died from suspected Ebola; part of the facility was set on fire. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with eight laboratory-confirmed cases, 246 suspected cases, and 80 suspected deaths since May 16. The WHO declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 due to risk of regional spread; spread has been noted in population centers including Bunia, Rwampara, and Mongbwalu. As of May 24, no licensed vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus; response relies on supportive care, contact tracing, and community engagement. The arson may delay containment and damage infrastructure; authorities have not confirmed extent of damage or whether confirmed cases were housed there. DRC and Uganda have intensified containment and emphasize rebuilding trust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの病院でエボラ犠牲者の遺体をめぐる暴力的な抗議が発生
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の集団発生（Bundibugyo ebolavirus、確定例8例、疑い例246例、疑い死亡80例）であり、WHOが5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。地域的な拡大リスクが明示されている。
triage.notes: WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による集団発生であり、複数の人口密集地（Bunia、Rwampara、Mongbwalu）での拡大が確認されている。病院施設への放火による消火活動が公衆衛生対応に悪影響を与える可能性が懸念される。記事ではウガンダとの関連性が言及されているが、主要なイベント発生地はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: plus de 900 cas suspects en RDC, selon l'OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: more than 900 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared on May 15 an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no vaccine or specific treatment available for this strain. More than 900 people are suspected to have contracted Ebola virus disease in the DRC, according to the World Health Organization. The report notes the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for Bundibugyo and indicates ongoing concern about transmission within the country. No further details on confirmed cases or fatalities are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOによるとDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）で900人以上の疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による900人以上の疑い患者報告は重大なシグナルであり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は特異的な医療対策（ワクチン・治療薬）が利用不可という点で特に懸念される。5月15日の公式宣言から10日経過した時点で900人超の疑い患者報告は急速な感染拡大を示唆。確認患者数・死亡者数の詳細情報が不足しているため、続報による更新が必須。

article.articleHeadline: FAAN Strenghtens Ebola Preparedness Measures Across Nation's Airports
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) preparedness has been strengthened across Nigeria's airports, led by the Federal Airports Authority of Nigeria (FAAN) in collaboration with health and safety agencies. At a workshop at Murtala Muhammed International Airport, Lagos, officials reviewed preparedness strategies, response mechanisms, and containment procedures to safeguard public health and prevent an outbreak. Port Health Services (PHS) reports intensified surveillance at international entry points, with emphasis on passengers arriving from high-risk countries, including the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, plus neighboring affected regions. Advanced screening and monitoring are in operation: active temperature checks, health monitoring protocols, and deployment of QR code scanners to capture health declarations and enable follow-up. Stakeholders urged cross-agency collaboration for rapid detection, reporting, and response to suspected Ebola cases. Medical experts note common EVD symptoms: fever, unexplained bleeding, weight loss.

triage.headline_ja: FAAN、全国の空港でエボラ対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスに関する高度な公衆衛生関心事であるが、記事は予防的準備活動の報告であり、実際の患者発生や確認例の報告ではない。ナイジェリアでの preparedness 強化が主題だが、DRCおよびウガンダからの脅威に対応する監視体制の構築が述べられている。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアでのエボラ preparedness 強化に焦点を当てているが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは対象国として verified_locations に含められた。記事は実際の患者発生を報告していなく、予防的対応と監視体制の整備に関する内容である。DRCおよびウガンダからの脅威に対する懸念に基づく準備が述べられている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO says 900 suspected Ebola cases found in DR Congo, 101 confirmed so far - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. As of 25 May 2026, WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said enhanced surveillance identified more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 confirmed to date. The health ministry had previously reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces; no new death toll update was provided in the latest briefing. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The outbreak centers in a conflict-affected region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo, highlighting ongoing challenges for surveillance and response in the country.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国で900件の疑似エボラ患者を報告、101件の確認例 - CNBC TV18
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な大規模発生、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全5つ該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高リスク病原体であり、確認例と疑似例の急増は即座のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（承認されたワクチン・治療法なし）による大規模発生。疑似例900件のうち確認例101件、死亡204件の報告。紛争地域での発生により対応・監視体制の脆弱性が懸念される。即座のRRA実施および国際的な対応体制の確立が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Indonesia bolsters precautions for citizens in Africa amid Ebola outbreak - Middle East and Africa - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts Indonesia to bolster precautions for its citizens in Africa. The Foreign Ministry issues advisories urging hygiene and health surveillance for Indonesians in DRC (270) and Uganda (13). Indonesian missions coordinate with local health authorities and monitor developments, with the embassy in Nairobi tracking updates from Africa CDC via honorary consuls in the two countries. No Indonesian nationals have been infected in DRC or Uganda as of Sunday afternoon, 2026-05-25, though repatriation plans remain available if conditions worsen, with evacuations contingent on on-the-ground conditions and needs of Indonesians in affected areas. The measures reflect ongoing concern over a deadly Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ流行の中、インドネシアがアフリカの市民のための予防措置を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行（DRC・ウガンダ）は致死的で、国際的拡大のリスクがあり、複数国での対応が開始されている。IHR基準3項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ流行はDRC（270人のインドネシア国民）およびウガンダ（13人）で報告されている。Bluedot APIはナイロビ、インドネシア、ケニアも記載していますが、サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの流行であり、インドネシアは流行国ではなく対応国、ケニアはアフリカCDC経由の情報追跡地点です。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: UNFPA Flash Update - Ebola Outbreak in Ituri, DRC (14 - 19 May 2026)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared 15 May 2026 in the DRC, spreading to Mongbwalu, Rwanpara and Bunia in Ituri Province, and Butembo and Goma in North Kivu, with 516 suspected cases and 131 deaths. In neighboring Uganda, two cases (one death) have been confirmed by the Ministry of Health. On 17 May, the WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. All Ebola cases reported at Bunia Centre Medical Evangelique Nyakunde are frontline health professionals; four health workers died within four days, signaling infection prevention gaps and facility transmission risk. The outbreak threatens sexual and reproductive health, risking nosocomial infection for pregnant women, newborns, and maternal care providers, and potentially reducing access to life-saving services. UNFPA is adapting programming in Ituri (10 zones, 443,278 served) to align with the national Ebola response, prioritizing IPC, emergency obstetric and neonatal care, risk communication, stigma reduction, and protection against gender-based violence.

triage.headline_ja: UNFPA Flash Update - DRCのイトゥリ州でのエボラ流行（2026年5月14-19日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WHOがPHEIC宣言を行っている。ウガンダでの確認例を含む国際拡大が既に開始している。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州・北キブ州での多地域流行（516疑似症例、131死亡）。ウガンダへの越境拡大を確認（2例、1死亡）。WHO PHEC宣言（2026年5月17日）。医療従事者への集積感染と院内感染リスクが顕著。DRCが対象国リストに含まれており、隣国ウガンダ（非対象国）での拡大も報告されている。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: ما عدد الإصابات المحتملة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو؟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is the number of suspected Ebola virus cases in the Congo?
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said suspected Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 900, with 101 confirmed. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province, a population of about 5 million, where around a quarter are in humanitarian need and roughly 20% have left their homes. Ongoing armed conflict across parts of the DRC is hindering contact tracing and early detection of cases. The first Ebola infection in this outbreak was detected on 24 April, with authorities linking transmission to miners in the area. On 17 May, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the DRC and neighboring Uganda, as reported by Russia Today.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラウイルスの疑い例の数は？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準5つすべてに該当。WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、国際的関心も極めて高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事に隣接国として言及されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言で言及しているが、記事サマリーでは実際の感染例はDRCのみで報告されている。DRCのイトゥリ州での発生が中心。4月24日以降の新規発生であり、武装紛争により接触追跡が阻害されている。スクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当することから、極めて高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases since the outbreak began, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. Suspected deaths are 119 (down from 204), while 10 Ebola deaths have been laboratory confirmed. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. In Uganda, five confirmed cases are linked to the eastern Congo outbreak; Uganda does not publish suspected-case numbers. The World Health Organization says the true case load is likely higher due to weeks of under-detection and clusters of unexplained deaths. The current Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or specific treatment, hindering containment. WHO rates the risk as very high in Congo, high regionally, and low globally; Ebola spreads through close contact with infected bodily fluids, not via airborne droplets.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが900件以上のエボラ疑い例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。確認死亡者10名、疑い例904名、ウガンダへの越境感染5例確認。WHOが非常に高リスク評価。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダの越境感染5例の報告に留まり、ウガンダでの主要な発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの主要発症地はIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu。ワクチン・特異的治療なし。WHO評価：コンゴ内で非常に高リスク、地域で高リスク、世界的には低リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Nguy cơ Ebola xâm nhập Việt Nam thấp nhưng không thể chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The risk of Ebola entering Vietnam is low, but we must not be complacent.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces a low risk of Ebola importation but vigilance is essential. Ebola transmits mainly through contact with blood, secretions, or deceased patients, and risk of spread is reduced by strict personal protective equipment and infection-control practices. COVID-19 spreads via respiratory droplets and aerosols. Health authorities urge the public not to panic but to avoid close contact with suspected cases or body fluids, practice hand hygiene, and monitor travelers returning from outbreak zones. The Health Ministry’s directive requires facilities to strengthen Ebola preparedness amid rising regional risk. Ebola is a severe acute hemorrhagic fever with high fatality, up to 90%. WHO reported 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths in Congo and Uganda from May 5–20, with more than 50 confirmed Bundibugyo infections; on May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a public health emergency of international concern. Vietnam calls for surveillance, screening, isolation, lab testing, PPE readiness, and 21-day post-travel measures.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムへのエボラ流入リスクは低いが、油断は禁物
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ多国家アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）の流入リスク評価であり、ベトナムが公式に警戒態勢を強化している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC・ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク（WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言）と、ベトナムの流入リスク評価を扱っている。Uganda（226074）はBluedotで検出されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。600疑い例、139死亡、50以上確認例（Bundibugyo）が報告されており、致死率最大90%と記載。ベトナムは厳格な監視、スクリーニング、隔離、検査、PPE準備、21日間の渡航後対策を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 900 ca nghi nhiễm Ebola ở Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases and 119 suspected deaths, with over 700 suspected cases concentrated in Ituri province. The World Health Organization deems the outbreak's global risk as low but the national risk as very high for the DRC. Health authorities face severe challenges, including attacks on Ebola treatment centers in eastern Congo, large-scale displacement, weak local governance, and reduced international aid. Burial practices conflict with strict funeral protocols for suspected cases, contributing to transmission. MSF notes deteriorating security around Ituri, prompting healthcare worker departures and overwhelmed facilities. The UN reports nearly 1 million people displaced by conflict in Ituri. Aid groups warn of shortages of PPE, testing kits, body bags, and burial supplies. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving the outbreak currently has no approved vaccine or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全てに該当。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした大規模エボラ発生。904件の疑い症例、119件の疑い死亡（致死率推定13%）。BundibugyoウイルスはVariant of Concern。治安悪化に伴う医療崩壊、PPE/検査キット不足、約100万人の国内避難民がいる。WHOは全球的リスクは低いが、DRCの国家リスクは「非常に高い」と評価。国際的支援が切実に必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Virus: WHO meldet mehr als 900 Verdachtsfälle in der DR Kongo - WELT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases in DR Congo - WELT
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda continues to accelerate. More than 900 suspected cases have been registered, including 101 confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The WHO has raised the risk of national spread in the DRC to 'very high' and regional risk to 'high', with global risk remaining 'low'. There is no established therapy for the current Ebola virus strain. The outbreak remains centered in the DRC, with new infections reported in Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. These figures underscore the need for intensified surveillance, containment measures, and rapid public health response in affected and neighboring regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：WHOがコンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑い患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。大規模エボラ流行の初期段階で、国家レベルの拡大リスク「非常に高い」、地域レベルのリスク「高い」と評価されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に相当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダも言及されているが、発生地域リストに含まれているウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。900件超の疑い患者、101件の確定患者、有効な治療法がない現在のエボラウイルス株、国家レベルのリスク評価が「非常に高い」等から、早急なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: International passengers to be screened for Ebola at airports
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-25, Andhra Pradesh will screen international travelers for Ebola at Visakhapatnam, Tirupati and Vijayawada airports amid rising cases in Congo, Uganda and South Sudan and WHO advisories. Passengers from Congo and Uganda will undergo medical screening based on travel history; anyone with Ebola symptoms will be quarantined, and contacts examined. Visakhapatnam Port and road entries will be monitored. Special isolation wards with 15 beds are being established in teaching hospitals near international airports. PPE and Ebola testing kits are stocked. Virtual awareness meetings are underway for health staff. Union government advisories urge avoiding non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Those who recently returned from affected countries and feel unwell should inform district authorities promptly. Ebola (Bundibugyo) virus symptoms include fever, severe weakness, intense headache, sore throat, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, red eyes and loss of appetite.

triage.headline_ja: 国際線旅客を対象とした空港でのエボラウイルス検査実施へ
triage.triage_reason: インドで開始されたエボラウイルスの国際旅客スクリーニングは、コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ症例増加への対応であり、IHR基準（国際拡大リスク、異常性）、WPROスクリーニング基準（管理可能性への対応、予想外の防疫体制整備）に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーに示されている「コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンでの症例増加」への対応としてインドが空港スクリーニングを実施しているイベントであり、実際の発生地域はアフリカ（コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはインドとDRCのみ。記事の主体は「インドの防疫対応」であるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。DRCは対象国に含まれるが、本記事ではインドの検査体制に焦点が当たっており、DRC内での新規発症報告ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό σύμφωνα με ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 lab-confirmed to date, according to the World Health Organization. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance is intensified and the tally includes 867 suspected cases, among which 204 have died per the latest Ministry of Health report. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is linked to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or therapies, with a case fatality around 50%. In response, the WHO has proclaimed a Public Health Emergency of International Concern to strengthen international coordination. The Ebola virus has caused at least 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past fifty years, with a global case fatality range of 25–90% according to the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑わしい症例が900件以上、WHOによると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス（致死率50%）の大規模アウトブレイクで、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。国際的調整強化が必要とされている。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株によるエボラアウトブレイク。5月15日に宣言され、既に204死亡が報告されている。ワクチン・治療法がない株種。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。対象国リストにDRCは含まれるが、この記事はアフリカ全域に関連する重大な国際的シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases reported in Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, 101 confirmed, and 119 suspected deaths (down from 204); 10 laboratory-confirmed deaths. Outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In neighboring Uganda, five confirmed cases are linked to the eastern Congo outbreak; Uganda does not publish suspected-case figures. WHO cautions that true case numbers are likely higher, noting the outbreak went under-reported for weeks and clusters of unexplained deaths were investigated. Security incidents hinder response, including an attack on Monbgwalu General Hospital in Mongbwalu that forced evacuations; 18 suspected cases fled. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain involved has no vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact with bodily fluids, not by airborne spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑似症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR 4基準中4つ全て該当。WHO が国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、DRC およびウガンダで確認症例が報告されている。高い死亡率と国境を越えた伝播が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダの確認症例を提及しているが、主題はDRC での発生であり、ウガンダはリンク症例のみで対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。WHO による PHEIC 宣言、Bundibugyo 株、セキュリティインシデント、ワクチン・特異的治療の不在など、複数の重大な懸念要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о более 900 предполагаемых случаях Эболы в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Ituri Province, housing 5 million people, is the outbreak epicenter where humanitarian needs are acute and 20% are internally displaced. Violence hampers movement and complicates contact tracing and early detection. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in DRC and Uganda; on May 22, the DRC risk level rose from high to very high. The outbreak is caused by a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or specific treatments; prior outbreaks of this strain occurred in Uganda (2000) and DRC (2012). Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Sudan and DRC; transmission is via close contact with bodily fluids, with symptoms including fever, weakness, muscle pains, headache, and in later stages vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス疑い症例が900件以上と報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで国際的に重大な懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主体はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ勃発であり、UgandaおよびSudanは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー上での詳細記述はDRCに集中している。ウガンダは2026年5月17日のPHEIC宣言対象に含まれているが、サマリーには詳細な流行状況が記載されていない。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOのPHEIC宣言、リスク評価上昇、治療法ワクチン不在、暴力による対応困難など複数の重大要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Congo: Khu điều trị bệnh nhân Ebola bị phóng hỏa, 18 ca nghi nhiễm bỏ trốn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola treatment unit set on fire, 18 suspected cases escaped.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no vaccine. On May 22, an Ebola treatment tent in Mongbwalu was set on fire, enabling 18 suspected cases to escape into the community amid attacks on care facilities; a second treatment center in Rwampara was burned the previous day after funeral arrangements were blocked. The ongoing situation has Mongbwalu as a disease epicenter, with broader surveillance showing 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, alongside 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths. Authorities have banned funeral vigils and gatherings over 50 people to curb transmission. The World Health Organization elevated Congo’s outbreak risk to “very high,” though global risk remains low. Three Red Cross/Red Crescent volunteers died, potentially from handling bodies during a March humanitarian mission not directly tied to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ患者治療施設が放火され、18例の疑い患者が逃亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響（750疑い例、177死亡）、稀なBundibugyo型の出現で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、およびWHO「極めて高いリスク」判定により国際的関心と規制リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）の稀な株、治療施設への攻撃と患者逃亡による感染拡大の懸念、WHO「極めて高いリスク」判定。ルワンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴが主題であり、ルワンダでの実際の患者発生は記述されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 视频｜非政府组织警告：不应低估埃博拉疫情严重程度-国际在线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video | NGOs warn: The Ebola outbreak's severity should not be underestimated - International Online
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province, centered on Bunia, is worsening. Official data show more than 860 suspected Ebola cases nationwide, with Ituri reporting over 700 suspected cases by May 24. Bunia’s airport has halted all passenger flights. MSF emergency coordinator Florent Uzzeni warns the outbreak is unprecedented in scale, spreading across multiple districts in a highly mobile region and affecting a city with hundreds of thousands of residents. Testing capacity remains extremely limited and data are incomplete. Many people stay within the community as isolation wards fill, and hospital-seeking behavior has diminished, leading to likely undercounting of cases. The situation indicates a severe outbreak with substantial public health risk and significant challenges in surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: 動画｜非政府組織が警告：エボラ疫情の重大性を過小評価してはならない - 国際オンライン
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、860件以上の疑似患者、高い致死率、多地域への拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限（空港閉鎖）が明確に存在する。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州ブニアを中心とした大規模エボラウイルス疾患アウトブレイク。疑似患者860例以上、検査能力の極度の限定、サーベイランスデータの不完全性、病院での隔離態勢の不足が指摘されている。MSFコーディネーターによる警告も社会的関心を高めている。フルRRA進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго са идентифицирани вече над 900 предполагаеми случая на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, more than 900 suspected cases of Ebola have already been identified.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo faces a new Ebola outbreak. By May 25, 2026, authorities identified over 900 suspected Ebola cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as the outbreak began in late April. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of rapid transmission and a major threat; on May 22, 2026, he reported 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, but cautioned that the true toll was likely higher. Epidemiological surveillance has been expanded, with reports of nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. On May 17, 2026, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Democratic Republic of Congo remains the affected country, with ongoing efforts to confirm cases and assess the scale of transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例900件以上が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) を宣言した確認済みの感染症危機であり、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: WHO による PHEIC 宣言済み。疑い例900件以上、確認例101件、死亡7件（報告時点）。エボラウイルスは最高レベルのバイオセキュリティリスク病原体。国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: 皮肤破损别接触海水与生海鲜！这种病菌一旦感染或致命
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: If you have broken skin, do not touch seawater or raw seafood. This pathogen can be fatal if contracted.
article.articleSummary: An elderly patient handling seafood sustained a finger puncture from a fish spine; within a day he developed a severe Vibrio vulnificus infection with heart failure. Vibrio vulnificus is a halophilic, heat-loving marine pathogen that colonizes the surfaces of fish, shrimp, crabs, and shellfish. If untreated, infections progress rapidly and can be fatal. The infection is rare, in the single digits per 100,000 people, but once established it can quickly progress to sepsis. High-risk groups include patients with alcoholic liver disease or cirrhosis, diabetes, immune suppression, chronic kidney disease, and long-term acid-suppressant use. Summer heat raises risk. Prevention: wear protective gloves when handling seafood; avoid contact of broken skin with seawater or raw seafood; do not eat raw seafood. If a wound is contaminated, rinse with running water, disinfect with iodine, monitor, and seek urgent care for redness, swelling, fever, or worsening pain. Beijing Ditan Hospital, Capital Medical University.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚に傷がある場合は海水と生の海産物に接触しないこと！この病菌に一度感染すると致命的になる可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症は稀だが致死的な可能性がある病原体であり、中国で報告された単一症例である。IHR基準は該当しないが、予防啓発と高リスク群特定の観点からWPRO基準の異常性と重症度に該当する。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事は単一の高齢患者の症例報告であり、集団発生ではない。ビブリオ・バルニフィカスは海洋環境に自然に存在する病原体で、中国の公式保健メディア（People's Daily Health）による予防啓発記事。流行の兆候はないが、高リスク群（肝硬変、糖尿病、免疫抑制患者）への喚起と季節的リスクに関する情報として記録価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉破900例！民主剛果爆縱火搶遺體　民眾堅信「病毒是騙局」 | 國際 | 三立新聞網  SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola surpasses 900 cases! Arson and the looting of corpses erupt in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as locals insist "the virus is a hoax" | International | SETN.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, concentrated in Ituri Province, has surpassed 900 suspected cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections.
