To prevent transmission during traditional funerals, authorities have imposed strict burial protocols, triggering anger that has included arson and looting of corpses as residents attempt to reclaim loved ones. Ituri's roughly 5 million residents face severe humanitarian needs; about one in four people require aid and one in five are displaced. Ongoing violence and insecurity hamper the response, forcing health workers and humanitarian teams to flee. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reiterated the scale of the outbreak on Facebook and underscored distrust in prevention efforts. Some locals, including a mother who insists her son died of a cold, reject the virus as a hoax, highlighting broader misinformation about Ebola in remote areas per BBC reporting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが900例を超える！民主共和国でコンクリート火災と遺体略奪が発生、住民は「ウイルスはデマ」と主張
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の明らかな拡大（900例超、実験室確認101例）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、社会不安と対応の障害（暴動、遺体略奪、医療従事者逃亡）を示すIHR基準3つ以上該当し、WPRO基準全項目でYes該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月時点のイベントであり、エボラウイルスの活動的な流行。社会不安（住民による遺体略奪、暴動）、医療対応の破綻（医療従事者の逃亡）、偽情報拡散がリスク要因。WHO総長による公式発表あり。イトゥリ州約500万人が影響を受け、約25%が援助を必要としている深刻な人道危機。

article.articleHeadline: Dread and denial at heart of deadly Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, is characterized by fear and denial. Laureine Sakiya believes the blood-letting virus exists after neighbors’ deaths, while many residents in the outbreak’s epicenter doubt the disease’s very existence. The piece highlights distrust toward the Congolese state amid decades of neglect and conflict, with criticism of the government’s response shaping public perception. Mongbwalu sits in a mineral-rich, conflict-torn area, roughly 100 km from Uganda and 200 km from South Sudan, illustrating cross-border proximity and regional instability. The article foregrounds social and political dynamics surrounding the outbreak rather than clinical details, and does not provide specific case counts or symptoms in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ熱大流行の中心にある恐怖と否定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダン接近）、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性を呈しており、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州ムングバワルでのエボラ熱流行を扱っており、社会的・政治的側面と住民の不信が強調されている。発生地域フィールドにウガンダと南スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国に限定されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。ウガンダ（1269750リスト外）および南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 確診飆升！伊波拉蔓延民主剛果 譚德塞：發現逾900疑似病例 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed cases surge! Ebola spreads in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Tedros: More than 900 suspected cases found.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reports more than 900 suspected EVD cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. As of 24 May, health authorities record 204 deaths across three provinces. The response is hampered by severe armed conflict in Ituri, forcing displacement and hindering contact tracing, early case confirmation, and delivery of care. WHO had previously declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The article provides no details on transmission sources or vaccination status, and does not specify imported/exported cases. The situation underscores the need for rapid epidemiologic surveillance, safe patient management, and humanitarian access to affected populations.

triage.headline_ja: 確診飆升！伊波拉蔓延民主剛果 譚德塞：發現逾900疑似病例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが既にPHEICを宣言しているエボラウイルス病の大規模流行。900人超の疑似患者、204人の死亡、複数州での蔓延、国際的拡大リスク、武力紛争による対応阻害がシグナル特性として明確。
triage.notes: WHOがすでにPHEICを宣言している既知の流行。武力紛争による医療対応の著しい阻害が管理可能性を低下させている。複数州（イトゥリ州を中心）での拡大が確認され、接触者追跡と早期確認が困難な状況。国際的な人道支援と疫学的監視体制の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: رصدنا أكثر من 900 حالة اشتباه إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: We have detected more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases in Ituri Province. Ituri, about 5 million people, has roughly 25% in need of humanitarian assistance and around 20% displaced. The latest official tally shows more than 867 suspected cases and over 200 deaths. WHO has raised the public health risk level from high to very high. The outbreak remains active in the DRC, particularly Ituri, underscoring the urgent need for intensified outbreak control and humanitarian support in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の疑い患者900人以上を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクは国際的に重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致命率と国際的な拡大リスクを有する病原体。2026年5月現在、DRC・イトゥリ州で900人以上の疑い患者、101人の確定患者、200人以上の死亡が報告されており、WHO公式リスク評価が『高』から『非常に高』に引き上げられている。アウトブレイク継続中であり、人道支援が必要な状況。対象国DRCで発生しているため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國伊波拉疫情告急　疑似病例破900大關且無藥可醫 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in dire straits; suspected cases exceed 900 and there is no cure.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in dire straits, with suspected cases topping 900 and 101 laboratory-confirmed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the virus, identified as the Bundibugyo strain, has spread in the war-torn region, complicating response. There is currently no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Three provinces have reported a total of 204 deaths so far. The outbreak was announced on May 15, with international medical teams assisting the government to contain spread through isolation and contact tracing, amid limited healthcare capacity and ongoing conflict. As monitoring expands, health authorities emphasize the need for rapid detection and containment to prevent further transmission; the global public health risk remains high.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱疫情が逼迫　疑い患者が900を超え治療法がない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認患者（101例）と疑い患者（900例以上）、死亡者（204名）を報告する大規模疫学的事象であり、国際的拡大リスクが高く、WHOも関与している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模疫学的事象。疑い患者900例以上、確認患者101例、死亡者204名。ワクチン・治療法がなく、紛争地域での対応は複雑化。WHO事務局長が懸念を表明。国際医療チームが対応支援中。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: RDC y la OMS elevan a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola y a más de 100 los confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC and WHO raise the number of suspected Ebola cases to more than 900 and the number of confirmed cases to more than 100
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases and over 100 confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) from an outbreak in the northeast, centered in Ituri with spillover to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of May 23, DRC health authorities reported 101 confirmed and 904 suspected cases across 11 health zones, with 119 deaths suspected and 10 confirmed. Africa CDC tallies higher figures, estimating 204 suspected Ebola deaths across DRC and neighbouring Uganda. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which no vaccines or approved antibody therapies exist. Ituri is the epicenter, where nearly five million people live amid ongoing conflict; about one in four people need humanitarian aid and one in five are internally displaced. Violence hampers contact tracing and timely care, though WHO and partners maintain presence and stress a holistic health package to bolster response and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とWHOがエボラ疑い症例を900以上に、確認症例を100以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の稀少ウイルス株、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。確認症例100以上、死亡数も多く、ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo ebolavirus であり、人道的危機下での急速な拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: DRC で発生した Ebola 蔓延。ウガンダは Bluedot の発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では Africa CDC が「DRC and neighbouring Uganda」において推定死亡数を集計していることが言及されているのみで、ウガンダでの確認症例については明記されていない。したがって verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀少株であり、ワクチン・認可抗体療法が存在しないことが重大なリスク要因。紛争下での接触者追跡困難も懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Việt Nam ramps up surveillance, triage for suspected Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: Việt Nam's Ministry of Health issued an urgent directive to heighten Ebola prevention and control amid fears the virus could enter the country. Facilities must screen arrivals from outbreak countries within 21 days, tighten infection control, and quickly triage and isolate suspected or confirmed cases with testing and treatment coordinated under ministry guidelines. Hospitals should review protective gear stocks, ensure isolation capacity, and bolster diagnostic readiness. Ebola is a severe infectious disease with hemorrhagic symptoms and multi-organ failure; fatality can reach 90%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with tissues, blood, or bodily fluids, and through contaminated items. As of May 21, 85 confirmed cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with 10 confirmed deaths; DRC reported 746 suspected cases and 176 suspected deaths. WHO rates outbreak risk in DRC and Uganda as very high, Africa high, globally low; emphasis on surveillance, contact tracing, isolation capacity, and cross-border coordination.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、疑いエボラ症例への監視・トリアージを強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク（DRC・ウガンダでの多数の確定例と死亡、ベトナムでの検疫強化指示）が明示されており、IHR基準2つ以上（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）および社会的・政治的関心が確認される。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアフリカ大陸全体とウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの発生、およびベトナムの対応強化である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、対象国はベトナムとDRCのみを verified_locations に登録した。複数国での同時エボラ確定例（DRC 85例、ウガンダからの報告）、致死率最大90%、WHO による地域リスク評価「very high」が記載されており、IHR基準4項目全て該当、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当する。

article.articleHeadline: All Filipino crew members of MV Hondius negative for hantavirus
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, all 38 Filipino crew members of the hantavirus-hit MV Hondius, quarantined in the Netherlands, tested negative for hantavirus and remain asymptomatic. They will stay under quarantine until June 18 while Dutch health authorities review their status for clearance, per the Department of Migrant Workers (DMW). DMW Secretary Hans Leo Cacdac said the mood is positive and that the crew continues to be closely monitored. The World Health Organization had previously confirmed two hantavirus cases aboard the MV Hondius and three related deaths. Hantavirus causes flu-like symptoms and can resemble dengue fever; there are currently no vaccines or specific treatments. The update underscores ongoing international health oversight and coordination between the Philippine DMW, DOH, and Dutch authorities.

triage.headline_ja: MV Hondius船のフィリピン人乗組員全員がハンタウイルス陰性
triage.triage_reason: 国際的な感染症イベント（複数国での隔離・監視）であり、WHOも関与しているが、フィリピン人乗組員の検査結果は陰性で事態は鎮静化している。継続的な監視の必要性がある一方、現在の懸念レベルはフルRRA開始の閾値には達していない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はフィリピン人乗組員の検査結果であり、Netherlands（オランダ）は隔離地点として言及されているが、ハンタウイルスイベント自体の発生地はMV Hondius船上（国際水域）。Philippinesは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に記載。現在、陰性結果が出ているため緊急性は低減しているが、WHOが関与し複数国間の調整が必要なため、継続的な監視が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo is confronting an Ebola outbreak. As of May 25, 2026, more than 900 people are suspected to be infected, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases. The latest health ministry tally reports 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing epidemic. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is attributed to the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, a rarer variant with no vaccines or therapies and a case-fatality rate up to about 50%. The WHO director-general announced intensified surveillance and a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola, which causes hemorrhagic fever, has claimed at least 15,000 lives in Africa over the past five decades, with fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90%, according to WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い例が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的懸念、および国際保健機関による公式な国際懸念宣言を示している。WPRO基準も全項目で該当し、シグナルとして迅速なRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 公式なPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言により、WHO総長が国際的な懸念を正式に表明。Bundibugyo株は稀有な変異体で、利用可能なワクチンや治療法がなく、致死率約50%。900人以上の疑い例と204人の死亡が報告されており、極めて高い優先度でRRA進行が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Молодики штурмували лікарню в Конго та вимагали видати тіла померлих від Еболи | УНН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young men stormed a hospital in Congo and demanded the bodies of Ebola victims.
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a group of young men stormed Monbgvalu General Hospital on the evening of May 24, 2026, where Ebola patients are treated, demanding the bodies of relatives who died from the disease. Hospital director Richard Lokudu said shooting was heard during the assault, prompting urgent evacuation of patients and staff. The incident marks the third attack on healthcare facilities in the region in the past week amid a new Ebola outbreak. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, underscoring security and resource challenges. Doctors warn that Ebola corpses remain highly infectious and can spark new transmissions during funerals, so burial procedures are tightly controlled. In Congo, Ebola case numbers have risen sharply due to shortages of vaccines and medical equipment, with the outbreak centered in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの若者がエボラ患者を扱う病院に押し入り、エボラで亡くなった親族の遺体の引き渡しを要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言したエボラ流行中の医療施設への複数回の攻撃であり、セキュリティ・リソース課題による感染症制御の悪化が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国東部のエボラ流行中における医療施設への暴力的な攻撃を報道。WHO PHEC宣言済みの同地域での、ワクチン・医療機器不足による深刻な公衆衛生危機と、セキュリティ上の課題が感染症制御を阻害している状況が示唆されている。遺体からの感染リスクに関する医学的懸念も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: الإصابات بفيروس إيبولا تتجاوز 900 حالة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus cases exceed 900 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 cases as of May 25, 2026, with 867 suspected and 204 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. The ongoing epidemic centers in Ituri province in the northeast, near Uganda, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu amid mining activity and insecurity; 10 confirmed deaths and 91 confirmed infections are officially recorded in the DRC, where testing is limited in remote areas. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, which has about a 50% fatality rate and lacks a vaccine or approved treatment, leaving containment reliant on isolation and rapid case-finding. Uganda reports 5 cases (3 new, 1 death). Rwanda bans entry for travelers who passed through DRC; the US enhances border surveillance. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Attacks on health facilities and mass funerals in Romambara prompt authorities to cap gatherings at 50 people.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者数がコンゴ民主共和国で900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)を宣言した重大な多国間エボラアウトブレイクであり、即座にフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。Bundibugyo variant（致命率約50%）による大規模アウトブレイク。ウガンダ・ルワンダへの国際拡大が確認され、米国が国境監視を強化。医療施設への攻撃と感染対策の困難さが懸念。対象国リスト外（ウガンダ・ルワンダ・米国）の拡大報告がある点も注視が必要だが、verified_locationsはサマリーの主題である発生国DRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases top 900 amid violence and aid shortages
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, Ituri province, with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths reported by Ministry of Communication as of May 24, 2026. Most cases are in Ituri; earlier counts exceeded 700, while the death toll was revised downward from over 170 without explanation. World Health Organization classifies the outbreak as posing a very high domestic risk, with the global threat deemed low; crisis has been declared a global health emergency. Security and conflict hamper response: treatment centres set ablaze in two towns; 1 million displaced in Ituri; health systems are overstretched and under-resourced. International funding reductions weaken surveillance and response; shortages of PPE, testing kits, and body bags. Tensions over burial protocols; a group burned an Ebola treatment facility while recovering a relative’s body. Authorities prohibited wakes and gatherings over 50; security forces oversee some burials. Risk of spread to displacement camps near Bunia.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者が900人を超える、暴力と援助不足の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROs基準も全て該当。WHOが「世界保健緊急事態」を宣言済みの確認されたエボラ流行。
triage.notes: 確認済みのエボラウイルス流行。904疑い患者、119疑い死亡。Ituri州が主な発生地。WHOが世界保健緊急事態を宣言し、国内リスクは非常に高いと評価。治療施設への放火、150万人の避難民、セキュリティの問題が対応を阻害。国際援助削減により監視・対応体制が弱化。Bunia周辺の避難民キャンプへの拡大リスク。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ出血熱、コンゴでの疑い例900件超に WHO事務局長
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus disease: More than 900 suspected cases in Congo, says WHO Director-General.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is circulating in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with more than 900 suspected cases reported and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections as of May 24, 2026, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus; no death toll update was provided. The outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo lineage, declared on May 15, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The Congolese health ministry reported as of May 23, 2026, 867 suspected cases across three provinces with 204 deaths confirmed. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴでの疑い例900件超に WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模感染と死亡が報告されており、即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の急速な拡大が報告されている。900件超の疑い例、101件の確認例、204件の死亡が記録されている。Bundibugyo系統で、承認されたワクチンや治療法が存在しない。WHOが公式に確認しており、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果(金)已发现超900例埃博拉疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has detected more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with more than 900 suspected cases reported as of May 24, 2026, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Of these, 101 cases are laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain; no approved vaccine or treatment exists yet. The DRC Ministry of Health reported 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths across three provinces as of May 23. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The report highlights ongoing surveillance and response efforts amid an active outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国で900例以上のエボラ疑似症例が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ予測不可能な新興感染症であり、国際的な拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模爆発。確認症例101例、死亡204例。Bundibugyo型ウイルス株が同定されている。ワクチンや承認済み治療法が存在しないため管理困難性が高い。DRCは支援国リストに含まれていないが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として最優先対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: मत जाना ये देश... भारत सरकार ने कर दिया सावधान, फिर छाया खौफनाक वायरस का साया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't travel to this country... The Government of India has warned, the shadow of a terrifying virus looms again.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Ebola Virus outbreaks are resurging with hundreds of reported cases and dozens of deaths across Africa, notably in Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. The Government of India has issued a strict advisory urging citizens to avoid non-essential travel to these countries. The alert reflects renewed global concern as the World Health Organization keeps the situation under close surveillance. The report notes widespread transmission in the highlighted nations, but provides no specifics on laboratory confirmation methods, infection sources, or exported cases. India’s precautionary stance demonstrates heightened international health vigilance and a rapid government response to cross-border infectious threats amid ongoing outbreaks in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: この国には行かないで...インド政府が警告を発令、恐ろしいウイルスの影が再び迫る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、エボラの異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。複数国での大規模アウトブレイク、多数の死亡、政府レベルの公式警告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCはサマリーで主要な発生地として記載。インドは発生地ではなく政府警告発令国だが、感染症危機管理の対象として含める。ウガンダ・南スーダンはサマリーに記載されるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラの高い伝播可能性と国際的懸念、政府レベルの渡航警告により、このシグナルはフルRRA優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala on high alert as WHO declares global emergency over Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India, on 25 May 2026 intensified surveillance after the WHO declared a global public health emergency over the fast-spreading Ebola outbreak driven by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The Bundibugyo variant is described as among the most dangerous Ebola strains, causing severe haemorrhagic fever with high mortality; existing vaccines are not effective against it. The WHO Emergency Committee, meeting on 22 May, issued stringent recommendations to bolster disease surveillance at international airports, seaports, and border checkpoints and to discourage non-essential travel to affected regions. Africa CDC declared the outbreak a continental public health security emergency. Nations bordering Congo and Uganda—South Sudan, Rwanda, Burundi, Tanzania—are considered high risk. India reports no Bundibugyo cases; citizens are advised to avoid non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Kerala authorities will coordinate with the union Health Ministry, airport authorities, and international agencies for import-preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州がエボラ出血熱の世界的な感染拡大宣言でハイアラート状態に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の国際的拡大、高い国際感染リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模多国間流行で、WHO緊急委員会が公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事象を宣言しており、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケーラ州インドを起点に、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラ流行に対する国際的な対応が記載されている。ルワンダ、ブルンジ、タンザニアも言及されているが、これらは高リスク国として列挙されており、実際の発生地域ではなく対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Bundibugyo株による致命率の高いエボラ出血熱で既存ワクチンが有効でないという点が特に重要。

article.articleHeadline: OMS señala 900 posibles casos de Ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO notes 900 possible Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no vaccines or approved treatments exist. The agency noted ongoing intensified surveillance but did not provide a fresh toll on deaths; a prior update from the DRC health ministry cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three central provinces. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe hemorrhage and multiorgan failure. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa. The current outbreak unfolds in a conflict-affected nation, complicating response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染の可能性のある症例900件を指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900件以上の疑似症例、101確定症例、204死亡）で公衆衛生への重大な影響があり、国際的に極めて懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株で、ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない。紛争地域での発生により対応が複雑化している。過去50年間でアフリカでは15,000人以上の死亡実績あり。WHOによる公式報告で確定情報である。

article.articleHeadline: ASN di Kupang Meninggal Diduga Rabies, Sempat Dua Kali Digigit Anjing
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Civil servant in Kupang dies of suspected rabies after being bitten by a dog twice.
article.articleSummary: One death in Kupang Regency, East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, is linked to suspected rabies after two dog bites. The victim, a civil servant identified as WIK, resided in Saukibe Village, Amfoang Barat Laut, and worked at the Amfoang Tengah sub-district office. The first bite occurred January 23, 2026 in Oelfatu with no report or treatment. A second bite, on May 14, 2026, came from the victim’s pet dog at home in Saukibe. He developed classic rabies symptoms—fever, photophobia, and hydrophobia—and deteriorated despite medical advice to evacuate to a primary health center (puskesmas). The family delayed; the patient died before timely care. Health officials consider rabies highly likely and have captured the pet dog for laboratory testing. As of May 20, 2026, six Oelfatu residents were bitten by dogs on May 18–19, 2026, including two teachers, indicating an ongoing canine rabies cluster in Amfoang Barat Laut.

triage.headline_ja: クパンの公務員が疑い狂犬病で死亡、2度の犬咬傷後
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（東ヌサテンガラ州）での狂犬病関連死亡事例、複数の犬咬傷クラスター発生、治療遅延による死亡という深刻な公衆衛生事象。WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）で複数該当し、進行中の動物由来感染症クラスターとして要注視。
triage.notes: 東ヌサテンガラ州クパン地域での狂犬病関連死亡事例。2026年1月と5月の2度の犬咬傷、治療遅延による死亡、進行中の動物由来感染症クラスター（5月18-19日に6人の追加咬傷）が報告されている。ペット犬の検査が進行中。公衆衛生当局が対応中。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準5つ全て該当するためPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Jóvenes irrumpen en hospital de tratamiento del ébola en el Congo para exigir cuerpos de familiares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young people storm an Ebola treatment center in the Congo to demand the bodies of their relatives.
article.articleSummary: Young people storm the General Hospital of Mongbwalu in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ebola care is provided, forcing evacuation as gunfire was heard. It marked the third health facility attack in a week amid the outbreak, which the WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Contaminated bodies of Ebola victims pose high transmission risk during funerals; authorities have restricted burials and gatherings over 50 people in the northeast. The attacks followed earlier raids on MSF tents; another treatment center in Rwampara was burned after authorities forbade removal of a suspected victim's body. The Congo health ministry reported 904 suspected cases, mostly in Ituri, with 119 suspected deaths, though regional tallies total 220. Bundibugyo Ebola has no vaccine; three MSF volunteers reportedly died, possibly contracting the virus on March 27, suggesting an earlier outbreak start than previously reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ治療センターに若者が押し入り、家族の遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上極めて深刻な影響を及ぼし、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが高く、WHO が公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態（PHEIC）として宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC（Ituri州）での複数のエボラ治療施設への攻撃、904件の疑い患者、119件の死亡が報告されている。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスであり、ワクチンがない。MSF の医療従事者3名が死亡している可能性がある。Rwanda にも言及されているが、サマリー主体は DRC での発生。

article.articleHeadline: Врач Онищенко ответил, грозит ли россиянам новая вспышка Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Onishchenko Answers Whether a New Ebola Outbreak Threatens Russians
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola outbreaks are active in Africa, with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda affected. The World Health Organization has declared the DRC-Uganda Ebola situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, reporting roughly 750 probable cases and 177 probable deaths, with numbers continuing to rise. Russian epidemiologist Gennady Onishchenko cautions that further spread depends on how effectively containment is implemented: rapid detection, patient isolation, treatment, and quarantine measures. He urges travel bans into and out of affected areas, aggressive case-finding, prompt hospitalization, and monitoring of those exposed. If these rules are followed, the virus should not disseminate further, including into Russia. The interview also references his prior warnings about the main danger posed by a new Ebola strain.

triage.headline_ja: オニシチェンコ医師が回答：新しいエボラ流行がロシア人に脅威を与えるか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO緊急宣言と死亡者数増加により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedt APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーでは主にDRCの感染状況について述べられており、ウガンダの具体的な感染状況は明記されていない。DRCのみを対象国として計上。ロシアは記事の文脈では対象国リスト外のため excluded。WHO PHEICの宣言、進行中の流行、高い死亡率がシグナル採用の主要理由。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго са регистрарани над 900 случаи на предполагаемо заразяване с ебола, съобщиха властите в страната и шефът на СЗО
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo there have been over 900 cases of suspected Ebola infection, the country's authorities and the head of the WHO said.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak: As of May 25, 2026, authorities report 904 suspected Ebola virus disease cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 119 suspected deaths (ten confirmed). The outbreak persists in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Uganda has five confirmed cases linked to the eastern DRC outbreak; suspected cases in Uganda are not published. WHO notes the true caseload is likely higher due to undetected spread in eastern DRC over weeks and several unexplained deaths under investigation. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Testing capacity is limited to a few laboratories, and the outbreak area is remote and affected by armed groups. WHO assesses very high national risk and high regional risk, with global risk considered low; Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over 50 years, with a case fatality ranging 25–90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑い例が900例以上報告。WHO事務局長と当局が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模集団発生で、既に900例以上の疑い例と119例の死亡（確認10例）を報告。ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認され、国際的脅威として認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダ（非対象国）への越境拡大が言及されているが、verified_locationsには DRC のみを含める。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による集団発生で、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。検査能力が限定的で、紛争地域における検査・対応体制が脆弱。WHO は国家レベルのリスク評価を「非常に高い」と判定。フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: अम्बाला में हीट वेव और जल जनित रोगों को लेकर स्वास्थ्य विभाग अलर्ट - Lalluram Ambala Heat Wave Advisory Issued by Civil Surgeon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ambala: Health Department Alert on Heat Wave and Waterborne Diseases - Lalluram Ambala Heat Wave Advisory Issued by Civil Surgeon
article.articleSummary: Ambala district in Haryana faces rising heat and waterborne disease risk. Civil Surgeon Dr. Renu Beery has ordered all government and private health facilities to follow strict guidelines, keeping emergency departments on full alert. If five or more patients from a single area present with typhoid, diarrhea, vomiting, hepatitis, jaundice, or high fever, the Civil Surgeon office must be notified immediately. Private clinics, hospitals, labs, and pharmacies must report any notifiable diseases to [email protected] or call 9813059474. Last week, jaundice, vomiting, and diarrhea were linked to Topekhana Ambala Cantonment, Jafrpur village, and Jandli area; water samples were collected and the situation is controlled. PHED will conduct daily drinking-water checks in urban and rural areas, monitoring chlorine and pipe leaks. Campaigns in industrial zones, brick kilns, and urban slums aim to prevent heat-wave and waterborne diseases. Public is urged to drink only chlorinated/purified water.

triage.headline_ja: アンバラ：保健部門が熱波と水由来疾患に関する警報を発令 - 土木外科医が発令した熱波勧告
triage.triage_reason: インドのハリヤナ州アンバラ地区で腸チフスと肝炎の集団発生の可能性があり、当局が報告閾値（単一地域から5名以上）を設定して対応している。異常かつ予想外の発生であり、複数の基準を満たしている。
triage.notes: 記事はハリヤナ州アンバラ地区での水由来疾患（腸チフス、肝炎）の発生を報告。当局は報告閾値を設定し、公衆衛生部門が能動的に監視中。熱波に伴う水衛生リスク増加が背景。5つのWPRO基準すべてに該当する明確なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: أكثر من 900 إصابة مشتبه بها بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. No death toll update was provided. The outbreak began on May 15 in Ituri Province, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. An earlier update reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. The epicenter is Mongabwalo in Ituri, a remote, conflict-affected area housing about 130,000 people. The virus has spread to two neighboring provinces and into Uganda, about 100 kilometers by air from Ituri, with South Sudan roughly 200 kilometers away. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Local hospitals use chlorine sanitizers, PPE, and isolation tents provided by MSF; samples await confirmation at Kinshasa’s Institute of Biomedical Research.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴでエボラウイルスの疑い患者900人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（疑い患者900人以上、確認患者101人、死亡204人）で、WHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染確認、南スーダン近接）と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事に記載されているウガンダ及び南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC（対象国）内のイトゥリ州およびキンシャサ市が主要な発生地点。WHOがPHEIC宣言しており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による大規模アウトブレイク。紛争影響地域での発生のため管理可能性に課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Clínicas precárias, desconfiança e insegurança sobrecarregam resposta ao ebola no leste da República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Precarious clinics, mistrust and insecurity burden the Ebola response in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province's Bunia city, DRC, declared May 15, 2026, has spread to North and South Kivu, with Uganda reporting imported confirmed cases. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, while authorities warn the true burden is much higher—roughly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths as surveillance and testing improve, though violence hampers response. Bunia’s central hospital functions as an improvised Ebola treatment center, with 56 suspected cases under care. Major challenges include isolation, testing, contact tracing, and safe burials amid rumors and mistrust. In Rwampara, a health zone hardest hit, a treatment center was burned; two eight-bed quarantine tents were set ablaze, and a body damaged, prompting patients and suspected cases to flee. Experts like Muyembe emphasize community engagement and local trust to combat imported cases and spread.

triage.headline_ja: 貧弱なクリニック、不信感および不安定性がコンゴ民主共和国東部におけるエボラ対応を圧迫
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、複数国への波及、高い死亡率、対応上の重大な課題が認められ、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはウガンダとルワンダも含まれているが、サマリー上でウガンダは輸入症例の報告のみであり、ルワンダは明示的な発生記載なし。DRCが主要な発生地であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。エボラの急速な拡大（5月15日宣言、短期間で複数州へ波及）、公式統計（82確定例、7死亡）と推定統計（750疑い例、177疑い死亡）の乖離、治療体制の脆弱性、暴力と不信による対応阻害、焼き打ちなどの社会不安など、複数の重大リスク要因が確認される。国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 100 confirmed infections and more than 200 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figures, noting the outbreak has primarily affected eastern regions of the DRC. On Saturday, the DRC's Ministry of Health reported the epidemic has caused over 200 fatalities. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, but the risk of international spread remains low as of May 23, 2026. The report highlights ongoing transmission in affected areas and emphasizes continued international attention and response efforts to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900件の疑い患者、200件以上の死亡）で、WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ感染症。WHOがPHEIC宣言している時点で、国際的な重大な懸念事項。東部地域での継続的な感染が報告されており、長期的な曝露リスクが存在する。ただし、記事では国際的な拡大リスクは低いと述べられているが、エボラの歴史的背景から国際的監視は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 suspected cases identified in DRC Ebola response: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 confirmed, as WHO scales up surveillance in the response. Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicentre, houses nearly 5 million people amid ongoing conflict, with roughly one in four in humanitarian need and one in five internally displaced. Violence is forcing people to flee, including health and humanitarian workers, severely impeding Ebola contact tracing and early identification for supportive care. WHO and humanitarian partners maintain a presence across Ituri, including the hardest-to-reach and most insecure areas, to deliver a comprehensive package of healthcare services and to build trust essential for response. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus; on May 16, this Ebola event was declared a public health emergency of international concern. On May 22, risk was raised to very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応で900人以上の疑似症例を特定：WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo型）の公衆衛生上の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認識されており、WHOによりPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo型）のアウトブレイク。確定症例101例を含む疑似症例900人以上を確認。2026年5月16日にPHEIC宣言済み。5月22日に国家レベルでリスク引き上げ。イトゥリ州（約500万人）が流行中心地。紛争下の不安定な状況により接触者追跡と初期対応が著しく阻害されている。国際的な支援体制が構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Strong first quarter can't stop Singapore's economic outlook from dimming; Thailand says no need for alarm over Singapore's Covid spike: Singapore live news
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 variant driving infections in Singapore, with Thailand stating no need for alarm as the variant is already widespread there. Thailand’s Department of Disease Control reports the NB.1.8.1 variant dominates more than half of sequenced samples. Between 1 January and 23 May 2026, Thailand recorded 3,642 COVID-19 cases and 1 death, with case numbers currently below the five-year median. Singapore has rising COVID-19 activity but the article provides no local case counts. The report is dated 25 May 2026 and emphasizes the region’s evolving situation without detailed laboratory confirmation or transmission sources. Keywords: COVID-19, NB.1.8.1, Singapore, Thailand, outbreak, cases, deaths, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: シンガポールの経済見通しは減速、タイはシンガポールのCOVID急増について警戒不要と言及：シンガポール速報
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の既知変異株（NB.1.8.1）による地域的な感染増加の報告だが、タイでは既に広く流行しており重症度は限定的。情報不足が多く、フルRRA前の継続観察が適切。
triage.notes: シンガポールは対象国リスト外だがタイは対象国であり、同地域での感染トレンド報告として記録。タイではケース数が5年中央値以下であり、既に同変異株が優位種となっているため、アラーム度は低い。2026年時点の将来的イベント記述であることに留意。

article.articleHeadline: Experts endorse unified plan to tackle Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo faces a worsening Ebola outbreak with 204 deaths reported; Uganda confirms three new cases as Red Cross volunteers die. Africa CDC coordinated with DR Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan in Kampala, endorsing a unified strategy: 'one team, one plan, one budget, one implementation.' Ten countries at risk: Angola, Burundi, CAR, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. The plan seeks about $319 million for June–November outbreak preparedness and response, with more than 75% aimed at DR Congo and Uganda; roughly $230 million has been pledged. Insecurity hampers deployment and contact tracing; misinformation led to a treatment tent being set on fire in Mongbwalu. WHO Africa emergency chief Marie Roseline Belizaire urged early community involvement. Uganda’s health secretary Diana Atwine stressed rapid case identification and logistics, warning that no country is safe until all are safe.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行に対応する統一計画を専門家が支持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の重篤な多国間流行により、深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常で予想外の事態、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが認められ、フルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、コンゴ民主共和国（東部）での主要な流行、ウガンダでの3例の新規確認、ザンビアを含む10カ国のリスク評価が明記されている。Bluedot APIが付与した多くの地域（スーダン、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、エチオピア、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、ブルンジ）は『リスク国』として言及されているが、記事サマリー上で『実際に発生が確認されている』のはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダであり、ザンビアは明記されているため verified_locations に含めた。資金要求（3.19億ドル）、複数国の医療システム関与、コミュニティレベルの対応困難（火焔、接触追跡の阻害）から管理可能性の懸念も高い。

article.articleHeadline: ÜST Konqo Respublikasında 900-dən çox Ebola virusuna yoluxma şübhəsi olduğunu bildirib
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO says there are more than 900 suspected Ebola virus infections in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports more than 900 suspected Ebola virus infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed infections, in an outbreak centered in Ituri province. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said epidemiological surveillance is being expanded to detect cases and trace contacts. Ituri, the epicenter, is home to about 5 million people; roughly one in four residents needs humanitarian aid and one in five is forcibly displaced. Violence is driving people, including health and humanitarian workers, from their homes, significantly hindering contact tracing and early detection, and complicating surveillance efforts. The figures underscore the severity of the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the urgent need for intensified surveillance, rapid isolation, and international support to curb transmission amid insecurity and displacement.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスへの感染疑い事例が900件を超えたと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例101件、疑い例900件超という深刻な公衆衛生影響。Ituri州での大規模アウトブレイク、国際支援ニーズが明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて致死率の高い感染症。記事ではIturi州でのアウトブレイク中心で、約500万人の住民がいる地域。暴力と避難民の移動により接触者追跡と早期検出が困難。WHO事務局長による言及があり、国際的なスケールの事象。すべての評価基準で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: El hantavirus y el ébola vuelven a poner en el foco el potencial pandémico de las zoonosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus and Ebola once again bring the pandemic potential of zoonoses into focus
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, hantavirus outbreak tied to a cruise ship that disembarked in Tenerife and an Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda have renewed focus on the pandemic potential of zoonoses—viruses transmitted from animals. Ebola in DRC and Uganda has caused nearly 180 deaths and about 750 suspected cases, per WHO, in a timeframe of just three weeks. The report underscores human vulnerability to zoonotic pathogens and warns that conditions enabling pandemics are increasing, even after COVID-19. It calls for strengthened prevention and protection measures globally, with emphasis on resource-limited settings facing these health challenges, to avert spread and enhance outbreak preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスとエボラが再び人獣共通感染症のパンデミック可能性に焦点を当てる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常・予想外の状況、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行で180人の死亡、約750人の疑い患者が3週間で発生しており、緊急的なRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の疾患（COVID-19、ハンタウイルス、エボラ）を言及しているが、主要な懸念はDRC及びウガンダのエボラ流行。スペインのテネリフェ島のハンタウイルスアウトブレイク（クルーズ船関連）も記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に追加しない。DRC及びウガンダはいずれも対象国リストに含まれる。多くの死亡者と疑い患者数が報告されており、国際的な懸念が高まっている状況。

article.articleHeadline: В ДРК число предполагаемых случаев заболевания лихорадкой Эбола превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the number of suspected Ebola cases has exceeded 900.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases, up from about 700; official deaths adjusted from 170 to 119 (France24). The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri province, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. The response is hampered by territory-control fragmentation between government forces and armed groups. The IFRC warns the outbreak is unfolding in communities already facing instability, displacement, and weak health systems. Local distrust and resistance to response measures complicate efforts; MSF mobile hospitals were burned in Mongbvalu and Rwamparé last week. On May 22, WHO raised the risk level to 'very high' nationally and 'high' regionally, while the global level remains 'low'.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の疑似患者が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生であり、WHO緊急委員会による国内『非常に高いリスク』評価と地域『高いリスク』評価により、フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高レベルの脅威。疑似患者900例超、確認死亡119例（調整済み）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu各州で多発。武装勢力による領土支配の断片化、地域の不安定性、保健システム脆弱性により対応困難。MSF医療施設の焼き打ち事件発生。WHO国内リスク『非常に高い』、地域『高い』の評価により、国際的対応の強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 100 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths as of May 25, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says response efforts have been intensified. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, a conflict-affected, hard-to-reach area that hampers detection and control. The African CDC warned of cross-border transmission risks to Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia, though global risk remains low. Violence and displacement are driving people from homes and disrupting health workers and humanitarian aid, undermining contact tracing and early treatment. Ebola has killed about 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴで900以上のエボラ疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の大規模な流行で、IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数対象国での確認・リスクあり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域には複数アフリカ諸国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は「DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）での流行」。リスク警告される他国（Angola、Burundi、Central African Republic、Ethiopia、Kenya、Rwanda、South Sudan、Tanzania）のうち、対象国リストに該当するのはZambiaのみ。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、サマリーで明示的に主流行地として記述されているため verified_locations に含める。エボラは最高リスク疾患であり、WHO総長言及、紛争地帯での制御困難性、多国間の国境越え拡大リスク指摘により、フルRRA対象案件。

article.articleHeadline: Four die, over 50 fall ill after ritual feast in Odisha village; cholera angle probed
article.articleSummary: Four people died and over 50 fell ill after a post-death ritual feast in Nuadihi village, Sundargarh district, Odisha. Two deaths were in Nuadihi; two others in Sunakhaen village, Jharsuguda district. The feast was held on Thursday. Four Sunakhaen residents—Ullas Khadia (41) and Sukanti Khadia (65)—were admitted to DHH around midnight Saturday with severe diarrhoea and vomiting and were later referred to VIMSAR, Burla; Ullas died there, Sukanti died at DHH around 5:30 am Sunday. Raibari Pradhan (50) was admitted to Hemgir CHC Saturday evening and died within an hour; Mangal Singh Naik (50) died during treatment at VIMSAR, Burla on Sunday morning. Health officials say food poisoning is suspected, but a cholera angle has not been ruled out since the host reportedly had a diarrhoeal infection prior. Stool samples are being collected to determine the exact cause.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州の村での儀式的饗宴後に4人が死亡、50人以上が発病；コレラの可能性も調査中
triage.triage_reason: オディシャ州で複数死亡を含む急性胃腸炎アウトブレイク（コレラ疑い）が報告された。死亡4例、患者50例以上という重症度と異常性、及びインドにおける公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められ、IHR基準2項目以上に該当する。
triage.notes: オディシャ州ヌアディヒ村での儀式後の急性胃腸炎アウトブレイク。死亡4例、患者50例以上。コレラ疑いで検査中。発症は2026年5月23日前後の食事後。複数地区（ヌアディヒ、スナカエン、ジャルスグダ）に拡がっている。患者はVIMSAR、Burlaなどの医療施設で治療中。検体採取により原因特定予定。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）已报告超900例埃博拉疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, has more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak centers on Ituri Province, where nearly 5 million people live in ongoing conflict; about one in four people needs humanitarian aid and one in five is displaced, conditions that hinder contact tracing and timely treatment and fuel community distrust. Uganda reports its first locally transmitted cases in this round, bringing total confirmed cases to 5. There is currently no vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The WHO designated the Congo and Uganda outbreaks as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. National risk is very high; regional risk high; global risk low. The response stresses strengthening health services to build trust and improve outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国が900例を超えるエボラ疑似症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス感染症は深刻な影響（死亡例含む）、予想外の流行規模、複数国での確認、国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として指定されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国リストに含まれない）での症例も報告されているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。イツリ州における紛争状況下での流行、ワクチン・特異的治療法の不在、WHOによるPHEIC指定、地域リスク「高」という評価が極めて重大。国際的支援体制の強化が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola: 900+ Suspected Cases, WHO Alert
article.articleSummary: 900+ suspected Ebola cases in Ituri province, DRC, amid ongoing conflict; WHO alert as of May 25, 2026. Ituri is the outbreak’s epicentre, with nearly 5 million residents, widespread humanitarian needs, and high internally displaced populations, impeding contact tracing and early care. The virus involved is Bundibugyo virus; on May 16, WHO declared it a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC) for DRC and Uganda. On May 22, risk was assessed as very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease; transmission occurs from wildlife to humans (fruit bats, porcupines, non-human primates) and human-to-human via direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, fluids, and surfaces contaminated with these fluids. The average case fatality rate is around 50%, with past outbreaks ranging 25–90%. First outbreaks occurred in Central Africa near tropical rainforests; the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak was the largest.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：900件以上の疑い患者、WHO警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの重大な公衆衛生事象。DRCとウガンダで確認され、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月16日にPHEIC宣言済み。Ituri州が流行の中心。Bundibugyo virus（エボラウイルスの一種）による爆発的感染。武力紛争下での対応で接触者追跡が困難。平均致死率50%。ウガンダにも拡大の可能性が示唆されるが、記事サマリーではDRCが主な発生地。

article.articleHeadline: África enfrenta terceiro maior surto de ebola da história
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa faces the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa ranks as the third-largest in history, centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 91 confirmed cases and seven deaths to date. There are 867 suspected infections, and 204 deaths are under investigation to confirm the cause. Across Africa, ten countries are at high risk for spread due to geographic proximity and population movement. Uganda reports five cases linked to a new Ebola variant for which no vaccine is available. The report underscores ongoing transmission risk and the need for expanded surveillance and containment efforts in affected and neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカはエボラウイルスの歴史上3番目に大きい流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則上の「公衆衛生上の懸念」の筆頭疾患であり、複数国での確認、複数死亡例、ワクチン未対応の新規亜型出現により、直ちにフルRRAを実施すべき重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが主要な発生地であり、ワクチン未対応の新規亜型の出現により管理が困難な状況。10カ国が地理的近接性と人口移動により高リスク下にある旨が記載されているが、具体的な他の対象国の確認はサマリー内では明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Suspek Ebola di Kongo Capai 900, Krisis Peralatan Medis Membayangi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Ebola Cases in Kongo Reach 900, as the Medical Equipment Crisis Looms.
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) rise to 904 with 119 deaths as of May 25, 2026. The World Health Organization designates the national outbreak risk as 'very high,' while global risk remains low, prompting concerns over cross-border spread. An official outbreak status was declared on May 15, 2026. The earliest known case traces to a nurse in Bunia, Ituri, who showed symptoms on April 24, 2026, with burial in Mongbwalu. The current outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rarer strain lacking approved vaccines or treatments, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and possible bleeding; incubation ranges from 2 to 21 days. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids. Three Red Cross volunteers in the area died after handling an Ebola-affected body."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疑い患者が900件に達する、医療機器危機が懸念される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当する。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模疑い患者発生（904件、死亡119件）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、高い致死性を示す。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は承認ワクチン・治療法がない稀な株。DRC東部（イツリ州）での発生で、医療機器危機と境界を超えた拡大リスクが懸念される。WHO国家リスク評価は『非常に高い』一方、世界的リスクは低いと評価。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: AP gears up to face Ebola threat
article.articleSummary: Ebola precautions rolled out in Andhra Pradesh as WHO and the Centre warn of possible spread. The government will focus on travellers from Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, with enhanced medical screening at Visakhapatnam, Tirupati and Vijayawada international airports and coordination between district health authorities and airport officials. Isolation wards of 15 beds are being established in teaching hospitals in international airport cities. Passengers with travel histories to affected countries will undergo diagnostic tests, and anyone with symptoms will be quarantined; their close contacts will also be tested. Similar vigilance extends to arrivals through Visakhapatnam Port and road routes. PPE and virus-detection kits are stocked to meet immediate needs. The health department is conducting virtual awareness sessions with ANMs and ASHA workers to ensure grassroots preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: AP gears up to face Ebola threat（アンドラ・プラデシュ州、エボラ脅威に備える）
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラ予防措置展開は異常かつ予想外の対応であり、IHR基準2つ（unusual_unexpected、international_spread risk）に該当する可能性があるが、実際の症例確認は記事に記載されていない。発症者がいない時点での予防的準備であるため、情報不足として要経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した地域にはDRC、Uganda、Sudanも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はインド（アンドラ・プラデシュ州）でのエボラ予防措置の展開であり、これら国での発症は述べられていない。したがってverified_locationsはIndiaのみとした。記事は予防的準備段階であり、確定症例の報告ではない点に注意。WHO警告による国家レベルの対応という点で社会・政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）伊波拉疑似及确诊个案增至逾900宗 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected and confirmed cases in DR Congo rise to over 900 - International - Real-time International.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The epidemic has spread to three eastern provinces, notably Ituri, where the capital Bunia continues church attendance despite a ban on gatherings of more than 50 people. Ongoing conflict is hampering outbreak response and patient care, and some domestic flight routes have been suspended. The Africa CDC warns cross-border transmission risk is rising, potentially affecting up to 10 African countries: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. The situation underscores the challenges of delivering services amid instability and the threat of regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似及び確定症例が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で、既に900例以上の症例が報告され、複数国への越境感染リスクが高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、越境感染リスク国として複数国が言及されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域には対象国外の国も多く含まれているが、verified_locationsには記事で実際に言及されている対象国のうち、確定した発生地（DRC）と具体的に感染リスク警告の対象となっているZambiaのみを記載した。Africa CDCの警告により、up to 10カ国への潜在的拡大リスクが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: 民主刚果发现逾900疑似伊波拉病例|光华网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Guanghua Net
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 204 deaths reported across three provinces, per WHO Director-General Tedros on May 24. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province, where nearly 5 million people live amid ongoing conflict, complicating surveillance and response. The DRC health ministry reports fatalities across three provinces. Africa CDC Director Kasaye described the situation as like soldiers going to war with bare hands, noting high cross-border movement and instability that fuel transmission. Ten African countries potentially at risk include Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. The crisis underscores the need for intensified detection, containment, and international support.

triage.headline_ja: 民主刚果发现逾900疑似伊波拉病例（民主共和国コンゴで900件以上の疑似エボラ病例を検出）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模感染が確認され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。204名の死亡、国境を越えた感染の可能性、医療体制の脆弱性が報告されており、国際的対応が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主共和国コンゴ）を主な発生地域として明記。Bluedot APIの発生地域に複数アフリカ諸国が列挙されているが、サマリー上で「10のアフリカ諸国が潜在的リスク」との記述があり、確認された感染は主にDRCである。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとZambiaのみ。WHO事務局長およびアフリカCDCの公式声明が引用されており、信頼性が高い。紛争地域での流行という複雑要因が管理可能性を低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: As Ebola Cases Rise, Don't Ignore These 7 Life-Saving Habits We Learned From COVID And Past Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Bundibugyo is a rarer Ebola strain with no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, heightening emphasis on prevention and daily habits. Ebola spreads mainly through direct contact with infected bodily fluids; casual airborne transmission is not the primary route. WHO notes cases are rising and emphasizes the following: wash hands with soap and water or alcohol-based sanitizer; avoid touching the face; maintain distance from the sick; stay home when unwell to prevent spread; learn early symptoms (fever, fatigue, headache, muscle pain) since early detection and supportive care improve survival. Community engagement, safe caregiving, responsible travel, and adherence to quarantine guidance help break transmission chains. Verify health updates from trusted sources to counter misinformation. The situation echoes lessons from COVID-19 and past outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例が増加する中、COVID-19と過去の流行から学んだ7つの命を救う習慣を無視しないでください
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebolasのアウトブレイクが5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されており、IHR基準の4つすべてに該当する。DRCとウガンダで発生しており、ワクチンや特定治療がない稀なエボラ株であることから重症度と国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にBundibugyo Ebolasのアウトブレイクが「Democratic Republic of the CongoとUganda」で発生していると述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみを含める。Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。PHEC宣言により国際的な懸念が正式に認識されている。ワクチン未承認で治療法がないBundibugyo株である点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Video WHO: Lebih dari 900 Kasus Suspek dan 101 Positif Ebola di Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Video: More than 900 suspected cases and 101 Ebola-positive cases in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with approximately 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus outlined the update, noting that Ituri Province is the outbreak’s epicenter amid an ongoing health and security crisis. The conflict-stricken area houses nearly 5 million people; about 25% require humanitarian assistance and 20% are internally displaced. Violence is driving the displacement of health workers and humanitarian staff, severely hindering contact tracing and the ability to identify infections early for supportive care. Ongoing insecurity and fear are fueling distrust within communities and complicating outbreak response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO動画：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い患者と101件の陽性確認患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（確定患者101名、疑い患者900名以上）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明白。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体。Ituri州を中心とした紛争地域での流行であり、セキュリティ上の課題（保健労働者の逃亡、接触者追跡の困難化）が対応を著しく阻害している。国内避難民を含む500万人以上が影響下にある。WHO事務局長による公式発表に基づくもので、信頼性が高い。IHR（2005）Article 12に該当し、直ちにWHO通知が必要な事象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo's east climb over 900: authorities
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo escalates, with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths reported as of May 25, 2026, per the Congolese Ministry of Communication on X. The surge follows earlier totals exceeding 700 suspected cases and over 170 suspected deaths, concentrated mainly in Ituri province where the outbreak is centered. The World Health Organization classifies the outbreak risk for Congo as 'very high,' while the global risk remains low. The report references suspected cases and deaths and provides no laboratory-confirmed figures, symptoms, transmission details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases. It notes the ongoing nature of the outbreak in eastern Congo, with Ituri as the focal area.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部のエボラ患者数が900件を超える：当局
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な増加、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準も全て該当、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的に最も危険な感染症の一つ。904件の疑い患者と119件の疑い死亡が報告されており、急速な増加傾向を示している。WHO分類でコンゴのリスク評価は『非常に高い』。Ituri州が集中地域として特定されている。疑い患者のみで確認患者数の詳細不明だが、公衆衛生上の深刻性は明白。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织：刚果（金）已报告超900例埃博拉疑似病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 subsequently laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province, is set against ongoing conflict that leaves nearly five million people in need of humanitarian aid and about one in five internally displaced, severely hampering contact tracing and early case detection. The disease is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. Uganda reports its first locally transmitted cases in this round, bringing total confirmed across both countries to five. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; on May 22, DR Congo’s national risk level was described as very high, regional risk high, global risk low. The situation underlines the need for comprehensive health services and community trust to control transmission.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 刚果（金）已报告超900例埃博拉疑似病例（WHO: コンゴ民主共和国は900例以上のエボラウイルス疑似患者を報告）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの確定的シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）が主たる発生地で900例以上の疑似患者と101例の確認患者がいる。ウガンダは「locally transmitted」（局所感染）として5例の確認患者を報告しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・特異的治療なし）、PHEIC宣言済み（5月17日）、地域リスク「very high」で確定的な重大シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: How the World's Delay on Congo's Ebola Outbreak Repeats Past Failures - And Why Speed Must Come First - News Directory 3
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) demands immediate, decisive action; delays have repeatedly fueled transmission, echoing 2014–2016 West Africa and 2018–2020 DRC flare-ups. A May 19 Guardian letter by epidemiologist Devi Sridhar argues speed must come first, noting slow deployment of treatment centers, contact tracing, and community engagement worsened earlier crises. The DRC’s rough geography, armed conflict, and mistrust of health workers hinder rapid vaccine and supply rollout, though tools exist—experimental vaccines such as rVSV-ZEBOV and ring vaccination targeting contacts to reduce spread. Ebola fatality can exceed 50% if untreated; past outbreaks saw patients dying while awaiting beds. Beyond lives, outbreaks devastate economies in a country where poverty exceeds 70%. As of May 24, the outbreak is underreported in headlines, but the call for fast, resourced response remains urgent; political will is the key hurdle.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行への世界の遅延が過去の失敗を繰り返す - そしてなぜスピードが最優先でなければならないのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は致死率50%超の重篤疾患であり、DRCでの発生は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ発生を主題としており、アンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリーではDRCが焦点。2014-2016西アフリカおよび2018-2020 DRC流行との比較分析を含む。2026年5月時点の現在の発生について警告を発している。地理的障害、武装紛争、保健ワーカーへの不信が対応を困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الإصابات المشتبه بها بفيروس إيبولا تتجاوز 900 حالة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Suspected Ebola cases exceed 900 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported that more than 900 suspected Ebola virus disease cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of the current outbreak. Of these, 101 are laboratory-confirmed, with no updated death toll provided in the latest post. Ebola is a highly lethal viral illness transmitted through direct contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause hemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure. The outbreak in the DRC began on May 15 and is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment to date. In a previous update, the Health Ministry cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over roughly 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス疑い症例が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。対象国DRCでの急速な発症者増加と高い致命率により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による急速な発症者増加（5月15日開始、現在900件超）、高い致命率（前回報告で204死亡/867疑い例）、有効なワクチン・治療法がないことが特に懸念される。WHOの公式発表により社会的・政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго зафіксували понад 900 підозр на Еболу - ВООЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, more than 900 suspected Ebola cases were recorded - WHO
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases are reported in the northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province around Bunia; the government lists 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths. WHO says the outbreak carries a very high risk for Congo but a low global threat. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus drives this outbreak; there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, with case fatality reported up to 90%. Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and human-to-human via blood, secretions, and contaminated surfaces. Authorities have banned wakes and mass gatherings over 50; some burials are conducted by aid workers under armed guard as treatment centers were set ablaze last week. The security crisis in eastern DRC—with armed groups and widespread displacement, nearly 1 million in Ituri—complicates containment. MSF reports fleeing healthcare workers and severe shortages of PPE, tests, body bags, and safe-burial materials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ疑い例900件以上を確認 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理困難性）。大規模なエボラアウトブレイク報告は国際的シグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ種）の大規模アウトブレイク。死亡率90%に達する可能性。東部DRCの武装勢力による治療センター放火、医療従事者の離脱、PPE不足など、極めて困難な対応環境。WHOは国内リスクは高いが世界的脅威は低いと評価している点を留意。

article.articleHeadline: Yön uutiskooste | Vantaan Korson tuhopoltosta annetaan tänään tuomio, WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nightly news roundup | A verdict will be delivered today in the Korson arson case in Vantaa, WHO: more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks have surpassed 900 suspected cases, with around 100 laboratory-confirmed infections and over 200 deaths, concentrated in the eastern region. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though the global risk of spread remains low. The update references statements by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and notes ongoing lab confirmation and surveillance, but provides no specific infection source or details on imported/exported cases. The situation highlights the persistent public health threat of Ebola in eastern DRC and the international coordination efforts, despite the assessment of low worldwide risk.

triage.headline_ja: 夜間ニュース速報 | ヴァンターの放火事件判決が本日下る、WHO：コンゴで疑い例が900件超のエボラ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的懸念）。エボラの大規模集団発生で、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラはIHRで報告義務のある指定感染症。900件超の疑い例、200人以上の死亡、PHEIC宣言済みは重大なシグナル。東部地域での持続的曝露リスク。WHOの公式見解および管理可能性の限定性から国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: NCDC Puts States on High Alert, Urges Preparation of Emergency Facilities
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s NCDC warns of a high risk of Ebola importation as of 25 May 2026 due to ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, and global travel. To mitigate, states should activate surveillance, early-detection management, referral pathways, ambulance transport, and ensure essential Ebola response supplies. Preparedness must be embedded in ongoing readiness activities, including detection, reporting, and response. Healthcare workers should receive refresher training on IPC, triage, and monitoring of alerts to support early case management. Enhanced surveillance at points of entry and border communities remains in place, with rapid response teams on steady alert. NCDC is distributing IPC readiness tools and mapping/prepositioning of critical commodities (PPE, body bags, lab consumables) for isolation and treatment centres, bed capacity, staffing, and logistics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：NCDC（ナイジェリア疾病管理センター）が州に高度警戒を指示、緊急施設の準備を要請
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行状況（DRC・ウガンダの進行中の感染）に対するナイジェリアの警戒・準備体制の強化に関する報告。IHR基準では国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行性・管理可能性が複数該当する。社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはNigeria（対象国でない）とUganda（対象国でない）が含まれるが、記事サマリーでは実際の進行中の感染は「DRC・ウガンダ」で、ナイジェリアは「警戒・準備を行う国」である。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）が含まれるため verified_locations に追加した。Ghana（2300660）はBluedotの発生地域に明示されていないため、記事サマリー上での言及を確認しても直接的な確認地域として記載されていないため、保守的に除外する判定も検討したが、感染症の地域的な流行パターン（West African context）から Ghana を監視地域として含める価値がある可能性がある。ただし、記事サマリーに明示されていないため，最終的には DRC のみに限定することが適切である。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला पर कांगो में बवाल... गलत जांच, डेड बॉडीज न मिलने पर फूट रहा लोगों का गुस्सा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uproar over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... faulty testing, people’s anger erupts as dead bodies are not found.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declares Ebola virus disease an International Public Health Emergency as the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri region reports rising cases, notably in Ravampara and Mongbwalu. Over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections are recorded, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus with no vaccine available. Early symptoms include fever, headache, muscle and joint pains, and fatigue, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, sore throat, and in severe cases, bleeding and organ failure. Incubation is 2–21 days. Community resistance—driven by funeral rites, distrust of authorities, and aid cuts—has hampered response and investigations, with treatment centers attacked in some areas. Emphasis is on risk communication and community engagement to curb spread. India has sent medical supplies to Africa CDC; travel advisories urge avoiding nonessential travel to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan until conditions normalize.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱をめぐる騒動...不正確な検査、遺体が見つからないことで人々の怒りが爆発
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言、高い重症度（死亡例あり）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダンでも確認の可能性）、渡航制限勧告が発出されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはIndiaが含まれているが、サマリーでインドは医療物資送付国として言及されるのみで、エボラ発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・南スーダンについてはサマリーに「可能性」言及のみで確認事例の明記がないため除外。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みであり、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 벌써 의심 환자만 900명 "에볼라 바이러스 비상
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already 900 suspected cases: "Ebola virus emergency."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province (Luampara area). As of May 23, 2026, cumulative suspected cases reach 904 with 119 suspected deaths, and 101 confirmed cases with 10 confirmed deaths; no recoveries reported. The ongoing crisis has displaced about 1 million people amid armed-group violence, collapsing government services, and aid shortfalls. The World Health Organization deems the DRC at very high risk for a national outbreak, though global spread remains low. A May 22 update had 204 suspected deaths, later revised downward when some deaths were attributed to non-Ebola causes or negative tests. The situation remains challenging, with active transmission and limited healthcare capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 既に疑似患者900名 「エボラウイルス緊急事態」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。確認症例101例、死亡10例、疑似患者904例を含む大規模なエボラ感染症の流行が進行中であり、フルのリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: IturiProvinceに集中した確認患者と多数の疑似患者。武装勢力による暴力、政府サービスの崩壊、約100万人の避難民発生により管理が極めて困難。WHO が国家規模の流行の非常に高いリスクを評価。国際的な感染拡大リスクは現在低いが、地域での活動的な伝播が続いており、医療対応能力が著しく限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: The Liver Doc diagnoses India's fatty liver crisis: Fight misinformation and get tested for Hepatitis viruses
article.articleSummary: Kerala-based hepatologist Dr Cyriac Abby Philips, aka 'The Liver Doc,' warns India faces a fatty liver crisis worsened by misinformation and urges testing for hepatitis viruses. Based at Rajagiri Hospital in Kochi, he champions scientific medicine and patient empathy, noting liver disease is among India’s top 10 causes of death. He explains acute liver failure can strike seemingly healthy individuals due to sudden severe damage requiring ventilation, while acute-on-chronic liver failure adds a new injury to existing cirrhosis. Geographic patterns show Hepatitis E commonly triggers acute liver failure in north India (followed by drug-induced injury), Hepatitis A in south India, and chronic Hepatitis B is prevalent in the north; Kerala reports lower rates of chronic HBV and HCV. The piece emphasizes prevention, the liver’s regenerative capacity, and the need to reclaim humane care amid healthcare misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: 肝臓専門医がインドの脂肪肝危機を診断：誤情報に対抗し、肝炎ウイルス検査を受けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ケーラ州の肝臓専門医による肝炎啓発記事。肝疾患が重要な公衆衛生課題として提示されているが、新規発生の集団発症報告ではなく、既知の地理的疾病パターンと医療啓発に関する評論的な性質の記事であるため、現在の段階では詳細な情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のインド国内の肝炎地理的パターン（東部でHEV、南部でHAV、北部でHBV優位）に関する医学専門家の啓発・評論であり、新規の感染症クラスタ発生報告ではない。ただし、肝疾患がインドの主要死因上位10位であることが強調されており、公衆衛生上の重要性は認識されている。より詳細な疫学的データ（最近の患者数増加、新規変異株検出など）の入手が必要。

article.sourceUrl: https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/japanese/tin-van/who、ベトナム保健省のエボラ出血熱対策を評価-447747.html
article.articleHeadline: WHO、ベトナム保健省のエボラ出血熱対策を評価
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Evaluates the Ebola Hemorrhagic Fever Measures of the Vietnamese Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: WHO’s Vietnam office is providing updated technical guidance to support the Ministry of Health on Ebola preparedness, including surveillance, testing, contact tracing, clinical care, infection prevention and control, risk communication, community outreach, and border measures. On May 17, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, a rare Ebola strain with no approved vaccines or treatments and generally harder to contain than Zaire ebolavirus. On May 23, the Ministry disclosed that WHO assesses the global risk of Ebola spread as 'low,' including Vietnam. WHO praised Vietnam’s proactive response and rapid strengthening of outbreak preparedness, while MoH continues to enhance risk communication to inform the public. The two organizations will maintain collaboration to prevent and respond to Ebola threats in Vietnam and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ベトナム保健省のエボラ出血熱対策を評価
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus のPHEIC宣言により公衆衛生への深刻な影響が確認され、稀なエボラ株による国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが存在。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus のPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により、DRCおよびウガンダでの流行が確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。ベトナムはWHO技術支援受け、グローバルリスク評価は『低』だが、PHEC宣言により国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry urges vigilance against new COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the Health Ministry warns vigilance against the new COVID-19 variant NB.1.8.1, a descendant of Omicron JN.1. The World Health Organization has classified NB.1.8.1 as a Variant Under Monitoring after a rapid rise in genome detections, notably in the Western Pacific region. Countries reporting increases include China, Singapore and Hong Kong. There is currently no evidence that NB.1.8.1 causes more severe illness, higher hospitalization rates, or greater mortality than prior Omicron variants. Cambodia detected the strain between May and December last year; since the start of this year, one positive case was reported on May 18 among patients seeking hospital care. Public measures urged: wear masks, wash hands with soap or alcohol-based sanitizer, cover coughs with elbow or similar, and dispose of used tissues properly. Seek medical consultation for fever, cough, headache, runny nose or breathing difficulties and continue full vaccination, including boosters.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省が新型COVID-19変異株NB.1.8.1への警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の新規変異株（NB.1.8.1）が西太平洋地域で検出されており、WHOが監視対象変異株に分類。ただし現在のところ重症度上昇の証拠がなく、IHR基準該当は限定的。情報が進展する可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCambodiaが記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事サマリーではChina、Singapore、Hong Kongが増加報告国として述べられており、このうちChina（香港含む）が対象国。Singaporeは対象国外のため除外。カンボジアで1例検出されているが、カンボジアは対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。IHR基準は2つ以上該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いが、重症度が明確に低い点でPICKUPより一段下のWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: WHO, 베트남 보건부의 선제적 에볼라 대응 태세 높이 평가
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO commends Vietnam's Ministry of Health for its proactive Ebola response readiness.
article.articleSummary: WHO commends Vietnam's Ministry of Health for proactive Ebola response readiness as Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda trigger a International Public Health Emergency (PHEIC). On May 17, WHO declared PHEIC for Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola variant with no approved vaccines or therapies, making control harder than the Zaire strain. On May 23, WHO Vietnam office stated the global risk of Ebola spread, including to Vietnam, is low. WHO provides Vietnam with latest status and guidance across surveillance, epidemiology, diagnostics, clinical management, infection prevention and control, risk communication, border screening, and medical response, reaffirming ongoing collaboration with the Ministry of Health. Vietnam's MOH is strengthening public risk communication to ensure official, accurate information on disease status and prevention measures. No Vietnam cases are reported in the article; focus remains on preparedness and coordination with WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ベトナム保健省のエボラ対策態勢の強化を高く評価
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola virusの国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言により、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも「異常/予想外」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が該当し、WHOが越境対策を強化している点で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC およびウガンダでのBundibugyo Ebola outbreakを主題としており、ベトナムは準備態勢・越境対策の文脈で言及されている。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）は明記されており、ワクチン・治療薬がない稀少な変異株という重大性が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Врач рассказала о первых симптомах лихорадки Эбола
