article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A doctor described the early symptoms of Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Influenza-like onset with fever may precede a hemorrhagic syndrome in Ebola, infectious disease specialist Yulia Minakova said on May 25. Early symptoms include fever and flu-like illness, followed by subcutaneous bleeding and then internal hemorrhages (gastrointestinal and uterine) with disseminated intravascular coagulation possible. Transmission occurs via contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person. The World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 15. By May 22, the DRC reported about 204 fatalities; CNN reported protests in eastern DRC at an Ebola treatment center after a young man’s death. Reuters on May 24 noted around 900 suspected Ebola cases identified as part of outbreak control in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がエボラ熱の初期症状について説明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが2026年5月15日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言したエボラアウトブレイク。DRCで204人の死亡、約900の疑い例が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRC（203312）でのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー内でウガンダの具体的な症例・死亡数の言及がなく、WHOの宣言対象国として列挙されている程度のため、主要な発生地はDRCのみと判断。ただし、ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため、いずれにせよverified_locationsに含めない。本イベントはWHO PHEIC（2026-05-15）として既に国際的に認識されている深刻なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Tiap 4 Menit 1 Orang Indonesia Meninggal karena Tuberkulosis - Lifestyle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One Indonesian dies of tuberculosis every four minutes — Lifestyle.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Tuberculosis (TB) remains a major public health challenge in Indonesia, with one TB death every four minutes and the country ranking second globally for TB case load. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin notes that the high case count reflects improved case finding and treatment access. Five primary symptoms to watch if they persist for two weeks or longer are: cough lasting more than two weeks; unintended weight loss; night sweats; persistent fatigue; and loss of appetite. The government pursues active TB case finding and offers free TB screening at Puskesmas community health centers. TB is a bacterial infection and is curable with proper, complete treatment; patients should not delay care and must adhere strictly to prescribed medications to prevent ongoing transmission and potential resistance.

triage.headline_ja: 4分ごとに1人のインドネシア人が結核で死亡している — ライフスタイル
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける結核の重大な公衆衛生影響（4分ごとに1死亡）が報告され、IHR基準のうち「公衆衛生への影響は深刻か」に該当。WPRO基準でも「重症度」「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当し、複数基準を満たす。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおける結核は既知の風土病だが、高い死亡率（4分ごとに1死亡）と症例数（世界2位）が報告されている。政府による積極的な対策（無料スクリーニング、治療アクセス向上）が進行中。WPRO基準の複数該当とメディア・政府の関心の高さからPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: رصد أكثر من 900 إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 Ebola virus infections detected in Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola infections detected in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases, as surveillance intensifies in the ongoing outbreak that began on May 15 in the east of the country. The World Health Organization director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus tweeted that intensified surveillance has identified over 900 suspected cases to date, including 101 confirmed, though no update on deaths was provided in his post. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with body fluids and can cause multi-organ failure. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus lineage, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment at present. In a previous update, the DRC health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Over the past half-century, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染が900件以上検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、重症度が高く、WHOから国際的警告が発出されている。確認された症例数（101例）と死亡例（204例）が多く、Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統は治療法とワクチンがない点で深刻。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に東部で開始された現在進行中のアウトブレイク。WHO事務局長による公式ツイート確認あり。Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統は治療薬・ワクチン未承認で高リスク。DRC保健省報告では204死亡/867疑い例。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Yön uutiskooste | Vantaan Korson tuhopoltosta annetaan tänään tuomio, WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nightly news roundup | Verdict to be delivered today in Korson arson case in Vantaa, WHO: over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to drive transmission mainly in the eastern regions. Over 900 suspected cases have been reported, with around 100 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 200 deaths. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus has stated that Ebola has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though the Organization notes the global risk remains low. The outbreak location and the number of cases underscore ongoing challenges in surveillance and response in the DRC. The article does not specify infection sources or exported cases. Emphasizes the need for continued international coordination, vaccination, and contact tracing to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 夜のニュースまとめ | ヴァンター市コルソ放火事件の判決が本日下される、WHO：コンゴで900件以上の疑い例エボラ患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイクであり、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言により、既に高い国際的関心がある。900件以上の疑い例と200件以上の死亡者が報告されており、特に東部地域での継続的な伝播が確認されている。国際協調、ワクチン接種、接触者追跡の強化が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Число предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой превысило 900  --  глава ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola infection cases has exceeded 900 — WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said suspected Ebola cases have surpassed 900, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus and affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with the WHO having previously declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and between people. Early symptoms include fever, muscle spasms, headache, and sore throat, potentially progressing to kidney and liver dysfunction and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. The response is complicated by the ongoing situation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, underscoring the challenges in containing this outbreak across the affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の疑い例が900例を超えた――WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは公衆衛生上重大な影響を持ち、複数国での発生は異常・予想外であり、国際的拡大リスク及び渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。WHOが既に国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言しており、即座にフルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、Ebolaの発生地域として明示されているのはDRCとウガンダ。ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため、verified_locationsからは除外。DRCは対象国（GeoNames ID: 203312）に含まれるため記載。WHOによる既宣言PHEIC、Bundibugyo ebolavirus関連、ヒト-ヒト感染、複数国での二次拡大リスク、DRC国内の複雑な状況背景により、極めて高リスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak could spiral out of control amid aid cuts, frontline doctor says
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda, including Kampala, is escalating as the World Health Organization declares an international public health emergency. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Cases are rising across DRC and into Uganda, raising fears of a crisis on the scale of West Africa's 2014 epidemic, which killed more than 11,000. The report notes limited details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or exact case counts. It emphasizes frontline health response, preparedness, and lessons from past outbreaks without providing new therapeutic options or confirmed transmission chains. No information on imported/exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が援助削減の中で制御不能に陥る可能性、最前線の医師が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率を持つ重篤な伝染病であり、DRC・ウガンダでの流行拡大は国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念となり、渡航制限や貿易への影響リスクも高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngola（対象国外）、Uganda（対象国外）が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでの流行。対象国リストに該当する国はDRCのみ。2014年西アフリカエボラ流行（11,000人以上死亡）との比較が言及されており、高い警戒が必要。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株が原因とされている。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 발생국 경유자 집중 검역···아프리카 확산에 입국 관리 강화
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensified screening for travelers transiting through Ebola-affected countries... Strengthened entry controls as Ebola spreads across Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, escalating Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda prompt South Korea’s Korea Disease Control and Prevention Agency (KDCA) to consider strengthened entry screening for travelers from Ebola-affected countries or those who transited through affected regions. The World Health Organization (WHO) has raised the Ebola risk level from high to very high and declared the outbreak an international public health emergency. KDCA plans would cover direct entrants and transit travelers, checking travel histories, assessing symptoms, and referring high-risk individuals to monitoring. DR Congo reports 867 suspected Ebola cases and 204 deaths, with WHO noting a higher suspected death toll than previously reported (177). Effective screening requires airline transit data, self-reporting, healthcare facility notification, and post-entry monitoring. Symptoms such as fever, muscle pain, vomiting, or diarrhea should prompt immediate reporting to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ発生国経由者の集中検疫···アフリカ拡散に入国管理強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的流行拡大、複数国での大規模アウトブレイク、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、各国の入国管理強化という対応から、シグナルとして識別し、フルRRA対象とすべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCとウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイク、および韓国のKDCAによる入国管理強化の検討が述べられている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態宣言を発令し、リスク評価をhighからvery highに引き上げた点は、国際的な深刻性と緊急性を示唆している。867例の疑似患者と204例の死亡が報告されており、重症度基準も明らかに満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疑似病例破900 民主剛果爆親屬燒醫療中心、搶遺體 - 趨勢
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola suspected cases exceed 900; in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, relatives set fire to a medical center and loot corpses - Trend
article.articleSummary: Ebola suspected cases exceed 900 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths as of May 24, 2026. WHO classifies domestic risk as 'very high,' though global risk remains low. The outbreak in Ituri Province is punctuated by violence against health facilities: on May 21 a treatment center in Rwampara was burned after authorities refused to release a body; on May 23 residents in Mongbwalu torched an MSF tent treating Ebola patients, allowing 18 suspected patients to escape; a May 24 assault in Mongbwalu forced evacuation of patients. The government has ordered that burials be handled officially to limit transmission and banned wakes and gatherings over 50 in the northeast. Analysts cite deep-seated distrust and insecurity hindering response; no laboratory-confirmed or imported/exported cases are noted.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑似症例が900例を超過 コンゴ民主共和国で親族が医療センターに放火し遺体を奪取 - トレンド
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（904疑似例、119疑似死亡）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、医療施設への暴力など異常事象、国際拡大リスク（隣国ルワンダでも発生地域に含まれる）、国際的な渡航制限・支援必要性が明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥーリ州での流行が主題。ルワンダはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーには「ルワンダで確認」との明記がなく、隣国としての位置づけのみ。対象国リストに基づきDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO による国内リスク評価「very high」、ただし全球リスクは「low」と記載。医療施設への暴力と住民の不信が対応を著しく阻害している状況が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pasauliui grasina mirtina Ebolos karštligė: jau įtariama daugiau nei 900 atvejų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola fever threatens the world: more than 900 cases suspected.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is facing a deadly Ebola virus disease outbreak. World Health Organization officials report more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed, with 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three large provinces in the DRC. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The DRC health ministry's latest update notes the death tally has not been updated in the briefing, while surveillance is being strengthened. Across Africa, the Ebola virus has killed more than 15,000 people in the past 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: 世界を脅かす致命的なエボラ熱：900以上の症例が疑われている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルス病の確認された集団感染であり、高い致死率と国際的な懸念を示す。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EBOV）の確認された集団感染。2026年5月25日現在、DRCの3つの大規模州で900以上の疑わしい症例、101の検査室確認症例、867の疑わしい症例中204死亡を報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は承認されたワクチンや治療法がない。ヒト-ヒト感染（体液接触）が可能。高い致死率とWHOの監視強化の報告あり。国際的な支援と関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 에볼라 의심환자 벌써 900명, 콩고 '초비상'...WHO "매우 높은 위험" 경고 - 매일경제
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Already 900 suspected Ebola cases, Congo 'extreme emergency'... WHO 'very high risk' warning - Maeil Business Newspaper
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026 local time, the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, 119 suspected deaths, and 101 confirmed cases with 10 deaths; no recoveries have been reported. Suspected cases surged from 746 on May 21 to 867 on May 22 and over 900 by May 23. Some suspected deaths may later be attributed to other diseases. The outbreak is centered in eastern Ituri Province, where armed conflict, distrust, and attacks on facilities hinder response. Two Ebola treatment centers in the Lwampala and Mongbalu areas were torched by residents. The WHO classifies internal outbreak risk as very high, though international spread remains unlikely at present. Roughly 1 million displaced people are in the region, amid clashes involving M23 militants and ISIS-linked Allied Democratic Forces.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者すでに900人、コンゴ『超非常事態』...WHO『非常に高いリスク』警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべて該当。Ebolaは確定のHigh Consequence Infectious Disease（HCID）であり、904疑い例・119疑い死亡の急速な増加、WHO『very high risk』評価、武装紛争と医療施設破壊により管理困難な状況が確認された。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのイトゥリ州東部での発生を主題としており、該当地域は対象国リストのDRC（203312）のみ。Ebola確定・疑い例の急速増加（746→904例/3日間）、死亡例報告、医療施設への攻撃による応答阻害、約100万人の避難民、武装勢力との衝突が、国内リスク『very high』と評価されている。現在国際拡大は『unlikely』と記載されているが、初期段階の疑い例急増と管理困難な環境下でのEbola確定例存在により、国際通知基準を満たす。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with about 100 laboratory-confirmed infections and more than 200 deaths as of May 25, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that containment efforts have been intensified. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri Province, a conflict-affected, hard-to-reach area that complicates detection and response. The region’s instability has driven population displacement and hampered health workers’ ability to trace contacts and provide timely care. The Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention warned of potential spread to Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, but the global risk of spread remains low. The article notes continued humanitarian needs and access challenges in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴで900件以上の疑似エボラ症例
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模な流行で、IHR基準4つ全て該当し、複数の対象国への拡大リスクがある国際的な公衆衛生上の危機。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの流行を主題とし、複数の対象国（ザンビア含む）への拡大リスクを明示している。WHO緊急事態宣言済み。紛争地域での難しい状況が対応を複雑化させており、これは管理可能性への懸念を高める。Bluedot APIの発生地域リストには多くの国が含まれているが、verified_locationsは記事の主題に基づいてDRCとザンビアのみを抽出した。

article.articleHeadline: 世銀がエボラ流行のコンゴに職員や物資を提供、資金面の準備も＝幹部
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Bank to provide staff and supplies to Ebola-hit Congo; funding preparations under way, official says.
article.articleSummary: World Bank plans to deploy staff and supplies to the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and to develop a rapid new funding package to sustain extra resources. A World Bank Global Health official told Reuters preparations include mobilizing quick funding over coming months. Ebola, which causes fever, muscle pain, vomiting, and diarrhea, spreads via body fluids, contaminated materials, and contact with deceased patients. The piece notes concerns for neighboring South Sudan and Burundi, while Uganda reports two confirmed Ebola infections with a comparatively stronger public health system but funding gaps. UN emergency funds amount to about $60 million; the United States has dispatched emergency response teams and plans to fund roughly 50 emergency clinics this week. Congo has 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths; 177 suspected Ebola deaths and about 750 suspected infections. A $250 million health project approved in March 2024 remains about $200 million unspent.

triage.headline_ja: 世銀がエボラ流行のコンゴに職員や物資を提供、資金面の準備も＝幹部
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスはハイリスク病原体であり、DRC東部での流行に対して多国間の支援体制が構築されており、国際的な拡大リスクと貿易・渡航制限の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはUS、Sudan、Burundi、Ugandaも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCの東部でのエボラ流行である。隣国への懸念は言及されるが、実際の流行の発生地域はDRC。Ugandaは2確認症例を報告しているが、主流行地はDRC。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations にはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में युवकों का अस्पताल पर हमला, इबोला संक्रमित अपने परिजनों के शव सौंपने की मांग की
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young men attack a hospital in Congo; Ebola-infected demand that the bodies of their relatives be handed over.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) escalated after a Sunday evening attack on Monbgbwalú General Hospital where Ebola patients were treated; gunfire forced evacuations as attackers demanded the bodies of two relatives. The incident marks the third assault on healthcare facilities in a week amid shortages for Ebola care. The World Health Organization has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. To limit transmission, authorities barred gatherings of more than 50 people at funerals and prayer services in northeastern Congo. A Doctors Without Borders tent for suspected and confirmed Ebola cases was attacked and burned; 18 evacuees previously left the facility. In Ravampára town, another treatment center was set ablaze after families were refused access to the body of a deceased Ebola patient. The outbreak is deemed very high risk for Congo, with global risk low. As of May 25, 2026, Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, mostly in Ituri, up from over 700.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの病院が若者に襲撃される。エボラ感染者の親族の遺体の引き渡しを要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。エボラウイルス疾患の国際懸念事項宣言、複数の医療施設への攻撃による感染対策の阻害、904件の疑い患者報告があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: WHOが国際懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、医療施設への複数の暴力的攻撃により感染対策が著しく阻害されている。患者数の急増（700人以上から904人へ）と地域的な葬儀制限措置の導入が確認される。DRCのみが実際の発生地であり、イツリ州はDRC内の州。

article.articleHeadline: NCDC places Nigeria at high risk of Ebola importation
article.articleSummary: Nigeria is at high risk of Ebola importation due to ongoing transmission in the DRC and Uganda and international travel. Three Red Cross volunteers in the DRC died from suspected Ebola, likely after handling dead bodies; they worked in Mongwalu, Ituri, and died between May 5–16, 2026: Udumusi Augustin, Sezabo Katanabo, Ajiko Chandiru Viviane. The DRC outbreak reports more than 200 suspected deaths and over 850 suspected cases. WHO has declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Africa CDC identifies 10 at-risk countries. Nigeria’s NCDC says the risk is high; the National Emergency Operations Centre is on alert with intensified event surveillance. Travellers from affected countries should monitor health for 21 days and report fever, weakness, vomiting, or unexplained bleeding. Nigeria has no confirmed cases and calls for a full National Ebola Preparedness Framework.

triage.headline_ja: NCDCがナイジェリアをエボラ出血熱輸入の高リスク国に指定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、およびWPRO基準複数該当。WHOが国際懸念公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済みで、対象国（DRC、ナイジェリア）での確認あり。
triage.notes: WHOが既にPHEIC宣言済み。DRC（イトゥリ州）での確認済み患者死亡と850件以上の疑い患者。ナイジェリアについては記事が「高リスク」と警告しているが、確認患者なし。DRC が対象国であり、ナイジェリアは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Africa CDC が10カ国を高リスクとして指定。

article.articleHeadline: PSO vadovas: Kongo DR įtariamų Ebolos karštligės atvejų skaičius viršijo 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: The number of suspected Ebola virus disease cases in DR Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo is confronting an Ebola virus disease outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections reported by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus via social media. A separate DR Congo health ministry update states 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in three major Central African provinces, with the outbreak declared on May 15. Ebola virus disease is transmitted through direct contact with body fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure. There is no licensed vaccine or treatment for this Bundibugyo strain. The WHO chief noted that surveillance has been intensified, and no new death toll was provided. Across Africa in the last five decades, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病の疑い例数が900を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて満たす。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模発生で、900例超の疑い例と101例の確定例が報告されており、死亡例も報告されている。コンゴ民主共和国での確認された発生地域であり、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）による大規模発生。900例超の疑い例、101例の確定例、204名の死亡が報告されている。有効なワクチンや治療法がないBundibugyo株であり、公衆衛生上の脅威は極めて高い。WHO事務局長による社会メディアでの発表により国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Yön uutiskooste | Vantaan Korson tuhopoltosta annetaan tänään tuomio, WHO: Kongossa yli 900 epäiltyä ebolatapausta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nightly News Roundup | Verdict to be handed down today in Korson arson case in Vantaa, WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with about 100 laboratory-confirmed infections and more than 200 deaths. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak meets the criteria for a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though the risk of international spread remains low. The update emphasizes ongoing case detection, laboratory confirmation, and contact tracing, with international coordination to bolster health authorities in the DRC. The outbreak remains concentrated in eastern provinces, underscoring the need for sustained local response and vigilant monitoring for cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 夜間ニュース速報｜ヴァンター市のコルソン放火事件の判決が本日下される、WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑い例が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900件超の疑い例、200件超の死亡）、異常性（大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクあり。WHO緊急事態宣言基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。WHOが公衆衛生緊急事態の基準を満たすと明言。東部地域での発生が確認されており、越境感染のリスク監視が強調されている。国際調整と技術支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Why Is This Outbreak Different This Time?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda prompts WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 17, 2026, with an Emergency Committee convened on May 20. The current outbreak centers on the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, a rarer form for which there is no approved vaccine or therapeutic. The PHEIC decision reflects urgency to accelerate global action, contrasting with the 2013-14 West Africa outbreak when a PHEIC was delayed for nearly a year. Historical context recalls ZMapp and other interventions: ZMapp received emergency use authorization in 2014 under MEURI and later FDA approval for REGN-EB3 in 2020, with REGN-EB3 ultimately more effective than ZMapp in later outbreaks. The article emphasizes Western delays in 2013 and ties the current lack of vaccine/therapy to the quicker declaration. No case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：今回の流行が異なる理由は何か？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言した、コンゴおよびウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行。ワクチンや治療薬が承認されていないBundibugyo株であり、国際的対応が急速に求められている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴとウガンダにおける流行が言及されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）と緊急委員会の招集（5月20日）は、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す重要な指標。Bundibugyo株はより稀な株型であり、承認済みワクチンまたは治療薬が存在しないことが特筆される。具体的な症例数は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Сусідні з ДР Конго країни вводять заходи, спрямовані на обмеження вірусу Ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neighboring countries of the Democratic Republic of the Congo are introducing measures aimed at containing the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Neighboring countries to the Democratic Republic of Congo are tightening measures to contain the Ebola outbreak centered in the DRC, reintroducing border screening and hygiene practices used during the Covid-19 pandemic. Uganda has banned large cultural events as a precaution and reported three new Ebola cases, bringing its total to five. Across Eastern and Southern Africa, health authorities and humanitarian groups are intensifying border checks, surveillance, and community outreach to curb cross-border transmission. The World Health Organization reported as of Sunday over 900 suspected cases, including 101 confirmed cases and 177 deaths related to the outbreak. The WHO has deemed the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). Residents are urged to report symptoms promptly and follow hygiene guidance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の隣接国がエボラウイルスの封じ込めを目指した対策を導入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO PHEIC指定されたエボラアウトブレイク、複数国への拡大、死亡事例多数、各国が国境措置を実施中。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはエボラアウトブレイクがDRCおよびウガンダで発生していることを述べているが、対象国リストはDRCのみを含む（ウガンダは対象国外）。WHO PHEICが宣言されており、複数国への国境措置実施、101確認症例・177死亡が報告されている。イベント日時は2026年5月で設定されており、この時点では未来日付だが、シグナルの重要性に変わりはない。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases top 900 in DRC, WHO chief says - Middle East and Africa - The Jakarta Post
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 101 confirmed, as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak was declared May 15 and is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccine or treatments. DR Congo’s health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus highlighted scaled-up surveillance in the DRC response. In Uganda, three new Ebola cases were confirmed, bringing total confirmed infections there since May 15 to five, with one death. The African Union’s Africa CDC warns 10 countries at risk due to high mobility and insecurity: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ疑い例が900例を超える、WHO事務局長が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な流行、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス疾患の大規模流行であり、ワクチン・治療法がない株による発生は極めて懸念度が高い。
triage.notes: DRCで901例の疑い例（確認例101例）、204死亡が報告され、ウガンダで3例の新規確認例が発生。Bundibugyo株は承認されたワクチン・治療法がない。アフリカCDCは10カ国（対象国ではAngolaが含まれているが記事本体ではサマリーの記述に基づきDRCとZambiaのみを対象国として検証）。多くの隣接国がリスト化されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC、Zambiaのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Jangkitan Ebola terus meningkat, lebih 100 disahkan di Congo | Berita Harian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections continue to rise, more than 100 confirmed in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 100 confirmed cases as the outbreak expands. As of May 23, 11 health zones across Congo have been affected since the outbreak began on May 15 in Ituri, with over 900 suspected cases. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. Health authorities are conducting ongoing monitoring, screening and awareness campaigns, stressing vigilance and adherence to preventive measures. WHO reports at least seven confirmed deaths in Congo. In neighboring Uganda, three new cases were announced, increasing total confirmed cases there to five. Congo has suspended social activities, including sports, in Ituri to curb transmission. CDC Africa lists 10 at‑risk countries (Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Congo, Ethiopia, South Sudan, Zambia). WHO has raised the alert level to very high; neighboring nations are tightening travel from Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染が増加続ける、コンゴで100例以上確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は深刻な公衆衛生影響（100例以上、死亡7例）、異常性（突発的発生5月15日開始）、複数国への国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に5例、10カ国が高リスク）、渡航制限実施（WHO警告レベルが非常に高い）を示す。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドに複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーから実際の感染発生は主にDRCで確認（100例以上、7死亡）。ウガンダで3新規例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。CDC資料の「10カ国リスク」言及も、対象国はZambiaのみ。他の記載国（Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Angola, Burundi, CAR, Ethiopia, South Sudan）は対象外。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट: न‍िगरानी बढ़ते ही सामने आए मामले, कांगो में 101 पॉज‍िट‍िव केस, 900 से ज्यादा संदिग्ध
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola crisis: cases emerge as surveillance intensifies; 101 positive cases in Congo, more than 900 suspected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province, shows 101 laboratory-confirmed cases among over 900 suspected as surveillance intensifies. As of May 25, 2026, Ituri’s roughly 5 million residents are amid conflict-driven displacement and humanitarian needs, with about 25% requiring aid and 20% already displaced. Violence is forcing health workers and communities to flee, complicating case identification and contact tracing and delaying treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted ongoing WHO and humanitarian partnerships in remote and unsafe areas to deliver essential health services and rebuild trust. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16; on May 22, WHO raised national risk to very high and regional risk to high. Ebola transmission originated from wildlife—bats, civets, and some primates—to humans, then spread via contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated items.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：監視体制の強化に伴い事例が判明、コンゴで101例の陽性事例、900例以上が疑い事例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確定事例101例、疑い事例900例以上という重大な公衆衛生上の影響、国際関心の深刻性（PHEIC宣言済み）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクすべてが認められ、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定事例101例、疑い事例900例以上が報告されている。2026年5月16日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）が宣言済み。武装勢力による紛争、医療従事者の逃亡、住民の避難など、症例特定と接触者追跡が著しく困難な状況にある。WHO事務局長による言及があり、国際社会の関心は極めて高い。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Nincs fék a halálos víruson: átlépte a lélektani határt a fertőzöttek száma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There's no stopping the deadly virus: the number of infections has crossed the psychological threshold.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus outbreak intensifies in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province near Bunia. Gyan suspected cases exceed 900 with 119 deaths; WHO classifies the region as very high risk. The virus spreads via highly infectious corpses, prompting authorities to ban traditional mass wakes and require armed protection for funerals amid violence and mistrust. The crisis coincides with armed conflict and about 1 million people displaced, fueling fears the virus could reach large Bunia-area refugee camps where crowded, poor hygiene could drive transmission. Health facilities are overwhelmed as international aid wanes; hospitals lack PPE, testing kits, and safe-burial supplies. Frontline clinicians operate with basic tools like hand sanitizer and simple masks against an untreatable virus with no available vaccine. The convergence of violence, distrust, and collapsing health systems jeopardizes containment.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なウイルスは止まらない：感染者数が心理的しきい値を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスの急速な拡大、900件以上の疑い例、健康システムの崩壊、難民キャンプ流入リスクが認められ、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョ株エボラウイルスの急速な拡大。疑い例900件超、死亡119件。イツリ州のブニア地域中心。武装紛争と約100万人の避難民との同時発生。難民キャンプへの流入リスク高い。国際支援の減少と医療体制の崩壊が懸念される。ウガンダの地理的近接性も注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Количество возможных случаев заражения Эболой превысило 900 - Свободный взгляд
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of possible Ebola infection cases has exceeded 900 - Free View.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda has surpassed 900 suspected cases as of May 25, 2026, with over 200 suspected deaths and 10 laboratory-confirmed fatalities. First cases were reported May 5 in Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter. The World Health Organization (WHO) has declared Ebola in DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern, later upgrading the risk assessment to very high. Ongoing violence between rebels and government forces hampers response, driving displacement of medical and humanitarian workers and hindering contact tracing and early detection. Russian authorities say there is no spread to Russia; a Rospotrebnadzor team is deployed for epidemiological investigation, and Russian specialists are planned to travel to Africa to assist in the Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の可能性がある症例数が900を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ大規模アウトブレイク（900+疑似症例、200+死亡、WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項として宣言）は、深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限リスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクが記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。900+疑似症例、200+疑似死亡、10確認死亡、WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言、およびリスク評価の最高段階への格上げにより、このイベントは直ちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施対象となる。反政府勢力との紛争が対応を著しく阻害している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand in erhöhter Ebola-Bereitschaft - Gesundheitsministerium bestätigt keine Fälle im Land - Pattaya Mail
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand on heightened Ebola alert - Ministry of Health confirms no cases in the country - Pattaya Mail
article.articleSummary: Thailand raises Ebola surveillance after WHO declares Congo and Uganda outbreaks a global health emergency. From May 21, Thailand designates Congo and Uganda as high-risk zones for communicable diseases, triggering stricter airport and border controls nationwide. No Ebola cases have been reported in Thailand; hospitals, laboratories, and rapid response teams are on heightened alert. Travelers from high-risk countries must register with the Thailand Digital Arrival Card and undergo 21 days of post-entry health monitoring, with immediate referral if symptoms develop. Ebola is transmitted via direct contact with blood, body fluids, contaminated objects, or infected animals such as fruit bats; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, and unusual bleeding; case fatality estimates range 40–80%. Travel to affected areas should be limited to essential travel; returnees should seek medical care if symptoms arise within 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: タイがエボラ出血熱への警戒を強化 - 保健省は国内での症例がないことを確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。エボラウイルス病はレベル4の重大感染症であり、アウトブレイク宣言時の国境検疫強化は公衆衛生上の高い懸念を示す。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダのエボラアウトブレイク宣言とそれに対するタイの対応措置を記述。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイでは症例報告がないが、WHO緊急宣言を受けた国境検疫強化（空港・陸路国境での厳格な管理、21日間の健康監視）が実施されており、予防的対応シグナルとして重要。エボラの致死率40-80%という高い重症度情報も含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand impone cuarentena obligatoria a viajeros del Congo por Ebola, incluso sin síntomas - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand imposes mandatory quarantine on travelers from Congo due to Ebola, even without symptoms - Notiulti
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bundibugyo region, Uganda prompts Thailand to impose mandatory quarantine on travelers arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, regardless of symptoms. Following the WHO declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, Thai authorities tightened border controls and activated BSL-3 laboratories to conduct rapid tests. The Ministry of Health reports no Ebola cases detected domestically; surveillance remains vigilant. Quarantine applies to passengers from affected zones and those with recent travel history to the DRC. Travelers are advised to follow quarantine protocols and report any symptoms on arrival, even if not Ebola related. Airport screening is intensified in collaboration with the WHO to prevent any cases from slipping through, and hospitals have been mobilized to handle possible imported cases. Authorities emphasize there is no evidence of spread beyond confirmed transmission zones.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、エボラ出血熱によりコンゴからの渡航者に症状がなくても強制隔離を実施 - Notiulti
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO公開健康緊急事態宣言、国際的な移動制限措置、複数国での対応などシグナル性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「ウガンダのブンディブギョ地域でのエボラアウトブレイク」と明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCはアウトブレイク発生国として言及され、タイは検疫措置を実施している対象国として確認された。WHOが公開健康緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している点も確認。複数国での同時対応とWHOの国際的認識がシグナルの強度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον ιό Έμπολα: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα στο Κονγκό, ακόμη 10 χώρες σε απειλή - Dnews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus alert: More than 900 suspected cases in Congo, ten more countries at risk - Dnews
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has generated more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The ongoing outbreak centers on the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, which has no vaccines or therapies and can yield fatality rates up to 50%. The DRC declared the outbreak on May 15. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A recent official health ministry update reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. Africa CDC warned that ten additional African countries are at risk, including South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia, highlighting the transnational threat of Ebola spread across the region. Symptoms include hemorrhagic fever; surveillance and containment efforts are being intensified.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスアラート：コンゴで900件以上の疑い例、さらに10カ国が危機にさらされている - Dnews
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事に列挙された周辺国（南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、コンゴ、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国）の中から、対象国リストに含まれるのはザンビアのみ。DRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致死率最大50％）による確認感染101例、死亡204例と深刻。

article.articleHeadline: อีโบลาสายพันธุ์หายาก คร่าชีวิตแล้ว 200 รายในสาธารณรัฐประชาธิปไตยคองโก | เดลินิวส์
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rare Ebola virus strain has killed 200 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo | Daily News
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease, caused by a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, has killed at least 204 people among about 867 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since May 15, 2026. Uganda has reported 3 cases with 1 death. Africa CDC is monitoring bordering and nearby countries, including Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo (Congo-Brazzaville), DR Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. Existing Ebola vaccines target the Zaire strain; WHO and partners are considering using vaccines or therapies still in development to counter Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs by direct contact with bodily fluids of infected humans or animals. The virus previously caused only two outbreaks (2007, 2015) with about 30% fatality. Overall Ebola case fatality averages around 50%, but past outbreaks ranged from 25% to 90%. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms resemble flu, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and possible bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: 稀なエボラウイルス株がコンゴ民主共和国で200人の死亡者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の多国家集団発生（DRC、ウガンダ）で深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い国際波及リスク、医学的に異常な高死亡率を示す。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strainは稀な株で既存ワクチン（Zaire株対象）の有効性が限定的。ウガンダでも症例確認済み。Africa CDCが複数国での監視体制を構築中。対象国リストから検証：DRC（主発生地）、Zambia（リスク監視対象）を verified_locations に含める。その他アフリカ諸国（スーダン、アンゴラ等）は対象外リストのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄市首例本土登革熱「規避疫調」　衛生局依法從重裁罰 | yam News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung City's first locally transmitted dengue fever case 'evading epidemiological investigation' — Health Bureau imposes heavier penalties in accordance with law | yam News
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City reported the nation's first locally transmitted dengue fever case this year, in Qianzhen District. The patient initially refused to share travel or activity traces, delaying epidemiological investigation; after thorough interviewing, the case admitted visits to Renwu, Daliao, Xinxing, and Lingya districts in Kaohsiung and to Pingtung County, severely complicating source identification and raising community transmission risk. The Health Bureau fined the case under the Infectious Disease Control Act, amounting to NT$180,000. City authorities activated a cross-agency emergency response, carrying out vector-control and chemical treatment around the residence and workplace, and expanded testing near the patient's activity footprints to nearly 120 people. On-site inspections found dirty sites and standing water, potentially undermining control efforts. Citizens are urged to practice surveillance, drainage, cleaning, and scrubbing; seek prompt medical care for fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia, or rash and report recent travel history.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市首例本土登革熱「規避疫調」　衛生局依法從重裁罰
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。地元当局による積極的な対応と社会的関心から、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事はタイワン高雄市における本土感染登革熱の初症例を報じている。患者は疫学調査回避により罰金18万台湾ドル、複数地区での活動歴が判明し二次感染リスク顕著。当局は約120人の検査拡大と媒介蚊駆除を実施。Bluedot APIはフィリピンの地名（Soccsksargen、Daliao）を含めているが、記事内容の主題はタイワン高雄市の事例であり、フィリピンでの発生報告は確認されない。よってverified_locationsはTaiwanのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Megszólalt a WHO-vezér: szintet lépett a terjedő vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO chief has spoken: the spreading virus has stepped up a level
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that a deadly, fast-spreading Ebola virus outbreak has escalated to the highest risk level and a Public Health Emergency of International Concern has been declared. The outbreak's epicenter is the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 82 officially confirmed cases and seven deaths, while authorities monitor about 750 suspected cases and investigate roughly 177 deaths likely caused by the virus. Officials warn that official figures likely understate the true burden due to ongoing surveillance and testing. Uganda, a neighboring country, has stabilized the situation through strict measures and intensive contact tracing, a key factor in preventing a wider regional catastrophe.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が声明：拡大するウイルスが警戒レベルを引き上げた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの流行がPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言され、IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。深刻な国際的公衆衛生危機である。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダは状況を安定化させていると述べられており、主な感染の中心地はコンゴ民主共和国であるため、verified_locationsはコンゴ民主共和国のみとした。PHEICの宣言は国際的かつ最高レベルのシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand to quarantine travelers arriving from Congo for 21 days even without Ebola symptoms - VnExpress International
article.articleSummary: Thailand will quarantine travelers arriving from Congo (DRC) for 21 days even without Ebola symptoms, following WHO’s May 17 declaration that the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda constitutes a public health emergency of international concern. There is no vaccine or officially approved treatment for this strain, and the DRC outbreak is worsening. Thai authorities have intensified border screening for travelers from affected areas. As of May 22, 10 travelers—8 from Uganda and 2 from the DRC—were screened on arrival with no symptoms and are under 21-day observation, required to report health status regularly. The move aligns with tightened measures in Southeast Asia, with Indonesia, Singapore, Malaysia, and Vietnam also boosting monitoring of Ebola-affected travelers.

triage.headline_ja: タイ、エボラ症状がなくてもコンゴからの到着者を21日間隔離へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（WHO PHEIC宣言済み）、異常性、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施が確認されており4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準においても全5基準に該当し、既に複数国で対応措置が実施されているシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreakはWHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。DRC・ウガンダでの原発生地が確認され、複数のSEA国（タイ、インドネシア、ベトナム）で既に検疫・スクリーニング強化措置が実施されている。シンガポールとマレーシアも記事に記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola response: MONUSCO hands over vehicles to WHO to boost field mobility in Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) continues as MONUSCO hands over a first batch of vehicles (five motorcycles, two ambulances, two 4x4s) to WHO in Bunia to boost field mobility, with a plan to provide additional ambulances, armored vehicles, motorcycles and 4x4s. The move aims to reach populations in hard‑to‑reach, insecure areas, complementing transport of medical supplies from Nairobi and Kinshasa. The outbreak was declared on 16 May 2026 in Ituri and is expanding across three provinces and six health zones in Ituri. Provincial authorities on 22 May announced restrictive measures: limits on public gatherings, suspension of local sports, and mandatory handwashing facilities. Dr. Richard Fotsing of WHO stressed that increased logistical capacity is needed to prevent spread beyond borders. Challenges include insecurity, limited treatment capacity, and community resistance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応：MONUSCOがイトゥリ地域での野外機動性強化のため車両をWHOに引き継ぎ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目に該当。エボラウイルス病の新規発生・拡大、国境外への拡大リスク、および国際支援の必要性が明確に認識されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)のイトゥリ、北キブ、南キブの3州にわたるエボラ発生を報道している。Nauirobi(ケニア)は医療物資の運送中継地として言及されているが、イベント発生地ではないため除外した。DRCのみが対象国リストに含まれる検証対象地域である。2026年5月16日に宣言された新規アウトブレイク、3州6保健地域への拡大、国境外への拡大リスク、社会的制限措置の実施により、IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で高いリスク評価を示している。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: A New Ebola Variant Declared in Ituri Threatens Children's Lives
article.articleSummary: New Ebola outbreak declared in Ituri Province, DR Congo, across Bunia, Mongwalu, and Rwampara health zones after Kinshasa announced on 18 May 2026. The outbreak involves a newly identified Ebola variant that matches no previously known strain and currently has no vaccine available. As of 18 May 2026, 246 suspected cases and 80 deaths have been reported, including 4 confirmed positive cases. Ituri hosts more than 900,000 internally displaced people, with children among the most exposed amid conflict, malnutrition, and severely limited healthcare access. Responders emphasize rapid, coordinated measures focusing on hygiene promotion, infection prevention and control, and protection of affected children. World Vision is cooperating with health authorities and partners, prioritizing child protection and preventive messaging. The report provides no details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo: イトゥリ州で宣言された新型エボラウイルス変異体が子どもの生命を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。新規未知のエボラウイルス変異体で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、ワクチン未開発、国際的拡大リスク、246疑似患者80死亡が報告されており、ウイルス学的にも疫学的にも異常・予想外の事象である。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事では主にDRCのイトゥリ州での新型エボラ変異体アウトブレイクが中心。ルワンダはKigali Provinceが地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの確認報告はなく、DRCのみが主題。90万人以上のIDPが存在する脆弱な環境での流行であり、公衆衛生危機の深刻度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS reporta más de 900 casos sospechosos de ébola y 101 confirmados en República Democrática del Congo, mientras la violencia en Ituri frena el rastreo de contactos y complica la atención médica
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases and 101 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, as violence in Ituri slows contact tracing and complicates medical care.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed cases are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, according to the World Health Organization. Ongoing armed conflict, internal displacement, fear, and the departure of health and humanitarian personnel are severely hindering contact tracing and medical care. Ituri, with nearly 5 million residents, faces acute vulnerability: about one in four people needs humanitarian assistance and one in five are internally displaced. The violence is forcing people to flee and complicating surveillance, early case detection, and timely care. Trust between communities and health workers is eroding, further reducing reporting and cooperation with contact tracing. The outbreak's epicenter in Ituri compounds containment difficulties, underscoring the need for safe access and robust epidemiological follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主共和国コンゴでエボラ疑い900例以上、確定診断101例を報告。イトゥリでの暴力により接触者追跡が遅延し医療対応が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当：公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900例以上の疑い患者、確定101例）、異常で予想外（出血熱の大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク（紛争下での移動制限困難）、渡航制限の可能性。加えてWPRO基準でも重症度、長期曝露リスク、管理可能性で懸念あり。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高致死率の病原体であり、紛争地域での流行拡大は制御困難。武装勢力による暴力、保健施設への信頼喪失、接触者追跡の破綻により、国際的な感染拡大リスクが急速に高まる。WHOによる公式報告があり、国際社会の対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 900 de persoane ar fi contactat deja febra hemoragică Ebola în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 people are said to have already come into contact with Ebola hemorrhagic fever in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola hemorrhagic fever cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The health ministry’s latest tally released Saturday cites 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with case fatality up to 50%. The WHO has declared an international health emergency in response to the crisis. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in the past five decades, with mortality ranging from 25% to 90% depending on the outbreak and care context.

triage.headline_ja: 900人以上がすでにコンゴでエボラ出血熱に接触したと言われている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生であり、204名の死亡、101名の確定患者、900名以上の接触者が報告されており、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はシグナルとして優先度が高い。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であり、ワクチンや特異的治療がなく、致死率最大50%と高い。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済みであり、多数の死亡者と確定患者が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Strah zbog ebole sve veći: WHO sumnja na više od 900 slučajeva u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola is growing: WHO suspects more than 900 cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared on 15 May 2026. As of 25 May 2026, the ministry of health lists 867 suspected cases with 204 deaths; the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed, though it does not specify a death toll in the latest update by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for this Bundibugyo outbreak, and case fatality can reach about 50%. In Africa, Ebola has caused over 15,000 lives in the past five decades, with reported mortality ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスへの恐れが高まっている：WHOはコンゴで900件以上の症例を疑っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO/PHEIC宣言済み、死亡率50％の重篤なアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: DRC内でのBundibugyo Ebola virus アウトブレイク。WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月）。867-900件以上の疑い例、101件確定、204死亡報告。ワクチンや特異的治療がなく、致命率約50％と極めて重篤。アフリカ地域での過去50年のエボラによる死亡数は15,000以上。国際的対応が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: WHO sumnja na više od 900 slučajeva ebole u Kongu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suspects more than 900 Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization (WHO) suspects more than 900 Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections as of May 25, 2026. The DR Congo Ministry of Health reports 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the latest tally. The outbreak, declared on May 15, 2026, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment, with mortality potentially up to 50%. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). Across Africa, Ebola outbreaks over the past 50 years have killed more than 15,000 people, with case fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90%, per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでの1000件以上のエボラ疑い例を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確認された outbreak、PHEIC宣言、高い致死率（最大50%）、国際的な拡大リスク、DRCの医療システム容量不足により国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus系統によるoutbreak。PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチン・特異的治療法なし。過去50年のアフリカ全体でのエボラ感染での致死数15,000人超。DRCの医療体制での管理困難性が高い。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue faces a 'swarm'
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Brazil faces a widening spread even as the Wolbachia-infected mosquito program expands. Aedes aegypti mosquitoes injected with Wolbachia, nicknamed 'wolbitos', are bred at the world’s largest factory in Curitiba, inaugurated in 2025. The facility can produce up to 100 million eggs per week, stored in capsules and shipped to urban areas where they will hatch to form a dengue-blocking population. Brazilian researchers say the Wolbachia-infected insects have protected millions, but dengue is spreading faster than breeding and shipping can keep up. Climate change is accelerating transmission, with the south of Brazil, once cooler and dengue-free, now seeing the disease. In the breeding room, Moreira and staff maintain ideal temperatures as mosquitoes are fed warm horse blood and sugar water. The program operates at scale to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が「大量発生」に直面
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱の急速な広がりと気候変動による北上が報告されているが、対象国ではないため国際的波及リスク評価が限定的。情報が技術的対策（ウォルバキア蚊プログラム）中心で、患者数・死亡数等の重症度指標が不明。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。記事はブラジルの技術的対策（ウォルバキア蚊プログラム）の拡大と、それでも制御しきれないデング熱の急速な広がりを報告。気候変動による影響も指摘されているが、患者数、重症度、死亡数等の定量的な健康影響が記載されていない。WATCH判定は、スクリーニング基準複数該当と社会的関心があるが、フルRRA実施の重症度証拠が不足しているため。

article.articleHeadline: How Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak complicated by aid cuts, armed rebels and anger
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo, centered in Ituri Province, worsened by armed conflict, aid cuts, and local backlash. As of 25 May 2026, the Congolese Ministry of Health reports about 904 suspected cases, mostly in Ituri, with 119 deaths per ministry tallies (regional counts list ~220). Cases also appear in North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission to Uganda. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain involved has no approved vaccine or treatment. Response led by the government with rebel authorities and aid groups is hampered by insecurity and an estimated near‑million displacement, raising risk to Bunia’s camps. Attacks on Ebola treatment centers (e.g., Monbgwalu) and arson at two health facilities reflect anger over governance, protection, and burial protocols. Aid cuts have reduced PPE, testing kits, and body bags, constraining detection and containment; the outbreak has been declared a global health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の流行に対抗：援助削減、武装勢力、怒りによって複雑化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で約900症例、死亡約119-220件、国際的な越境感染（ウガンダ）、グローバルヘルス緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの越境感染に言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、約900症例、110-220死亡、治療法なし、グローバルヘルス緊急事態宣言済みという点でWHO通知基準を満たす。武装紛争、援助削減、地域住民の反発により対応が著しく阻害されており、管理可能性が低い状態。

article.articleHeadline: 健康網》WHO示警伊波拉疫情拉警報！ 感染方式、高風險族群一次看 - 自由健康網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HealthNet: WHO Issues an Ebola Outbreak Warning! Transmission Routes and High-Risk Groups at a Glance - Freedom Health Net
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a cross-border threat with over 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections. The DRC has reported 204 deaths across three provinces; WHO has elevated the regional risk to very high and classifies the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The current strain is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. Transmission is primarily via direct contact with the blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects of infected individuals, and not through airborne routes. High-risk groups include healthcare workers, family and intimate contacts, funeral attendees, and hunters who encounter infected animals. Symptoms progress from fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, and sore throat to vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and bleeding, with incubation 2–21 days. Taiwan maintains a Level 2 travel advisory; no local cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: WHO示警エボラ疫情警報！感染方式、高リスク集団を一目で確認 - 自由健康網
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。既にPHEIC認定済み。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、204死亡、101確認感染、900超の疑い患者を報告。WHOはすでにPHEIC認定、地域的リスクを非常に高いと評価している。Taiwanは記事内で言及されているが、地域の関連情報提供の背景であり、実際の発生地ではない（台湾は旅行警告レベル2で確認患者なし）。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: ¿La movilidad internacional eleva el riesgo de casos importados de ébola en el Mundial?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Does international mobility increase the risk of imported Ebola cases during the World Cup?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, presents a travel-related risk during the 2026 FIFA World Cup hosted by Mexico, the United States, and Canada (June 11–July 17; 104 matches). In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities report more than 900 suspected Ebola cases and over 100 laboratory-confirmed, with deaths under investigation. The CDC considers the risk of sustained spread in the United States low but urges case identification, testing, and biosecurity for health workers and laboratories. The WHO notes conflict, displacement, and limited contact tracing complicating containment at the source. The Bundibugyo strain has no widely approved vaccine or licensed antibody treatment, underscoring early detection, safe isolation, and contact tracing. Transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects from a symptomatic person; airports, hospitals, and hotels are higher risk than stadiums, necessitating enhanced surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的な人の移動は、ワールドカップ中のエボラ輸入症例のリスクを高めるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際イベント中の輸入症例リスクは極めて高いシグナルである。
triage.notes: 対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーでは、DRCにおける900件以上の疑い例と100件以上の確認症例、および2026年ワールドカップ開催国（米国、メキシコ、カナダ）での輸入症例リスクを述べており、DRCが疾患の実発生地点である。Bundibugyo株はワクチンや承認された治療法が限定的という点でも懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Co wydarzyło się w nocy? Katastrofa na Filipinach, Ebola szerzy się w Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What happened overnight? Disaster in the Philippines, Ebola is spreading in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Angeles City, Philippines: a nine-story hotel under construction collapsed overnight, with at least three dead, 17 workers missing, and a rescued individual who initially had a pulse but later died; another worker suffered cardiac arrest beneath the rubble. A 65-year-old Malaysian was found dead in a neighboring hotel; authorities are investigating whether an unauthorised tenth floor (featuring a pool) contributed to the collapse. Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province): Ebola linked to the Bundibugyo strain shows a growing outbreak with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections; authorities report 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no approved vaccine or specific therapy; WHO warns of very high risk domestically but low cross-border spread risk. Data current as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 夜間に何が起こったか？フィリピンで災害、コンゴでエボラが拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。DRCのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクは119名の死亡と900件以上の疑似症例があり、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: フィリピンの建設中ホテル崩落はサマリーに記載されているが、感染症イベントではないため除外。DRCのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイクが主要なシグナルで、119名の死亡、900件以上の疑似症例、101件の確定症例を報告。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がない株であり、WHO国内リスク「極度に高い」と評価。2026年5月25日時点の情報。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα ανακοίνωσε ο ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: More than 900 suspected cases announced by WHO
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is battling an Ebola outbreak declared May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain—the rare form for which there are no vaccines or approved therapies. WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said that surveillance shows more than 900 suspected Ebola infections to date in the DRC, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases. In the most recent official tally, the health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing outbreak. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, has caused at least 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past fifty years, with case-fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90%. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern. No details on index cases or transmission chains are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：WHOが900件以上の疑似症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、900件超の疑似症例、確認症例101件、死亡204件、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。ワクチンや承認済み治療法がない希少株であり、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響は明白。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は珍しいエボラ株であり、ワクチン・承認済み治療法がない点が重要。WHO緊急委員会による国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）宣言済み。発生地域フィールドにはAfricaも含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのアウトブレイクであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Peste 900 de cazuri suspecte, identificate în RD Congo, anunţă şeful OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 900 suspected cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, says the WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, authorities report more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, amid intensified surveillance in the outbreak response. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo lineage, declared on May 15; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. Earlier updates cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and can lead to severe bleeding and multi-organ failure. The disease has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in the past five decades. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted the intensified surveillance but did not provide an updated death toll.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑い例が特定されたとWHO事務局長が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（15,000人以上の死亡、101人の確認例）、異常性（新しいBundibugyo系統の発症宣言）、国際的な拡大リスク（ヒト-ヒト感染可能な出血性ウイルス）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが全て該当（4/4）。WPRO基準でも重症度（確認死亡例、多臓器不全の可能性）、流行しやすさ（体液接触による直接感染）、管理可能性（WHO事務局長が言及、ワクチンおよび治療法が存在しない）が該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルスは既承認ワクチンおよび治療法が存在しないという重大な公衆衛生的懸念がある。3州にわたる拡大が報告されており、サーベイランスの強化が進行中。WHO事務局長の言及により国際的な認識も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie de Ebola din Congo: Peste 900 de cazuri suspecte, dintre care 101 confirmate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: Over 900 suspected cases, of which 101 are confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo includes over 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Surveillance has intensified in response to the outbreak declared on May 15 caused by the Bundibugyo strain; there are no vaccines or approved treatments for this strain. Earlier government briefings reported 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths across three central provinces. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with body fluids, potentially causing severe hemorrhage and organ failure. In Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people over the past five decades. The WHO post does not provide an updated death toll.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：900件以上の疑い例、101件の確定例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラの大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ流行は極めて危険。ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、過去50年間でアフリカで15,000人以上の死亡。DRCコンゴ中部3州で204人の死亡報告あり。WHO事務局長による公式確認。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: - Ξεπέρασαν τα 900 τα κρούσματα στο Κονγκό - Ανησυχία ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 900 cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO concerned.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed, per the World Health Organization. Surveillance is being intensified in the fight against Ebola in the DRC. In the latest official tally published Saturday, the health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing outbreak. The country declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15, linked to the rarer Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or therapies, with case fatality up to 50%. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with mortality rates historically ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴで900件以上の症例が報告され、WHOが懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の大規模流行で、WHO PHEICが宣言されており、国際的な公衆衛生危機に該当する。
triage.notes: WHO PHEICが既に宣言されている。Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・治療法なし、致死率最大50%）による大規模流行。204名の死亡が報告されている。対象国リストにはDRCが含まれており、記事サマリーもDRCが主要な発生地であることを明確に述べている。

article.articleHeadline: Число предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой превысило 900  --  глава ВОЗ - Новости Кыргызстана
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola infection cases has surpassed 900 — WHO chief — Kyrgyzstan News.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: The World Health Organization chief reports that suspected Ebola infections have surpassed 900 amid the Congo outbreak, with at least 131 deaths confirmed thus far. Officials indicate there is no vaccine ready for immediate deployment, estimating it will take about nine months to develop and approve a vaccine for the current strain. In response to the outbreak, the United States has implemented a special-entry protocol for travelers who have recently visited three African countries affected by Ebola. The article underscores ongoing transmission concerns and the critical need for enhanced surveillance, rapid case finding, and international coordination to curb spread, while other Kyrgyzstan news items are unrelated to the health story.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染の疑い例が900を超える――WHOの首脳
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当。深刻な公衆衛生影響（900例以上、131死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（米国が渡航制限導入）、ワクチン未開発による対応困難性があり、フルリスク評価を要する。
triage.notes: 米国と南キルギス共和国は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主要な公衆衛生イベントであり、米国は対応措置（渡航制限）の実施国、キルギスは記事配信地点に過ぎないため、verified_locationsはDRC（対象国）のみに限定。ワクチン未開発という深刻な管理困難性が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Ấn Độ ban hành cảnh báo đi lại tới 3 quốc gia châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: India issues travel advisories to three African countries.
article.articleSummary: India issues travel advisories for the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan after the World Health Organization declares a PHEIC over the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak. Citizens are urged to avoid nonessential travel and to follow local health guidance; residents in affected areas should intensify preventive measures. Health checks for passengers arriving from or transiting through Ebola-affected regions were tightened on May 21. India reports no confirmed Bundibugyo cases linked to its territory and has dispatched emergency medical supplies to Africa CDC, as part of cooperation with the African Union. Bundibugyo has no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros warns vulnerability to fast-spreading infections remains high. In Ituri, DRC, the epicenter, there are about 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths; Uganda has reported cases among travelers from DRC. Gates Foundation allocates 15 million USD for response via CDC Africa, WHO AFRO, and WHO HQ to support JEAP coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症：インドがアフリカ3国への渡航警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。WHOがPHEICを宣言し、複数国での確認症例および死亡者がある高リスク状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州が感染地域の中心）、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの感染症発生を言及しているが、対象国リストではDRCとインドのみ該当。インドは直接的な感染確認事例がないため、二次的な関連性での含有。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、複数国での死亡者（204例）、ワクチン・治療法なしという特性から、国際的リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 의심 900건...보고된 완치 사례 없어
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... no reported recoveries.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues in eastern Ituri Province with more than 900 suspected cases. As of May 23, cumulative suspected cases reached 904 and suspected deaths 119; 101 laboratory-confirmed cases and 10 confirmed deaths; no recoveries reported. Earlier tallies showed 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths on May 22, and 746 suspected cases with 176 deaths on May 21. The drop in reported suspected deaths from previous days was not explained, possibly due to negative Ebola tests or deaths attributed to other illnesses after testing. The World Health Organization deems the outbreak in DRC as “very high” risk for the country, while global spread risk remains low. Response challenges include armed groups, reduced international aid, and community anger. Ituri hosts roughly 1 million displaced people, complicating containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴのエボラ疑い例900件...報告された完治事例なし
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、死亡例を伴う異常事態。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最重要監視対象疾患。904疑い例、119疑い死亡、101確定例、10確定死亡の報告。WHOが国レベルで『極度に高い』リスク評価。武装勢力、国際援助削減、コミュニティ反発など対応上の課題あり。約100万の国内避難民が包含される地域での拡大リスク高い。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला संकट न‍िगरानी बढ़ते ही सामने आए मामले, कांगो में 101 पॉज‍िट‍िव केस, 900 से ज्यादा संदिग्ध | Over 900 suspected cases identified in Congo Ebola response: WHO chief
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As Ebola surveillance intensifies, 101 positive cases reported in Congo, over 900 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak update: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola surveillance has intensified with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, centered in Ituri Province. Ituri, home to about five million people amid protracted conflict, faces widespread humanitarian needs (about one in four people require aid) and displacement (one in five displaced). WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said violence and insecurity drive people to flee, hampering case identification and contact tracing and delaying treatment. WHO and humanitarian health partners remain active in many areas, including remote and unsafe zones, to deliver essential services. The outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 16; as of May 22, national risk is very high and regional risk high. Ebola is a serious, deadly disease that originates in wildlife such as bats, mongooses, and some monkeys, before spreading between humans via blood, sweat, body fluids, or contaminated objects.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス危機監視の強化により多くの症例が判明、コンゴで101件の陽性確定、900件以上の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。5月16日にPHEIC宣言済み。WPRO基準も複数該当。即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として5月16日に宣言済み。900件以上の疑い例と101件の確定例、Ituri州での高い感染リスク、紛争地帯での社会的脆弱性（被爆露人口約500万人、人道支援必要者25%、避難民20%）が報告されている。動物由来感染症（コウモリ、マングース等が自然宿主）で国際的な拡散リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nowa odmiana groźnego wirusa w Afryce. Rośnie liczba ofiar epidemii
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new variant of a dangerous virus in Africa. The number of victims of the epidemic is rising.
article.articleSummary: By May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ministry of Communications reported 904 suspected Ebola cases, concentrated in Ituri Province’s northeast, with an official death toll of 119 and 220 deaths in regional tallies cited by AP. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare Ebola strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine. The first death occurred in Bunia at the end of April, after weeks of undetected transmission; testing for a more common Ebola virus was negative. Violence erupted when angry young men attacked an Ebola hospital, demanding the bodies of two relatives. Authorities say funerals must be state-organized to prevent transmission. WHO classifies the Congo outbreak as “very high” risk domestically, though the risk of global spread remains low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの危険なウイルスの新種。流行の犠牲者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の稀株、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による大規模アウトブレイク（904疑い例、119-220死亡）。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀少株、ワクチン未承認）による重大なアウトブレイク。DRC保健当局が公式に904疑い例、119死亡を報告（地域集計では220死亡）。Ituri州Buniaに集中。社会不安（病院への暴力事件）も報告。WHO国内リスク分類「非常に高い」。国際的拡大リスクは現在低いと評価。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam's Khanh Hoa sets up rapid response teams over Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: Khanh Hoa province in Vietnam has deployed rapid response teams and tightened infection-control, screening, classification, and isolation procedures for suspected or confirmed Ebola cases. As a major tourist destination, contingency plans were drafted earlier this year to avoid being caught off guard. The Khanh Hoa Center for Disease Control and the International Health Quarantine Center are reinforcing border checks and coordinating with aviation, maritime, port authorities, and border police to detect passengers showing symptoms or arriving from affected regions. Rapid response teams are stationed at airports and seaports. Officials update World Health Organization information hourly to respond promptly and conduct scenario-based training. The health ministry’s Department of Medical Service Administration issued an urgent directive for nationwide Ebola preparedness, with emphasis on travelers from outbreak countries within 21 days. Ebola virus disease can have case fatality rates up to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのカインホア省がエボラに関する懸念から急速対応チームを設置
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重篤度が高く国際的懸念があるが、記事サマリーから実際の患者発生や確定症例は報告されておらず、準備・対応体制強化の段階である。情報が不足しているため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は患者発生ではなく、ベトナムの準備・対応体制強化に関する報道。エボラ病は高い致死率（最大90%）で国際的懸念事項だが、実際の発症者や流行の報告がない段階。ベトナム全土での警戒態勢構築が進行中。WHO情報を時間ごとに更新し、訓練を実施するなど、管理能力は一定程度確保されている。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry calls for stronger preparedness against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is described as an acute, highly dangerous infection with fatality rates up to 90%, transmitted via direct contact with blood, tissues, bodily fluids, or contaminated objects, and via broken skin or mucous membranes. On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Amid concerns about potential entry into Vietnam, the Ministry of Health instructed medical units to strengthen prevention and control: enhanced surveillance—especially for travellers or returnees from outbreak areas within 21 days; strict infection control, screening, triage, and isolation for suspected/confirmed cases; global situation monitoring and accurate risk communication to prevent panic; rapid detection, testing, treatment, and outbreak coordination. Facilities should ensure adequate PPE, isolation capacity, and diagnostic readiness to handle potential Ebola cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、エボラに対する強化された備えを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言したBundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）について、ベトナムが入国警戒・サーベイランス強化を指示。国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性あり。
triage.notes: WHOがBundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）をPHEICと宣言した重大事象。ベトナムは記事の主題で、入国者スクリーニング・サーベイランス強化を指示している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。致命率最大90%の高危険病原体であり、DRCでの現在の流行とベトナムの警戒体制が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: число предполагаемых случаев заражения лихорадкой Эбола в Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The number of suspected Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports the Democratic Republic of the Congo has more than 900 suspected Ebola virus disease cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, home to about 5 million people, where roughly 25% need humanitarian aid. Ongoing fighting between insurgents and pro-government forces is hindering surveillance, driving displacement of civilians and essential workers, and severely constraining contact tracing and early detection. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda, and the DRC risk level has been raised to very high. Authorities are prioritizing surveillance, laboratory testing, and cross-border coordination to contain transmission amid insecurity and ensure preparedness for potential exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルス病疑い例が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべて該当。PHEIC宣言済みで、確定例101件、疑い例900件超、国際的に周辺国ウガンダでも確認。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただしPHEIC宣言済みで国際的関心が極めて高い。Ituri Province（約500万人）での発生で、紛争による不安定要因が封じ込めを困難にしている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला वायरस इस देश में मचा दिया हाहाकार, संदिग्ध मामलों की संख्या 900 के पार पहुंची - India TV Hindi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus has sparked panic in the country, with the number of suspected cases crossing 900.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has sparked panic, with suspected cases surpassing 900. The Congo Communications Ministry said on Sunday, via social media, that 904 suspected Ebola cases and 119 suspected deaths have been recorded in the ongoing outbreak in the country’s eastern region. The report emphasizes escalating transmission and public concern as authorities monitor the situation. The article focuses on the surge in suspected cases rather than confirmed data and does not provide detail on laboratory confirmation or infection sources. The situation underscores the need for continued public health responses in the affected area, with authorities tracking the outbreak as it unfolds in the eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスが同国でパニックを引き起こし、疑い例の数が900を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900例以上の疑い例、119例の死亡）と国際的拡大リスクが認められ、2基準以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（多数の死亡）、流行しやすさ（ヒト-ヒト感染性エボラ）、管理可能性（継続的な公衆衛生対応の必要性）が認められる。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは高い致死率と人間-人間の感染可能性を持つため、IHRおよびWPRO基準のすべての項目で該当性が高い。DRC東部での904例の疑い例と119例の死亡報告は、フルのRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が急務である。記事は疑い例ベースであり確定例数が限定的との指摘があるが、エボラのような高病原性病原体においては疑い例段階での対応が重要。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS annonce plus de de 900 cas suspects d'Ebola en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO announces more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
