article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) as of May 24, 2026, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the latest health ministry update. The outbreak began on May 15 and is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a strain with no approved vaccine or specific treatment, and a reported case-fatality up to 50%. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak recorded in the DRC. The World Health Organization has declared an international public health emergency (PHEIC) over Ebola in the DRC. Symptoms align with Ebola hemorrhagic fever (fever and bleeding). Surveillance and laboratory confirmation are ongoing; the article does not specify imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主共和国コンゴでのエボラ疑い症例900件以上を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。Bundibugyo virus（エボラ出血熱）によるアウトブレイク、致死率50%、PHEIC宣言済み、国際的拡大リスク高。フルRRAへ進む。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはWHO公式発表に基づき、DRCの第17回エボラアウトブレイク。PHEIC宣言済み。ワクチンなし、特定の治療法なし、致死率50%という極めて高いリスク。2026年5月15日に発生開始。101件の検査確認例、204件の死亡報告。国際的な懸念極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 의심 900건 넘어..."확산 위험 낮아"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... "Spread risk is low"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) surpasses 900 suspected cases with ongoing transmission. As of May 23 (local time; reported May 24), the DRC public communications office records 904 cumulative suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths, with 101 confirmed cases and 10 confirmed deaths; no recoveries are reported. WHO assesses the outbreak domestically as very high risk, while global spread risk remains low. The report provides no details on infection source or recovery, and emphasizes the situation centers in the DRC rather than international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ疑い例900件超...「拡散リスクは低い」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の集団発生で900件超の疑い例と119件の疑い死亡が報告されている。IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「異常性」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準の「重症度」「流行しやすさ」も満たす。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生。WHO評価では国内リスクは非常に高いが、世界的拡大リスクは低いとされている。確定例101例・確定死亡10例が報告されており、感染伝播が継続中。回復例や感染源の詳細情報は記事に含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы: число случаев заражения перевалило за 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the number of infections has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the number of suspected Ebola cases has surpassed 900, with 204 suspected deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported the day prior. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figure on X and highlighted difficulties containing spread in the DRC due to fighting between rebels and pro-government forces. On May 17, the WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a public health emergency of international concern. Ebola virus is transmitted from wildlife to humans. Initial symptoms include fever, muscle spasms, headache, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver impairment and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. Russian academic Gennady Onishchenko suggested spread beyond Africa is possible but does not indicate an ongoing pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：感染者数が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、900人超の感染疑い例と204人の死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「DRC and Uganda」が明示されており、DRCでの900人超の感染疑い例と204人の死亡が記載されている。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakはDRC・ウガンダ両国での流行。WHOは5月17日に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言している。ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに該当しないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ただし、記事サマリー上で両国が同時に言及されており、国境を越えた流行である点を考慮し、国家間の流行であることは確認。

article.articleHeadline: Explozie a numărului de cazuri de Ebola în Congo. Peste 900 de persoane suspecte că sunt infectate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spike in the number of Ebola cases in Congo. More than 900 people suspected to be infected.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026, per the World Health Organization. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. The epidemic has already claimed hundreds of lives across multiple provinces; earlier reports cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. Ebola is a viral disease transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever and organ failure. The DR Congo declared the outbreak on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance efforts have intensified as part of the response, but did not provide updated death totals. Across Africa in the past 50 years, Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ確定例が急増。900人以上が感染を疑われている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認された流行であり、900人以上の疑い患者、101人の実験室確認例、数百人の死亡が報告されている。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、旅行・貿易制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の確認された流行。ワクチンなし、承認された治療法なし。複数の県で流行。WHO事務局長が対応を発表。過去50年間でアフリカ全体でエボラにより15,000人以上が死亡。緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ: выявлено более 900 предполагаемых случаев заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected cases of Ebola virus disease identified
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is centered in Ituri Province, where nearly 5 million people live and about one in four needs humanitarian aid, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. As of May 24, 2026, authorities suspended air travel to Bunia in eastern DRC as the epidemic has spread to three provinces. The health system is overwhelmed and unable to adequately trace contacts. The outbreak has resulted in 91 confirmed Ebola infections, 867 suspected cases, and 204 probable deaths, underscoring a persistent, expanding threat and the need for robust surveillance and response measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラウイルス病の疑い例が900件以上確認されたと報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模感染事例で、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。確認患者91名、疑い患者867名、死亡204名という重大な影響、複数州への拡大、航空移動制限措置の実施など、国際的対応を要する緊急シグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体。DRCのイトゥリ州中心に、既に3州に拡大。保健システムの破綻、接触追跡の不可能、航空移動制限など深刻な状況。WHOトップによる公式発表。緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Liczba podejrzanych przypadków Eboli rośnie. Wirus wymyka się spod kontroli?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola cases is rising. Is the virus getting out of control?
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak expands: 904 suspected cases identified, mainly in Ituri Province (northeast), with 101 confirmed infections by WHO chief Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Total suspected deaths reach 119, but regional data tally 220 deaths. A Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine, has circulated undetected for weeks in Ituri after a late-April death in Bunia, the provincial capital. An incident at an Ebola hospital saw gunfire as enraged youths demanded bodies. Authorities warn that Ebola corpses can carry the virus, prompting state-led funerals without family involvement to curb spread. WHO assesses the outbreak risk in the DRC as very high, while international spread remains low. Symptoms typically appear 2–21 days post-exposure and include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal and muscle pains; case fatality varies by strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疑い患者数が増加。ウイルスが制御不能になっているか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、Bundibugyo ebolavirus という希少株の検出、死亡数の増加、医療施設での暴力事件、ワクチン未開発による高いリスクなどWPRO基準も複数該当。DRC当局とWHOの懸念表明により社会・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイール型以外の希少株）の検出により重要度が増加。サマリーでは数値の矛盾が認識される（確認症例101 vs 疑い患者904、死亡119 vs 地域集計220）。医療施設での暴力事件・埋葬慣行の衛生懸念も追加的リスク。DRC内での流行拡大段階にありながらワクチン未開発という管理可能性の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: L'Île Maurice à renforcer ses contrôles sanitaires aux frontières pour se prémunir du virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mauritius to Strengthen Its Border Health Controls to Safeguard Against the Ebola Virus.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, Mauritius tightened border health controls to guard against Ebola virus, following rising regional alerts. The World Health Organization reports the Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain, is circulating in Central and East Africa with more than 200 deaths and crossing several borders. The Seychelles has activated its protection plan in response to the threat in the Indian Ocean region. In Mauritius, authorities discreetly renewed border surveillance and are drafting a protocol for international travelers to prevent importation while avoiding a full border closure. The outbreak reportedly began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and is now active in Uganda, highlighting the ongoing need for preemptive screening and rapid response measures to protect Mauritius’ public health.

triage.headline_ja: モーリシャス、エボラウイルスに備えるため国境の衛生管理強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がアフリカ中部・東部で200人以上の死亡を伴い複数国境を越えて流行中。モーリシャス、セイシェルなど島嶼国が国境検疫を強化するなど、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRCでの発生と、ウガンダでの活動が明記されている。セイシェル、モーリシャスは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが実際のエボラ発生地として確認された。この地域での広域流行の可能性が高く、フルRRA優先度は高い。

locations.name: Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka

article.articleHeadline: Ebola triggers heightened vigilance in Sri Lanka
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, includes 83 lab-confirmed cases, 746 suspected infections, and 176 suspected deaths, with Bunia, Rwampara and Mongbwalu affected. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. Transmission occurs through contact with blood or bodily fluids; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, chills, severe weakness, headaches, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea and abdominal pain; some patients may bleed. Ebola is not airborne. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of Concern under IHR (2005), though not a pandemic. Sri Lanka has intensified precautionary measures, remaining low-risk with no local cases. A five-step plan strengthens airport surveillance, readiness at the National Institute of Infectious Diseases, laboratory testing at the Medical Research Institute, disease surveillance, and WHO coordination. Travellers from affected countries should seek medical care for symptoms within 21 days and report travel history.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがスリランカでの警戒態勢を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WHO が Public Health Emergency of International Concern を宣言している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にスリランカ（Sri Lanka）が含まれているが、記事サマリーではスリランカは予防措置を講じているのみで、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC（Ituri Province）である。DRCのみが verified_locations に含まれる。WHOが IHR(2005) に基づき Public Health Emergency of Concern を宣言しており、4つの IHR 基準すべてに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Tren Kasus Rabies di Kupang Terus Meroket, Ini Data Sebaran Wilayah Paling Rawan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies Case Trend in Kupang Continues to Soar; Here Is Data on the Distribution of the Most At-Risk Areas.
article.articleSummary: Rabies exposure from dog bites in Kupang Regency, East Nusa Tenggara (NTT), Indonesia, surged in early 2026, with 520 suspected rabies bites reported across 26 Puskesmas in five months. A fatal case involves a civil servant from Amfoang Tengah who died after two dog bites. The first bite occurred January 23, 2026 in Oelfatu; no care sought. A second bite on May 14, 2026 in Saukibe led to classic rabies symptoms—fever, photophobia, and hydrophobia—and the patient died despite delayed evacuation. Health authorities confirmed suspected rabies and detained the biting dog for laboratory observation. Historically, the rise is steep compared with prior years, with 2025 peaks at Naibonat (299 cases), Oesao (253), and Camplong (204). The data underscore ongoing transmission risk across Kupang and the need for timely dog bite management and laboratory confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: クパン市の狂犬病症例の増加傾向が続く。最もリスクが高い地域の分布データ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア（クパン地区）で狂犬病の咬傷事例が5ヶ月間で520件と急増し、死亡例も報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染は稀だが、犬からの広範囲な暴露が継続しており、地域的な公衆衛生上の重要な懸念。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は通常ヒト-ヒト感染がないため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、Kupang地区での犬咬傷事例の急増（520件/5ヶ月）と死亡例の報告は地域的な獣疫コントロール上の重大な問題。2025年ピーク値との比較で異常な上昇傾向が確認される。WPRO基準で複数該当し、社会的・行政的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia eboli w Demokratycznej Republice Konga. "Wirus widmo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. "The Ghost Virus"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is concentrated in Ituri Province's northeast, with Bundibugyo ebolavirus circulating. More than 900 suspected cases have been reported, including 101 confirmed infections. Ituri accounts for the surge, rising from about 700 to 904 suspected cases. Death tallies are disputed: authorities report 119 suspected deaths, but regional sums suggest up to 220 fatalities. The first death occurred in Bunia in late April, with the outbreak spreading since. There is no vaccine for Bundibugyo virus, complicating response; early tests targeted other Ebola variants, delaying detection. The World Health Organization has raised the DRC’s risk level to very high, though global risk remains low. Burial restrictions requiring state-organized funerals have sparked unrest and security incidents at hospitals.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行。「幽霊ウイルス」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900件以上の疑い患者、119～220死亡）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの重篤性、高い死亡率（CFR推定13～24%）、Bundibugyo型にはワクチンがなく検出遅延、埋葬規制による社会的不安定性が報告されている。WHO risk level引き上げ。DRCは対象国であり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Grupa mladića upala u bolnicu gdje se liječe oboljeli od ebole: Čuli se pucnji, evakuirani pacijenti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A group of young men burst into a hospital where Ebola patients are being treated: gunshots were heard, and patients were evacuated.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) intensified after youths stormed Mongbwalu Hospital, evacuating patients as families demanded two bodies. The attack was the third on facilities treating suspected Ebola cases in seven days, highlighting containment challenges in a WHO-declared Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities warn Ebola corpses are highly infectious, prompting state-led burials and protests; gatherings over 50 are restricted. A MSF tent in Mongbwalu was burned earlier, and 18 people with suspected infection disappeared after leaving the facility. A treatment center in Rwampara was burned after families were denied a body. The Ministry reports 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths, though regional totals reach 220. WHO says high risk for DRC, low global risk; Bundibugyo ebolavirus has no vaccine. Three MSF volunteers died in Mongbwalu, likely from handling bodies on March 27 in a humanitarian mission not linked to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者を治療している病院に若者グループが押し入る：銃声が聞こえ、患者が避難
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、施設への暴力的攻撃による感染制御の混乱、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、およびWHO緊急事態宣言が確認されるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHO緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）済みのBundibugyo ebolavirus。7日間で3度の施設攻撃、患者失踪、遺体管理をめぐる社会不安が発生。感染制御の失敗リスク極高。ルワンダの言及はあるが、記事主題はコンゴでの発生・対応であり、ルワンダは検証済み位置情報に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα - Φόβοι για ανεξέλεγκτη εξάπλωση της επιδημίας
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: More than 900 suspected cases - Fears of uncontrolled spread of the epidemic.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has triggered intensified surveillance amid fears of uncontrolled spread. More than 900 suspected cases have been reported, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections to date. The latest official tally cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is attributed to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there are no vaccines or therapies and which carries a case fatality rate up to about 50%. The World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the continued escalation of surveillance and that the agency has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Hemorrhagic fever symptoms accompany infection. The report emphasizes ongoing international concern and the urgent need for surveillance and response capacity in the DRC to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：900件以上の疑似患者 - 流行の制御不能な拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模発生で公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスクが明確。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模発生。2026年5月15日に公式宣言。204人の死亡、101人の確定患者、900人以上の疑似患者。ワクチンと治療法がなく、致命率は約50%。WHOがPHEIC宣言。国際的な支援と監視強化が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: Млади мъже нахлуха в болница в ДР Конго, в която се лекуват пациенти с ебола, за да поискат телата на свои близки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Young men storm a hospital in DR Congo where Ebola patients are being treated to demand the bodies of their relatives.
article.articleSummary: Angry youths stormed the Mongbvalu Hospital in eastern DR Congo, where Ebola patients are treated at the epicenter of the latest outbreak, forcing evacuation of patients amid nearby gunfire. The attackers demanded the bodies of two relatives, hospital director Dr. Richard Lokudu said, with the facility on heightened alert and few additional details available amid escalating unrest. The incident marks the third attack on health facilities in a week as clinicians cope with resource shortages in the Ebola response. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, highlighting the ongoing challenge in northeastern DR Congo. It was not clear whether anyone was injured.

triage.headline_ja: ザイール民主共和国の病院でエボラ患者治療施設にそれ以上の混乱：若い男たちが親族の遺体要求で医療施設を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク、医療施設への攻撃による対応能力の著しい低下
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）既に宣言済みのエボラウイルス感染症アウトブレイク。医療施設への武装攻撃は3週間で3度目で、感染症対応能力の著しい低下と社会不安定性が懸念される。患者の強制移送による感染リスク拡大の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: DR Kongo potvrdila 101 novi slučaj zaraze ebolom, WHO proglasio međunarodnu uzbunu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo confirmed 101 new Ebola cases, WHO declared an international alert.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with no approved treatment or vaccine; case fatality can reach up to 50%. As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo, of which 101 are laboratory-confirmed; earlier, the Ministry of Health confirmed 204 deaths from this virus. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted intensifying surveillance in the response, but did not provide a death toll in his post. DR Congo had declared the Ebola outbreak on May 15, 2026. The situation highlights a high-mortality, vaccine-less strain ongoing in the region, underscoring the urgent need for public health measures and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ感染の新規確認症例101件、WHOが国際的警報を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く、ワクチンがなく、確認症例101件、死亡204件の深刻な公衆衛生上の影響。国際的警報発出と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による流行。致死率最大50%、ワクチンなし。5月25日時点で900以上の疑い例、確認例101件、死亡204件。WHOが国際保健上の懸念事項(PHEIC)を宣言。緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: أكثر من 900 حالة اشتباه إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected cases of Ebola virus infection in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola virus infections are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with the World Health Organization later citing nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths linked to the outbreak. The African CDC warns that 10 African countries are at risk of transmission: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia; the DRC remains the epicenter, and Uganda is a neighboring country. The outbreak is identified as the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second-largest recorded globally. As of May 25, 2026, authorities emphasize rapid spread and the need for continued surveillance and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染の疑い例900件以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。エボラウイルスの大規模な疑い例集団発生で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事態、10ヶ国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにて、DRCが震源地であり、10ヶ国のリスク国として南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、ウガンダが挙げられている。対象国リストから、実際に発生・リスク国として明示されているのはDRC（203312）とザンビア（895949）のみ。他の対象国（ガーナ等）は記事に言及されていないため verified_locations に含めない。第17次DRC エボラ流行、全球的に2番目に大きい規模とされ、極度の警戒が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cambodia renews Covid-19 precautions as NB.1.8.1 variant circulates in region - phnompenhpost.com
article.articleSummary: Covid-19 NB.1.8.1 variant, a descendant of Omicron JN.1, is circulating regionally, prompting Cambodia's Ministry of Health to renew preventive measures. The variant has been detected in Singapore, China and Hong Kong, with the WHO classifying NB.1.8.1 on May 23, 2025 as a 'variant under monitoring' after a surge in sequencing data in the Western Pacific and Southeast Asia. Cambodia reported NB.1.8.1 cases between May and December last year, and since the start of 2026 has identified one positive case (May 18) among patients seeking hospital care. Officials say there is currently no evidence of more severe disease, higher hospitalisation or mortality versus earlier Omicron strains. Public guidance emphasizes masks, hand hygiene, respiratory etiquette, vaccination including boosters, and seeking care for symptoms such as fever, cough, headaches, runny nose, or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: カンボジアがNB.1.8.1変異株が地域で流行する中、COVID-19予防措置を更新
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19のNB.1.8.1変異株に関するシグナルであり、複数地域での検出と WHO の「monitoring under monitoring」分類により WPROスクリーニング基準の異常性・流行しやすさを満たすが、重症度の増加は報告されておらず、カンボジアの単一症例確認のみであるため情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事はカンボジアでの COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 変異株検出と予防措置更新を主題としているが、カンボジアは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。China（香港含む）のみ対象国として含める。IHR基準の international_spread は肯定（シンガポール、中国、香港での検出）。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性、流行しやすさ、長期曝露の懸念あり。重症度の増加は報告されていない（No）。WHO分類と複数国での確認により監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Będą kontrole na lotniskach. Wszystko przez Ebolę
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There will be inspections at airports. It's all because of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in Africa prompt expanded U.S. airport screening. The CDC imposes new rules for travelers recently in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Designated passengers must first arrive at one of three U.S. airports—Washington Dulles, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, or George Bush Intercontinental Houston—where mandatory screening occurs before onward travel. Screenings include temperature checks, travel history and symptom assessments to trigger further testing or hospital referral if fever or Ebola-like symptoms are detected. Airlines have been instructed to route the first U.S. stop through these airports. As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization lists DRC as very high risk, with cases also reported in Uganda and South Sudan; approximately 750 suspected infections and 177 probable deaths have been reported, though totals may be higher. The U.S. government has allocated $32 million for aid and formed a task force; observers note ongoing gaps in comprehensive relief at the epidemic’s center.

triage.headline_ja: 空港での検査が実施されます。すべてはエボラのせいです。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。DRCでの大規模流行（750疑い例、177死亡）と複数国への確認、米国での空港スクリーニング導入が公表されており、国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行に言及しているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。ウガンダおよび南スーダンは対象国ではないため除外。米国での空港スクリーニング導入は流行対応の重要な措置であり、国際的な関心の高さを示唆。WHO指定の「very high risk」評価と死亡例数（177例）から重篤な影響が明確。

article.articleHeadline: ΠΟΥ: Πάνω απο 900 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 Ebola cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which causes hemorrhagic fever, has generated more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The latest official tally reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing outbreak. The country declared Ebola on May 15, attributed to the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or treatments, with a case-fatality rate up to 50%. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Across Africa, Ebola has cost at least 15,000 lives in the past five decades, with overall fatality rates historically ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱患者900人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、致命的/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPublic Health Emergency of International Concernを宣言。
triage.notes: エボラ熱の稀なBundibugyo株で、ワクチン・治療法がなく致命率最大50%。WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola अलर्ट: स्क्रीनिंग बढ़ी, अस्पताल तैयार; क्या आम लोगों को डरने की जरूरत है? जानिए कैसे फैलता है वायरस, इसके शुरुआती लक्षण और बचाव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert: Screening Intensified, Hospitals Prepared; Do the General Public Need to Fear? Learn How the Virus Spreads, Its Early Symptoms, and Prevention.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain is spreading across the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), Uganda, and South Sudan, prompting India to issue an alert. On May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). DR Congo reports 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths; WHO confirms 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths, with Africa CDC calling it a continental emergency. No cases in India; authorities intensified airport screening. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or animal; it is not airborne like coronavirus. Early symptoms resemble fever, malaise, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, with bleeding possible in severe cases. Preventive measures: avoid non-essential travel to these countries, maintain hand hygiene, wear masks, use sanitizer, and seek testing if fever or symptoms after travel. Do not panic; follow official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：スクリーニング強化、病院準備；一般国民は恐れる必要があるか？ウイルスの感染方法、初期症状、予防方法を学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの国際的エボラアウトブレークのため、即座にRRA評価対象となる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in DRC/Uganda/South Sudan with WHO PHEIC declaration (May 17, 2026). 867 suspected cases, 204 deaths in DRC. India issued travel advisory and intensified airport screening despite no domestic cases. South Sudan is not in target country list so excluded from verified_locations. Article explicitly states India's response with enhanced screening and hospital preparedness.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 900 cas suspects recensés (chef de l'OMS)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 900 suspected cases recorded (WHO chief).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) expands with over 900 suspected cases identified and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, where nearly five million people live amid ongoing conflict; about 25% need humanitarian aid and 20% are internally displaced. Violence disrupts health work, hampering contact tracing and early case identification, and fueling mistrust among communities. WHO and partner health agencies maintain a field presence across Ituri, including hard-to-reach and unstable areas, to deliver surveillance and essential health services and to build trust for an effective response. Separately, the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola linked to cases in DRC and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) on May 16. The WHO subsequently raised national risk to very high, regional risk to high, and kept global risk at low on May 22.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：900件以上の疑似症例が確認される（WHO事務局長）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として既にPHEICが宣言されている。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株に関連する事例がウガンダでも確認されているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCでの発生であり、またウガンダはWPROの対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。既にWHOによりPHEIC（2026年5月16日）が宣言され、地域リスクは高、国家リスクは非常に高と評価されている。紛争地域での対応困難性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: USA: Kontrole na lotniskach po wzroście przypadków Eboli w Afryce
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USA: Airport screenings after a rise in Ebola cases in Africa.
article.articleSummary: CDC expands health screening for travelers recently arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), South Sudan, or Uganda. Screening occurs at Washington Dulles International, with weekend additions at Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta and George Bush Intercontinental Houston; affected passengers are directed to these airports. Travelers must complete a travel-history form, undergo temperature checks, and be observed for Ebola-like symptoms; fever or related signs trigger further evaluation and possible hospitalization. WHO estimates the outbreak started in the DRC and spread to South Sudan and Uganda, with about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, though numbers may be higher. The organization raised the DRC national risk to ‘very high,’ while global risk from Bundibugyo Ebola remains a separate concern. The U.S. State Department activated an Ebola Response Task Force, deployed a Crisis Response Team, and allocated $32 million. The New York Times notes border closures and flight redirections, including to the USA, though relief in Bunia remains limited.

triage.headline_ja: USA: アフリカのエボラ症例増加に伴う空港での検査強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での流行拡大、国際的な移動制限措置の実施、高い死亡率を示唆する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは米国での空港検査措置に焦点を当てているが、実際のエボラ流行はDRC、南スーダン、ウガンダで発生している。対象国リスト上ではDRCのみ該当。米国内での確認患者報告はないため、米国は verified_locations から除外した。約750疑い患者、177疑い死亡との報告と、WHO による DRC 国家リスク「非常に高い」評価は深刻性を示す。

article.articleHeadline: Смъртоносна заплаха: Над 900 случая на ебола в Африка, СЗО бие тревога - Свят  --  Новини Стандарт
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Threat: Over 900 Ebola Cases in Africa, WHO Sounds the Alarm - World  --  Standard News
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, 101 confirmed, and 10 laboratory-confirmed deaths, with 119 suspected deaths revised downward from 204. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated on X that more than 900 suspected cases have been identified, 101 confirmed, without providing death counts. Uganda has five confirmed cases linked to the eastern DRC outbreak; suspected Ugandan cases are not published. Testing is limited to a few laboratories in a remote, conflict-affected area with armed groups. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO assesses the risk as very high in DRC, high regionally, and low globally. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa over the last 50 years, with case fatality rates from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的な脅威：アフリカでエボラウイルス病患者900件以上、WHOが警告を発する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。エボラ出血熱は国際保健上最高レベルのリスク。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の確定患者101例、疑い例904例、確認死亡10例を報告。ウガンダでも5例の確認患者あり。ワクチンと特異的治療なし。紛争地域での検査能力の制限がリスク要因。WHOが非常に高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉延烧　世卫：刚果（金）疑似病例逾900例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola flare-up continues; WHO: More than 900 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak persists, with WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reporting more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The health ministry’s latest tally across three provinces lists 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases, while WHO notes the higher suspected-case count and has not updated the death toll. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is centered in Ituri Province, where nearly 5 million people live amid ongoing conflict, with about one in four needing humanitarian aid. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. There is currently no approved vaccine or treatment. Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ延焼　世保：コンゴ（金）疑似病例900例超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による確認症例101件を含む900例超の疑似患者と204死亡が報告されており、治療法ワクチンなし。紛争地域での5百万人曝露と高い感染可能性により、国際支援が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の流行により、DRC のイトゥリ州を中心に900例超の疑似患者と101件の実験室確認患者が報告されている。紛争地域での発生、治療法・ワクチン欠如、高い感染可能性、広範な人口曝露（約500万人）から、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は極めて高い。WHO事務局長による報告であり、国際的な関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS fait état de plus de 900 cas suspects en République démocratique du Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola hemorrhagic fever cases were identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 24 as surveillance expands; 101 confirmed cases have been reported. The health ministry’s latest tally indicates 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment, with a case fatality rate up to 50%. The World Health Organization has triggered an international health alert as investigations intensify. Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with mortality ranging from 25% to 90% depending on the outbreak setting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑い患者を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WPRO基準全5項目該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイクで、ワクチンなし、症例致命率最大50%、既に101確定患者204死亡が報告されている。WHOが国際保健警戒を発令している。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω απο 900 τα κρούσματα Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό σύμφωνα με ΠΟΥ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 900 Ebola cases in the DRC according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 people in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are suspected to have been infected with Ebola virus, which causes hemorrhagic fever, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The announcement was made around midnight on May 25, 2026. The report refers to suspected rather than confirmed infections and provides no further details on laboratory confirmation, specific provinces, infection sources, or any exported cases. The figure signals a significant potential outbreak in the DRC, underscoring the need for ongoing surveillance, diagnostic testing, and public health measures to control Ebola in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ジンバブエでのエボラ出血熱患者数900人以上、WHOの発表によると
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクをすべて有する。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の疑い患者900人以上という大規模なシグナル。WHOが公式発表しており、検査確認状況や地理的詳細が不明であることは懸念だが、パンデミック可能性を考慮すると緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。診断確認、感染源追跡、輸出例の有無確認が急務。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS elevó a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola en el Congo y confirmó más de un centenar de contagios en el país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raised the number of suspected Ebola cases in Congo to more than 900 and confirmed more than a hundred infections in the country.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces near the eastern border. The World Health Organization reports 101 confirmed infections and 904 suspected cases as of May 23, with 10 confirmed and 119 suspected deaths. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain with no approved vaccines or antibody therapies. Authorities warn the outbreak may have circulated for months before detection. The conflict and humanitarian crisis in Ituri, where almost five million people live amid ongoing fighting, with about one in four needing assistance and one in five internally displaced, severely constrain surveillance and contact tracing. WHO and partners maintain a field presence across Ituri to deliver a health package and rebuild trust. Cross-border considerations involve Uganda; Africa CDC cites 204 suspected deaths linked to the outbreak in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ疑い例を900例以上に引き上げ、確認感染は100例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク、確認例101名・疑い例904名、死亡報告あり、ワクチン・治療法なし、ウガンダへの越境拡大懸念。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーの主眼はDRCでのアウトブレイク。ウガンダは『越境考慮』『204疑い死亡』と言及されるが、確認された発生地はDRCの3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）のみ。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれない為、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ザイール種でなく異なる株）、ワクチン・抗体療法なし、紛争・人道危機による監視困難、という複合的リスク要因あり。

article.articleHeadline: Спалах Еболи в Конго: авіарейси масово скасовують, а збірну з футболу можуть не пустити на Чемпіонату світу
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Flights canceled en masse, and the national football team could be barred from the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers flight suspensions, tighter controls, and a potential ban of the national football team from the World Cup. Congo reports transmission in at least three provinces, with Uganda confirming five related cases and cross-border spillover risk via open borders. Bunia airport is closed to commercial flights; only humanitarian and medical flights with clearance are allowed. Africa CDC says this is the second-largest outbreak since 2014–2016, driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. The United States tightens entry screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda and South Sudan, pledging funding and rapid-response teams. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. In northeast DRC, about 65 deaths and hundreds of infections are reported. US officials say the Congolese team must undergo a 21-day isolation in Belgium before arriving in Houston to maintain a bubble.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが流行：航空便が大量にキャンセル、サッカー代表がワールドカップから除外される可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間の国境越え感染、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）宣言、複数地域での確認と国際的な人的・経済的影響が顕著。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の流行で、コンゴ民主共和国内3州での伝播、ウガンダでの関連5症例確認、国境を越えたスピルオーバーリスクあり。約65人の死亡と数百の感染者。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。米国は渡航スクリーニング強化、資金提供、対応チーム派遣を表明。スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響も報告されており、社会政治的関心が高い。記事ではアフリカ（特にDRC、ウガンダ）での発生が主題であり、テキサス州やベルギーは対策・経由地として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: HURIWA urges Ebola emergency preparedness
article.articleSummary: HURIWA urged Nigeria to activate an emergency national Ebola preparedness and response framework amid Africa CDC warnings of rising Ebola risk across parts of Africa. Nigeria remains vulnerable due to population density, cross-border movements, and weak health surveillance. The group notes at least 10 African countries at risk of Ebola transmission: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. They argued that Nigeria has not publicly presented a comprehensive Ebola preparedness framework comparable to the COVID-19 coordinated response, with inadequate information on isolation centres, border surveillance, emergency response teams, and awareness strategies. HURIWA called for strengthened surveillance at airports, land borders, and seaports, and daily public enlightenment campaigns in English, Hausa, Igbo, Yoruba and other Nigerian languages. It urged disclosure of readiness of isolation centres, laboratory facilities, PPE stockpiles, protection and welfare for frontline workers, and regular national briefings to prevent panic and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: HURIWA、エボラ出血熱の緊急事態対応準備を促促
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱とCOVID-19の同時言及、複数アフリカ国での感染リスク指摘、ナイジェリアを含む対象国での国家レベルの対応課題提起により、IHR基準2項目以上（異常性・国際拡大リスク）とWPRO基準複数項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアのエボラ出血熱対応準備の不備を指摘し、アフリカ10カ国（対象国リストから検証）での伝播リスク言及。Africa CDCの警告引用で国際的関心が高い。ただしソースはナイジェリアのNGO(HURIWA)報道であり、公式確定例ではなく『リスク警告・準備呼びかけ』である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Authorities step up Ebola response in rebel areas as Congo battles outbreak
article.articleSummary: Regions controlled by the AFC/M23 rebel groups in eastern Congo imposed a 21-day mandatory quarantine for people returning from Bunia and Ituri as part of their response to the Ebola outbreak. As of May 25, 2026, the move signals intensified containment in rebel-held areas amid the ongoing epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The report provides no case or death counts. By mandating quarantine for travelers from Ebola-affected areas, the AFC/M23 zones aim to limit transmission despite security challenges and limited access for health workers. The measure illustrates how Ebola response strategies are being implemented in conflict-affected regions to curb cross-area spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが感染症発生と闘う中、反政府勢力地域でエボラ対応が強化される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。エボラウイルスの流行が進行中であり、紛争地域での対応困難性とヒト-ヒト感染リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国東部（イトゥリ地域、ブニア）でのエボラ流行が明確に述べられており、反政府勢力支配地域での隔離措置実施が報告されている。ケース数・死亡数は不明だが、「ongoing epidemic」と明記されている。紛争地域における公衆衛生対応の困難さが強調されており、管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: BBC World Service - Global News Podcast, African countries join forces to prevent Ebola spreading
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with suspected cases surpassing 900; Uganda and South Sudan co-ordinate their response with the DRC, signaling regional cross-border efforts to contain the outbreak. The article notes the surge in suspected DRC cases but provides no laboratory-confirmed case counts or death tolls in the excerpt. Details on infection sources or imported/exported cases are not given. Framing the event as an ongoing health emergency in East-Central Africa, the report underlines the need for coordinated action among neighboring countries to halt transmission. The report focuses on the coordination aspect rather than clinical specifics. Published on May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国がエボラ出血熱の拡大を防ぐため一致団結
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は極度に危険な病原体であり、DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（疑い症例900例超）と複数国への地域的波及は国際的関心事である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの主要アウトブレイク（疑い症例900例超）と地域的対応を記述。ウガンダと南スーダンは「対応を調整」と記載されているが、記事本文がないため、これらの国での実際の症例発生確認が不十分。DRCは対象国リストに該当（id: 203312）し、エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であることから PICKUP と判定。続報でウガンダ・南スーダンでの確認症例が報告される場合は、それらも verified_locations に追加される可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: В ДР Конго выявлено более 900 случаев лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 cases of Ebola fever identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 Ebola fever cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The epicenter is Ituri Province in the northeast, where about 5 million people live amid ongoing armed conflict. The outbreak, detected in mid-May, is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved antiviral treatment or available vaccine. The epidemic has now spread to three provinces, and authorities have suspended air travel to the town of Bania in Ituri. In response to the outbreak, the United States and Bahrain barred entry to foreigners who have recently visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan. Public commentary cited potential drivers such as bushmeat consumption, funeral practices, and the spread of myths and misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の患者が900例以上確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、国際的な渡航制限実施）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行で、ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬なし。即座にフルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus は致死率が高く、有効なワクチンや抗ウイルス治療がない。武力紛争地域（イツリ州）での流行であり、感染制御能力の制約が懸念される。米国・バーレーンによる渡航制限が既に発動されており、パニック・誤情報の拡散リスクも報告されている。WHO事務局長による公式声明が出ている点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о более чем 900 предполагаемых случаях Эболы в Республике Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the number of suspected Ebola virus disease cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 900, with Ituri province still the outbreak’s epicenter. Ituri, home to about 5 million people, faces severe humanitarian needs—roughly 25% require aid and about 20% are internally displaced. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced the figure, underscoring the ongoing regional risk. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, signaling a high regional threat. The article provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection sources, or information on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ共和国でエボラの疑い例が900例以上と報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的懸念事項として公式宣言（PHEIC）したエボラ侵襲であり、地域的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州）を主要な発生地域として記述。Ugandaも地域的懸念として言及されているが、サマリー本文の焦点はDRCのエボラ発生であり、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）は国際的に極めて重要な公式通知であり、フルRRAの実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: V DR Kongo več kot 900 domnevnih primerov ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the DRC, more than 900 suspected cases of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has identified just over 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 119 Ebola-related deaths, according to the World Health Organization. Authorities in the affected country report the same totals. The report originates from Kinshasa and centers on the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC. No additional details on case confirmation methods, geographic distribution within the country, or transmission chains are provided in the article. The figures indicate a significant level of activity, underscoring ongoing public health concerns as health authorities and international partners monitor the situation closely. The article is dated May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。DRC での大規模エボラ発生は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRC（キンシャサ）でのエボラ発生が主題。2026年5月24日時点で900件以上の疑い例と119件の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準及びWPRO基準いずれも基準を満たすため、フルRRAの実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ предупредил об ухудшении ситуации с Эболой в ДРК - Minval Politika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief warned of a worsening Ebola situation in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of a worsening Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). He said that, as part of expanded outbreak response, epidemiological surveillance has been broadened, and more than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified to date. The information was shared in a post on X (formerly Twitter). The article provides no laboratory-confirmed case counts or deaths, and it does not detail transmission chains, exact infection sources, or any imported or exported cases. The statement highlights rising concern about ongoing transmission in the DRC and the need for continued surveillance and international support. Published 2026-05-25.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ状況の悪化を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際支援の必要性、継続的な人間-人間感染）。900件超の疑い患者と拡大する監視体制、WHO事務局長による警告により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は致命的な感染症であり、DRCでの疑い患者900件超および拡大する監視体制は深刻な公衆衛生の懸念を示唆している。WHO事務局長による直接的な警告により国際的関心が高い。ただし、確定患者数と死亡数が記事に記載されていないため、重症度の詳細な評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Более 200 человек могли погибнуть от Эболы в Конго из-за насилия и срыва борьбы со вспышкой | УНН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people could have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to violence and the disruption of the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: More than 200 people have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 210 confirmed deaths reported as of May 23, amid ongoing violence that is hampering the outbreak response. In three eastern provinces, there are over 900 suspected Ebola cases, but health workers have been able to establish contact with only about 20% of potentially infected individuals. Attacks on treatment tents in Ituri and other facilities have forced evacuations and patient escapes, seriously undermining containment and contact tracing efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence is driving away medical and humanitarian personnel, threatening early case detection. Cross-border spread is feared as population movement increases and border controls remain weak; the Africa CDC notes ten African countries are at risk. Uganda has reported five cases linked to the Congo outbreak. The outbreak is characterized as the third largest in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱：暴力と対応の混乱により200人以上が死亡した可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する大規模エボラ出血熱の流行。確認死亡者210人、疑い患者900人超、国際的な越境感染リスク、および医療体制の機能不全が報告されている。
triage.notes: イベント情報の発生地域にはウガンダ(Republic of Uganda)も含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの関連事例は補足的に言及されており、主要な発生地はDRCである。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれているため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。本案件はWHO通知水準を大きく超えるシグナルであり、直ちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）に進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola May Have Killed Over 200 People in Congo as Violence Disrupts Response
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Ebola may have killed more than 200 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo, underscoring the immense difficulties of mounting an outbreak response in one of the world's most unstable regions. Armed groups control territory and health systems are fragile, hampering surveillance, patient care, and rapid containment. The report points to violence, mistrust, and disrupted health services as key drivers of transmission, with response efforts constrained by insecurity and restricted access. The excerpt highlights the broader operational challenges of laboratory confirmation, contact tracing, and case management in conflict-affected areas, rather than clinical specifics. The situation raises concern for continued spread within the DRC and highlights how conflict-driven barriers impede outbreak control and the delivery of lifesaving measures amid an Ebola emergency as of May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが200人以上を殺害した可能性、暴力が対応を阻害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響を持つ。DRCでの大規模流行は異常かつ予想外であり、紛争地での対応困難さは国際的懸念となる。
triage.notes: 200人以上の死亡と報告された大規模エボラ流行。武装勢力による領土支配、脆弱な保健システム、暴力による対応阻害が主要な懸念。DRC内での継続的拡大と国際的な波及リスクが高い。WHO通知対象イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Эпидемия Эболы быстро распространяется в Африке - PrimaMedia.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is rapidly spreading in Africa - PrimaMedia.ru
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in Africa are accelerating, with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The epicenter is eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, where ongoing armed conflict hinders containment, raising concerns of spread to Uganda. The World Health Organization has previously designated this multi-country outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. Ebola is a highly dangerous viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted from animal reservoirs (bats and primates) and spread via human-to-human contact with infected bodily fluids. Case fatality ranges from 25% to 90%, influenced by access to care and outbreak dynamics. The article highlights the global threat and urges serious attention to Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がアフリカで急速に拡大中 - PrimaMedia.ru
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、多国家への国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO由来の国際保健上の緊急事態として既に指定されており、死亡率25-90%の高リスク病原体である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ流行の震源地はコンゴ民主共和国（東部）と明示されている。ウガンダへの拡大懸念が言及されているが、サマリー上では確定的な発生地としてはDRCのみが主題である。武装紛争による公衆衛生上の対応困難があり、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態として既に指定している。

article.articleHeadline: Κονγκό: Περισσότερα από 900 τα κρούσματα του Έμπολα - Συναγερμός στο Π.Ο.Υ.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: More than 900 Ebola cases — Alarm at the WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 people are estimated to have contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases, as surveillance ramps up per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In the latest official tally, the health ministry of the Central African country reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing outbreak. Declared on May 15 and attributed to the rare Bundibugyo strain, the outbreak has no vaccines or therapies and a case fatality rate up to 50%. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola has killed at least 15,000 people in Africa over the past five decades, with fatality rates generally ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ: エボラ患者900人以上 — WHO警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数死亡例、PHEIC宣言済み、国際拡大リスク（中央アフリカ共和国への拡大報告）、高い致死率（50%）による深刻な公衆衛生影響。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国は記事サマリーに記載されているが、確定患者数が明記されておらず、DRCでの動向が主題のため verified_locations には含めなかった。PHEIC宣言済み、ワクチン・治療法なし、致死率50%という深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ оценивает риск распространения вируса Эболы, как крайне высокий
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO assesses the risk of Ebola virus spread as extremely high
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization raises risk of Ebola spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to extremely high. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the outbreak is unfolding rapidly. The risk assessment places country-level risk as very high, regional risk as high, and global risk as low. Protests have erupted after a treatment center was burned; tensions rose as relatives attempted to retrieve the body of a person who died of Ebola from Rwampara hospital. WHO calls for coordinated action by local authorities and international partners to control transmission and deliver effective treatment and prevention. Measures emphasized include vaccination, public awareness of symptoms, and ongoing briefings and information campaigns to improve preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがエボラウイルスの拡大リスクを極めて高いと評価
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の急速な流行拡大、WHOによる極めて高いリスク評価、国家レベルのリスク認定、および国際的な対応要請がされており、IHR基準4項目全てが該当する深刻な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、ルワンダはKigali Provinceでの緊張（遺体搬出時の事象）の文脈で言及されているが、実際の発生地域はDRCに限定される。WHOの極めて高いリスク評価（国家レベル）、急速な流行展開、治療センター焼却などの社会不安が報告されており、国際的対応・ワクチン接種などが強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": إصابات "إيبولا" تتجاوز 900 حالة في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola cases exceed 900 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak began on May 15 and is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. No death toll update was provided in the latest statement. In a previous update, the DRC Ministry of Health said 204 deaths had been recorded across three provinces among 867 suspected cases. Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa in the last five decades. The ongoing response includes intensified surveillance and control efforts as authorities work to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模なアウトブレイクであり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。重篤度が高く、確定症例と死亡者が報告されており、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（特にBundibugyo ebolavirus株）による新規アウトブレイク。900件以上の疑いケース、101件の確定症例、204件の死亡が報告されている。ワクチンや承認された治療法がない株である点が特に懸念される。WHO事務局長からの公式発表に基づく情報。フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: سازمان صحی جهان: بیش از ۹۰۰ مورد مشکوک ابتلا به ابولا در کانگو شناسایی شده‌است
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports a surge of Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 900 suspected cases identified and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. Africa CDC notes at least 177 Ebola deaths to date, though the true toll may be higher. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said risk assessments are being revised to very high at the national level, high regionally, and low globally. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with blood or body fluids of infected people or animals; common symptoms include fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting, and, in severe cases, bleeding. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene and avoiding contact with contaminated materials. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑似症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてが該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。大規模な疑似症例数（900件以上）と確認死亡者（177人以上）により、深刻な感染症危機として認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ流行を主要なイベントとして報告している。900件以上の疑似症例、101件の確認感染、177人以上の死亡を記載。WHO事務局長による「国家レベルで非常に高リスク」との評価も記載。ウイルス性出血熱の特性上、人動物接触と直接接触による感染拡大リスクが高い。対象国リストに該当するのはコンゴ民主共和国のみ。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria intensifies Ebola surveillance amid fresh outbreak fears in East Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease: Nigeria intensifies surveillance as East African outbreaks prompt heightened readiness. As of 2026-05-25, Nigeria has no confirmed Ebola case linked to Uganda or the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreaks, but importation risk is deemed high due to international travel and population movement. The NCDC has placed the National Emergency Operations Centre on alert and activated the National Incident Management System to coordinate nationwide response. Epidemiologists and Rapid Response Teams are on standby, with intensified surveillance at border communities, international airports and major transport hubs. Preparedness measures include distribution of Ebola infection prevention tools and checklists, staff refresher training, designation of isolation and treatment centers, bed-capacity and logistics strengthening, and prepositioning of PPE and lab supplies. Public awareness campaigns counter misinformation using Ebola Myths and Facts materials. Nigeria's 2014 Lagos outbreak (20 cases, 8 deaths) provides historical context for rapid action.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、東アフリカの新規アウトブレイク懸念の中でエボラ監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。エボラウイルス病という高い公衆衛生リスク疾患で、複数国での同時発生とナイジェリアへの輸入リスクが指摘されており、政府対応も既に強化されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはナイジェリアのエボラ監視強化を主題としているが、実際の発生地はウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、モザンビークは対象国外のため除外。高度な準備態勢が既に構築されており、政府レベルの対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Stravičan napad na Kijev, novi soj ebole se širi, skandal potresa Britaniju: Šta se juče dogodilo u svetu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A horrific attack on Kyiv, a new strain of Ebola is spreading, a scandal rocks Britain: What happened yesterday in the world?
article.articleSummary: New Ebola strain spreading in Central Africa, likely from fruit bats to humans; outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Report notes at least 204 deaths and about 870 infections. Investigators are racing to contain transmission in DR Congo, with ongoing surveillance, case management, and public health measures. Three Red Cross volunteers died in DR Congo, suspected Ebola fatalities linked to handling bodies of the deceased. The spillover from animal hosts appears to have triggered the first incident, with continued human-to-human transmission. No imported or exported Ebola cases are detailed in the report. Health authorities are coordinating cross-border response and risk communication to prevent wider spread. Published May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: キーウへの恐ろしい攻撃、新しいエボラウイルス株が拡大、英国を揺るがすスキャンダル：昨日世界で何が起こったか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てが該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全てが該当する。エボラ出血熱の新種が中央アフリカで拡大し、死亡者204名・感染者870名以上の大規模なアウトブレイクであり、ヒト・ヒト感染が継続中である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによるとエボラ出血熱の新種が中央アフリカ（主にDRC）で拡大中。動物から人間への感染が起点で、ヒト・ヒト感染が継続している。赤十字ボランティア3名を含む204名の死亡者が報告されており、国境を超えた対応が実施中。このイベントはWHO通知基準（IHR Annex2）の全4項目に該当する国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威である。

article.articleHeadline: 致命病毒埃博拉再度肆虐，非洲面临前所未有防控难点
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Ebola virus ravages again, Africa faces unprecedented prevention and control challenges.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri Province, centered on Bunia and Mongwalu near the Uganda border, is spreading through close contact. As of May 22, the World Health Organization raised the national risk level to very high, with more than 750 suspected cases and about 1,400 close contacts being traced. The earliest known case is a nurse who fell ill on April 24 in Bunia and died; the subsequent funeral led to further transmission. By May 5, Mongwalu reportedly had about 50 deaths, and on May 15 the DRC officially declared a new Ebola outbreak. Bundibugyo ebolavirus currently has no vaccine, antiviral therapy, or rapid diagnostics, complicating containment. Specimens from Ituri must be transported up to 2,000 km to Kinshasa's National Biomedical Research Institute, with a testing capacity of six per hour and results taking days. The crisis is worsened by conflict-driven displacement and a system, raising cross-border concerns.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラウイルスが再び蔓延、アフリカは前例のない防疫上の課題に直面
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の確定的な流行で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。750例以上の疑い患者、約1,400名の接触者追跡、死亡例あり、WHOが国家リスクレベルを最高段階に引き上げ、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ国境近辺）と医療体制の限界が明らかであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus型であり、既知のワクチンや抗ウイルス治療法がない。ウガンダ国境近辺での発生のため越境感染リスク高い。検査体制の限界（1時間に6検体、結果に数日要する）が対応を困難にしている。紛争による人口移動が伝播を加速させる可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: 의심 환자 벌써 900명...바이러스 확산 '초비상'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 900 suspected cases already... virus spread 'red alert'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in eastern Ituri Province, with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths as of May 23, 2026. Confirmed infections total 101, with 10 confirmed deaths and no recoveries reported. Earlier tallies showed 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths on May 22, and 746 suspected cases with 176 suspected deaths on May 21; authorities did not explain the apparent drop in suspected deaths. Ongoing conflict, armed groups, and reduced aid impede response efforts, and two Ebola treatment centers in Ituri were firebombed last week by local residents. Ituri hosts roughly one million displaced people amid activity by groups such as M23 and ADF. The World Health Organization regards domestic outbreak risk as very high, while global spread remains low. No infection source or export/import case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 疑い患者すでに900人...ウイルス拡散「超警戒態勢」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病アウトブレイクの継続、複数死亡例、紛争地域での対応困難により高リスク。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国東部イトゥリ州でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク継続。2026年5月23日時点で疑い患者904名、疑い死亡例119名、確認患者101名（確認死亡10名）。武力紛争、武装勢力活動、治療施設への攻撃により対応が著しく阻害されている。WHO評価では国内リスクは非常に高いが、世界的拡大リスクは低いとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Tramp o detaljima pregovora, biznismen iz BiH ubijen u Nemačkoj, novi soj ebole: Šta se desilo juče u svetu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trump on the details of negotiations, Bosnian businessman killed in Germany, new strain of Ebola: What happened yesterday in the world?
article.articleSummary: New Ebola sub-strain circulating in Central Africa, likely originating from fruit bats, has sparked an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. Researchers are racing to contain transmission as the epidemic unfolds in the DRC, with at least 204 deaths and approximately 870 people infected reported to date. On Friday, the World Health Organization raised the outbreak threat level from high to very high, signaling a potentially prolonged and difficult containment. Officials believe the epidemic may have been silently spreading for months before detection. There is concern about spillover into human populations and potential for broader regional spread, underscoring the need for intensified surveillance, rapid case finding, and infection control measures within the DRC and neighboring areas.

triage.headline_ja: トランプが交渉の詳細について語る、ボスニア人ビジネスマンがドイツで殺害、新しいエボラ株：昨日世界で何が起きたか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRCでの確認されたエボラ流行であり、死亡者数・感染者数が多く、WHO脅威レベルが「非常に高い」に引き上げられている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中央アフリカ全体と特にDRCでのエボラ新亜系統の流行を主題としている。204人以上の死亡、約870人の感染が報告されており、WHOが脅威レベルを高から非常に高に引き上げている。隣接地域への波及リスク、数ヶ月間の無症状伝播の可能性が指摘されている。Bluedotの「発生地域」にCentral Africa（地域コード）も含まれているが、記事の実質的な発生地はDRCに特定されている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: أكثر من 900 حالة اشتباه إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية - أردو بوینت
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Urdu Point
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization stated in Geneva that the Democratic Republic of the Congo is facing an Ebola outbreak with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed cases to date. The outbreak centers on the rare Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, a variant WHO had previously identified. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the risk of a national-level epidemic in the DRC remains very high. The figures reflect a large pool of suspected cases alongside confirmed infections, underscoring the ongoing challenge of containing transmission of this rare Ebola lineage within the country. The situation signals a significant international public health threat for the DRC as of the published date.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い症例が900例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤で、DRCでは大規模流行リスクが警告されており、国際的な懸念および渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月25日付でWHOジュネーブオフィスからの発表を報道。DRCでのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）について、疑い症例900例以上、確認症例101例を報告。WHOトップが国家規模流行リスクが非常に高いと警告。Genève（ジュネーブ）はWHO発表地点であり、実際の流行地はDRCのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases top 900 in DR Congo: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has more than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections identified through expanded surveillance after the May 15 outbreak declaration tied to the Bundibugyo strain, which has no approved vaccines or treatments. The health ministry's latest update cites 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces; the WHO chief did not provide a death toll update in a Sunday post. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. Laboratory confirmation is ongoing for suspected cases; no details on imported or exported cases are provided. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congo(コンゴ民主共和国)のエボラ疑い患者が900例を超える：WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模発生は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の危険性を内在している。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン・治療法が承認されていないため懸念度が高い。904年以来アフリカでエボラによる死亡者は15,000人超。3州にまたがる発生で地域的な拡大傾向が見られる。2026年5月15日の発症宣言後の急速な症例増加は懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Число заболевших лихорадкой Эбола в Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola virus disease cases in Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 119 deaths. The World Health Organization rates the outbreak as a very high risk for Congo, while global risk remains low. In the east, Ebola treatment centers have been attacked, with the first arson at the Rwampar Ebola treatment center by youths who sought to retrieve a friend's body; locals accuse an international humanitarian organization amid strict public-health restrictions, such as prohibiting traditional funerals. Cases are also reported in large refugee camps housing people displaced by ongoing intercommunal conflict in Congo. The outbreak continues to strain health services and humanitarian operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱患者数が900人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5項目該当。大規模アウトブレイク（900人超の疑い患者、119人死亡）で社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高リスク。難民キャンプでの発生、治療センターへの攻撃による感染対策阻害など、管理上の課題が複合している。難民流入による地域内および周辺国への拡大リスクが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Понад 200 людей могли загинути від Еболи у Конго через насильство та зрив боротьби зі спалахом | УНН
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 200 people could have died from Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to violence and a breakdown in the response to the outbreak | UNN
article.articleSummary: 210 Ebola-related deaths and 900+ probable cases have been reported in three eastern provinces of the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 23, with only about 20% of potential contacts identified. Violence and attacks on healthcare facilities, including arson of Ebola treatment tents in Ituri, are severely hindering the response and driving clinicians and aid workers to withdraw. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns that insecurity undermines contact tracing and early case detection. Regional health ministers warn of cross-border spread risks due to active population movement and weak border controls, with ten African countries identified as at risk. Uganda has confirmed five cases linked to the Congo outbreak. The outbreak is described as the third-largest in history.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ熱で200人以上が死亡した可能性、暴力と対応の崩壊が原因 | UNN
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（第3位の規模）で、国境を越えた拡大リスク、複数国への影響、および対応能力の深刻な阻害が認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダも含まれているが、サマリーでは5例の確認報告にとどまり、主要な発生地はDRCであるため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。暴力による対応能力の低下、接触者追跡の停滞（約20%のみ特定）、医療施設への攻撃（イトゥリ州）により、さらなる拡大のリスクが極めて高い。10の アフリカ諸国が危険リストに含まれているが、それらは対象国に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Identificados más de 900 casos sospechosos en respuesta al ébola en República Democrática del Congo, según OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected cases identified in response to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 confirmed, as the response intensifies in Ituri province, the outbreak’s epicenter where about five million people live amid ongoing conflict. Violence and displacement are hindering contact tracing and timely identification of infections. Approximately one in five residents are internally displaced, complicating access for health workers and responders. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said the agency and partners remain on the ground across Ituri, including the most insecure areas, emphasizing a comprehensive package of health services to build trust and sustain care. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus; on May 16 it was declared a public health emergency of international concern, with risk assessments on May 22 rated very high nationally, high regionally, and low globally.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱対応において900例以上の疑い患者が確認されたとWHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ出血熱アウトブレークである。複数のWPRO基準にも該当しており、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月16日にPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）として宣言済み。Bundibugyo Ebola virusによるアウトブレーク。Ituri州が震央で約500万人が居住。武力紛争と住民の国内避難により接触追跡が困難。5月22日の評価では国家レベルで非常に高いリスク、地域レベルで高いリスク、グローバルレベルでは低リスクとされている。

article.articleHeadline: مدير منظمة الصحة العالمية: أكثر من 900 حالة مشتبه بها و101 حالة مؤكدة بالإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General: More than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed cases of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected and 101 confirmed Ebola cases are being reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the Ituri region identified as the outbreak epicenter. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance intensification continues as conflict displaces millions: about 5 million people in Ituri live amid armed violence, with one in four needing humanitarian aid and one in five internally displaced. Violence and insecurity hinder contact tracing and early detection, and erode trust in response teams. WHO and partners remain in Ituri's remote and insecure areas to deliver a comprehensive health package, essential for meeting urgent Ebola needs and rebuilding community trust for an effective response. On May 16, Ebola linked to the Bundibugyo virus affecting DRC and Uganda was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with risk assessments updated on May 22 to Very High nationally, High regionally, and Low globally.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス疑い患者900人以上、確認患者101人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの3基準を満たす。5月16日にPHEICが宣言済みで、複数国での発生確認、深刻度評価があり、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（エボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ種）による複数国間の流行。5月16日にPHEIC宣言済み。Ituri地域が震源地で、武力紛争による避難民500万人、接触者追跡困難、地域信頼低下などの対応困難要因あり。WHO及びパートナー組織が現地で対応中。記事サマリー上ではウガンダについても言及されているが、具体的な発生数やイベント詳細がないため検証困難。DRCのみを verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in DRC: WHO
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases reported. In Congo, 82 cases are confirmed, including seven deaths, alongside 177 suspected deaths and nearly 750 suspected infections. Uganda reports two confirmed Ebola cases tied to travelers from the DRC, including one fatality. WHO is revising the risk assessment to very high at the national level, high regionally, and low globally. No updated death toll has been released recently. Ebola is a highly contagious viral disease transmitted through direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected people or animals, with symptoms such as fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting, and bleeding in severe cases. The virus was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC, marking the start of the current concerns.

triage.headline_ja: DRCで900例以上のエボラ疑い患者が確認：WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生で複数国影響。WHO評価で国家レベルで非常に高リスク。
triage.notes: 記事は主にDRCのエボラ発生を扱っており、DRCが主要な発生地。Ugandaは記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。900例以上の疑い患者、101例の確認患者、複数の死亡例が報告され、WHO評価で国家レベルで非常に高リスクとされている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola may have killed over 200 people in Congo as violence disrupts response
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) hits the eastern region, with over 900 suspected cases across 11 health zones and 210 deaths as of May 23. Violence, mistrust and weak surveillance hinder containment; contact follow-up is around 20% per day. Attacks on treatment centers and unrest in Ituri disrupted responses, including a May 24 event in Mongbwalu. Cross-border risk is rising, with porous borders, mining corridors and population movements putting ten African countries at risk. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain drives the outbreak, and there are no approved vaccines or antibody therapies. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Uganda reports five confirmed cases related to the outbreak. An American caregiver infected in Congo was evacuated to Germany; high-risk contacts were moved to Germany and the Czech Republic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがコンゴで200人以上を殺害した可能性、暴力が対応を妨害
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラアウトビレイクで900以上の疑似症例、210人以上の死亡、複数国への越境リスク、WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言あり。即座にフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラアウトブレイクが主題。ウガンダで5例の確認症例報告あり（越境拡大の初期兆候）がウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ドイツ、チェコへの患者搬送は医療避難に伴う輸入症例であり原発生地ではない。DRCのみ該当。WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）がなされており、極めて高いリスク評価である。

article.articleHeadline: Почти 150 коров погибли от неизвестной болезни в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nearly 150 cows died from an unknown disease in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Approximately 150 cattle in the Central Congo region of the Democratic Republic of the Congo have died from an unknown tick-borne disease. Reported by radio Okapi and cited by AIF-Moscow, cases began about three months ago. Farmers link transmission to ticks and suspect the outbreak originated from the December arrival of livestock from neighboring countries. Infected cows show fatigue, impaired coordination, and reduced appetite. Officials have imposed a quarantine to prevent potentially infected meat from entering markets. Separately, the report notes ongoing Ebola activity in the DRC with air-travel restrictions around Bunia. No laboratory confirmation is provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでほぼ150頭の牛が原因不明の病気で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主要な事象は原因不明の牛疾病（ダニ媒介）であり、Ebolaとの直接的な関連は不明確。Ebola分類されているが、実質的な人間への感染症イベントの詳細が欠落している。
triage.notes: 記事はダニ媒介性の原因不明な牛疾病を主題としており、Ebola分類は不適切である可能性がある。DRCにおけるEbola活動の言及は背景情報に過ぎず、本イベントの中核ではない。ラボ確認なし、病原体不明であることが主な懸念。追加情報と病原体確認の続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: NCDC places Nigeria on high alert - The Nation Newspaper
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda triggers Nigeria's heightened alert on 25 May 2026. Nigeria has not recorded any Ebola case linked to the current outbreak. The NCDC activated the National Incident Management System and placed the National Emergency Operations Centre on alert to bolster coordination, reporting and rapid response amid increased regional travel and cross-border movement. A dynamic risk assessment highlighted international travel, population movements, and potential delayed detection due to symptom overlap with malaria and Lassa fever as key concerns. High-risk states, border communities, transport hubs and entry points will see intensified surveillance. Nigeria’s public health infrastructure — labs, rapid response teams, and EOCs — remains in place, with ongoing staff training, laboratory capacity strengthening, and risk communication campaigns. Citizens are advised to practice hand hygiene, avoid bodily fluids of the sick, not handle unknown bushmeat, and rely on verified public health updates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：NCDCがナイジェリアを高度警戒態勢に配置
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダにおけるエボラ発生がナイジェリアに波及する国際的リスク、多国間での対応体制が確立され、異常・予想外の事態、および高い公共衛生上の重要性からIHR基準3項目該当。また地域内での高い関心と対応体制整備がWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるUganda（226074）およびNigeria（2328926）は評価対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCのみがリスト対象国。サマリーから、DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ発生がナイジェリアの警戒体制発動を引き起こし、地域的な国際的リスク伝播の懸念が明確であるため、本イベントは対象国DRCのシグナルとしてピックアップ判定。

article.articleHeadline: O que a atual epidemia de ebola tem de diferente das outras; entenda em 7 pontos
