article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What makes the current Ebola outbreak different from the others; explained in seven points.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri province remains the epicenter of the current Ebola outbreak, with at least 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, and 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, according to the WHO. The Bundibugyo variant—rarer and less understood than Zaire—drives this outbreak, potentially making it the second-largest in world history; the 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak (Zaire) recorded about 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths (~40% CFR). There is no approved treatment or vaccines for Bundibugyo; vaccines exist for Zaire but not this variant, and WHO is evaluating cross-protection from existing vaccines. Diagnosis is hampered by scarce PCR cartridges specific to Bundibugyo, delaying confirmation, contact tracing, and isolation. The outbreak complicates regional control amid armed conflict in DRC, with about 250,000 displaced and difficult access between Bunia and Mongwalu. Other vulnerable countries include Angola, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Central African Republic, and Zambia.

triage.headline_ja: 現在のエボラ出血熱の流行が他と異なる点；7つのポイントで理解する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）のDRCでの大規模流行で、治療法やワクチンが不足し、地域紛争の中での制御が困難。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の近隣国を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーでは実際の流行はDRC（Ituri州）が震源地。Zambiaは「脆弱国」として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれるため記載。他の発生地域（スーダン、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、エチオピア、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、ブルンジ）は対象国リストに非該当。Bundibugyo株は稀で、治療法・ワクチンが不足しており、西アフリカ流行（2014-2016、Zaire株）に次ぐ規模の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: افزایش موارد مشکوک ابولا در کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Increase in suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, WHO reports a surge in suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: over 900 suspected, 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak is the 17th in DRC since 1976 and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with the case fatality rate estimated at 30–50%. The epicenter is Ituri province in eastern DRC, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda has reported imported cases. Dozens of deaths are confirmed; more than 100 suspected deaths are under investigation. Ongoing challenges include armed conflict, population displacement, weak health infrastructure, and limited access to remote areas, hindering contact tracing. WHO assesses national risk as very high, regional risk high, and global risk low. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for this strain yet; authorities are testing existing vaccines and strengthening surveillance and rapid response, calling for international support and community training.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラの疑わしい症例の増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。確認症例101例、疑わしい症例900例以上、死亡例多数の報告があり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定症例101例、疑わしい症例900例以上が報告されている。症例致命率30-50%と高い。感染源はブンディブギョエボラウイルス。ウガンダへの輸入症例報告があるが、当記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイクのため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。武装勢力の活動、保健インフラの弱さ、遠隔地へのアクセス困難などが対応を阻害している。WHOが国家リスクを「非常に高い」、地域リスクを「高い」と評価。ワクチンと特異的治療法がまだ利用できない状況。

article.articleHeadline: Reflex.cz - Viry v ráji luxusu: Na velkých výletních lodích vládnou specifické podmínky pro šíření nemocí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reflex.cz - Viruses in the lap of luxury: On large cruise ships, specific conditions for the spread of diseases.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of hantavirus occurred on the Dutch luxury cruise ship Hondius, operated by Oceanwide Expeditions. A Dutch passenger developed a serious hantavirus illness on April 6, during a voyage that had departed Ushuaia, Argentina, on April 1 and was visiting Antarctica and remote southern Atlantic islands near South Georgia. The ship carried about 60 crew members, many Filipino, who provided guest services while passengers paid substantial tips. The episode underscores how large cruise ships’ closed, high-density environments and long itineraries can facilitate the spread of infections, with hantavirus involvement highlighted in recent reporting about Hondius. The voyage’s route near South Georgia is noted in the account. The excerpt does not provide additional case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: 贅沢の楽園のウイルス：大型クルーズ船では感染症が広がるための特定の条件が存在する
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの発症事例は報告されているが、患者1名（オランダ人乗客）であり、船上集団発生の明確な証拠がない。発生地域の地理的バイアス（Bluedotの誤検出）があり、実際の主要発生地は対象国外（アルゼンチン・オランダ船舶）である。公衆衛生上の重大な危機を示す情報も不足している。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した発生地域は大部分が誤検出と判断される。記事サマリーの主題は船舶上でのハンタウイルス発症事例（患者1名）であり、オランダ船（Hondius）のアルゼンチン発のクルーズである。WPRO対象国としてはフィリピン国籍の乗務員（約60名のクルー中多数）の関与があるため、Philippinesのみを verified_locations に含める。ただし実際の感染発生地はアルゼンチン・船舶上であり、対象国外である。情報不足（追加患者数、死亡、船上集団感染の確認なし）のため DISMISS とした。

article.articleHeadline: কঙ্গোর হাসপাতাল থেকে পালালেন ১৮ জন ইবোলা রোগী
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 Ebola patients fled from a hospital in Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, 18 Ebola patients fled a hospital isolation tent in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo after a violent mob attacked a Doctors Without Borders treatment center. The escape leaves highly infectious patients untraceable as they blend into local communities. Hospital director Dr. Richard Lokudi confirmed the disappearances. The event follows a similar attack a week earlier in Roayampora, where protests erupted over a death and a delayed burial; authorities completed a mass burial under heavy security with Red Cross involvement. The World Health Organization has labeled the outbreak as a regional 'very high risk' though global risk remains relatively low. Lab-confirmed cases are 82 with 7 deaths; approximately 750 suspected infections and 177 additional deaths are under investigation. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which no vaccine or treatment exists, underscores the need for community trust and restrictions on large gatherings in northeastern Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの病院からエボラ患者18名が逃げた
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確定症例82件と死亡7件、疑い患者約750名に加え、患者の病院からの逃亡という公衆衛生上の深刻な事態。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による発生。18名の逃げた患者による感染拡大リスクが極めて高い。暴力的な群衆の病院襲撃および社会不安が対応を複雑化させている。WHOは地域レベルで『非常に高いリスク』と評価。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh Ebola có triệu chứng giống cúm, làm sao để phân biệt?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola disease has flu-like symptoms; how can it be distinguished from influenza?
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease spreads rapidly and has a high fatality rate, up to 90% without timely detection and treatment. Due to its severity, many countries classify Ebola as a disease requiring strict surveillance, isolation, and emergency response to prevent entry and spread. Transmission occurs via animal-to-human contact—fruit bats are the natural reservoir—and via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of infected animals or humans; virus can persist in semen after recovery, enabling sexual transmission. Early symptoms resemble influenza, with abrupt fever, profound fatigue, and muscle aches; incubation is 2–21 days. Progression may include vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, kidney and liver dysfunction, and internal/external bleeding. Diagnosis requires laboratory confirmation; specimen handling and transport demand strict biosafety, with three-layer packaging for transport. In Vietnam, border surveillance is tightened, and the VNVC vaccination system is referenced.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ病はインフルエンザのような症状がある。どのように区別するか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラとインフルエンザの識別に関する教育的・情報提供記事であり、ベトナムでの実際の患者発生や流行状況は記述されていない。記事は疾病特性と診断方法の説明であり、シグナルというより予防啓発である。
triage.notes: 記事は一般向けの教育・啓発コンテンツであり、ベトナムでのエボラ流行の報告ではなく、エボラとインフルエンザの症状区別や診断方法に関する情報である。ベトナムの国境監視強化言及により政府関心はあるが、実際の患者発生・流行シグナルとは判断できない。継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: เครียด! คองโกเผย ยอดต้องสงสัยติดเชื้ออีโบลา พุ่งกว่า 900 กลุ่มชายฉกรรจ์บุกป่วนรพ. ทวงศพญาติ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shocking! DR Congo reveals suspected Ebola cases rise to over 900 as armed groups raid a hospital to reclaim their relatives' bodies.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak concentrates in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of May 24, 2026, authorities report 904 suspected Ebola cases and 119 deaths among suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The World Health Organization indicated the outbreak's domestic risk is 'very high,' while global risk remains low. The health response is hindered by ongoing violence and displacement; earlier that week, a hospital in eastern Congo was attacked, with staff evacuated after armed men demanded the bodies of two relatives, marking the third hospital assault in a week and highlighting health-system strain. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Regional Red Cross/Red Crescent officials note that insecurity, displacement, and fragile health systems drive transmission in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: 深刻！コンゴが発表　エボラ疑い例900件超に増加　武装集団が病院を襲撃し親族の遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、既にPHEIC宣言済みの進行中のエボラアウトブレイク。管理能力の低下（武装勢力による保健施設への攻撃）が報告されており、フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国東部のイトゥリ州で発生していることを確認。既にWHOによりPHEIC宣言済み（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）。疑い例904件、確定例101件、死亡119件が報告されており、保健施設が武装勢力による攻撃を受けるなど危機管理体制の深刻な障害が認識されている。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Pandemia de ébola?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Pandemic?
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-25, Ebola fears intensify as outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda are labeled 'very high' risk for Sub-Saharan Africa by the WHO, though global risk remains low as of May 22. About 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths have been reported across Congo and Uganda, prompting concern over the Bundibugyo strain (identified in 2007) with about 30% mortality and no licensed vaccine or approved therapies. Separately, a hantavirus cluster on a cruise has reached 12 cases and appears stabilizing. Historical context recalls the 2013 outbreak that began in Guinea and spread to Liberia, Sierra Leone, Mali, Senegal and Nigeria, with 28,652 cases and 11,325 deaths, including 518 healthcare workers. In Colombia, the Instituto Nacional de Salud reports no alerts or evidence of circulation. The WHO's 79th Assembly in Geneva urged proactive preparedness, epidemiological intelligence, sustainable funding, and equitable access.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱パンデミア？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。コンゴ民主共和国及びウガンダにおけるエボラ出血熱の集団発生が『極度の高リスク』と評価され、750件の疑い例と177人の死亡が報告されており、サハラ以南アフリカでの国際的拡大のリスク、WHOによる明示的な懸念、過去の大規模流行の歴史から公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の発生を主題としている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみ記載。ハンタウイルス感染の言及もあるが、サマリーではクルーズ船での小規模クラスタ（12例）と記述され、地理的位置が不明確なため verified_locations には含めない。コロンビアに関しては、サマリーで「アラートなし・流行の証拠なし」と明記されているため、対象国であっても該当イベントなしとして除外。

article.articleHeadline: Over 900 suspected cases identified in Congo Ebola response: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening, centered in conflict-hit Ituri province. The WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 confirmed infections, as surveillance and emergency responses intensify. Ituri, home to nearly five million people, faces acute humanitarian needs (about one in four requiring aid) and rising internally displaced (about one in five). Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence and mass displacement are disrupting contact tracing and timely care, with health workers and civilians forced to flee. Insecurity, fear, and mistrust within affected communities further hinder transmission prevention and outbreak response, underscoring the challenge of scaling up the response in a volatile environment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対応で900人以上の疑い患者が特定：WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生であり、紛争地域での複雑な状況下での感染拡大が懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生。Ituri州での900人以上の疑い患者（確認例101人）が報告されている。紛争地域での発生に伴い、連絡先追跡困難、医療アクセス阻害、住民の不信感など、対応を複雑化させる要因が多数存在。WHO事務局長による公式警告により社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Irish firm launches rapid hantavirus antibody kits after deadly cruise ship outbreak
article.articleSummary: Irish life sciences company Assay Genie launches ELISA-based hantavirus antibody detection kits for IgG and IgM with results in about 1.5 hours, designed for research use and not diagnostic. Kits aim to study immune responses after exposure and support outbreak investigations, including high-throughput testing. The launch follows the MV Hondius cruise ship outbreak (Dutch-flag) in which three passengers died and several fell ill; the Andes strain was confirmed among cases and can cause hantavirus pulmonary syndrome (HPS) with a 30–50% fatality rate. Argentina has reported 101 hantavirus cases and 32 deaths since last July, per Guardian. Inquiries have come from Saudi Arabia, China, Jordan, and the Philippines. The company argues rapid testing could aid preparedness in high-risk environments like cruises, though the assays are not for clinical screening or diagnosis.

triage.headline_ja: アイルランド企業、致命的なクルーズ船アウトブレイク後、迅速なハンタウイルス抗体キットを発売
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症（Andes株）による死亡者を含むクルーズ船アウトブレイクが報告され、アルゼンチンで101症例・32死亡が発生。複数国（中国、フィリピン、サウジアラビア、ヨルダン）からの問い合わせがあり、国際的な関心が高まっている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にアイルランドの企業による診断キット開発に焦点があるが、背景となるハンタウイルスアウトブレイク（Andes株）はアルゼンチンが中心。対象国リストに基づき、実際の発生国がアルゼンチン（対象外）であるため、言及されている対象国のみを verified_locations に含めた。中国とフィリピンから問い合わせがあったことが示唆されているが、これらは診断キット販売への関心であり、実際の発生地ではない可能性がある。ただしWPRO地域内での関心の高まりが明確であるため、PICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus Alert In Andhra Pradesh: Precautions Issued Amid Concerns
article.articleSummary: Andhra Pradesh on 25 May 2026 declared an Ebola alert with screening for passengers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan at Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, and Vijayawada airports; coordinating with airport authorities and district health officials for screening and quarantine. Symptoms trigger isolation, and close contacts are to be examined promptly. Measures extend to Visakhapatnam Port and road routes. Dedicated isolation wards with 15 beds are being established in teaching hospitals near international airports; PPE kits and virus diagnostic testing kits are stocked. Central Government monitoring and WHO guidance inform an action plan prepared to manage potential cases. Public advisory urges avoiding nonessential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; travelers arriving from affected countries in the past three weeks should report illness to district officials to enable preventive and curative measures.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州におけるエボラウイルスアラート：懸念の中での予防措置発令
triage.triage_reason: インドがエボラ出血熱の輸入リスクに対して公式アラート（screening、隔離準備、公衆への勧告）を宣言。IHR基準で異常性・予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク該当。社会的・政治的関心（中央政府監視、WHO関与）あり。
triage.notes: 記事はインド（アンドラプラデシュ州）での予防的対応を主題としており、Congo、Uganda、South Sudanからの輸入リスク管理が焦点。DRCなど他国は感染源国として言及されているが、本記事のイベント発生地はインド。スクリーニング、隔離施設設置、診断キット備蓄、中央政府監視、WHO関与により管理体制整備状況が確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Over 900 Suspected Cases In Congo, Says WHO Chief
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), including 101 confirmed, as of May 25, 2026. Ituri province, the epicenter, is home to nearly 5 million people living amid conflict; one in four need humanitarian assistance and one in five are internally displaced, hindering contact tracing and early detection. WHO and partners maintain presence across Ituri, including hard‑to‑reach areas, stressing the need for a comprehensive health package to build trust and support the response. On May 16, the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in DRC and Uganda was declared a public health emergency of international concern; on May 22, WHO raised national risk to very high, regional risk to high, and global risk to low. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease transmitted from wildlife to humans and via direct contact with infected fluids, with case fatality rates historically around 50% (range 25–90%).

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイク：コンゴで900件以上の疑い患者、WHOチーフが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（900件以上の疑い患者、101件確定）であり、国際的緊急事態が既に宣言されている。
triage.notes: 既に2026年5月16日にBundibugyo virus outbreakが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)として宣言されている。DRCとウガンダで確認されているが、サマリーの主題は DRC であり verified_locations には DRC のみを含める。Ituri 州は紛争地域であり、人口 500 万人が一般的なヘルスケアと人道支援の課題に直面している。ケース・ファタリティ・レートは歴史的に 25-90% の範囲であり極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ebolatapauksia yli 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola cases over 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections as of May 25, 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported the figures. The disease has spread mainly in eastern DRC. The Bundibugyo-type Ebola virus involved has no vaccine. Death toll estimates vary, with WHO reporting 176 deaths. Finnish virologist Olli Vapalahti says a pandemic is unlikely. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling a substantial risk of local and regional spread. The article does not provide details on symptoms, transmission sources, or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: エボラ患者数が900を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスはワクチン未開発。WHO事務局長による公式報告。東部DRCでの地域的流行。PHEIC宣言済みで国際的懸念が既に公式認定されている。死亡数176件、疑い患者900件超、確定患者101件の詳細データ記載あり。

article.articleHeadline: Health Ministry calls for stronger preparedness against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Health Ministry issued an urgent May 24 dispatch to medical facilities nationwide to strengthen preparedness against Ebola virus disease (EVD). EVD is an acute, highly dangerous infection causing haemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure, with fatality rates up to 90%. It spreads primarily via direct contact with blood, tissues or bodily fluids, and contaminated objects; human-to-human transmission can occur through broken skin or mucous membranes exposed to fluids such as secretions, feces, urine, saliva and semen. On May 17, the World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. Vietnam calls for enhanced surveillance for travelers from outbreak-hit areas within the prior 21 days, strict infection-control measures (protective procedures, screening, triage, isolation), and ongoing monitoring of the global situation, early detection, testing and treatment readiness, and adequate PPE and isolation capacity.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラに対する強化された備えを呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）はIHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・予想外の多国流行・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WHOが既にPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: ベトナムはPHEIC宣言後の警戒態勢強化を主題としており、対象国に含める。ウガンダ（226074）はBluedot発行の地域に含まれるが、記事サマリー上では「DRCおよびウガンダでの発生宣言」が触発要因であり、ベトナムの主要対応が中心。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは対象国であり、PHEICの原発症例地域として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les coupes budgétaires américaines ont-elles eues un impact sur la propagation de l'épidémie?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Did US budget cuts have an impact on the spread of the Ebola outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak with more than 900 suspected cases, per WHO figures as of May 2026. The AU health agency says response funding needs exceed $300 million. The absence of USAID, dissolved by President Trump at the outset, is highlighted as a critical factor. Jeremy Konyndyk, a former USAID emergency director, argues that budget cuts wiped decades of on-the-ground expertise and could have delayed early detection of this flare-up, comparing its risk level to the 2014 West Africa epidemic. He stresses that timely detection hinges on field outreach—hospital or laboratory reports of unexplained illness or mobile clinics flagging viral hemorrhagic fever—reports not reaching U.S. authorities in time. He also critiques White House plans to fund via the UN fifty Ebola clinics in DRC and Uganda as insufficient and misaligned with field realities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国の予算削減は流行拡大に影響を与えたか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例900件超（WHO発表）、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、社会政治的関心が高い。IHR基準3つ以上、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は米国予算削減がDRCでのエボラ流行の初期検出遅延に寄与した可能性を論じている。ウガンダへのエボラ診療所設置言及あるが、サマリー主題はDRCの流行であるためウガンダは検証対象外。対象国リストに含まれない米国・アンゴラは verified_locations に除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus in Congo: इबोला वायरस ने मचाया हाहाकार, 900 के पार पहुंची संक्रमित मामलों की संख्या, अब तक 119 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus in Congo: Ebola virus wreaks havoc, the number of infected cases has crossed 900, 119 people have died so far.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo intensifies with 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths reported as of May 25, 2026. The World Health Organization has declared this as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. A security incident struck Monbgbwalú General Hospital where Ebola patients are treated, marking the third attack on healthcare facilities in a week amid resource shortages. Authorities now require government surveillance for the burial of suspected Ebola victims; gatherings of more than 50 people at funerals or prayer services in northeastern Congo are prohibited to curb transmission. India issued a health advisory urging travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan to report symptoms to authorities, with DGHS enhancing inbound surveillance for arrivals from these countries.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラウイルス：エボラウイルスが大混乱を引き起こし、感染者数が900を超え、119人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：深刻な公衆衛生影響（119人死亡、904症例）、異常/予想外（新規流行）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国への拡大とWHOのPHEIC宣言）、渡航制限のリスク（インドが健康勧告発令）。スクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要な発生地はDRC（東部コンゴ）。ウガンダとスーダンも発生地域リストに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主たる詳細な発生地として記述されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ただしインドは健康勧告を発令している対応国として記載されているため含める。WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言済み。セキュリティ上の課題と医療施設への攻撃も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Lekarze bez Granic o Eboli w Demokratycznej Republice Konga: wyścig z czasem - Vatican News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders on Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: a race against time - Vatican News
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo demands urgent action as of May 25, 2026. Kinshasa government data report 867 suspected cases and 204 probable deaths linked to Bundibugyo Ebola in Ituri province, with Bunia as the epicenter. The WHO notes no approved vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, and mortality is reported between 30% and 50%. MSF describes a race against time, coordinating with Congolese authorities and partners including WHO, which has raised the country’s risk level from high to very high. Challenges include patient care, contact tracing, and maintaining services for malaria, cholera, and HIV. About 50 international staff are expected to join some 400 local specialists in Ituri. Security tensions have led to arson at MSF facilities in Bunia and Mongwalu. Nine other African countries are at risk; the US has mobilized roughly $400 million and the UN about $60 million.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラについて語る：時間との競争 - バチカン放送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaの流行で867疑似症例・204死亡例、他9ヶ国への波及リスク、国際支援（WHO、MSF、米国・国連の資金援助）が動員されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）はコンゴ民主共和国Ituri州を中心に流行中。記事は867疑似症例・204死亡例（30～50%の致死率）を報告し、MSFと国際機関が対応を調整。米国が約4億ドル、国連が約6000万ドルを動員。セキュリティ上の懸念（MSF施設への放火）も記載。他9アフリカ国への波及リスク指摘あり。発生地域に米国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRC内の流行であり、米国の支援活動を指すため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Izbruh ebole vse hujši, v DR Kongo že več kot 900 primerov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak worsening, with more than 900 cases already in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) worsens, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections reported by WHO, while the DRC's health ministry tallies 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths. WHO director Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted the higher true burden, as early in the outbreak it went unrecognized. The epidemic remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces; neighboring Uganda has reported five confirmed cases linked to the outbreak. The WHO has raised the domestic risk level to very high, though global risk remains low. Ebola is transmitted by direct contact with infected body fluids. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain (first isolated in 2007); there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Common symptoms include fever, bleeding, and vomiting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が悪化、コンゴ民主共和国で既に900件以上の症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象、国際的拡大リスク、隣国ウガンダへの波及）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは隣国からの波及確認（5件の確定症例）として言及されており、主たる発生地はDRCである。verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。エボラウイルス病は重篤な病原体で、119人の死亡、国家間での症例波及、WHOによる国内リスク「極度に高い」評価など、極めて懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola Kongo Membabi Buta Tembus 900 Kasus, Fasilitas Kesehatan Justru Diserang Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo Ebola outbreak runs rampant, surpassing 900 cases, with health facilities attacked by residents.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ebola outbreak in the eastern region has surpassed 900 cases, with authorities reporting 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths. Most cases are centered in Ituri province. The World Health Organization has said the outbreak poses a 'very high' risk to the DRC, though global risk remains low, and the outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The response faces security and social challenges, including attacks on Ebola treatment centers in Rwampara, with two centers targeted in two towns last week as violence linked to armed rebels, displacement, poor local governance, and aid cuts complicate containment. Contention over burial practices has driven some hostility; authorities have taken over burials to curb transmission during traditional funerals. A first center burning in Rwampara occurred as residents claimed aid groups lied about Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラアウトハウが猛烈に流行、900ケースを超える、保健施設が住民に攻撃される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なエボラ流行、国際的拡大リスク、国際関心と移動制限の可能性）。PHEIC宣言済みで、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）東部のエボラアウトブレイク（Ituri州が中心）に関するもの。ルワンダについては地理的隣接や関連への言及がないため、記事の主題ではなく除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、100人超の死亡、900ケース超、保健施設への攻撃など複合的リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго загадочная болезнь убила 150 коров: власти вводят карантин
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, a mysterious disease has killed 150 cows; authorities have imposed a quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Mysterious disease in central Democratic Republic of Congo has killed about 150 cows. Authorities imposed a strict quarantine, aiming to bar infected meat from markets as veterinary officials monitor spread from the region. Farmers attribute the outbreak to ticks; the livestock losses began after imports of foreign cattle from neighboring countries in late December. Affected animals show weakness, loss of appetite, and poor coordination. No laboratory-confirmed pathogen is stated; authorities seek to prevent wider spread among domestic animals and protect public health. Separately, the article notes the Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with suspected cases exceeding 900 and 119 deaths officially confirmed. The response faces community resistance and violence against health workers amid staff shortages and bans on traditional burial rites. No details on infection source or laboratory confirmation provided in the article for the Ebola data. The double focus underscores concurrent infectious-disease threats in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで謎の病気が牛150頭を殺す。当局が検疫を導入
triage.triage_reason: DRCで複数の感染症イベント（未確認の牛疾患とエボラ）が同時に報告。エボラは確認症例900件超、死亡119件で深刻な公衆衛生影響。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、国際的拡大リスクあり。
triage.notes: 記事は2つの異なる感染症イベントを報告：(1) 中央DRCの未確認の牛疾患（150頭死亡、ダニが原因と考えられる）、(2) DRCのエボラアウトブレーク（疑い例900件超、確認死亡119件、コミュニティ抵抗と衛生労働者への暴力が報告）。ヒト・動物・ベクターの複合的脅威を示唆。エボラは明確な公衆衛生危機だが、牛疾患は病原体未確認のため詳細評価は困難。いずれにせよDRCはPICKUPの判定に値する。

article.articleHeadline: 39 người ở Quy Nhơn ngộ độc sau ăn bánh mì
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 39 people in Quy Nhon poisoned after eating bread
article.articleSummary: 39 people in Gia Lai province were hospitalized with vomiting, headaches, dizziness and diarrhea after eating bread bought at a shop on Hung Vuong Street in Quy Nhon Bac Ward. As of May 25, Gia Lai Central General Hospital reports patients undergoing intensive care in Infectious Diseases, Pediatrics, Gastroenterology, and Internal Medicine; 12 are under 16 years old. Initial diagnosis is food poisoning; clinical samples have been collected for laboratory confirmation. A 34-year-old patient, Tran Minh Dat, bought two meat sandwiches on May 23; after eating, he developed nausea, dizziness, severe abdominal pain, diarrhea, and fever up to 39°C, and was admitted the next day. Authorities note recent bread-related food poisoning outbreaks in several provinces, with suspected contamination of sandwich fillings (pate, meat, herbs) by Salmonella and E. coli as common culprits.

triage.headline_ja: クイニョン市でパンを食べた39人が食中毒
triage.triage_reason: 腸チフス・パラチフス・大腸菌による集団食中毒イベント（39人が入院）。複数省にわたる同様の食中毒アウトブレイクが報告されており、公衆衛生影響が深刻。ベトナムの感染症監視対象として国家的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではギア・ライ省とクイニョン市の両地点が言及されている。クイニョン市（Quy Nhon）はビンディン省に位置し、発生地域に含まれている。複数の省での類似の食中毒アウトブレイクが注記されており、系統的な食品安全上の懸念を示唆している。サルモネラおよび大腸菌の汚染が疑われる。12人の患者が16歳未満であり、小児への影響が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases top 900 in DR Congo: WHO chief
article.articleSummary: In the conflict-hit Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak declared on May 15 has identified more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 confirmed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance efforts have been scaled up, but the post provided no death toll update. The Bundibugyo strain driving the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatments. The DR Congo health ministry, in a prior update, reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola is a viral disease spread through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. Globally, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people across Africa in the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ疑い例が900例を超える：WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生として公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン・治療法なしという重大性が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生。DRコンゴは紛争地域で、監視体制の強化が進行中。ワクチンおよび承認済み治療法がなく、管理可能性に懸念あり。WHO事務局長からの公式声明であり、国際的関心は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО съобщи за над 900 предполагаеми случая на Ебола в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reported over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Ituri Province, home to about 5 million people, remains the epicenter. Violence displaces populations, hindering contact tracing; roughly a quarter need humanitarian aid and about one-fifth are internally displaced. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the DRC and Uganda; on May 22, the DRC risk was raised to 'very high'. The outbreak is driven by a rare Ebola variant with no approved vaccines or specific treatments. The virus has previously appeared in Uganda (2000) and DRC (2012). Regionally, Sub-Saharan Africa risk remains high, globally risk remains low. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River; typical case fatality is around 50%. Transmission requires close contact with bodily fluids; early symptoms include fever, weakness, and muscle pains, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, organ dysfunction, and hemorrhage.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでのエボラ疑い例900件以上を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて満たす。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク病原体であり、DRCで公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項(PHEIC)が宣言されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはUgandaが言及されているが、確認症例の発生地はDRCに集中しており、PHEICはDRCとUgandaに宣言されている。ただし記事の主題はDRCのエボラ発生であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。対象国リストにUgandaは含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱であり稀な亜種の関与、ワクチン・特異的治療なし、Ituri Province約500万人が影響下、紛争による変位人口発生など極めて重大な懸念状況。

article.articleHeadline: RDC y la OMS elevan a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola y a más de 100 los confirmados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC and WHO raise the number of suspected Ebola cases to more than 900 and the number of confirmed cases to more than 100.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of May 23, 2026, the DRC health authorities report 101 confirmed and 904 suspected cases across 11 health zones, with 119 deaths under suspicion and 10 confirmed deaths; on May 25, the World Health Organization reported over 900 suspected and over 100 confirmed cases. The outbreak circulated for months before recognition. There are no licensed vaccines or antibody therapies for Bundibugyo. The epicenter Ituri is a conflict-affected region where almost five million people live amid ongoing violence, with high humanitarian needs and displacement, complicating surveillance and contact tracing as well as trust. WHO and partners maintain presence across Ituri and advocate for a comprehensive health services package to support response. Africa CDC notes up to 204 suspected Ebola deaths in DRC and Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国とWHOが、エボラ疑似症例を900例以上、確認例を100例以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行で、確認例100+、疑似例900+、死亡104+（疑似死亡119+確認死亡10+ウガンダ204）。ワクチン・治療薬なし、紛争地域での対応困難。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラの発生地がDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）とウガンダに言及されているが、主な流行はDRC。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は希少な株で、ワクチン・特異的治療薬がない点が懸念。紛争地域での防疫対応の困難性を指摘。Africa CDCがウガンダでの204疑似死亡を報告しているが、記事の主要な焦点はDRCの流行であり、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός για τον Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα και φόβοι για νέα εξάπλωση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over Ebola in DR Congo: More than 900 suspected cases and fears of a new outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; outbreak declared May 15, 2026. By May 21, WHO cites over 900 suspected cases, with 101 lab-confirmed infections; local authorities report about 204 deaths among 867 suspected. Transmission centers on Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with cross-border risk as Uganda reports cases. No approved vaccine or specific therapy for Bundibugyo EBV; care remains supportive—hydration, oxygen, and symptom management. Critical control measures include rapid isolation, 21-day contact tracing, PPE for health workers, and safe burials, since corpses are highly infectious. Insecurity in eastern DRC, including attacks on treatment centers, compounds response challenges. WHO assesses very high regional risk but low global risk, with ongoing monitoring for possible spillover.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱に警報：900件以上の疑い例と新たな感染拡大への懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で、既に204人の死亡と900件以上の疑い例があり、ウガンダへの越境リスクもある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるBundibugyo ebolavirus流行を明確に記述。ウガンダについては「cases reported」とあるが、サマリー主体はDRCであるためDRCのみを対象国として含める。2026年5月15日に流行宣言、5月21日時点で101の確認症例と約204人の死亡を報告。東部DRCの不安定性が対応を複雑にしている点が注目される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus explodes in DRC Congo, officials report 119 deaths, and over 900 cases
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus outbreak explodes in DRC Congo with 204 deaths and over 900 cases in the latest surge, with Uganda reporting rising cases as of 2026-05-25. WHO classifies the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo as very high risk; global risk considered low. Authorities in north-eastern Congo banned funeral wakes and gatherings over 50 people; armed personnel guard burials conducted by aid workers. The surge is driven by delayed detection, weak healthcare, and ongoing conflict hindering contact tracing and safe isolation; cross-border movement, community mistrust, and unsafe burial practices have accelerated transmission. The outbreak is dominated by the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, associated with high mortality (60-90%). There is no approved vaccine or treatment reported. India advises citizens to avoid non-essential travel to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; no Indian cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがDRコンゴで急増、当局が119人の死亡と900件以上の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは重症度が高く（致死率60-90%）、200人以上の死亡と900件以上の症例を報告。複数国への国際的拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）の実績があり、ワクチンや治療法がない状況で、渡航勧告など国際的影響も発生している。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とスーダン（366755）も含まれていますが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外しました。インドについては、「インドがDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの渡航を市民に勧告」と記事に明記されており、インド国内での症例は報告されていませんが、対象国リストに含まれているため記録しています。エボラの高い致死率（60-90%）、複数国への拡大、ワクチン・治療法の不在により、フルRRA実施が必須です。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго стремительно растет число случаев Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, the number of Ebola cases is rising rapidly.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), Ebola virus disease is spreading rapidly, with more than 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections reported as of 25 May 2026. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus highlighted difficulties in curbing transmission amid ongoing armed clashes between rebel groups and government forces. The surge underscores persistent vulnerabilities of health systems in conflict-affected regions. The World Health Organization and international humanitarian organizations are urging the global community to intensify support for the DRC to prevent further spread of the virus beyond national borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラの患者数が急速に増加している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的な拡大リスクが明白。900症例以上の疑い患者と101件の確定感染が報告されており、紛争地域での制御困難性により管理可能性が低い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（過去の流行で50-90%）を有し、紛争地域での感染制御の困難さが強調されている。記事サマリーで『国境を超えたさらなる拡大を防ぐ』との懸念が明記されており、国際的な支援要請が行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Travel Advisory: What Every Summer Traveller Needs To Know Before Boarding A Flight
article.articleSummary: India has issued a travel advisory amid fresh Ebola concerns in parts of Africa, urging its citizens to avoid all non-essential travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. As summer travel picks up, officials stress that travellers should stay cautious and informed before flying abroad. There are currently no Ebola cases in India, and the overall risk inside the country remains low. The advisory underlines caution for international travel while outbreaks continue in Africa, and it calls for travellers to remain vigilant and check latest guidance before departure. The article notes the advisory accompanies cautious travel messaging as Ebola concerns persist in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の渡航勧告：夏の旅行者が搭乗前に知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: アフリカでのエボラ熱の流行継続は国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクを示唆するが、インドの記事は主に渡航勧告の紹介であり、新規アウトブレイク発表ではない。情報不足のため要経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの渡航勧告に関するもので、実際のエボラ症例はコンゴ・ウガンダ・南スーダンで報告されている。インドには現在症例なし。Bluedot APIの発生地域にインドが含まれているのは渡航勧告発出国としての言及であるが、verified_locationsではサマリー主題に基づきインドを含める。ウガンダと南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО алармира: Над 900 сомнителни случаи на ебола во Конго, - Trn.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026 – The World Health Organization reports in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 867 suspected cases resulting in 204 deaths, per the DRC Ministry of Health. On May 15, authorities declared an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted rising suspected cases as surveillance intensifies and confirmed a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The article reiterates that Ebola has caused over 15,000 deaths in Africa over the past five decades, with outbreak case-fatality rates historically ranging from 25% to 90%, and up to about 50% in this context."

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑似患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイクは国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として宣言されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として正式に宣言されている。実験室確認感染101件、疑似患者867件、死亡者204名という深刻な状況。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は高い致命率（歴史的に25～90%、現在約50%）を示す。WHO事務局長が直接言及しており、国際的な対応が必要な段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果爆發伊波拉 感染及死亡人數攀升-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: infections and death tolls rise - TTV News Network
article.articleSummary: Novel Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, with cross-border transmission leading to more than 100 deaths and over 600 suspected infections. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. Reported case fatality ranges from 30% to 50%, with mortality potentially near 50%. There is no licensed vaccine or specific cure. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, and rash; progression causes severe inflammation, coagulopathy, bleeding, multi-organ failure, and shock. In response, WHO mobilized medical experts and 18 tons of supplies to the outbreak area, establishing an epidemic center to treat patients, enhance surveillance, and trace contacts. Neighbouring countries are urged to strengthen border surveillance and reporting rather than close borders to prevent panic.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国でエボラ出血熱が発生 感染者と死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの新規発生で100人以上の死亡、600人以上の疑い症例、国際的に懸念されるり患者の健康上の緊急事態（PHEIC）をWHOが宣言。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの新規発生で、Ituri州を中心に100人以上の死亡、600人以上の疑い症例。致死率30～50%。WHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）。医学専門家18トンの物資を動員。国境監視強化を隣接国に要請。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Rapport de Situation de la 17ème épidémie de la Maladie à Virus Ebola/RDC : SitRep MVE SitRep N° 009/MVB_24/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Situation Report on the 17th Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the DRC: SitRep MVE SitRep No. 009/MVB_24/2026
article.articleSummary: As of 23 May 2026, 10 new confirmed Ebola virus disease cases were reported in the DRC’s 17th outbreak: 9 in Mongbwalu and 1 in Katwa. Cumulative confirmed cases rise to Ituri 94, Nord Kivu 6, and Sud Kivu 1. The outbreak spans three provinces, with Ituri as epicenter and 7 of 36 health zones affected—Rwampara, Bunia, Mongbwalu, Nyankunde, Nizi, Kilo, Aru; Nord Kivu with 3 of 35 health zones affected—Goma, Butembo, Katwa; and Sud Kivu with 1 of 34 health zones affected—Miti-Murhesa. Transmission remains ongoing, concentrated in Ituri (epicenter). SitRep No. 009.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラウイルス病流行の状況報告書：SitRep MVE SitRep No. 009/MVB_24/2026
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認例が複数地域で報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の第17次流行。累積確認例は101例（イトゥリ州94例、北キブ州6例、南キブ州1例）。3州にまたがり、イトゥリ州が震源地。伝播は継続中。ルワンダの地名がBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国での発生のみが報告されているため、verified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Países de esta región se activan con protocolos sanitarios en aeropuertos por posibles casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countries in this region activate health protocols at airports due to possible Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) has 204 probable deaths to date. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 30–50% case fatality rate; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The virus likely began circulating in Ituri about two months ago and has spread into North and South Kivu amid ongoing conflict. Uganda has confirmed five cases, including a Congolese national who died in Kampala; this is considered imported. The WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC) a week ago and recently raised the regional risk to very high, with global risk still deemed low. Ten African countries are at risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo (DRC), Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia. The United States has tightened border controls with a 21-day travel ban for foreigners who visited these areas.

triage.headline_ja: この地域の国々がエボラの可能性のある症例により空港での衛生プロトコルを発動
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラアウトブレイク（CFR 30-50%、204人の死亡）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、10ヶ国での地域リスク評価、米国を含む国際的な渡航制限実施。
triage.notes: エボラの実際の発生地はDRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）およびウガンダ（輸入例）。対象国リストの中でDRCとザンビア（地域リスク国として言及）を verified_locations に含める。米国の渡航禁止は対象国ではないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言により高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго разъяренная толпа штурмовала больницу с пациентами, зараженными Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Congo, an enraged mob stormed a hospital with patients infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, a mob stormed a hospital in Mongbvalu treating Ebola patients, the third attack on regional health facilities in days. Witnesses say residents demanded the bodies of deceased relatives; gunfire was heard, though no injuries were confirmed. Medical teams withhold bodies because deceased Ebola patients remain highly infectious, and burials are conducted by specialized squads in protective gear with armed guards at cemeteries. Earlier in Rwampara, unknown assailants torched a field center for suspected Ebola patients, allowing 18 potentially infected individuals to escape and whose whereabouts remain unknown. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned of deep mistrust toward health workers and humanitarian groups, complicating vaccination, contact tracing, and care amid ongoing conflict in the east with Islamist groups and M23 rebels. WHO cites over 900 suspected cases, 101 laboratory-confirmed, and at least 176 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで激怒した群衆がエボラ患者を収容する病院を襲撃
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行、複数の死亡、医療施設への攻撃による感染制御の破綻、および国際的な懸念が存在。IHR基準3項目以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCにおけるエボラ流行の詳細を述べており、Kigali Province（ルワンダ）およびRepublic of Rwanda自体は発生地として述べられていない。DRCが主要発生地であり、ルワンダは言及されていない。医療施設への暴力によるエスカレーション、約900例の疑い患者、101確認例、176以上の死亡が報告されている。接触追跡の困難さ、医療従事者への不信感、東部紛争による複雑化が指摘されており、WHOが公式に警告を発出している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, l'allerta si estende a dieci nazioni: l'epidemia minaccia l'Africa centrale.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, the alert has spread to ten countries: the epidemic threatens Central Africa.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain outbreak rooted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo threatens to spread to ten African states: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia, with foci in DRC and Uganda. Director Jean Kaseya confirms monitoring to prevent a cross-border catastrophe. Epidemiological analyses suggest circulation began before identification; the first patient showed symptoms on April 24, 2026, and Imperial College models place transmission as early as late March/early April. Delayed detection stems from technical and social factors, including low test sensitivity, suboptimal samples, funeral ceremonies, and hospital contacts. Bundibugyo variant carries mutations; vaccines for the Zaire strain may have limited efficacy against it. Conflicts around Goma and Ituri, and M23 activity, hinder tracing. WHO flags high internal risk for DRC and high risk for neighbors. No specific drugs exist; containment and thorough contact tracing are essential; risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、警戒が10ヶ国に拡大：中央アフリカが脅威にさらされている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo株による新規流行で、DRC内での多地点での症例、10ヶ国への越境拡大リスク、ワクチン効果の不確実性が確認され、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはAngola、Burundi、Central African Republic、Republic of the Congo、Ethiopia、Kenya、Rwanda、South Sudan、Tanzaniaが拡大リスク国として列挙されているが、対象国リスト内で検証されたのはDRCとZambiaのみ。Bundibugyo株の新規流行は現在のワクチン（Zaire株対応）の効果が限定的である点が懸念。DRC内のGoma、Ituri、Ugandarでの活動が報告されており、紛争・M23活動による疫学調査の困難性あり。初例患者の症状発症が2026年4月24日で、流行初期検出の遅延が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Grupos de jóvenes irrumpen en un hospital del Congo para enfermos de ébola y exigen los cuerpos de sus familiares
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Groups of young people storm a hospital in the Congo for Ebola patients and demand the bodies of their relatives
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo’s Ituri province escalates as groups attack health facilities. In Mongbwalu, General Hospital Mongbwalu was stormed Sunday night by youths demanding bodies of relatives; gunfire sounded as staff evacuated patients. The assault follows two earlier attacks on Ebola treatment sites, highlighting the strain on an under-resourced system. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Authorities have barred funeral rites and large gatherings to curb transmission. On Saturday, a camp treating suspected cases was set on fire in Mongbwalu, with 18 people with suspected infection fleeing. A separate attack occurred in Rwampara. The Congolese ministry reported 904 suspected cases, mostly in Ituri, and 119 suspected deaths, though some regional tallies reach 220. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which there is no vaccine; Bunia reported a late-April death. Three MSF/Red Cross volunteers died after handling corpses, delaying the outbreak’s onset.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者病院に若者グループが乱入し、親族の遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中4項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目中5項目該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国東部イツリ州のエボラアウトブレイクを主題としている。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）が発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、サマリー上ではルワンダでの発生は明記されておらず、主要な発生地はDRCのIturi州（Bunia、Mongbwalu）である。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、ワクチン未対応のBundibugyo変異体、医療施設への攻撃による管理困難性が特徴。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand announces Ebola quarantine measures - even for people with no symptoms
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, declared a public health emergency of global concern by WHO on May 17; no approved vaccine or treatment. Thailand tightens screening for arrivals from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, ordering a 21-day quarantine even for asymptomatic travelers; by May 22 eight arrivals from Uganda and two from Congo were quarantined though asymptomatic. In Congo, the outbreak has generated more than 900 suspected cases, with about 101 laboratory-confirmed as of mid-May. Three International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent volunteers died in Ituri province (Ajiko Chandiru Viviane, Sezabo Katanabo, Alikana Udumusi Augustin) after likely contracting Ebola during dead-body management in March; they died on May 5, 15 and 16 respectively. Unsafe burials are a leading driver; Red Cross reports door-to-door efforts to counter misinformation. The situation reflects rising international surveillance and cross-border exposure from Uganda and Congo.

triage.headline_ja: タイがエボラ対策を強化 - 無症状者も含めた隔離措置を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)宣言済み、複数国への国際的拡大、各国による渡航制限措置が進行中。
triage.notes: Uganda はGeoNames ID 226074で対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事では Uganda からの渡航者隔離が主要な対応策として記述されている。Bundibugyo 株は Zaire 株より低い死亡率であるが、PHEIC 宣言により国際関心は極めて高い。Red Cross ボランティアの死亡により現地での管理困難性が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: "الصحة العالمية": أكثر من 900 حالة اشتباه إصابة بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak involves the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which WHO previously designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The agency warns the national risk in the DRC remains very high. Contributing factors include delayed detection of cases, absence of vaccines or therapies specific to this virus, ongoing armed conflict, and high population movement, all of which hinder surveillance and response efforts. The report underscores that these combined challenges heighten the threat to the DRC and attract international attention, highlighting the need for strengthened detection, medical countermeasures, and security-enabled outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い例が900例以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC指定されたBundibugyo Ebolavirus株による大規模発生。国際的な懸念と支援必要性が高い。
triage.notes: PHEIC指定済みのBundibugyo Ebola virus株による発生。900例以上の疑い例と101例の確定例。武装紛争、ワクチン/治療薬の欠如、人口移動による対応阻害など複合リスク要因あり。即座にフルRRAに進める。

article.articleHeadline: Strzelanina w szpitalu z ebolą! "Nie chcą wydawać ciał"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gunfight at an Ebola hospital! "They won't release the bodies."
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks escalate in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri, with Mongbwalu General Hospital attacked Sunday evening as residents demanded the bodies of two relatives; gunfire was heard and staff rushed to evacuate patients. This is the third hospital attack in a week amid disputes over burial rules, with authorities insisting that bodies can still transmit the virus and funerals be state-organized, prompting bans on wakes and large gatherings in the northeast. More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, most in Ituri. Official death tolls are inconsistent: the government cites 119 suspected fatalities, while detailed counts reach about 220. MSF’s tent for suspected Ebola patients was burned in Mongbwalu, and 18 patients fled; another treatment center was burned in Rwampara. There is no vaccine for the Bundibugyo strain; WHO regards the outbreak risk as very high in the DRC, while global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱病院での銃撃事件！「遺体を引き渡してくれない」
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（900件以上の疑い患者、200名以上の死亡）がコンゴ民主共和国東部で発生しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にコンゴ民主共和国（特にIturi州Mongbwalu）でのエボラ流行を報じている。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）がBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではルワンダでの発生について言及されていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。Bundibugyo株で既知のワクチンがなく、WHO地域的リスク評価も「very high」と判定されている。社会不安（病院襲撃、遺体の扱いをめぐる紛争）も顕著。

article.articleHeadline: دول أفريقية تشدد إجراءاتها خشية اتساع تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African countries tighten measures amid fears of a widening Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in eastern and southern Africa prompt tighter border screening and community outreach. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, suspected infections exceed 900, with WHO reporting 750 confirmed cases and 177 deaths through Friday. Uganda has five cases after three new infections and is urging calm and vigilance. Rwanda tightens entry checks and bars foreigners who traveled through Congo in the last 30 days, with mandatory quarantine for returning citizens. Malawi intensifies airport and border testing and activated health emergency plans. Zambia describes the threat as very high due to porous borders and potential pre-symptomatic transmission, noting up to a 21-day incubation. Uganda suspends major cultural events and some transport links with Congo for four weeks. The United States pledges $23 million to support response; aid groups warn containment is hampered by security issues and limited diagnostic capacity in DRC. Published May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国がエボラ出血熱の流行拡大への懸念から対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全て該当。確認済み死亡者177名、複数国での広がり、複数国による対策強化と国際支援を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでルワンダとマラウイの対策強化が述べられているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外。ウガンダも対策強化が述べられているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。米国は資金援助提供国であり、エボラ発生地域ではないため除外。DRCで900+の疑い例、750の確認例、177の死亡が報告されており、極めて深刻。複数国での国際的な対策強化とウイルスの国境越え拡大のリスクが明白。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola outbreak in Congo: A call for global action
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and nearby Uganda has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO. The outbreak has already claimed many lives and is hindered by damaged infrastructure, scarce hospitals, and fear or misunderstanding surrounding Ebola. These factors complicate containment and the delivery of aid. The response is weakened by cuts in US foreign aid and the United States' withdrawal from the World Health Organization, undermining international support. Many academics say political decisions and global inequality worsen the crisis. The article calls for urgent, unified global action to protect vulnerable communities and prevent further loss of life.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行：世界的行動の呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告され、WHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されている。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの流行を言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。USA（対象国外）の外交政策や国際支援の低下についても述べられているが、当該記事が主題とする感染症イベント発生地は DRC である。WHO の PHEIC 宣言済みであり、複数の死亡者が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi: število okuženih se bliža 1000, pogrebne obrede prepovedali | 24ur.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading: the number of infected is nearing 1,000, funeral rites have been banned | 24ur.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with the World Health Organization and local authorities reporting more than 900 suspected cases and about 119 Ebola-related deaths as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak persists, with counts aligning between WHO estimates and national totals. Frontline health workers face shortages of basic personal protective equipment, hindering response efforts. Communities exhibit increasing resistance to containment, preferring traditional burial practices while corpses remain infectious. In response, authorities have banned funeral rites and limited gatherings to curb transmission. The situation highlights ongoing transmission in the DRC and underscores the need for safe burial protocols, robust infection control, and adequate PPE for healthcare workers. Keywords: outbreak, PPE shortage, burial bans, Congo, Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大：感染者数が1,000に近づき、葬儀の儀式が禁止されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクは深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的な懸念、および感染制御上の課題を示している。
triage.notes: 900例以上の疑い例と119例の死亡が報告されており、医療従事者のPPE不足と地域レベルの伝統的埋葬慣行への抵抗が対応を複雑にしている。WHOと現地当局の報告が一致し、継続的な人間-人間感染が確認されている。国際支援と感染制御強化が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Top 5 Stories Of The Day | NCDC Raises Ebola Alert as Congo and Uganda Outbreaks Worsen " YNaija
article.articleSummary: No confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria as of 2026-05-25, despite a regional outbreak in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control and Prevention (NCDC) has intensified nationwide surveillance and emergency preparedness. The public health advisory from Director-General Jide Idris notes that Nigeria's risk of importation remains high due to international travel and population movement. Border communities, transport hubs, and international entry points are flagged as high-risk for early detection gaps. Ebola symptoms can mimic malaria or Lassa fever, risking delayed recognition. The update provides guidance for monitoring and does not report laboratory-confirmed cases in Nigeria or details on infection sources or export/import cases.

triage.headline_ja: 本日のトップ5ニュース | NCDCがコンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ流行悪化に警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。ウガンダ・DRCでのエボラ流行拡大が確認され、ナイジェリアへの輸入リスクが高い状況であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ・ウガンダでのエボラ流行の悪化とナイジェリアへの輸入リスク上昇を主題としている。ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCは対象国として含める。ナイジェリアは確認例がないため対象外。Bluedot APIが付与した地域（Uganda, Nigeria）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、記事サマリーの主題国（DRC）のみ verified_locations に含める。ザンビアについては、DRC流行との地域的近接性から関連国として別途検討する必要があるが、記事サマリーに明示的に記載されていないため、厳格なルール適用によりDRCのみとすべき。補正：記事に地域的言及がないため verified_locations は [DRC] とする。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola sa v Afrike šíri desivým tempom: Lekári nemajú ani základné ochranné pomôcky
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Africa at a terrifying pace: Doctors do not even have basic protective equipment.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province), with over 700 suspected cases and more than 170 suspected deaths, concentrated around Bunia where first cases were reported. WHO classifies the outbreak as a 'very high' risk for the country, though global risk remains low. The security crisis in Ituri—marked by attacks from armed groups like M23 and ADF—has driven doctors and nurses from facilities, leaving healthcare systems overwhelmed and nearly one million displaced. The risk to large displacement camps near Bunia is a major concern as the outbreak continues. Funeral restrictions—limiting gatherings to 50 people and often police- or soldier-guarded—reflect containment efforts amid security challenges. Aid cuts from the US and other rich nations have reduced outbreak detection and response capacity. On the ground, humanitarian groups report critical PPE shortages, including face shields, gowns, test kits, body bags, and safe burial supplies; local facilities operate with minimal supplies.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでエボラが恐ろしい速度で拡散：医師たちは基本的な防護具さえ持っていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当し、死亡例を含む多数の患者と医療体制の崩壊が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）Ituri州のエボラ集団発生を主題としている。700以上の疑い例、170以上の死亡が報告されており、WHO が国レベルで「非常に高いリスク」と分類。武装勢力による治安危機、医療体制の崩壊、PPE の深刻な不足、援助削減による検査・対応能力の低下が報告されている。Bunia 周辺の大規模避難民キャンプへのリスクも懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго второй раз за неделю подожгли медцентр с зараженными Эболой, больные сбежали
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, for the second time in a week, a medical center housing Ebola patients was set on fire; the patients fled.
article.articleSummary: In Mongbvalu, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, a mobile Ebola treatment center run by Doctors Without Borders (MSF) was set ablaze by locals, causing 18 symptomatic patients to flee and leaving their whereabouts unknown. This marks the second such attack on a treatment site in a week, following the May 21 burning of a mobile hospital in Rwamparé after residents were prevented from retrieving bodies for burial. MSF condemned the assaults as risking further transmission. On May 22, the World Health Organization raised the national Ebola threat to very high and the regional threat to high, with the global level still considered low. As of May 24, suspected Ebola cases in eastern DRC surpassed 900, and official deaths were revised from 170 to 119, per France24, highlighting an ongoing, severe outbreak and security challenges for health interventions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1週間内に2度目、エボラ感染者収容の医療施設が放火され、患者らが逃走
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の継続的流行、治療施設への暴力的攻撃による患者逃亡で公衆衛生への深刻な脅威、900件以上の疑い患者と国際的拡大リスク、WHO脅威レベルの引き上げにより国際関心も高い。
triage.notes: 東部DRCでのエボラ流行は継続中。治療施設への暴力攻撃は患者逃亡と感染拡大リスクを劇的に増加させ、コミュニティ信頼の喪失を示唆。WHOは国レベルの脅威を「非常に高い」に引き上げており、国際支援と安全保障面での介入強化が急務。疑い患者数900件超は過去のデータ修正と合わせてさらなる監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: تفشي الإيبولا في الكونغو.. 900 حالة مشتبه بها - جريدة الأنباء الإلكترونية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: Ebola outbreak in the Congo... 900 suspected cases - Al-Anbaa Online
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as part of an ongoing outbreak, according to the World Health Organization. Of these, 101 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus posted on social media that intensified surveillance is underway as part of the outbreak response, but there is no update on the death toll. The report emphasizes active monitoring and case confirmation to guide control efforts, with no additional details provided on transmission sources, laboratory confirmations beyond the 101, or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴでのエボラ流行...900の疑い患者 - アルアンバー電子新聞
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。エボラの集団発生は公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。
triage.notes: 900件以上の疑い患者、101件の実験室確認例を伴うエボラ出血熱の継続中の流行。WHO事務局長が社会メディアで報告。死亡数の更新がないため正確な重症度については不明だが、エボラウイルスの高い致命率を考慮すると重大なシグナル。継続的な監視下にあり、フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: UK Researchers "Urgently" Developing Ebola Vaccine Based On Platform Used For Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 Jab * 100PercentFedUp.com * by Danielle
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Bundibugyo Ebolavirus is driving an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, where more than 900 suspected cases have been identified, including 101 confirmed. Ituri province, with about 5 million residents amid ongoing conflict, faces humanitarian need (1 in 4) and internal displacement (1 in 5), complicating surveillance and contact tracing. Oxford Vaccine Group (OVG) and partners are urgently developing a monovalent ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine using the same viral-vector platform that underpinned the Oxford/AstraZeneca COVID-19 jab, with the Clinical BioManufacturing Facility and the Serum Institute of India (SIIPL) to rapidly produce and scale doses, and to support potential ring vaccination trials if needed. The effort aims to generate preclinical data for outbreak use while maintaining ethical and regulatory standards. Teresa Lambe and the team highlight rapid response built on years of research and collaboration; Tedros cites security challenges hindering response.

article.articleHeadline: 135 Warga Dua Desa Jalani Skrining TBC di UPTD Puskesmas Sukamulya Kabupaten Ciamis - Tribunjabar.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 135 residents from two villages undergo TB screening at Sukamulya Puskesmas UPTD, Ciamis Regency - Tribunjabar.id
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, about 135 residents from Desa Cijulang and Desa Sukasetia in Ciamis Regency underwent systematic TB screening at UPTD Puskesmas Sukamulya, integrated with free non-communicable disease (PTM) checks. The effort targets household and close contacts of TB patients, the elderly, and others at risk. Screening begins with TB assessment, followed by chest X-ray; radiographs are interpreted by a doctor to determine if further steps are needed. If abnormalities or symptoms are present, sputum testing with Tes Cepat Molekuler (TCM—rapid molecular test) is used to confirm TB infection. This program is part of a phased TB screening initiative by the Ciamis Health Department. The initiative combines TB and PTM health checks to address infectious and non-communicable disease risks in the community.

triage.headline_ja: チアミス県スカムリヤ保健所でTB検診を受ける135名の住民
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで結核の定期的スクリーニング活動が報告されているが、新規患者の確認や異常な増加を示す具体的証拠がない。スクリーニング自体は公衆衛生上の通常の対応措置と考えられる。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の定期的なスクリーニング活動を報告しており、新規患者数の急増や異常な発症状況についての記載がない。チアミス県保健局による計画的な公衆衛生対応としての解釈が適切。結核は流行しやすい疾患であり、継続的な検視（prolonged_exposure）の可能性があるため、WPRO基準2つが該当しているが、重大度の明確な証拠および社会的パニックの兆候がないため、WATCH判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Tekan Kasus Penyakit Menular dan PTM, Dinkes Banjarmasin Gencarkan Deteksi Dini  - Banjarmasinpost.co.id
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To curb cases of infectious diseases and non-communicable diseases, the Banjarmasin Health Office intensifies early detection.
article.articleSummary: Banjarmasin's Health Office intensifies early detection of both non-communicable and communicable diseases in the city, via socialization, advocacy, and cross-sector coordination with all technical implementation units (UPT), hospitals, community health centers (Puskesmas), district/city pharmacy installations (IFK), and the Public Health Laboratory (Labkesmas). The program emphasizes comprehensive services from screening to management. For non-communicable diseases, hypertension is monitored regularly to prevent stroke and heart disease; diabetes is screened by checking blood glucose; cancer screening is conducted for early detection; and mental health services are integrated at basic health facilities. For infectious diseases with high transmission risk, seven conditions are prioritized: Tuberculosis (with contact tracing to uncover hidden cases); HIV (expanded counseling and voluntary testing); Dengue Fever (rapid clinical screening and intensive care to prevent shock); Acute Respiratory Infections (ARIs) with surveillance among children and the elderly; Measles (active screening and rapid response to fever with rash); Acute Flaccid Paralysis (to maintain polio-free status); and Diphtheria (monitoring for throat symptoms to prevent outbreaks). All efforts are underway in Banjarmasin as of 2026-05-25.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症と非感染症の事例を抑制するため、バンジャルマシン保健所が早期検診を強化
triage.triage_reason: 記事は感染症の公衆衛生対策・早期検診プログラムの実施例であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや異常な発生報告ではない。予防・管理施策の一般的な情報であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の疾患名が列挙されているが、いずれも現在のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、バンジャルマシン市の保健施策における優先監視対象疾患として言及されているのみ。実際の患者発生数、死亡者、地域的異常性の報告がないため、シグナルとしての価値は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 'Ebola virus' spread in Africa prompts strengthened quarantine in Korea
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus, Bundibugyo strain (BDBV), is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the DRC reporting 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases; case fatality is about 30–50%. The World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on the 17th, while Africa CDC warns 10 at-risk countries including DRC, Uganda, Angola, Burundi, and the Central African Republic. Transmission occurs through contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, hemorrhage, and multi-organ failure; no vaccine or treatment exists. Korea tightened its response: Level 1 'Attention' alert, a task force, and designation of DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as key quarantine areas from the 19th; travelers with stay history must report via Q-CODE. KDCA urges reporting for fever or abdominal pain within 21 days of travel and avoidance of fruit bats, primates, or funeral sites. Some projections reach around 1,000 confirmed cases; Korea’s risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラウイルス拡大、韓国で検疫強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、致命率30～50%の深刻なエボラ感染症の国際的拡大リスクがある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにおいて、DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ拡大が主な対象であり、韓国での検疫強化は対応措置である。対象国リストではDRC(203312)のみが該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHO PHEICの宣言、複数国への拡大リスク警告、致命率の高さ、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性から極めて重大なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường giám sát biên giới, chủ động ứng phó nguy cơ dịch LMLM SAT1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen border surveillance, proactively respond to the risk of SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam faces rising SAT1 foot-and-mouth disease risk after China reported its first SAT1 outbreak in April 2026, with cases in Gansu and Xinjiang, underscoring cross-border cattle movement as a transmission route. Vietnam currently detects serotypes O, A, and Asia1; SAT1 has not yet been found domestically. WOAH/FAO warnings note SAT1 spreading beyond Africa to the Middle East, West Asia, and Europe. Vietnam’s livestock herd comprises about 31.4 million pigs, 6.14 million cattle, 1.95 million buffalo, and over 3 million goats and sheep. The response focuses on heightened border and market surveillance, with active monitoring in 11 provinces and more than 1,000 samples; central labs have RT-PCR tests for O, A, Asia1, and SAT1. Vaccine import plans involve Amavet and Argentina partners; stock is unavailable, requiring roughly 4–5 months from order to herd immunity, plus regulatory checks. Long-term aim: develop domestic vaccine production.

triage.headline_ja: 国境監視を強化し、SAT1口蹄疫のリスクに主体的に対応する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。動物由来感染症の国境越えでのリスク上昇が明確であり、ベトナムの防疫体制整備が進行中との報告から、フルRRA実施の必要がある。
triage.notes: 中国での初めてのSAT1型口蹄疫発生（2026年4月、甘粛省・新疆ウイグル自治区）がベトナムの越境家畜移動を通じた感染リスクを急速に高めている。ベトナムは現在O型、A型、Asia1型を検出しているがSAT1型は未検出。WOAHとFAOの警告により、SAT1がアフリカ外でも拡大していることが確認されている。ベトナムの家畜資源規模（豚3,140万頭、牛614万頭など）と11州での積極的監視体制、ワクチン調達計画（アルゼンチン等との協力）が記載されており、地域的に重要な防疫情勢である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Mehr als 900 Verdachtsfälle nach Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected cases after an Ebola outbreak in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant first identified in 2007. This rare strain has no vaccine or targeted therapy, and the case fatality rate is about 30–50%. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), the second-highest alert level. The African Union's Africa CDC has declared a continental emergency due to the high risk of regional spread. Uganda has reported infections as well. As of May 25, 2026, the outbreak is ongoing; the article does not provide details on laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or clinical symptoms in this excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴでのエボラ発生後に900件以上の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の稀なBundibugyo亜種、国際的拡大リスク、PHEIC宣言済み）。複数国での確認とアフリカ大陸非常事態宣言によりWPRO基準も全て満たす。即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも感染が報告されているが、記事サマリーの主眼はDRCでのアウトブレイク。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な亜種で、ワクチン・標準治療の欠如と30-50%の致命率が特に懸念される。WHOはPHEIC宣言済み、アフリカ連合も大陸非常事態を宣言。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole izmiče kontroli: 119 mrtvih, strah raste i u susjednim državama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spiraling out of control: 119 dead, fear growing in neighboring countries.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) with over 900 suspected cases and 119 deaths reported as of 2026-05-25. WHO notes more than 900 possible cases, including 101 confirmed; Congo’s health ministry confirms 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths, with at least 10 lab-confirmed Ebola fatalities. Uganda has reported several confirmed cases linked to the same outbreak. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids; Ebola is a severe hemorrhagic fever caused by the Bundibugyo strain (first identified 2007). There is no specific treatment or vaccine cited in the report. Symptoms include high fever, vomiting, and internal bleeding. WHO has raised the Congo outbreak risk from high to very high, while global risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に：119人が死亡、隣国での不安が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行拡大、国際的拡大リスク、隣国への拡大）。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクであり、複数国への拡大確認とWHOによるリスク引き上げがある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの確認症例は「同アウトブレイクに関連している」と述べられており、主要な発生地はDRCである。DRCでの904件の疑い患者と119人の死亡が主要な関心事。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱であり、治療法やワクチンが報告されていない。WHOがコンゴ国内のリスクを「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, quanto è preparata la Sanità del Friuli Venezia Giulia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, How Prepared Is Friuli Venezia Giulia's Healthcare System?
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness in Friuli Venezia Giulia (FVG), Italy, centers on a historical 2014 alert when the region first implemented a formal protocol—becoming Italy’s first to do so—though the measure did not ultimately trigger a real case. The discussion references an Ebola epidemic centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; however, FVG's ties to Congo were minimal. The article notes that Ebola, while controllable with hand hygiene, patient isolation, and barriers, is facilitated by systemic factors in Congo, such as limited infrastructure and cultural healing practices involving human secretions. Technically, a hospital screening questionnaire assessed recent contact with central Africa sources. In a suspected case, authorities would deploy an ambulance directly to the Infectious Diseases Clinic in Udine or Trieste, rather than routing through a general hospital or ER, to prevent nosocomial spread and protect the broader healthcare system.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、フリウリ・ベネツィア・ジュリア州の保健医療制度はどの程度準備できているか？
triage.triage_reason: イタリアの地域医療体制に関する準備状況の解説記事であり、実際のエボラ症例発生報告ではない。DRCのエボラ流行への言及は背景情報に過ぎず、イタリア国内での発症や国際的拡大リスクの証拠がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はイタリア地域の準備状況解説であり、DRCのエボラ流行状況を背景参考として言及しているのみ。記事サマリーに実際の発症例、疑い例報告、または国際的拡大リスクの具体的根拠がない。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載したが、本記事は疾病サーベイランスのシグナルとしては判定対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് വീണ്ടും ഷിഗെല്ല; പെരുമണ്ണയിലെ 2 കുട്ടികൾക്ക് രോഗബാധ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella in Kozhikode again; two children in Perumunna infected.
article.articleSummary: Shigella infection reported in Kozhikode district again, with two children from Parakkandam and nearby Puthiyottil areas of Perumunna Panchayat testing positive. They were admitted first to Perumunna Health Centre, then transferred to Government Medical College Hospital after initial treatment. Laboratory confirmation of Shigella triggered intensified preventive measures and containment efforts in the area. Shigella causes dysentery with blood in stool, transmitted via the fecal-oral route through contaminated feces and food handling; dehydration can be fatal, and in rare cases infection may involve the brain. Ahead of the monsoon, this month alone more than 100,000 people across the state have sought fever treatment; dengue and leptospirosis cases are rising sharply, prompting heightened public health vigilance in Kerala.

triage.headline_ja: コージコード地区で再びシゲラ感染；ペルムンナの2人の子どもが感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性・重症度・国際拡大リスク）。ケーラ州で複数の感染症（シゲラ、デング、レプトスピラ症）が同時多発的に増加しており、モンスーン時期の公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: 記事はコージコード地区ペルムンナパンチャヤットでのシゲラ感染報告を主とするが、サマリーにはケーラ州全体でのデング・レプトスピラ症の急増（月間10万人以上の発熱患者）も記載されており、複合的な感染症危機の状況を示唆している。モンスーン時期の衛生環境悪化がリスク要因として明記されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS: Peste 900 de cazuri suspecte de Ebola în RD Congo. 101 au fost confirmate
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC. 101 have been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The Ministry of Health reports 204 deaths in three provinces among 867 suspected cases. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments. Ebola transmits via direct contact with body fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever and multi-organ failure. The figures were provided by WHO Director-General in a social media post as surveillance intensified within the response to the outbreak. No updated death toll was given in the briefing. The data underscore the ongoing, high-consequence outbreak in the DRC, highlighting the need for strict infection control and containment measures as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑似症例900例以上、101例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）に該当。エボラ出血熱の確認例が存在し、死亡者（204名）が報告されており、ワクチン・治療法のない株による大規模流行は重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行（ザイール種ではない株）。無承認ワクチン・治療での対応困難。WHO事務局長からの公式発表による情報確度が高い。急速なリスク評価（RRA）の優先対象。
