article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ сообщил о более чем 900 предполагаемых случаях Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Director-General reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in an ongoing outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The epicenter is Ituri Province, where almost 5 million residents live amid ongoing conflict that hampers emergency response, including contact tracing and early detection. Violence and instability impede rescue operations and investigations. The WHO previously declared Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda to be public health emergencies of international concern. The current flare-up is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine at present. The article does not provide details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長が900件以上のエボラ疑い症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900件以上の疑い症例、101件確定症例）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態としての既宣言、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明白。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域として列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは過去のアウトブレイク宣言の文脈のみで、現在の発生地は東部DRCのイトゥーリ州が主体。サマリーに「imported or exported cases」の詳細がないとの明記があるため、現在の確定的な流行地はDRCのみと判断。ワクチンなしでの拡大リスク、武力紛争による対応困難という管理可能性への懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemija ebole izmiče kontroli: 119 mrtvih, strah raste i u susjednim državama - 24sata.info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic spiraling out of control: 119 dead, fear rising even in neighboring countries - 24sata.info
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are ongoing, with 904 suspected cases reported by the Ministry of Health and at least 119 deaths attributed to the illness, of which lab tests confirm at least 10 fatalities. The outbreak is active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and neighboring Uganda has reported several confirmed cases linked to the same outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cited more than 900 probable cases, including 101 confirmed, though exact fatality counts were not specified. WHO has raised Congo’s outbreak risk to very high, while global risk remains low. Ebola, a hemorrhagic fever transmitted via direct contact with bodily fluids, has no specific treatment or vaccine; the involved Bundibugyo strain was first identified in 2007, with symptoms like high fever, vomiting, and internal bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が制御不能に：119人死亡、隣国での懸念も高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の多数死亡例、複数国への国際的拡大、WHO高リスク判定により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダは確定症例が報告されているが、記事の主眼はDRCの流行状況であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。WHO高リスク評価、Bundibugyo株、致死率約13%（119/904）、治療法・ワクチン欠如により、極めて重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ആദ്യലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ പനിയും തൊണ്ടവേദനയും തലവേദനയും; എബോളയെന്ന 'പഴയ' രോഗത്തിന്റെ 'പുതിയ' ഭീഷണി
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Early symptoms: fever, sore throat, and headache; Ebola, the 'old' disease, has a 'new' threat.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD), also called Ebola haemorrhagic fever, is a deadly viral illness first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the Congo. It spills over from animals (notably fruit bats) to humans and spreads via direct contact with infected body fluids or contaminated materials. There are six Ebola species; four (Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Taï Forest) cause human disease, with Zaire the most lethal. Incubation ranges from 2 days to 3 weeks; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, and headache, progressing to internal or external bleeding and kidney/liver failure. Diagnosis relies on ELISA and RT-PCR; case fatality historically ~50%. Notable outbreaks: Congo 1976 (318 cases, 280 deaths; CFR 88%), Sudan 1976 (284/151; CFR 53%). Major West Africa 2014–16 (Sierra Leone, Liberia, Guinea) and Congo 2018–20 (3,481 cases, 2,299 deaths) followed by isolated Congo/Guinea cases in 2021. In 2022, Uganda reported Sudan ebolavirus without approved vaccines. In May 2026, Bundibugyo variant outbreaks in DR Congo and Uganda prompted WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with cross-border spread into Uganda and significant surveillance and security challenges. International response focuses on vaccines, therapeutics, diagnostics, and health-system strengthening in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 初期症状は発熱、喉の痛み、頭痛；エボラ、「古い」病気の「新しい」脅威
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。2026年5月にDRC・ウガンダでブンディブギョエボラが発生し、WHOがPHEIC宣言。死亡率が高く、国際的拡大リスク・貿易制限の懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月のブンディブギョエボラアウトブレイクをカバー。DRCで初発、ウガンダへの越境拡大を報告。WHOがPHEIC宣言、予防接種・治療薬・診断法・保健システム強化に焦点。Sierra Leone、Liberia、Guineaは過去のアウトブレイク言及であり、現在の発生地域ではないため除外。Sudan、Repbublic of Guineaは発生地域リストにあるが記事サマリーでは2026年の現発生地として言及されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: หมอแชร์เคส ป่วย "ไข้หูดับ" หลังกินสุกี้ร้านดัง เตือน 3 จุดเสี่ยง แม้ไม่กินหมูกึ่งสุกดิบ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctor shares a case of "deafness fever" after eating at a famous suki restaurant, warns of three risk points, even if you don't eat undercooked pork.
article.articleSummary: Thailand-based case of Streptococcus suis bloodstream infection, colloquially known as 'deafness fever,' causing septic shock with multi-organ failure and cardiac arrest after dining at a famous suki/shabu restaurant chain with nationwide branches. The patient, who did not consume raw pork, required immediate CPR in the emergency department. Hemoculture yielded Streptococcus suis in two bottles, confirming bloodstream infection linked to S. suis disease. The most likely transmission route: cross-contamination during hotpot/shabu consumption, through utensils or contact between raw and cooked foods, enabling gut-to-blood invasion even without raw pork intake. Public health takeaway: consumers should be cautious and ensure strict separation of raw and cooked foods and utensils; restaurants should use clearly separated equipment and color-coded tools and provide guidance to prevent cross-contamination. Emphasizes persistent risk of S. suis infection in Thailand and the need for behavioral changes across diners and operators, regardless of high restaurant standards.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が「聾唖熱」患者例を公開 有名しゃぶしゃぶレストランでの食事後、3つのリスク箇所を警告 生豚肉を食べなくても危険
triage.triage_reason: Streptococcus suis敗血症による重篤な多臓器不全と心停止という重症度の高いケース。タイ国内の食品衛生関連の感染症アウトブレイク疑いであり、飲食施設での交差汚染リスク、公衆衛生への著しい影響、異常性、及び社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 食品媒介性Streptococcus suis感染症の事例報告。患者は敗血症ショック、多臓器不全、心停止を呈しており、生豚肉非摂取にも関わらず感染。調理器具や食器の交差汚染がリスク要因と指摘されている。全国展開する飲食チェーン店での発生であり、追加ケースの可能性と食品安全対策の強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Đông Nam Á tăng cường phòng dịch khi ca nhiễm biến thể COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 tăng nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Southeast Asia ramps up disease prevention as COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 variant cases rise rapidly.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 NB.1.8.1 variant drives rising cases across Southeast Asia as of May 2026; globally, NB.1.8.1 accounts for about 32% of cases. In Singapore, weekly cases reached 12,700 (May 10–16), up 4,700 from the prior week, with daily admissions rising from 56 to 73; NB.1.8.1 accounts for more than half of sequenced genomes. In Thailand, NB.1.8.1 is the circulating strain, representing 50.95% of samples; by May 23, 2026, the country reported 3,642 new COVID-19 cases this year and 1 death. Experts say NB.1.8.1 is a descendant of JN.1 with mutations that enhance spread and immune evasion, though current data show a cyclical rise and no evidence of more severe disease; ICU occupancy remains low. Cambodia has about 50 NB.1.8.1 cases; Malaysia is tightening border health screening. Public health advice emphasizes hygiene, limiting unnecessary contact, masking when symptomatic; high-risk groups should update vaccines, which remain effective against NB.1.8.1.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19 NB.1.8.1変異株の症例増加により東南アジアが感染症対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19 NB.1.8.1変異株の急速な拡大が東南アジア複数国で確認されており、国際的な関心と地域的な公衆衛生対応の強化が見られるが、現在のところ重症化や死亡の増加は限定的であり、フルRRA実施の緊急性は判断保留。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、タイで確認されたNB.1.8.1変異株の実際の流行が主題。シンガポール、マレーシア、カンボジアも言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイはWPRO基準3項目該当し、IHR基準も2項目該当しているが、重症度が低いため「PICKUP」ではなく「WATCH」判定。事態進展に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BBC Audio | Global News Podcast | African countries join forces to prevent Ebola spreading
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) are ongoing, with suspected cases in the DRC exceeding 900. A regional response is coordinated by the DRC alongside Uganda and South Sudan to prevent further spread. The report emphasizes cross-border collaboration and an intensified regional effort to contain transmission, though it does not provide laboratory-confirmed case counts or fatalities beyond the DRC’s suspected cases. This reflects a continuing multinational public health response to Ebola in central Africa, focusing on coordinated surveillance and information sharing among neighboring countries to curb the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: BBC Audio | Global News Podcast | アフリカ諸国がエボラ拡大を防ぐため力を合わせる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生であり、DRCで900件以上の疑い患者、地域間での感染拡大リスク、国際的な協調対応が報告されている。IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性が複数該当し、WPRO基準においても重症度・流行性・管理性において複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンの地域対応について言及されているが、ウガンダ（ID226074）および南スーダン（対象国リストに含まれない）は対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCのみが対象国であり、verified_locationsに含める。エボラは極めて致死性が高く、公衆衛生上の脅威が大きいため、IHR基準、WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Ponad 900 podejrzanych przypadków wirusa Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Over 900 suspected cases of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases, including 101 confirmed, per WHO director-general Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. On Sunday, the DRC Ministry of Communications recorded 904 suspected cases, concentrated in the northeast Ituri province, marking a sharp rise from just over 700 previously announced. The ministry also cited 119 suspected Ebola deaths, though a separate regional tally obtained by the Associated Press listed 220 deaths with officials unavailable for comment. Later Sunday, enraged young men stormed a hospital treating Ebola patients demanding the bodies of two relatives, triggering a shootout and evacuation of patients and staff. Authorities say remains of Ebola patients carry the virus and funerals should be state-organized without family involvement. The outbreak is assessed as posing a “very high” risk domestically, while the global risk of spread remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：900例以上のエボラウイルス疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱集団発生で、900例超の疑い患者と複数の死亡例が報告され、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス集団発生は最高段階のリスク事象。900例超の疑い患者（確定例101例）と119～220例の死亡が報告されており、Ituri州に集中している。地域リスク評価は「very high」。国際的拡大リスクは現在低いと評価されているが、公衆衛生上のインパクト、異常性、国際的な懸念が顕著。病院での暴動事件も対応の困難性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о более чем 900 предполагаемых случаях заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province. To date, more than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. Ituri, a region of about 5 million residents, has roughly 25% in humanitarian need. Vaccines and treatments remain in limited supply, complicating control efforts. The UN warns that the virus could cross borders into neighboring countries, worsening an already strained regional health system. On May 24, Bloomberg reported that authorities in the DRC halted air service with the eastern city of Bania as the epidemic has spread to three provinces, with tracking of contacts proving difficult. In the country overall, 91 confirmed cases, 867 suspected cases, and 204 possible deaths have been documented. The WHO has dispatched a field team to assist response, vaccination logistics, and public guidance on precautions.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが900件以上のエボラ感染が疑われる症例について報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスは極めて高い重症度と死亡率を示し、DRCの複数州に拡大、国境越え懸念あり、国際支援とWHOの介入が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはIturi（ADM1）とBania（PPL）を地域として提示しており、これらはDRC内の領域である。記事サマリーはDRCのIturi州を中心とした発生を明確に述べており、3州への拡大と国境越えの警告がある。900件超の疑い患者、101確認例、204の可能性のある死亡が報告されている。ワクチンと治療が限定供給であり、管理可能性への懸念が存在。WHOフィールドチーム派遣済み。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Hantavirus, Rutan Ambon Sosialisasikan Pola Hidup Sehat bagi WBP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Hantavirus, Ambon Detention Center Promotes Healthy Living for Inmates.
article.articleSummary: Hantavirus prevention at Ambon Class IIA Detention Center (Rutan Ambon), Indonesia, targets rodent-borne transmission linked to hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome (HFRS). As of May 25, 2026, Indonesia reports at least 23 laboratory-confirmed hantavirus cases across nine provinces since 2024, signaling heightened national vigilance. The program engages staff and incarcerated individuals with education on zoonotic risk and hygiene in closed settings. Dr. Edwina notes transmission via infected rats’ urine, feces, or saliva, and inhalation of aerosolized particles. Rutan Ambon tightens hygiene in housing blocks, discourages food waste that attracts rats, and mandates cleaning of drainage and storage areas. No hantavirus cases have been found at Rutan Ambon to date, but the initiative follows Ditjen Pemasyarakatan directives to minimize spread by maintaining a clean, sterile environment and protecting inmate health.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス予防、アンボン拘置所が受刑者に健康的な生活習慣を推進
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける2024年以降の広がったハンタウイルス感染（9州で23例確認）は注視対象であるが、記事の主題は拘置所での予防対策であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。追加情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: インドネシアでの既存のハンタウイルス感染クラスター（2024年以降9州で23例）が背景にあり、拘置所という閉鎖空間での継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低いがげっ歯類を介した感染のリスクが存在。政府当局の対応（Ditjen Pemasyarakatan）が確認されている。アンボン拘置所での症例報告はまだないが、引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch DR Kongo: Diakonie Katastrophenhilfe bereitet Nothilfe vor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: Diakonie Katastrophenhilfe prepares emergency relief.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo virus; On May 17, the WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Diakonie Katastrophenhilfe, with local partners, is preparing emergency relief, prioritizing prevention, public education, and hygiene to curb transmission and to accelerate identification of suspected cases. The outbreak compounds an already fragile health system weakened by funding cuts and gaps in surveillance. The article stresses a high risk of spread and that communities facing violence, displacement, and poverty are especially vulnerable. No case counts, deaths, lab confirmation details, or infection source are provided. The response centers on protection, information, rapid action, and donations to fund measures to safeguard and assist people in the DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行：ディアコニエ・カタストロフェンヒルフェが緊急支援を準備
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。DRCはエボラのハイリスク国であり、脆弱な保健システムと複合的な社会情勢がリスク要因。フルRRA進行対象。
triage.notes: WHOがすでにPHEIC宣言済みという極めて重要な情報あり。患者数・死亡数が記事に記載されていないが、Bundibugyo virus（エボラウイルス属）による流行で、保健システムの脆弱性、紛争地域での脆弱な人口、監視体制の不備など複合リスク要因が複数指摘されている。DRCはエボラのエンデミック地域であり、国境を超えた拡大リスクは既知。

article.articleHeadline: Woedende menigte bestormt Congolees ziekenhuis en eist lichamen overleden ebola-patiënten op
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angry mob storms Congolese hospital and demands the bodies of deceased Ebola patients.
article.articleSummary: Angry crowd storms Mongbwalu hospital in Ituri, DRC, where Ebola patients are treated, demanding the bodies of deceased relatives. Bodies of Ebola victims are handled only by specialized teams due to high infectivity; this is the third attack on the facility in a short time. A separate Saturday attack on an MSF camp left 18 people with suspected Ebola missing. On Thursday, another treatment center in Rwampara was set ablaze after families were denied access to the body of a relative who likely died of Ebola. WHO warns such incidents hinder outbreak response. The DRC–Uganda Ebola outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern last week. Africa CDC says ten other countries are at risk due to movement and insecurity. Three Congolese Red Cross volunteers died in Ituri during humanitarian work. WHO reports over 900 suspected infections in the DRC, with 101 confirmed and 204 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 怒った群衆がコンゴの病院に押し入り、亡くなったエボラ患者の遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。DRC・ウガンダで国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（226074）が含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥリ地域での発生・対応障害。ウガンダは「10カ国がリスクあり」の警告の中に含まれるが、実際の発生地は記述されていないため verified_locations から除外。DRC–ウガンダ発生は既に国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、900以上の疑い例、204人の死亡、セキュリティインシデント複数件により異常性と管理可能性の課題が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Gates Foundation commits $15m to Ebola response as WHO suspects 900 cases
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with about 900 suspected cases reported as authorities raise alarm. The World Health Organization and Africa CDC have declared a public health emergency, underscoring cross-border spillover risks and the need for regional and global coordination under the 'one plan, one budget, one team' approach. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine and has circulated undetected in densely populated areas, complicating contact tracing. Gates Foundation commits $15 million to the response, while WHO workers mobilized 4.7 tonnes of essential medical supplies and emergency kits from Jomo Kenyatta International Airport in Nairobi to support affected regions. Stellenbosch University FMHS scientists lead rapid containment efforts. Congo has faced 16 prior Ebola outbreaks; responders highlight shortages of basic supplies and transport for tracing. South Africa pledges $2.5 million to regional Ebola efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ゲイツ財団がエボラ対応に1500万ドルを拠出、WHOは900症例を疑い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（900疑い症例）、WHOとアフリカCDCが公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言、国際的な対応と域外流出リスクが明示的に認識されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にSouth Africa、Kenya、Nairobi等が列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイク。ケニアはWHO医療物資の転送地点（ナイロビのジョモ・ケニヤッタ空港）として機能しているのみで、発生国ではない。南アフリカはStellenbosch University等が対応支援をしているが、アウトブレイク発生国ではない。対象国リストに南ア・ケニア等が含まれないため、verified_locationsはコンゴのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak : കോംഗോയിൽ 900 ലധികം എബോള കേസുകൾ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചതായി ലോകാരോഗ്യ സംഘടന
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Outbreak: WHO says more than 900 Ebola cases have been confirmed in Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in Congo as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak is driven by the Ebola virus’ Bundibugyo strain. Major symptoms include high fever, bleeding, weakness, and muscle pain; the virus spreads through patients’ bodily fluids. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for this strain. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus cautions that insecurity and distrust hinder response efforts, with ongoing WHO and partner presence across Africa, including hard‑to‑reach areas. Historically, the disease began near Central Africa’s tropical rainforests, and the largest West African outbreak (2014–2016) affected Guinea, Sierra Leone, and Liberia. Health authorities advise screening travellers for fever and avoiding nonessential travel to reduce spread. International agencies are scaling up medical support to African countries to avert a repeat of the West Africa‑scale outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の大流行：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ確定患者が報告されたとWHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による900件以上の疑い患者がコンゴで確認されており、IHR基準で4項目全てに該当する（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでコンゴでの発生が主題。他のアフリカ地域（シエラレオネ、リベリア、ギニア）は歴史的事例として言及されているが、現在の流行はコンゴで確認されている。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱で、インセキュリティと信頼不足が対応を阻害している点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: ഷിഗല്ലെ വൈറസ് ബാധ;ചികിൽസയിലുണ്ടായിരുന്ന കുട്ടികളിൽ ഒരാൾ ആശുപത്രി വിട്ടു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella infection; one of the children who were admitted to hospital has been discharged.
article.articleSummary: Shigella infection has been confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala, at Permunna panchayat’s Paarakkandam and Puthiyottil areas, involving two children aged about 2.5 and 3 years. One child has been discharged from the Medical College maternity and child protection center, while the second child has been shifted to a hospital ward. Laboratory confirmation of Shigella infection (shigellosis) has been reported, and public health authorities are enforcing containment measures to prevent further spread. Earlier, a child in the area died from the illness, underscoring the ongoing risk. The authorities are monitoring transmission and reinforcing hygiene and infection-control precautions. No further case details are provided in the report, but the response aims to curb the outbreak and protect vulnerable pediatric populations.

triage.headline_ja: シゲラ菌感染症；入院治療を受けていた子どもの1人が退院
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。小児対象で死亡例あり、重症度高く、インドの対象国における確認シグナル。
triage.notes: Shigella（赤痢菌）感染症は水系感染症で、不十分な衛生環境・給水インフラにおいて急速に拡大。本件は幼児（2.5～3歳）対象で、既に死亡例あり。ケーララ州コジコード地区での確認により、南インドにおける流行兆候として注視が必要。公開情報からは地域内での継続的な感染リスク・伝播が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Trois volontaires de la Croix-Rouge morts par le virus Ebola - La Nouvelle République Algérie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Red Cross volunteers died from the Ebola virus - La Nouvelle République Algérie
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers died of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) amid an outbreak centered in Ituri, with neighboring Uganda affected. The outbreak was declared mid-May following a World Health Organization (WHO) global alert. Laboratory confirmation identified the Ebola-Bundibugyo strain. As of May 25, 2026, the WHO has logged about 750 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC and roughly 177 suspected deaths. The three volunteers reportedly contracted the disease on March 27 while recovering bodies on a humanitarian mission unrelated to Ebola; their work was not linked to the epidemic. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies expressed sorrow. The outbreak prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on the night of May 16–17, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字のボランティア3人がエボラウイルスで死亡 - La Nouvelle République Algérie
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生上の影響（多数の死亡・疑い患者）、異常性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの波及）が明確に認められ、WHO PEICが宣言されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州を中心とした大規模エボラ流行（750疑い患者、177死亡）を報じており、ウガンダへの波及も記載されている。しかしウガンダは対象国リストに未含有のため verified_locations には含めない。WHO PEICが5月16-17に宣言されており、緊急性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: СМИ сообщили о гибели около 150 коров от неизвестной болезни в ДРК
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The media reported the deaths of around 150 cows from an unknown disease in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: About 150 cattle have died from an unknown tick-borne disease in Mbanza-Ngungu, Democratic Republic of Congo, according to Okapi Radio on May 24, 2026. The first fatalities occurred three months after December 2025, when cattle from neighboring countries were transported through the city. By late May, roughly 150 cows had died, presenting lethargy, hematuria, poor coordination, and loss of appetite before death. The disease remains unnamed, with no laboratory confirmation reported. Transmission is attributed to a tick-borne pathogen, linked to movement of cattle from neighboring countries through Mbanza-Ngungu. The report provides no data on human infections or additional imported/exported cases beyond the cattle movement, nor confirmation of containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: メディアが報じるDRCの未知の病気による約150頭の牛の死亡
triage.triage_reason: 未知の病気による家畜大量死が報告されており、異常性と地域的懸念がある。しかし人間への感染報告がなく、ラボ確認も不明なため、情報が不足している。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家畜への未知の病原体による大量死事例であり、人間への感染は報告されていない。ダニ媒介性の未知の病原体とされるが、実験室確認がなく詳細情報が限定的である。隣国からの家畜移動に関連した国際的な家畜衛生上の懸念として注視する価値があるが、IHR(2005)適用の主要な基準には限定的に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 전북자치도, 구제역 방역관리 개선대책 본격 추진
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jeonbuk Autonomous Province Pushes Ahead with Foot-and-Mouth Disease Quarantine and Management Improvement Measures
article.articleSummary: Jeonbuk Autonomous Province announced rapid implementation of Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) quarantine and management measures, focusing on SAT1-type virus preparedness from China. The plan aims to boost farm biosecurity by preventing vaccine omissions and noncompliance. Cattle and goats will receive annual vaccination twice (March and September); pigs will follow a staged, ongoing vaccination schedule. From June 4–12, regional mobile quarantine education will be held in Iksan, Jeongeup, and Namwon to reinforce farmer accountability. From June through October, vaccination efforts will expand to 28 West Coast counties nationwide, including Gunsan, Gimje, Gochang, and Buan, with priority SAT1 first and second doses at northern border areas (Incheon, Gyeonggi, Gangwon) and provincial livestock institutes and breeding farms. Minister Moon Seon-sik urged strict adherence to biosecurity basics, such as vehicle disinfection and restricted access, given SAT1 and other FMD risks.

triage.headline_ja: 全北自治道、口蹄疫防疫管理改善対策を本格推進
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は家畜疾病であり公衆衛生上の直接的脅威は限定的。中国からのSAT1型ウイルス対策に基づく予防的措置であり、既存の発生報告ではなく予防強化の施策発表である。情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は韓国（対象国外）における口蹄疫の予防的政策発表であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での実際の発生イベントではない。サマリーは中国（China）からのSAT1型リスクに言及しているが、韓国国内の予防強化策が主題であり、中国での発生は明記されていない。対象国に該当する実際の発生地域なし。

article.articleHeadline: أستاذ مناعة بأكسفورد يحذر: السلالة الحالية من إيبولا بلا لقاح حتى الآن
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Oxford immunology professor warns: The current Ebola strain has no vaccine yet.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is active in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. WHO updates through May 21, 2026 report 746 suspected cases with 176 deaths in the DRC and 83 confirmed cases with 9 deaths; total confirmed across both countries stands at 85 cases and 10 deaths as of May 21–24, 2026, with suspected cases exceeding 900 by May 24. There is no vaccine for the current Bundibugyo strain. A vaccine previously developed for Zaire ebolavirus (2014; deployed 2019) is not specific to Bundibugyo. Oxford University has contracted with the Serum Institute of India to develop a Bundibugyo vaccine, requiring at least three months for development and testing, with large-scale use if efficacy is demonstrated. No 100% effective cure exists; antivirals and some drugs offer control. Officials warn that travel — including Africa’s teams and the World Cup — could heighten spread risk.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学の免疫学教授が警告：現在のエボラウイルス株にはまだワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生が確認され、IHR基準では4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当する。国際的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が主題。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。インドは、オックスフォード大学とセーラム研究所インドの協力によるワクチン開発に関連するため、記事の実質的な対象地域として含める。確定症例85例、死亡10例、疑い症例900例超で、ワクチン未開発のBundibugyo株による重大な脅威。

article.articleHeadline: "Ситуация международного масштаба": Эбола уже унесла жизни 204 человек - Технологии Onlíner
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "A situation of international scale": Ebola has already claimed 204 lives - Onlíner Technologies
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ministry of Health reports 204 Ebola-related deaths, with the World Health Organization counting 177 fatalities three days earlier; the WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Africa Union’s Health Agency warns that, besides the DRC and Uganda, multiple African countries—Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia—are at risk. Ebola is a highly contagious viral hemorrhagic fever spread by direct contact with infected bodily fluids, capable of causing severe bleeding and organ failure. Experts attribute the surge to the less common Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccines or treatments are yet approved. Across Africa, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in the past half-century. The article emphasizes ongoing transmission and the need for heightened surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 「国際的規模の状況」：エボラはすでに204人の命を奪っている - Onlíner Technologies
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の集団発生で204人の死亡、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への拡大リスク、国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数のアフリカ諸国（アンゴラ、ブルンジ、中央アフリカ共和国、コンゴ、エチオピア、ケニア、ルワンダ、南スーダン、タンザニア）をリスク国として言及しているが、確認された発生地は主にDRCとウガンダであり、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCとザンビアのみである（ザンビアはリスク国として明記）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの重大イベント。

article.articleHeadline: Число предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой в ДРК превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola cases in the DRC has surpassed 900
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) shows more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed infections. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said epidemiological surveillance has been expanded, and current counts exceed 900 suspected cases. The outbreak began in late April 2026, and on May 17 the WHO declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. On May 22, Ghebreyesus warned the disease is spreading rapidly and poses a high threat, with 82 confirmed cases and seven deaths at that time, though he cautioned that actual numbers are much larger. The article later cites nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths, illustrating how estimates have evolved as the response continues.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い患者数が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（疑い患者900人以上、確定患者101人、死亡7人）であり、WHO が5月17日に PHEIC 宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク高く、公衆衛生上の重大な影響と国際的な懸念がある。
triage.notes: WHO により5月17日に PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。記事サマリーに示される患者数の増加推移（82確定例→101確定例、死亡7人）は流行が進行中であることを示唆。DRC のみが主題であり、他国への拡大言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα Έμπολα στo Κονγκό σύμφωνα με τον ΠΟΥ - Ελεύθερος Τύπος
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Congo according to the WHO - Free Press
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 confirmed by lab tests as of May 23, 2026; 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases are recorded in the latest tally. The outbreak, declared May 15, is driven by Bundibugyo, a rare strain with up to 50% fatality and no approved vaccine or specific therapy; experimental vaccines are in development, and others may offer partial protection. The first known case was a nurse who developed symptoms on April 24 in Bunia; her body was moved to Mongoualu, where most cases have since been recorded. The epidemic spans conflict-affected areas with about 250,000 displaced and cross-border movement to neighbors; Uganda reports one case and one death in Kampala, while Rwanda closed its border. Transmission is human-to-human via contact with infected fluids, worsened by funeral practices. WHO and Congolese authorities have deployed response teams and treatment centers; misinformation delays care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い例 WHO発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模爆発で深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo株による高い致死率、複数国への国際拡大、渡航・貿易制限措置の実施。
triage.notes: Bunia（DRC東部）での最初の症例報告から拡大。ウガンダで1症例1死亡が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCにおける深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であることは明確。情報日時が2026年5月であり、架空のシナリオである可能性があるが、提供された情報に基づいて評価している。

article.articleHeadline: What Indian travellers need to know about the Ebola outbreak in East and Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in East and Central Africa is linked to the Bundibugyo strain. The World Health Organization declared it a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. The outbreak has affected the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with neighboring South Sudan identified as high risk for transmission. So far, 968 confirmed and suspected cases have been reported, with 216 deaths. In response, India issued a travel advisory and, with the Directorate General of Health Services, tightened airport screening for travellers arriving from affected regions (DRC, Uganda, South Sudan). The article outlines what Indian travellers need to know amid enhanced surveillance at airports and the ongoing international response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 東・中央アフリカのエボラ流行についてインドの旅行者が知る必要があること
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱のPHEIC宣言済みの緊急事態であり、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより実際の流行地はDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン。対象国リストから該当するのはDRCのみ。Indiaはサマリーに旅行勧告と空港検査強化の対応が記載されており、感染症イベントの発生地ではなく対応国だが、国際的影響が及んでいる対象国として含めた。PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、968確認・疑い症例、216死亡報告。Bundibugyo strain による流行。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh on Ebola alert as state begins traveller screening
article.articleSummary: Ebola alert in Andhra Pradesh as screening begins at Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, and Vijayawada airports following rising concern in Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. Travellers from Congo, Uganda and Sudan will undergo screening; diagnostic testing where needed; symptomatic individuals moved to quarantine; close contacts monitored. Authorities plan airport, port, and road surveillance, with isolation wards (15 beds each) in teaching hospitals near international airports. PPE stocks and diagnostic kits secured; staff alerted from ANMs and ASHAs via virtual meetings; action plan inspired by COVID-19 response. Public travel advisory urges avoiding travel to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; residents who recently returned from Ebola-affected countries in the last three weeks should report if unwell.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州がエボラアラートに：州が旅行者スクリーニングを開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病という極めて高い致死率の疾患が関連しており、複数国（コンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での流行背景の中でインドで警戒体制が敷かれている。国際的な公衆衛生への潜在的影響とWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行可能性）の複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ、ウガンダ、南スーダンでのエボラ流行を背景としながら、インド・アンドラプラデシュ州での予防的スクリーニング及び警戒体制について報じている。verified_locationsはインドのみとした理由は、実際のエボラ患者発生がインドで報告されていない点。むしろ流行国（コンゴ、ウガンダ、スーダン）からの輸入リスク対応の段階。しかし、高致死率疾患の国際的拡大懸念、複数空港での検疫体制構築、公式な旅行勧告の発出など、IHR4基準全て該当しWPRO基準も全て該当するため、PICKUP判定は適切。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: les coupes budgétaires américaines ont-elles eues un impact sur la propagation de l'épidémie?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Have US budget cuts had an impact on the spread of the epidemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda are portrayed as more detectable earlier had U.S. budget cuts to USAID not occurred. Jeremy Konyndyk, a former USAID emergencies chief, argues these cuts eroded years of field expertise essential for spotting early signals—such as a hospital or laboratory director reporting unexplained illness or a mobile-clinic provider suspecting viral hemorrhagic fever. He equates the current outbreak with the 2014 West Africa Ebola epidemic in terms of health risk, noting USAID mobilized over $1 billion then to combat the disease. Today, he contends that without the agency’s on-the-ground presence, earlier detection in the DRC might have been possible. The White House pledges funding via the UN for 50 Ebola clinics in the DRC and Uganda, but he warns the administration lacks awareness of field-difficulty and the crucial need for fieldwork.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国の予算削減は感染症の拡大に影響したのか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（重度で国際的関心の高い病原体）がDRC・ウガンダで発生しており、IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」の最低2基準を満たす。また米国の予算削減による検出遅延という政策的・国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIがウガンダ、アンゴラ、米国を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。米国・アンゴラの記載は背景情報・地政学的文脈であり、実際の疾病発生地ではない。Machupo（ボリビア出血熱）は対象外地域での発生のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kongas praneša apie daugiau kaip 900 įtariamų Ebolos atvejų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 904 suspected since the outbreak began and 101 laboratory-confirmed; suspected deaths are listed at 119 (down from 204), while lab-confirmed Ebola deaths total 10. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. In neighboring Uganda, five confirmed cases are linked to the eastern Congo outbreak; Uganda does not publish suspected case counts. WHO says the true case numbers are likely much higher due to weeks of under-detection and unreported deaths. Ebola is highly infectious and deadly; control is challenging because there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the circulating Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Transmission occurs through close contact with bodily fluids, not airborne droplets. WHO assesses Congo’s infection risk as very high, regional risk as high, and global risk as low.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが900件以上の疑似エボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な大規模アウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで確認例）、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病は致死性が高く、既に国境を越えて伝播している。
triage.notes: ウガンダで確認例があるが、主たる発生地はDRCであり、記事の中心もDRCの900件以上の疑似症例報告である。WHO評価では地域リスク「高」、全体リスク「低」とされているが、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株による既知のワクチン・特異的治療がなく、国境越え伝播が既に起きている点で国際的なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）已确诊101例埃博拉病例 疫情风险升至"非常高"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo confirms 101 Ebola cases as outbreak risk rises to "Very High".
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed as of May 25, 2026. The government announced on May 23 that the eastern outbreak is expanding, with Ituri Province’s capital Bunia most affected. Bunia airport has suspended all inbound and outbound passenger flights. On May 22, the World Health Organization raised the national risk level from High to Very High, while regional risk remains High. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated on social media that 101 cases were confirmed after testing. The article does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The evolving situation in eastern DRC emphasizes escalating transmission and ongoing public health measures and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ病例101件を確認、流行リスクが「非常に高い」に上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施、異常・予想外性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。WHO危険度レベルが「Very High」に引き上げられた重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ危険度の高い感染症。DRC東部での拡大、空港閉鎖、WHO危険度レベルの引き上げなど、複数の重大シグナルが存在。Ituri州Bunia地域が最も影響を受けている。疑い症例900件超に対し確定診断101件という急速な検査体制の進展も注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: ছড়াচ্ছে 'স্টমাক ফ্লু', হাসপাতালে বাড়ছে রোগীর ভিড়, কী থেকে ঘটছে সংক্রমণ? সতর্ক থাকার উপায় কী?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spreading 'stomach flu', hospitals are crowded with patients, what is causing the infection? What precautions should be taken?
article.articleSummary: Stomach flu (viral gastroenteritis) is spreading across India as heatwaves push temperatures toward 30–45°C, triggering widespread food- and waterborne outbreaks. Norovirus and rotavirus are the main culprits, causing fever, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and vomiting, with dehydration that can last more than a week. High-risk groups include young children and adults with diabetes, kidney disease, or cancer treatment; these patients may require hospitalization. The Indian Council of Medical Research notes that heat accelerates proliferation of bacteria and viruses in contaminated food and water, including leftovers kept in the fridge or foods served hot. Preventive steps: avoid empty-stomach tea/coffee; drink plenty of fluids; water infused with carom (ajwain) and fenugreek (methi) seeds or with cumin; avoid street fruit juices, cut fruits, and soft drinks; eat light, freshly cooked meals and reheat leftovers. Rehydration with ORS or salt-sugar drinks is advised; children should avoid outside foods.

triage.headline_ja: 「胃腸風邪」が蔓延、病院に患者が殺到、何が感染の原因か？どのような予防策をとるべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスとロタウイルスによる胃腸炎がインド全域で発生している報告だが、死亡例や重症化の詳細情報が不足しており、国際的拡大リスクの記述も明確でない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はインド全域での胃腸炎の流行を報告しており、熱波が食・水道衛生関連の病原体増殖を促進している状況が述べられている。ノロウイルスとロタウイルスは流行性が高く、高リスク群（小児、糖尿病患者等）での入院の可能性が言及されているが、死亡例や重症度については明記されていない。インド医学研究評議会の公式言及があり、政府機関の関心が窺える。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: Health authorities struggle as violence disrupts response in DRC; toll crosses 200
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province epicenter) exceeds 900 cases with over 200 deaths as violence disrupts response. Two eastern Congo treatment centres were attacked; 18 patients disappeared in Mongbwalu after clashes over body retrieval, and isolation wards were set on fire, severely hindering contact tracing and early care. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns violence is driving people to flee, complicating containment. International reactions include the United States’ enhanced travel restrictions with passenger health assessments, and India issuing advisories for travelers from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan. In India, Andhra Pradesh declared an alert, implementing airport screening, quarantine for symptomatic individuals, and expedited examinations for close contacts, with coordination between airport authorities and district health officials and Visakhapatnam Port involvement. The Bundibugyo virus outbreak was designated a WHO PHEIC on May 16, with an approximate 50% case fatality rate.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：DRCにおける暴力による対応の混乱、死者数200人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラは重症度が極めて高く（200人超の死亡）、異常で国際的拡大リスクが明確（複数国が対応、WHOがPHEIC指定）、渡航制限を誘発している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国・スーダン・ウガンダを列挙していたが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの流行とインドでの対応実施（警報発令、空港スクリーニング実施）に限定されるため、これら3カ国は除外。WHOがBundibugyo virus（エボラ関連）をPHEICに指定し、暴力による治療中断と接触追跡の失敗によりリスク管理の可能性が極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: Vasai Virar News: वसई-विरारमधील नागरिक दहशतीत! भटक्या कुत्र्यांचा 4 महिन्यांत 15 हजार जणांना चावा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Vasai Virar News: Residents of Vasai-Virar terrified! Stray dogs have bitten 15,000 people in four months.
article.articleSummary: Stray dogs in Vasai-Virar, part of Mumbai's suburban area, have caused a surge in dog-bite incidents, with 15,000 bites reported from January to April this year. Authorities estimate about 100,000 stray dogs in the Vasai-Virar twin cities, but only 30,000 have been sterilized so far, leaving roughly 70,000 unsterilized and driving rapid population growth. A 9-year-old girl died from rabies after a dog bite, intensifying public anger toward municipal governance. In response, the Vasai-Virar City Municipal Corporation plans to accelerate sterilization through private organizations and welfare groups and to build a dedicated dog shelter. The outbreak highlights gaps in animal control and rabies prevention in the Vasai-Virar area, with ongoing risk to residents. Keywords: rabies, dog bites, sterilization, animal shelter, public health measures, Vasai-Virar.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァサイ・ヴィラール地区の住民が恐怖に！野良犬が4カ月間で15,000人を咬傷
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。15,000件の咬傷とラビーズによる死亡例の報告があり、対象国インドの都市部での明確な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: ムンバイ郊外ヴァサイ・ヴィラール地区での野良犬によるラビーズ関連の大規模咬傷事案。4カ月間で15,000件の咬傷、ラビーズによる小児死亡例1件確認。動物管理とラビーズ予防対策の不備が明らかであり、継続的な住民への脅威あり。当局の対応計画も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: WHO ruft Notlage aus: Mehr als 900 Verdachtsfälle nach Ebola-Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Declares a State of Emergency: More Than 900 Suspected Cases Following the Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization declared a state of emergency over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. WHO reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases; 101 infections have been laboratory-confirmed, while WHO did not provide new death figures. The Congolese Ministry of Health had previously cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. The update notes scarce diagnostic equipment in the country, signaling testing bottlenecks that hinder rapid confirmation and outbreak assessment. Health authorities are continuing surveillance and case-finding efforts, with international support sought to bolster laboratory confirmation and case management as the outbreak evolves.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が緊急事態を宣言：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症発生で 900 件を超える疑い患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOが緊急事態を公式宣言しているエボラ出血熱の大規模発生。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: WHO緊急事態宣言済み。101件の確定患者と900件以上の疑い患者、204名の死亡報告あり。診断機器不足による検査ボトルネック指摘。国際支援の需要が明記されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Peste 900 de cazuri suspecte de Ebola au fost identificate în Congo, avertizează autoritățile sanitare
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Congo, health authorities warn.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have surged, with authorities reporting over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak, officially declared on May 15, involves the Bundibugyo lineage, a strain for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 23, the DRC Ministry of Health documented 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola is a highly contagious viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids, often causing severe hemorrhage and multi-organ failure. The report underscores intensified surveillance and ongoing outbreak response in the DRC, with confirmed cases and deaths rising, and highlights the historical impact of Ebola in Africa over the past decades.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス疑い症例が900件以上、コンゴの保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（204死亡、867疑い症例）、異常かつ予想外なアウトブレイク、国際的な拡大リスク（ワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が高い。フルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo系統のエボラウイルスで、承認されたワクチンなし。2026年5月15日に正式に宣言。DRCの3州で発生。WHO事務局長からの報告で信頼性が高い。アフリカ大陸での過去数十年のエボラの歴史的影響を考慮すると、国際的な対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in der DR Kongo: Tote bei Rotem Kreuz und verschÃ¤rfte EindÃ¤mmung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DR Congo: Deaths at the Red Cross and tightened containment measures.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers in the Democratic Republic of Congo died, likely from Ebola exposure while assisting patients or handling the deceased in Mongwalu, now the outbreak's epicenter in Ituri province. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine exists, pushing response toward enhanced PPE, testing, and reducing contact with corpses. The WHO raised the DR Congo's risk from high to very high; neighboring Uganda reported three new cases (five total), and Africa CDC warned of possible spread to Angola, Burundi and Kenya. In response, the government suspended commercial and private flights to Bunia, with humanitarian flights only by special approval. MSF reported a burned tent in Mongwalu and, a day earlier, a hospital set on fire after relatives could not collect an Ebola-deceased body, highlighting trust as critical in containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：赤十字での死亡と強化された封じ込め対策
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模な多国間エボラウイルス病の集団発生。死亡例、複数国への拡大リスク、国境を越えた症例確認、および渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のIturi州における現在の集団発生を報じている。隣国ウガンダの症例報告やアンゴラ・ブルンジ・ケニアへの拡大リスク警告が記載されているが、これらは現時点での推定リスクであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未承認株）、感染した医療従事者の死亡、信頼喪失による治療回避（病院放火など）が記載され、管理難度が高い。WHOがDRCのリスク評価を「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げている。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО регистрира повеќе од 900 сомнителни случаи на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO records more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have led to more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on 2026-05-25. The national risk is assessed as very high, with regional risk high and global risk low, as containment is hampered by the absence of an approved vaccine or proven treatment for the current strain. In Ituri province, distrust and misinformation are hindering field operations, with demonstrators last week setting fire to treatment tents amid disputes over safe burial of suspected Ebola deaths. The outbreak has crossed borders, with Uganda reporting five confirmed cases over the weekend. An American citizen infected in Congo is undergoing treatment at Charité hospital in Berlin; the clinic notes the patient does not require intensive care at this time.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが900件以上のエボラ疑似患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多発事例、国際的拡大、国際的支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（Ituri州）を主要な発生地としており、ウガンダでの確認例も記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。ドイツの記載はアメリカ市民の治療地であり、エボラ発生地ではないため除外。エボラの非常に高い国家リスク、ワクチン・治療法の不在、国境越えの報告から、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 防伊波拉風險 中國宣布自剛果入境須自我監測21天 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To Prevent Ebola Risk, China Announces That Travelers Entering From Congo Must Self-Monitor for 21 Days | Lianhe News Network
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province, Bunia) and neighboring Uganda were declared International Public Health Emergencies of International Concern by WHO on May 17, 2026. In DRC, authorities report 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths, with Bunia Airport in Ituri Province suspending all passenger flights. Uganda confirms 5 cases total, including first locally transmitted case, following 3 new confirmed cases. The risk of cross-border spread has prompted intensified border and transport controls. China CDC announces that travelers entering China from DRC and Uganda must undergo 21 days of self-monitoring, with guidance to seek medical care for fever, malaise, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, or unexplained bleeding; patients should inform clinicians of travel and exposure history. Chinese health facilities should screen for Ebola symptoms and travel history and report suspected cases promptly. Ongoing WHO updates may adjust affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱リスク防止、中国はコンゴ入境者に21日間の自己監視を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラウイルス病の多国間拡大で、既に204死亡、複数国での確認例あり。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）でのエボラアウトブレイク、ウガンダでの確認例、中国のCDCが発表した入国制限措置を主要な主題としている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。中国の言及は対応・管理措置の記述であり発生地ではない。WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）既宣言であり、死亡率が高く、複数国への波及が確認されている点で高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: Update Ebola di Kongo-Uganda: 119 Orang Meninggal dan 900 Suspek
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola update in Kongo-Uganda: 119 dead and 900 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak centers in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with spillover into North and South Kivu and concerns of spread to Kongo and Uganda. As of May 24–25, 2026, authorities report 900 suspected Bundibugyo Ebola cases and 119 deaths. The outbreak began May 16, with the Bundibugyo variant circulating after misdiagnosis of another Ebola strain, allowing undetected transmission for weeks. Ituri Province—with Bunia, Wampara, and Monbgwalu as initial epicenters—has seen the surge extend to adjacent regions; health facilities in Monbgwalu reported being overwhelmed. The World Health Organization marks the outbreak as carrying a "very high" risk for the DRC, though global risk remains low. The crisis is compounded by insecurity, displacement, and attacks on health facilities (including two centers burned in Ituri at Rwampara), fueling rumors and hampering response. Doctors Without Borders notes healthcare workers fleeing; aid cuts worsen capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱最新情報：119人死亡、900人が疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模集団発生で、死亡119人・疑い患者900人、複数州への拡大とウガンダへの越境リスク、医療施設崩壊、国際的な対応必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（南キブ州、イトゥリ州）を主要な発生地とし、ウガンダへの越境リスクと懸念を述べている。Bluedot APIが付与したウガンダは警戒対象地域だが、記事の主題は確認済みの発生地域としてはDRC。医療施設の攻撃、医療従事者の逃散、援助カット等により対応能力が著しく低下している深刻な状況。Bundibugyo型という稀な亜種の流行であり、初期の誤診に伴う無検出伝播週間があった点も異常事象として重要。

article.articleHeadline: 懶人包》致命伊波拉病毒襲來！感染症狀、傳播方式一次看 | 生活 | Newtalk新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quick Guide: Deadly Ebola Virus Strikes! Symptoms and Modes of Transmission at a Glance | Life | Newtalk News
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) remains a deadly threat in Africa, with the World Health Organization declaring the current outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Ebola virus, first identified in 1976 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Sudan, likely has fruit bats as its natural reservoir. Humans acquire infection by direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or other fluids of infected animals or people, with higher risk during care, burial rites, or improper PPE. Transmission occurs in hospitals and communities; healthcare workers, family and close contacts, funeral workers, and hunters are high-risk. Early symptoms mimic flu: sudden high fever, severe fatigue, muscle and joint pains, sore throat; later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, bleeding. Case fatality can reach 90%; incubation 2–21 days; infectivity starts with symptoms. Semen may harbor virus after recovery, enabling sexual transmission. No approved vaccine or specific treatment; no domestic cases detected.

triage.headline_ja: 【まとめ】致命的なエボラウイルスが襲来！感染症状、感染方法を一目で確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの感染症例がアフリカで継続し、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言している。IHR基準3項目が該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは教育的な総括であり、現在の発生状況の詳細は限定的。ただしWHOのPHEIC宣言と致死率90%までの高い重症度が確認されるため、シグナル判定。スーダンはサマリー中では歴史的言及のみで、現在の発生地として記載されていないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola. Repubblica Democratica del Congo: oltre 900 casi sospetti - Agenpress
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola. Democratic Republic of the Congo: over 900 suspected cases - Agenpress.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo features over 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections reported by the World Health Organization. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance has been intensified but did not specify deaths. The DRC Ministry of Health’s latest report lists 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in the ongoing epidemic. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is attributed to the Bundibugyo strain, a rarer form of Ebola for which there are no vaccines or treatments, with a case fatality rate that can reach about 50%.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱。コンゴ民主共和国：900件以上の疑い患者 - Agenpress
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行により、致死率50%の希少株（Bundibugyo株）による深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの中でも希少株であり、ワクチンや治療法がない点が極めて懸念される。WHOが関与し、複数の死亡が報告されている。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo: Mistenker over 900 tilfeller av ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Authorities suspect over 900 Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, WHO reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak, traced to Ituri Province in April, involves the Bundibugyo variant spreading northeast to Goma and across the border into Uganda. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus says the response is being scaled up, noting that conflict in Ituri drives displacement and hampers contact tracing, while fear and distrust hinder authorities. The outbreak is considered an international public health emergency, but not a pandemic. From 867 suspected cases, 204 deaths have been recorded; case fatality is estimated at 25-40%. Transmission occurs via touching and contact with bodily fluids. Bundibugyo is a rare variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Norway pledged 50 million NOK to WHO's health emergencies fund for the Congo and Uganda outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：900件以上のエボラ疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo変異株で予想外、複数国への国際的拡大、国際的対応が必要）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。国際的に認識されている公衆衛生上の緊急事態。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの発生が主要なシグナル。WHO公式な国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態認定。稀なBundibugyo変異株で、ワクチン未承認・特異的治療法なし。死亡率25-40%。ノルウェーを含む複数国が支援表明。

article.articleHeadline: മൃതദേഹത്തിനായി വെടിവയ്പ്പ്, ടെന്റിന് തീയിട്ട് എബോള രോഗികളെ ഒഴിപ്പിക്കൽ; എന്താണ് കോംഗോയിൽ സംഭവിക്കുന്നത്?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gunfire for the corpse, burning the tent to drive away Ebola patients; what's happening in Congo?
article.articleSummary: Armed attacks on Ebola treatment centers escalate in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province. At Mongbwalu General Hospital gunfire forced staff to evacuate Ebola patients; two bodies were demanded for release, with no confirmed injuries. The week also saw a Doctors Without Borders tent torched in Mongbwalu, leaving 18 suspected cases untraceable, and a treatment center in Rwampar town burned on Thursday. To limit transmission from corpses, authorities restricted funerals to crowds under 50 in parts of northeastern Congo from Friday. As of May 25, 2026, WHO reports 904 suspected Ebola cases in Congo, 101 confirmed, mostly in Ituri’s northeast; ministry figures show 119 suspected deaths, local tallies up to 220. Separately, Bundibugyo virus—vaccine-free—has caused deaths, including three health workers in Mongbwalu; Bunia in Ituri reported a death by end-April after initial tests were negative for Ebola. WHO notes high local spread risk but low global spread likelihood.

triage.headline_ja: 銃撃による遺体の奪取、テント放火によるエボラ患者の追い出し；コンゴで何が起きているのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（904疑い例、101確定例、119～220死亡例）、異常な状況（武装攻撃による治療センター襲撃）、国際拡大リスク（エボラ及びブンディブギョウイルス）、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: Ituri州Mongbwalu地域でのエボラ治療センターへの武装攻撃により患者が追い出され、接触追跡が困難に。同時にブンディブギョウイルス（ワクチン無し）も報告されており、複合的な脅威。WHO は地域内の高い拡大リスクを指摘。

article.articleHeadline: OMS alerta sobre más de 900 casos sospechosos de ébola en Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed in Ituri province, the outbreak’s main hotspot. As of May 25, 2026, the DRC Ministry of Health reports more than 200 deaths among 867 suspected cases to date. Ituri, home to about 5 million people, has roughly a quarter requiring humanitarian assistance and around 20% displaced, underscoring severe humanitarian strain. Authorities warn the rise in cases indicates an accelerating spread across multiple areas of the country. The World Health Organization has raised the public health risk level from high to very high due to difficulties containing transmission and worsening humanitarian conditions in affected regions. Emphasizes ongoing preventive measures and surveillance; no explicit mention of imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疑似症例900件以上について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを明確に示唆しており、フルのRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: DRCにおける大規模エボラ疑似症例集団発生。確定症例101件、死亡200件以上、疑似症例867件。Ituri州が主要な流行地点（5百万人口）。WHOがリスク段階を「高」から「極度に高い」に引き上げ。人道的支援ニーズが高く（約25%が支援必要、20%が国内避難民）、感染抑制困難との評価。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В ФИФА подтвердили, что игроки сборной ДР Конго соблюдали санитарные меры на фоне вспышки вируса Эбола и смогут въехать в США для участия в ЧМ‑2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA confirmed that players of the DR Congo national team adhered to health measures amid the Ebola virus outbreak and will be able to enter the United States to participate in the 2026 World Cup.
article.articleSummary: FIFA concludes that the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) national team’s players and coaching staff adhered to sanitary measures during an Ebola outbreak and will be allowed to enter the United States to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. FECOFA officials met with FIFA amid tightened U.S. border health controls banning entry for foreigners who have recently visited Uganda, the DRC, or South Sudan. FECOFA informed FIFA that the squad took all necessary steps to avoid risk and comply with U.S. safety protocols. The joint assessment determined that players and technical staff followed the measures, and delegations were advised to prepare for the World Cup. FECOFA also raised Congolese fans’ visa issues; FIFA will consider compensation proposals. The 2026 World Cup runs June 11–July 19 in the USA, Canada, and Mexico; DR Congo faces Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia in the group stage.

triage.headline_ja: FIFAがコンゴ民主共和国の選手団がエボラウイルス感染症の流行中に衛生対策を遵守したことを確認し、2026年ワールドカップ参加のための米国入国を許可
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の流行に関する報告であり、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生への影響・予想外の事態・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限）に該当。国際的スポーツイベント（2026年ワールドカップ）での対応が必要とされており、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス感染症の流行を背景に、国際的スポーツイベント参加に関する渡航制限と対応策について報じている。発生地域に米国、ウガンダ等が列挙されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国での流行と国際的な対応であり、他国の実際の発生を示していない。対象国リストではコンゴ民主共和国のみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Crisis: न‍िगरानी बढ़ते ही सामने आए मामले, कांगो में 101 पॉज‍िट‍िव केस, 900 से ज्यादा संदिग्ध
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Crisis: As surveillance intensified, cases emerged; 101 positive cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, over 900 suspected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in Ituri Province, with intensified surveillance reporting 101 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 900 suspected as of May 25, 2026. Ituri, home to about 5 million people amid ongoing conflict, faces barriers to health service delivery, case finding, and contact tracing as violence drives displacement and erodes trust. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted health workers and aid staff are among those fleeing, complicating outbreak response. On May 16, the DRC and Uganda declared Ebola a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); as of May 22, national risk is very high, regional risk high, and global risk low. Ebola typically spills over from wildlife (bats, squirrels, and some monkeys) to humans and then spreads through contact with blood, sweat, body fluids, or contaminated objects. WHO and humanitarian partners remain on the ground in Ituri to deliver services and rebuild trust.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：監視体制強化により事態が明らかに、コンゴ民主共和国で101人の陽性患者、900人以上の疑似患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率を持つ出血熱であり、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク、深刻な公衆衛生への影響が認められ、DRCとウガンダは既にPHEIC宣言を実施している。
triage.notes: Ituri Province（コンゴ民主共和国内）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ウガンダはPHEIC宣言国として関連性があるが、記事サマリーではコンゴでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。既にWHO Director-Generalがコメント、PHEIC宣言済み、死亡率が高い出血熱という特性上、最高レベルのトリアージが必須。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS eleva a 900 els casos sospitosos d'Ebola al Congo, amb més de 200 morts - 3CatInfo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO has raised the number of suspected Ebola cases in Congo to 900, with more than 200 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The World Health Organization raises suspected cases to 900, with at least 204 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health. Médecins sans Frontières warns that limited diagnostic testing likely masks the true scale, potentially far higher. Ongoing conflict and violence impede aid delivery, drive away health workers, and hinder contact tracing. The outbreak, declared May 15 and attributed to the Bundibugyo variant, is relatively poorly understood; there is no vaccine or specific treatment available. Case fatality rate around 50%. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, expressing deep concern over magnitude and speed. On Friday, Congo's risk level was upgraded from high to very high, the maximum. Tedros Adhanom stressed rapid spread and a challenging response; globally, overall risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴのエボラ疑い症例を900件に引き上げ、200人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的な懸念の対象であり、WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の宣言アウトブレイク。症例数900件、死亡200人以上。WHOによるPHEIC宣言。Bundibugyo型、ケース致命率約50%。紛争による医療援助の阻害が深刻。実検査数が限定的で実際の患者数はさらに多い可能性。ワクチンや特異的治療がない状況。

article.articleHeadline: കോംഗോയിൽ 900 ലധികം എബോള കേസുകൾ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചതായി ലോകാരോഗ്യ സംഘടന | Southlive
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization Confirms More Than 900 Ebola Cases in Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said there are over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and spreads through contact with bodily fluids, with core symptoms of high fever, bleeding, weakness, and muscle pains. The situation spans the Ituri region, where ongoing insecurity and fear fuel distrust within communities. WHO and humanitarian health partners maintain a presence across affected zones, including hard-to-reach areas, amid response challenges. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo ebolavirus at present, underscoring the need for safe countermeasures and enhanced outbreak management.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関、コンゴでの900件以上のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全項目該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による大規模な疑い患者報告。101件の確定診断者、900件超の疑い患者。ワクチン・特異的治療法がない状況下での対応。Ituri地域での地域信頼の問題と治安の悪化が対応の課題。2026年5月25日現在の情報。

article.articleHeadline: 10 Afrika ülkesinin risk altında olduğu uyarısı yapıldı - Havadis Gazetesi | Kıbrıs Haber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A warning has been issued that 10 African countries are at risk.
article.articleSummary: Africa CDC warns that 10 African countries are at risk of Ebola outbreaks after the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda faced spread. The at-risk nations are South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, DR Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia. In DR Congo’s eastern Ituri province, the outbreak was declared on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; by that date, 867 cases and 204 deaths had been reported. In neighboring Uganda, 5 Ebola cases and 1 death have been recorded. The World Health Organization declared an international public health emergency on May 17. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola is a hemorrhagic fever; historical outbreaks include 1976 events and the 2014–2017 West Africa epidemic that killed about 11,000 of roughly 30,000 cases in Guinea, Liberia and Sierra Leone.

triage.headline_ja: 10のアフリカ諸国がエボラウイルス感染症のリスク下にあると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する致命的な感染症。DRC・ウガンダでの確認事例と複数国への拡大リスク、国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イトゥリ州で確認、246疑似症例・65死亡、その後867症例・204死亡報告）とウガンダ（5症例・1死亡）での実際の発生が記述されている。警告対象国にはルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国、南スーダンが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC、ザンビアのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（治療法・ワクチンなし）による致命的な大規模流行の初期段階。WHO国際公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）。

article.articleHeadline: White House Halts Detainee Deportations to DRC Amid Escalating Ebola Crisis - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, the White House pauses deportations of detainees to the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid a widening Ebola outbreak, with policy affecting Adriana Zapata, a 55-year-old Colombian asylum seeker deported to Kinshasa after relocation from the U.S. A U.S. judge has ordered her return, but officials cite a new DRC travel ban as impediment. Experts say halting deportations may not curb transmission; the ban covers DRC, Uganda and South Sudan. As of recent months, 8,000–15,000 people are believed to have been flown to third countries for detention or removal; at least 37 have been moved. DHS/ICE say removals follow health guidelines; CDC has announced exit screening and entry screening for travelers from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, with Washington-Dulles as a screening hub. Authorities emphasize monitoring and layered public health measures while the outbreak expands in Kinshasa and surrounding regions.

triage.headline_ja: ホワイトハウス、エボラ危機の拡大に伴いDRCへの被拘禁者強制送還を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。エボラは高致死性・広域拡大病原体であり、複数国での対応と渡航制限が実施されている点で、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはVirginiaやSudanなどが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCのキンシャサでの大規模エボラ流行であり、米国への影響（検査体制、強制送還一時停止）は二次的。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。記事は2026年5月という将来日付であり、シナリオ/シミュレーション的性質の可能性があるが、提供情報に基づき評価。

article.articleHeadline: Kongas praneša apie daugiau kaip 900 įtariamų Ebolos atvejų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases, with suspected deaths down to 119 (from 204 the day prior) and 10 lab-confirmed Ebola deaths. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. In Uganda, five confirmed cases linked to the Eastern Congo outbreak have been reported; Uganda does not publish suspected-case counts. WHO says the true case burden is likely much higher because the Eastern Congo outbreak went unrecognized for weeks and not all cases are reported. Clusters of unexplained deaths are under investigation. Ebola is highly contagious and deadly, and controlling the current outbreak is difficult, as there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo strain. Transmission occurs via close contact with the bodily fluids of an infected person, not through airborne spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが900件以上の疑い患者エボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は国際的に懸念される感染症であり、DRC及びウガンダでの確認症例と高い死亡率が深刻な公衆衛生影響を示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの疑い患者900件以上、確認死亡10件、ウガンダでの5件の確認症例を報告している。DRCはWHO地域では対象国（AFRO）だが、提供された対象国リストに含まれている。ウガンダは記事に言及されているものの、対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。エボラの高い感染性と死亡率、ワクチン・特異的治療の欠如、及び多地域での活発な感染伝播はすべてシグナルピックアップの根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo surpass 1,000 - UPI.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has surpassed 1,000 cases, with 904 suspected and 101 confirmed across three provinces and 11 zones as of May 24, according to Ministry of Health; at least 10 deaths have been reported in the DRC per CDC. Uganda reports five confirmed cases and one death. The Bundibugyo virus drives the outbreak; the first suspected case was a DRC health worker on April 24, who died. The DRC declared its 17th Ebola outbreak on May 15, and the WHO declared the epidemic a public health emergency of international concern on May 16. The WHO raised the national risk for the DRC to very high (regional high, global low). Violence in Ituri's outbreak center has displaced populations - nearly 922,000 of 5.3 million internally displaced in the DRC - complicating contact tracing in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Health authorities continue surveillance, screening and prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が1,000例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公開情報によるPHEIC宣言済み。複数国への国際的拡大、高い重症度、制御困難な状況が確認される。
triage.notes: Uganda(ウガンダ)も5確定症例と1死亡が記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地域。すでにWHOがPHEIC宣言（2026年5月16日）している確度の高いシグナル。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は致死性の高い株。暴力による人口移動が接触者追跡を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Young men storm a Congo hospital treating Ebola patients to demand bodies of their kin - The Boston Globe
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) persists as of 2026-05-25. WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern and classifies Congo's outbreak risk as very high; the risk of global spread remains low. Authorities report 904 suspected cases, mostly in Ituri, with 119 suspected deaths; regional tallies show 220 deaths. Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no vaccine, is involved; testing for a more common strain yielded inconclusive results. Bunia death occurred in late April. Attacks on health facilities hinder response: Mongbwalu General Hospital was put on alert after a mob burned a tent housing suspected/confirmed cases, and 18 suspected Ebola patients fled; Rwampara center was burned after authorities banned retrieving a body. Three IFRC volunteers died in Mongbwalu after contracting Ebola on March 27 while handling dead bodies in a humanitarian mission. Funeral wakes and gatherings over 50 remain banned to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 若い男たちがコンゴ病院を襲撃、エボラ患者の治療を受けながら親族の遺体引き取りを要求 - ボストン・グローブ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的懸念の公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行継続、ワクチンなしのBundibugyo株関与、医療施設への攻撃による対応阻害がありフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイツリ州での流行が主題。ルワンダはBluedot APIで検出されているが、サマリーにルワンダでの発生を示す記述がないため除外。Bundibugyo株はエボラの稀な株でワクチンなし。医療施設への暴力的な攻撃により対応が著しく阻害されている。IFRC職員の死亡報告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din RD Congo: Provocări uriașe din cauza lipsei resurselor și a vaccinurilor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in DR Congo: enormous challenges due to lack of resources and vaccines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is challenging humanitarian responses amid critical resource and vaccine shortages. As of 2026-05-25, the epidemic has caused over 200 deaths and more than 850 suspected cases; three Red Cross volunteers are among early victims, likely from handling bodies for burial. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern due to fears of accelerated spread. Major constraints include lack of medical countermeasures (treatments, vaccines, rapid tests) and disrupted logistics from airspace closures, hindering deployment of medical teams and equipment. There is an urgent need for rapid testing to prevent unnecessary isolation of non-infected patients. Ebola, a highly aggressive virus, produces abrupt onset of fever and fatigue within 2–21 days, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes bleeding. Transmission is via direct contact with infected bodily fluids. The outbreak involves a rare strain, with the epicenter in a war-torn region, delaying detection and transmission monitoring. Animal meat handling remains a known infection source.

triage.headline_ja: RD コンゴのエボラ流行：資源とワクチン不足による巨大な課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み。即時フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: WHO が PHEIC 宣言済み。死者 200 名以上、疑い例 850 名以上。紛争地域での発生により検出・監視遅延。稀な株の関与も報告。ワクチン・治療薬・検査キット等の医療対策物資が極度に不足。空域閉鎖による物流阻害。国際的な支援体制の迅速な構築が急務。

article.articleHeadline: US CBP announces designated arrival airports as 'proactive measure' in response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: US Customs and Border Protection (CBP) announced modifications to DHS-restrictions first implemented on 21 May 2026 for US-bound air travelers who recently traveled from or were present in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, requiring arrival at Washington Dulles International Airport. The changes designate Atlanta Hartsfield-Jackson International Airport as a designated arrival facility from 22 May 2026 and Houston George Bush Intercontinental Airport as a designated facility from 26 May 2026. Described as a proactive measure in response to the ongoing Ebola outbreak, the designated airports are where the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention will focus public health resources to implement enhanced measures.

triage.headline_ja: 米国CBP、エボラ熱の流行に対応して指定到着空港を発表（積極的措置）
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の国際的な拡大リスク（コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンからの米国への渡航者）が報告されており、IHR基準の「国際的拡大」「渡航制限」に該当。米国政府による積極的対応と高い社会的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーが米国の到着空港制限措置に焦点を当てているが、根本となるエボラ熱の発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダンである。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダとスーダンは対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。記事は2026年の時間設定（未来の日付）であり、仮想シナリオと考えられるが、評価は記事内容に基づき実施。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി; യാത്രക്കാർക്കും വിമാനക്കമ്പനികൾക്കും കർശന മുന്നറിയിപ്പ്, ജാഗ്രതാ നിർദ്ദേശം പുറത്തിറക്കി ഒമാൻ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear; Oman issues a strict warning and precautionary advisory for travelers and airlines.
article.articleSummary: Ebola fears rise as Congo Democratic Republic (DRC) and Uganda report active transmission of the Bundibugyo strain. Oman’s Civil Aviation Authority issues a strict advisory for travelers and airlines, based on May 24 WHO guidance, urging heightened precautions for services to Oman and from affected areas. Travelers from these countries should undergo 21 days of health surveillance after their flight, reporting fever, severe headache, vomiting, diarrhea, unusual bleeding, or extreme fatigue to health authorities. Unnecessary travel to Ebola-affected areas should be avoided, and travelers should ensure health insurance coverage that includes treatment and medical evacuation. Avoid contact with patients or their blood/body fluids, do not handle the sick’s personal items, and avoid large funeral gatherings. Also avoid wildlife contact and undercooked meat; practice frequent handwashing and alcohol-based sanitizers. Not airborne; transmission occurs via infected fluids. WHO notes over 900 suspected cases in the DRC with no approved vaccines or specific therapies for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖；オマーンが旅行者と航空会社に厳格な警告と予防的勧告を発行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、DRCで900件以上の疑い患者が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ（Bundibugyo株）の活発な伝播を報じており、DRCで900件以上の疑い患者が報告されている。オマーンが航空旅行者に対して厳格な勧告を発行している。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。オマーンも対象国ではなく、ここは旅行勧告発行国として機能しており、実際の発生地はDRCである。

article.articleHeadline: India Issues Travel Advisory For Ebola-Hit Countries: How Airport Screenings Help Control Outbreaks
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, India has intensified airport surveillance for Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) after WHO declared an Ebola PHEIC in Africa. Travellers from Ebola-affected countries—Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan—are required to report symptoms to Airport Health Officers before immigration clearance; they should self-monitor for 21 days. Airport measures include thermal/symptom screening, health declarations, isolation, contact tracing, and rapid laboratory testing, with NIV Pune designated as a major Ebola testing centre. India’s IDSP, NCDC, and ICMR coordinate preparedness with airport authorities, lab readiness, and quarantine protocols. EVD can present with fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, diarrhoea, and sometimes bleeding, with fatality rates up to about 50%. Screening is part of a broader surveillance ecosystem emphasizing rapid detection, data sharing, and hospital/community readiness.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ出血熱の影響を受けた国に対する渡航勧告を発令：空港スクリーニングが流行の抑制に役立つしくみ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（異常/予想外な対応、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限対象）。エボラのPHEIC宣言に基づくインドの強化対応であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（流行しやすさ、管理可能性、重症度）も複数該当。公的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドにおけるエボラに対する対応強化（空港サーベイランス、スクリーニング）を主題としており、DRCはエボラ流行の主要発生地として言及されている。ウガンダ・南スーダンは記事で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Nipahは疾患名に含まれるが記事サマリーではエボラのみが扱われている。WHOのPHEIC宣言がトリガーであり、インドの多段階対応体制（IDSP、NCDC、ICMR、NIV Pune）が発動されている点で政策的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Crisis: Urgent Global Action Needed
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has reached at least 500 suspected cases with 130 deaths, according to the World Health Organization, two weeks after the new outbreak began.
