Save the Children warns that decimated health systems in the DRC are ill-equipped to halt spread and calls for urgent global action to support local health facilities, protect children, and help affected families. The outbreak involves a Bundibugyo strain, with limited testing initially focused on the Zaire strain, allowing the virus to spread before detection. The DRC faces a broader humanitarian crisis amid conflict, with about 5.6 million internally displaced and roughly 15 million in need of assistance, particularly in North Kivu, South Kivu, Ituri, Kasai, Kasai Oriental and Lomami. Measures emphasize infection prevention and control in health centres, avoiding direct contact with the sick, and arrival of equipment and teams to halt further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ危機：緊急な世界的行動が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。DRC内の複数州での大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（500疑い例、130死亡）は深刻で、国際的な対応が急務。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイクで、初期検査がZaire株に限定されていたため検出が遅延。DRCの保健システム崩壊と広範な人道危機（550万人の国内避難民、1500万人が支援必要）が背景にあり、South Kivu、North Kivu、Ituri、Kasai、Kasai Oriental、Lomamiなど複数州が影響を受けている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Δυσκολεύονται να περιορίσουν την επιδημία στο Κονγκό - Πάνω από 900 ύποπτα κρούσματα | LiFO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Struggling to contain the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - More than 900 suspected cases | LiFO
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 904 suspected cases and 119 probable deaths, centered in Ituri province. The World Health Organization classifies the outbreak as 'very high' risk for the DRC, while global risk remains low. Health authorities face major challenges amid ongoing violence, displacement, and resource shortages; two Ebola treatment centers were attacked in separate towns last week, underscoring community anger and distrust. Strict burial protocols are in place to prevent further spread; gatherings over 50 people are banned in the northeast, and security forces guard burials conducted by humanitarian groups. Aid organizations report shortages of PPE, testing kits, and safe-burial supplies, compounded by deteriorating health infrastructure. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or therapy for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: コンゴ民主共和国での流行封じ込めに苦戦 - 900件を超える疑い症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準では4つすべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による確認された流行で、900件超の疑い症例、119件の死亡が報告されており、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、DRC東部Ituri州でのエボラ流行が主題。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株が確認されており、承認されたワクチンや治療法がない。医療施設への攻撃、コミュニティの不信、PPEやテスト用キットの不足など、対応上の重大な課題が存在。WHO分類で「very high」リスク。フルのRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: UN boosts Ebola response with up to USD 60 million - Caribbean News Global
article.articleSummary: On 25 May 2026, the United Nations allocates up to $60 million from the Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the wider region, including Uganda and South Sudan. There are no licensed vaccines or treatments for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain yet. The response, led by WHO, faces difficult operating environments due to conflict and population movement, with access hindered in areas controlled by armed groups; safe routes by air, land and water are essential. Containment relies on rapid, coordinated community action, trust-building, and effective early warning and detection systems. The UN will deploy additional staff and preposition supplies to reinforce frontline responders. Related May 23 updates note the Global Action Plan on Antimicrobial Resistance 2026–2036 to strengthen One Health governance, with FAO, UNEP and WOAH.

triage.headline_ja: 国連がエボラ対応に最大6000万米ドルを配分 - カリブ海ニュースグローバル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当：エボラ出血熱の広域多国間発生、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な資金配分と支援体制の構築、ワクチン・治療法未開発の緊急対応。WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ対応であり、UgandaおよびSouth Sudanは「wider region」として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていない（UgandaはGeoNames 226074、South SudanはGeoNames 366755）。対象国はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株（未ワクチン化）の特定、紛争影響下の困難な対応環境、UN/WHO主導の大規模資金配分投入など、高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria at high risk of imported Ebola: alerts and preventive measures
article.articleSummary: Nigeria faces a high risk of imported Ebola virus disease as of May 25, 2026, according to alerts from the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC). The outbreak currently affecting neighboring Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo underscores the risk via cross-border spread. The principal potential entry route is travelers arriving from areas with active Ebola transmission. In response, Nigerian health authorities have intensified surveillance and preparedness, deploying strategies to ensure rapid detection and response and to minimize transmission. International partners are urged to collaborate in epidemiological surveillance, data sharing, and support for local efforts. Officials emphasize maintaining calm and following official guidance to prevent panic. Readers are directed to consult official sources for updated protocols.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congolese national football team is in danger of exclusion from the 2026 FIFA World Cup due to the Ebola epidemic - Aktual24
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) caused by Bundibugyo variant; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. As of May 25, 2026, over 740 suspected cases and about 180 deaths have been reported; community transmission persists in Ituri province and adjacent areas, including Uganda. There is no widely approved vaccine at scale for Bundibugyo. The Congolese national football team is at risk of exclusion from the 2026 FIFA World Cup after the U.S. mandated a 21-day strict medical quarantine in Belgium prior to entry, with any contact with affected zones potentially denying visas. RD Congo athletes are training in Belgium to avoid travel risks; FECOFA says it is complying with recommendations. A 21-day quarantine could hamper preparations for a group that includes Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third-largest in history! Ebola ravages the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 210 suspected dead; health facility attacked for the third time, arson; 18 patients escaped.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo faces a major Ebola outbreak in the eastern region, centered in Ituri and spanning three provinces and 11 health zones. As of May 23, authorities report over 900 suspected cases and 210 suspected deaths, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The Bundibugyo strain is involved; there is currently no vaccine or antibody therapy. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, and Uganda has reported five confirmed cases, with concerns the virus may have reached South Sudan. Health facilities have suffered attacks: May 24 saw the Mongbwalu General Hospital in Ituri stormed, MSF treatment tents burned, and a center in Rwampara previously set ablaze. Bunia, the provincial capital, struggles with limited testing (about 40 tests per day) and PPE shortages as response begins. International Medical Corps notes the outbreak is outrunning containment, prioritizing slowing transmission over eradication.

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola outbreak: More than 900 suspected cases identified | News.az
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has identified more than 900 suspected cases, with at least 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Dr. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. He announced the figures during the opening sessions of the WHO's 79th World Health Assembly. The health agency said it is monitoring the situation as local and international medical teams deploy resources to contain the outbreak in the region. The update emphasizes ongoing transmission and the role of laboratory confirmation in tracking the outbreak, highlighting the international effort to support containment measures. The figures cited include both suspected and laboratory-confirmed cases, reflecting ongoing assessment as health authorities respond.

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises alarm over rising Ebola cases in Congo
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak centers on Ituri province; as of May 25, 2026, >900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections have been identified. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, with Uganda also involved; on May 16 the WHO Director-General declared Ebola a public health emergency of international concern, and on May 22 risk is assessed as very high at the national level, high regionally, and low globally. Ituri’s roughly 5 million residents live amid ongoing conflict, with one in four needing humanitarian aid and one in five internally displaced, obstructing contact tracing and timely care. Ebola is a severe, often fatal illness transmitted from wildlife to humans and through direct contact with blood, secretions, organs, or contaminated surfaces; the case fatality rate averages around 50%, with past outbreaks ranging 25–90%. Context references the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (Guinea, Sierra Leone, Liberia).

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases top 900 in DRC as epidemic spreads, warns WHO chief
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed, as of 25 May 2026. The outbreak, declared on 15 May 2026 in eastern DRC, is centered in Ituri province, where prolonged conflict leaves nearly 5 million residents and frequent humanitarian needs (about 1 in 4 in need; 1 in 5 internally displaced), hindering contact tracing and access to care. Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The Bundibugyo strain is driving transmission; there are no approved vaccines or treatments for this strain. The health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Neighboring Uganda reported three new cases (total five) with one death. The African Union warned ten countries at risk, including Angola, Burundi, CAR, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania and Zambia.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : Plus de 900 cas suspects détectés en RDC, où la surveillance s'intensifie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 900 suspected cases detected in the DRC, where surveillance is intensifying.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026. The Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is detected in Ituri province in the northeast, a border region with Uganda and South Sudan where about five million people live amid ongoing conflict. Armed violence displaces healthcare teams and disrupts access, with poor road networks hindering intensified case finding and early identification necessary to provide care. Surveillance efforts are escalating but are challenged by security and infrastructure constraints that impede contact tracing and timely outbreak control in the conflict-affected Ituri region and adjacent border areas.

article.articleHeadline: Ébola agrava crisis congoleña
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Worsens Congolese Crisis
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola outbreak worsens crisis in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with the Bundibugyo strain driving transmission in Ituri province, including Bunia-area camps. Authorities report more than 900 suspected cases in Ituri as the health emergency escalates. The situation deteriorated after arson attacks on Ebola treatment centers in Rwampara and Mongbwalu, underscoring security, displacement, and resource shortages hampering response. Humanitarian groups warn of a constellation of emergencies: armed groups such as M23 and Allied Democratic Forces linked to ISIS, widespread displacement approaching one million in Ituri, and fragile health systems. Doctors Without Borders flags "catastrophic" conditions at some facilities; Physicians for Human Rights notes reduced capacity to detect and respond to outbreaks amid aid shortfalls. Community distrust and restrictions on funerals increase transmission risk. No vaccine is approved for Bundibugyo Ebola, complicating containment.

Rwanda is mentioned as neighboring country but Kigali Province reference appears to be geographic/administrative context; primary outbreak location is DRC Ituri. Humanitarian emergency with catastrophic conditions reported by MSF. Community distrust and funeral restrictions increase transmission risk.

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola scapă de sub control în Congo după incendierea unor centre medicale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic gets out of control in Congo after the burning of several medical centers.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola response centers were attacked as locals burned a MSF tent for treating suspected and confirmed cases in Mongbwalu, allowing 18 people suspected of infection to escape; a prior attack hit a clinic in Rwampara. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said over 900 suspected Ebola cases and 101 confirmed, noting the outbreak is likely far larger than official counts. The current outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo lineage, for which no vaccine exists, and the virus had been spreading for weeks undetected while authorities tested patients for more common Ebola forms. Funeral restrictions and handling of the deceased remain high-risk, with specialized teams strictly controlling burial procedures, fueling community tensions. This marks the second attack in days; no injuries were reported.

article.articleHeadline: Misiones humanitarias culpan a EE.UU. ante el peligroso brote del ébola sin tratamiento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Humanitarian missions blame the U.S. amid the dangerous Ebola outbreak with no treatment.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda intensifies as U.S. funding for international aid wanes. The Bundibugyo virus, highly transmissible, has produced over 900 suspected cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed in the DRC after reinforced surveillance. No vaccines or specific treatments exist for this strain. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Humanitarian groups warn that funding cuts effective March 2025 have crippled frontline activities: the International Rescue Committee reduced operations in Ituri province from five health districts to two, and former USAID outbreak-response staff were laid off, eroding trust and capacity. The United States had been a major donor for disease treatment, surveillance, and the construction of water, sanitation, and infection-prevention infrastructure (including waste management, handwashing stations, showers, and latrines) in eastern DRC. Cross-border transmission risk to Uganda persists.

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola Cases Top 900 In DR Congo
article.articleSummary: DR Congo declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15, 2026, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatments. By May 25, 2026, health authorities and the World Health Organization reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the conflict-affected nation, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections; the death toll had not been updated by WHO Director-General Tedros, though a previous ministry update cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola, a viral hemorrhagic fever, spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The ongoing outbreak is centered in multiple provinces within DR Congo, with surveillance scaled up to identify cases. No vaccine-based mitigation exists for Bundibugyo, highlighting the need for rigorous public health measures and case management.

article.articleHeadline: Нападнаха болница с пациенти от ебола в ДР Конго, евакуираха болни и медици
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital attacked in DR Congo with Ebola patients; patients and medical staff evacuated.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo escalates as violence disrupts response. Angry youths storm Mongbvalu Multispecialty Hospital, forcing urgent evacuation of patients and staff on 23 May at 19:10 local time; gunfire reported and attackers sought bodies of two relatives. No confirmed injuries reported to date. The incident occurs amid a broader outbreak deemed the epicenter in the area, with three health-facility attacks in a week as authorities grapple with limited resources and suspected Ebola cases. By 24 May, the World Health Organization declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing ongoing violence and more than 200 deaths in Africa connected to the outbreak. The article provides no laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or information on imported/exported cases.

triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行拡大と暴力による対応の混乱、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、200人以上の死亡を伴う深刻な公衆衛生上の影響とアフリカ全域への国際的脅威を示唆する複数の要因がIHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を満たし、フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは DRC 東部での暴力によるエボラ対応の混乱を主題としており、Mongbvalu 病院への襲撃、複数の保健施設攻撃、200人以上の死亡、WHOによるPHEIC宣言が確認される。記事ではアフリカ全体への影響が言及されているが、具体的な他国での流行確認は記載されていないため、verified_locations は DRC のみとする。追加の情報（検査確認、感染源、輸入・輸出症例の詳細）は記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nijmegen patient cleared of ebola as Congo outbreak grows - DutchNews.nl
article.articleSummary: Netherlands, 2026-05-25: A Nijmegen patient admitted to Radboudumc’s high-level isolation unit after returning from central Africa was suspected of Ebola virus disease (EVD); blood tests confirmed no infection, and the patient has been moved to a regular ward. The initial suspicion was described as low. The DR Congo Ituri Province outbreak was declared on May 15; WHO declared a public health emergency on May 17, with risk in DRC rated very high on May 22. As of now, 82 laboratory-confirmed EVD cases and seven deaths in the DRC, with around 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. Two cases have been confirmed in Uganda, and a US citizen infected in the DRC was evacuated to Germany for care. RIVM notes travel risk remains small and advises avoiding contact with the sick, raw meat from wild animals, and unsafe burials.

triage.headline_ja: ニイメーヘン患者がエボラ陰性、コンゴの発生が拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（死亡例、高い致死率）、異常性（新規流行宣言）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での確認、予防接種なし）、渡航・貿易制限リスクをもたらす。WHO公開衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みで、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC の Ituri Province が主要な発生地域であり、ウガンダ（対象国外）での2例確認、ドイツ（対象国外）での米国市民の避難治療が言及されている。オランダ（対象国外）での患者はエボラ陰性確認。対象国リストに基づき verified_locations に含めるべき国は DRC のみ。WHO 公開衛生上の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月17日）済みで、Bundibugyo Ebola ウイルス株で予防接種なし、極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS eleva a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the number of suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to over 900.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola outbreak in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu remains active, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases and 904 suspected cases across 11 health zones as of May 23, 2026. Authorities report 119 suspected deaths and 10 confirmed deaths. Africa CDC reported higher mortality estimates (204 deaths under suspicion) across DRC and Uganda, but Uganda is less affected. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there are no licensed vaccines or approved antibody therapies. Genomic and epidemiological clues suggest the virus circulated undetected for months in Ituri. Tedros warns of violence in Ituri, posing challenges to contact tracing and healthcare delivery, with five million people in a conflict zone, one in four in humanitarian need, and one in five internally displaced. WHO and partners maintain a presence, calling for a health package to bolster trust and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い症例を900件以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。稀なBundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模なエボラ流行で、ワクチンや承認治療法がなく、紛争地域での対応困難性により国際的な支援と懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（South Kivu、Ituri）での流行が主題。Ugandaは「less affected」と述べられ、流行の中心はDRCであるため verified_locations はDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は稀な株で、ライセンス取得済みワクチンや承認抗体療法がないことが重要なリスク要因。紛争地域での対応困難性（接触者追跡の障害、医療供給の課題）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola News: Mehr als 900 Verdachtsfälle nach Ausbruch im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola News: More than 900 suspected cases after outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks persist in eastern Africa, with the Congo reporting rising fatalities linked to an especially aggressive Ebola variant. The outbreak has generated more than 900 suspected cases, according to reports accompanying the story, and other countries remain at risk. In Berlin, Charité hospital is treating an Ebola-infected doctor; reports say the White House pressed to prevent the physician from returning to the United States. The affected American’s wife and four children have since arrived in Berlin. The article highlights international concern over cross-border transmission and the politically sensitive handling of an infected clinician abroad, but provides no details on laboratory confirmation, infection source, or specific exported/imported cases beyond the patient’s travel-linked status. Ongoing outbreak monitoring and public health measures are implied as eastern Africa remains affected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラニュース：コンゴでの流行後、900件以上の疑い患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病のアフリカ東部での流行拡大、複数国への波及の可能性、国際的な感染リスク、および医療従事者の国際間移動に伴う拡散懸念が認識される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはベルリン、ドイツ、米国も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東アフリカでのエボラ流行であり、ベルリンでの患者治療は二次的な情報。対象国リストに該当する検証可能な発生地はDRCのみ。記事は900件以上の疑い患者と増加する死亡者数を報告しており、特に侵襲性の高いエボラ亜種によるもの。医療従事者の国際移動と白宮の政治的対応も記載されており、国際的な保健上の関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Visszatért a rettegett ebolavírus: minden, amit a járványról tudni lehet!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dreaded Ebola virus has returned: everything there is to know about the outbreak!
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus outbreak has been identified in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically Ituri Province, with initial cases detected in May 2026. The exact start date remains unknown. The region hosts displaced people due to conflict and a migrant workforce attracted to local gold mines, factors WHO says increase transmission risk due to population movement. The United States has imposed strict travel restrictions on African countries in response. The report provides no confirmed case counts or fatalities. Authorities are monitoring for imported or exported cases, while cautioning that movement in the Ituri region raises the risk of further spread.

triage.headline_ja: 恐れられていたエボラウイルスが再び現れた：感染症の流行について知っておくべきすべてのこと！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当、米国による渡航制限など社会政治的関心が高い。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに示されたように、エボラウイルスの新規発生がDRC北東部Ituri州で2026年5月に確認されている。紛争による避難民と金鉱採掘労働者の人口移動がWHOにより伝播リスク増加要因として指摘されている。米国による渡航制限が実施されている。ただし、確定症例数および死亡数の情報は記事に含まれていない（重症度評価は不明）。

article.articleHeadline: Zahl der Verdachtsfälle in der Ebola-Region steigt auf über 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected cases in the Ebola region rises to over 900.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surged. By May 25, 2026, authorities reported more than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections; 82 infections and seven deaths had been officially confirmed earlier, with 177 unconfirmed deaths possibly linked. The WHO raised national risk to 'very high,' regional risk to 'high,' global risk 'low.' Ituri Province bears the majority of cases; the region hosts over 920,000 internally displaced people, with up to 4 million IDPs across eastern Congo. The virus has crossed borders, with five confirmed cases in Uganda. An infected American doctor is treated in Berlin; his wife and four children are quarantined high-risk contacts. Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or established treatment. Transmission is via contact with blood and body fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure. First lab-confirmed cases were May 15; WHO PHEIC declared May 17.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ地域の疑い患者数が900人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常・予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大（ウガンダ・ドイツ）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPRO基準5つすべて該当。WHO PHEICが既に宣言され、国際的な高い関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確にコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行が主題。ウガンダでも5例の確認患者があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツ（ベルリン）での症例は医療者の治療事例であり、流行の中心地ではない。コンゴ民主共和国のみ verified_locations に含める。WHO PHEICがすでに宣言（2026年5月17日）されており、極めて高い優先度でのフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Аларм во СЗО: СЕ ШИРИ ЕБОЛА ЗА КОЈА НЕМА НИТУ ВАКЦИНА НИТУ ЛЕК!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm at WHO: Ebola spreading for which there is neither a vaccine nor a cure!
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where suspected cases exceed 900 and 204 deaths have been confirmed. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned the epidemic is spreading rapidly despite intensified controls. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no vaccine or cure, with mortality around 50%. Local authorities declared an epidemic in mid-May, and WHO fears a worse scenario given that this virus historically has mortality rates up to 90%. The report notes the situation as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警戒中：ワクチンも治療法もないエボラが拡大中！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言した重大なエボラ出血熱の流行である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の流行。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。900件以上の疑い例と204人の確定死亡例。致死率約50%、歴史的には最高90%。ワクチンも治療法もない状況。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Fruit bats, a common link between Ebola and Nipah; urgent attention required: Doctors explain
article.articleSummary: Fruit bats carry Ebola; Nipah outbreaks in 2018 and 2023 were amplified in hospitals, and the WHO declared an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo a global health emergency. The current Ebola outbreak involves Bundibugyo virus, with activity in Congo, Uganda and South Sudan. Ebola causes fever, hemorrhage, vascular damage, coagulopathy, and multiorgan failure, with mortality ranging from 40% to 90%. Kerala experts warn of risk. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Nzara (SUDV) and Yambuku (EBOV); fruit bats of genus Pteropus are natural hosts and can shed virus for months. The Indian flying fox is common in Kerala, Karnataka, Tamil Nadu and northeast India and was linked to the 2018 Nipah outbreak in Kozhikode. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bats or contaminated fruits; the virus mutates rapidly. Congo variants show mortality around 42–47%. India faces Nipah/Ebola risk via African travelers (over 8 million annually) and potential spread before confirmation in 3–5 days.

triage.headline_ja: フルーツコウモリはエボラとニパーの共通のリンク。医師が説明：緊急の注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Ebola/Nipahは高致命率(40-90%)、複数国での発生、インド南部での顕在的リスクが報告されており、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国の地理的な文脈を提供しているが（DRC、Sudan、Uganda、Burundi）、サマリーの主題は現在のEbola（DRCおよび周辺地域での活動）とインド南部でのNipahリスク。対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）とIndia（1269750）のみ。高い致命率、複数国での検出、airport/medical transmissionのリスク、インドへの旅行者ボリュームが大きいことから国際的脅威レベルは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Выявлено более 900 предполагаемых случаев заражение вирусом Эбола в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected cases of Ebola virus infection detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports more than 900 suspected Ebola virus infection cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri Province, home to about 5 million people. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus disclosed these figures. In Ituri, roughly one in four residents needs humanitarian assistance, and about one in five has left their home, underscoring severe humanitarian distress amid the outbreak. The brief notes ongoing transmission within the Ituri outbreak zone, but provides no details on symptoms, transmission chains, infection sources, or information on imported/exported cases. The report emphasizes the scale of suspected versus confirmed cases and the challenging conditions facing the population in the outbreak area.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染の疑い例900件以上がコンゴ民主共和国で検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当するため。エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクは極めて高い公衆衛生リスク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは極めて高い致死率を有する病原体。900件以上の疑い例が報告されており、イトゥリ州は約500万人の人口を抱える。WHOの事務局長が公式に数値を開示していることから政治的関心も高い。人道支援ニーズと人口移動の報告から、二次感染及び地域間拡大のリスクが懸念される。ただし記事本文が欠落しており、確定例数、症状、感染源などの詳細情報が不足している点は注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Uganda und DR Kongo: Drei Tote bei Hilfshelfern der Rot-Kreuz-Bewegung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Uganda and DR Congo: Three dead among Red Cross relief workers.
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross relief workers died likely after Ebola exposure in Mongbwalu, Djugu district, Ituri Province, DR Congo, during a March 27 burial/handling mission; Vivaine (May 5), Katanabo (May 15), and Augustin (May 16) deaths. The outbreak began in DR Congo and has spread to Uganda, with Uganda reporting five cases including a driver, a medical aide, and a Congolese woman with mild abdominal symptoms. WHO classifies the Congo outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with ongoing transmission hampered by violence and insecurity. Bundibugyo hemorrhagic fever is driving transmission. Suspected Congo cases: 746 with 176 deaths; at least 88 confirmed cases, 10 deaths; one confirmed case in Uganda. US has imposed entry bans for foreign nationals who visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan within 21 days (as of May 18); citizens face enhanced screening. Agencies involved include WHO, IFRC, CDC, ECDC, MSF.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダとコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：赤十字運動の支援者3人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の出来事、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。WHO公式にPHEIC指定済み。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づきウガンダでの症例報告がされているが、発生地域の具体的位置（Mangbwalu, Ituri Province）はDRC内であり、主要イベント発生地はDRC。ウガンダは二次的影響地域として言及されているが、verified_locationsはイベント発生地のDRCのみとした。WHO PHEIC指定済み、複数国への拡大、死亡事例複数、国際的渡航制限実施により高度な優先度案件。

article.articleHeadline: "Kann noch ganz andere Dimensionen annehmen": Paar aus Oberschwaben erlebt Ebola-Ausbruch mit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Can take on even more dimensions": A couple from Upper Swabia experiences an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Eastern Congo's Ebola outbreak has reached Goma, a city of about two million in Ituri Province. Ursula Langkamp and Manfred Bischofberger from Oberschwaben, who run Welthungerhilfe's country office there, recall Sierra Leone's 2014–2016 Ebola epidemic that killed more than 11,000 people. The current outbreak involves the Bundibugyo virus, a rare variant, delaying laboratory confirmation and response. Mobility in the gold-mining belt accelerates spread, and contact tracing is strained: for a female patient in Goma, 255 contacts were identified; overall contacts per suspected case appear around two—far too low. Public health measures include bans on gatherings over 50, temperature checks, and hand-washing stations; border closures with Rwanda and Uganda disrupt trade. Goma is under rebel control (M23); banks closed, cash flow jeopardized. Safe burials are enforced to prevent transmission, restricting family contact with the deceased.

triage.headline_ja: 「さらに大きな規模に拡大する可能性がある」：上シュワーベン出身のカップルがエボラ流行を経験
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の東部コンゴ流行がゴマに到達し、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダ・ウガンダとの国境接触）と渡航制限が生じている。重症度・流行可能性・管理課題が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の流行地はDRC（ゴマを含むイトゥリ県）。過去のシエラレオネ流行や接近国（ルワンダ・ウガンダ）への参照は文脈情報であり、当該シグナルの発生地ではない。Bundibugyo株（稀な変異体）の確認遅延、接触者追跡の不十分性（識別255例に対し平均2接触者のみ）、反政府勢力M23支配下での公衆衛生対応能力の低下が管理可能性の主要懸念。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : الصحة العالمية: الاشتباه بأكثر من 900 حالة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon Newspaper: World Health Organization: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 25 May 2026, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections; no death toll update from WHO yet. The response centers on eastern DRC near Bunia at the Modjigbalala checkpoint, screening travelers from the mining town of Mongbwalu believed to be the outbreak’s epicenter. Health workers require handwashing and temperature checks for vehicles and pedestrians crossing between Bunia and Mongbwalu. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a rare lineage; there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. The DRC health ministry’s latest update cited 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause hemorrhagic fever and organ failure. Since Africa-wide outbreaks, more than 15,000 deaths have been reported in the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: アンモン新聞：世界保健機関：コンゴでエボラ患者が900人以上と疑われる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5つすべてに該当する。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生であり、公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク、稀有なBundibugyo株の出現により、フルRRAに進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 900人以上の疑い患者、101人の確定患者、204人の死亡がDRC東部（ブニア周辺）で報告されている。Bundibugyo Ebola virus株はまれな系統で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がない。国境検問所での旅行者スクリーニング実施中。社会的・政治的関心および国際支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: OMS a ridicat alerta la nivelul maxim! "Epidemia de Ebola se propagă rapid!"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has raised the alert to the highest level! "The Ebola outbreak is spreading rapidly!"
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak prompts WHO to raise national risk to very high, regional risk high, global risk low. The epidemic is spreading in North Kivu and South Kivu, including Bukavu, amid clashes with M23 rebels; Ituri remains a focal area. 82 cases are lab-confirmed with seven deaths; about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths are under investigation. Uganda reports two confirmed cases and one death. Over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the DRC, with 101 confirmed. The outbreak is linked to Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine or approved treatment. Declared May 15; earlier figures show 204 deaths among 867 suspected across three provinces. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; response hampered by violence and insecurity.

triage.headline_ja: WHO が警戒水準を最高レベルに引き上げ！「エボラ流行が急速に拡大」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。DRC及びウガンダでのエボラ出血熱の確認事例、高い致死率、複数国への拡大、国際的な対応の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダでも2例の確認例と1例の死亡が報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC内での流行拡大である。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱。WHOが国レベルでの非常に高いリスク評価を発表、地域レベルでは高リスク、グローバルレベルでは低リスクと判定。武装勢力との衝突により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: 101 حالة مؤكدة و900 اشتباه بإصابات الإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: 101 confirmed cases and 900 suspected Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the World Health Organization reports an Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 900 suspected infections. Ituri, home to about 5 million people, is the outbreak’s epicenter amid ongoing conflict, with roughly one in four residents in need of humanitarian aid and about one in five internally displaced. Violence drives people, including health workers, to flee, hindering contact tracing, surveillance, and early diagnosis, and fuelling transmission and mistrust. WHO and partners maintain a presence across Ituri, including hard-to-reach areas, while communities face Ebola alongside other health needs such as maternal and child health services, treatment for acute malnutrition, mental health support, and assistance to Ebola survivors. Ongoing lab-confirmed and suspected cases indicate the outbreak remains active and challenging to control.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：101件の確認症例と900件のエボラ疑い感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模アウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを有する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も高リスクな感染症の一つ。DRC Ituri州における101件の確定症例と900件以上の疑い症例は極めて重大。武力紛争、大量の避難民、保健体制の脆弱性により、制御困難性が高い。WHO及びパートナー機関が対応中だが、国際的支援が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Число предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola infection cases exceeded 900.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring Uganda as of May 25, 2026, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. Response efforts are hampered by ongoing fighting between rebels and pro-government forces. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda had earlier been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Ebola spreads from wildlife to humans and between people. Early symptoms include fever, muscle spasms, headache, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver dysfunction and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding. Security constraints are a major obstacle to containment; the article provides no confirmed case or death counts beyond the stated 900+ suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染の疑い例が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラは極めて高い重症度と致死率を有する公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRC・ウガンダでの集団発生は国際的懸念事項。WHO Director-General による公式声明と PHEIC 宣言により、国際的な対応の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: Uganda（発生地域に含まれ、サマリーでも言及）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。DRC での Bundibugyo Ebola 系統の集団発生は既に PHEIC 宣言済みであり、900+ の疑い例、セキュリティ上の制約による対応の困難さが報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染および動物からのスピルオーバーが確認されており、流行性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo outbreak jump to more than 900
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, driven by the Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or virus-specific treatment. As of May 25, 2026, suspected cases have risen to 904, with reported Ebola deaths around 119 (regional tallies total 220, a discrepancy officials could not explain). WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern, and the risk of a national epidemic in the DRC is deemed very high. Ituri’s near-1 million displaced amid conflict compounds transmission risks in a fragile health system already short of PPE, testing kits, and burial materials. Attacks on treatment centers and insecurity hinder response; Ugandan authorities are enhancing contact tracing. Aid cuts last year aggravated shortages. Oxford University researchers are pursuing a vaccine, but WHO expects none for six to nine months.

triage.headline_ja: DR Congoのエボラ出血熱の疑い例が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的な公衆衛生上の重大事象。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言し、ウガンダへの波及リスクも高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれるが記事本文ではウガンダでの発生ではなく接触者追跡強化の記述のため、verified_locationsには含めない）。Bundibugyo strain、PHEIC宣言、ワクチン未開発、DRC国内の地域流行リスク非常に高い、紛争による100万人近い避難民が感染リスク増加要因。

article.articleHeadline: WHO reports 900 suspected Ebola cases, including 101 confirmed ones in Democratic Republic of Congo
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026 – The World Health Organization reports 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. A new wave of Ebola outbreaks has spread further in the DRC, the government said on Saturday. Bunia, the capital of Ituri province in eastern DRC, has suspended all passenger flights as part of containment efforts. On Friday, the WHO raised the public health risk level for the current outbreak from high to very high; however, the global risk remains low. The figures were communicated by WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus via social media on Sunday. The report underscores ongoing transmission within the DRC and highlights international concern despite the low global risk.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い患者900件（確定101件）を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900疑い患者、101確定患者）であり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死性と感染性を持つ。WHOが公衆衛生リスク警告レベルを「高」から「非常に高い」に引き上げている。航空便の運行停止など具体的な防疫措置が取られている。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: NCDC Places Emergency Centre On Alert, Warns Importation Risk High
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Nigeria’s NCDC intensified surveillance after Ebola outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, noting no confirmed Nigerian cases but high importation risk due to international travel and cross-border movement. The advisory issued May 24, 2026, targets border communities, major transport hubs, and international entry points for enhanced monitoring. Early Ebola symptoms can resemble malaria and Lassa fever, risking delayed detection; health workers and the public are urged to stay vigilant. The National Emergency Operations Centre is on alert, with the National Incident Management System activated and epidemiologists and Rapid Response Teams on standby. Preparedness includes isolation and treatment centres, bed-capacity assessments, logistics readiness, and prepositioned PPE, body bags, laboratory consumables, and other emergency supplies. Nigeria maintains Ebola testing capability at ports of entry with surge capacity if needed. Public awareness campaigns and Ebola myths and facts materials are being rolled out; context references the 2014 Lagos outbreak of 20 cases and 8 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：NCDC が緊急センターに警戒態勢を敷き、輸入リスクが高いと警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病、ラッサ熱、マラリアの複数疾患に関する多国的流行イベント。ウガンダ、DRCでの実際の流行、ナイジェリアでの高い輸入リスクと国家的な緊急対応態勢の活動化により、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性、国際拡大リスク）と社会的関心を満たし、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（対象国外）が主要な記事主題だが、DRCは対象国のため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダはGeoNames IDが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。複数疾患同時流行の可能性が指摘されており、診断の複雑性が管理可能性に影響。国家レベルの緊急対応態勢が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Scientifically Speaking: The evolving map of Cholera
article.articleSummary: Cholera has caused seven pandemics since 1817, with the seventh beginning in 1961 in Sulawesi and ongoing. The Ganga Delta’s Jessore region features among early outbreak sites; in 2023, WHO reported about 667,000 cases across five of six regions, and a spring 2022 Dhaka outbreak in Bangladesh led to over 42,000 hospitalizations. In 1896, Hankin observed river water downstream of cholera victims inhibiting the bacterium, stronger in the Ganga than the Yamuna, suggesting a chemical agent capable of passing through porcelain filters. Frederick Twort and Félix d’Hérelle later described bacteriophages—viruses that infect bacteria—whose rise accompanies outbreaks; mid-2000s data linked phage abundance to ending outbreaks, and milder dehydration correlates with higher phage-to-bacteria ratios. Two Nature studies add depth: (1) a cholera defense gene transfer in Bangladesh led to 91% of samples carrying a phage-resisting shield by 2021, but 2022 outbreaks saw phages falter until new variants emerged; (2) genomics reveal India more often seeds outbreaks, with Kolkata strains closer to North India than to Bangladesh, highlighting cross-border spread via rivers.

triage.headline_ja: 科学的に語る：コレラの進化する地図
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：2023年に5地域で約667,000例、国際的拡大リスク：インドとバングラデシュ間の越境拡大を示唆）。WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（異常性、重症度、流行リスク）。対象国複数での認証済み発生。
triage.notes: 記事は2023年WHO報告（5地域で約667,000例）および2022年ダッカアウトブレイク（42,000以上の入院）を言及。インドがコレラの発生源となることが多く、越境拡大（河川経由）を示唆する遺伝子解析結果を述べており、国際的リスク評価が必要。第7次パンデミック（1961年開始、現在も続行中）の一部として評価される。

article.articleHeadline: Visszatért a rettegett ebolavírus: minden, amit a járványról tudni lehet!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The dreaded Ebola virus has returned: everything you need to know about the outbreak!
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus has re-emerged with an outbreak centered in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, specifically Ituri Province. The disease was first identified in May, though officials have not stated the exact outbreak start date. The focus includes a large displaced population due to ongoing conflict and numerous migrant workers drawn to the region's gold mines. The United States has imposed strict travel restrictions related to African countries amid the outbreak. The World Health Organization notes that regional population movement heightens the risk of further transmission. The article does not provide confirmed case or death counts, nor laboratory confirmation details, and it does not specify the exact infection source or any confirmed imported/exported cases. Ongoing containment and public health measures are implied by travel restrictions and the global concern.

triage.headline_ja: 恐れられていたエボラウイルスが再出現：アウトブレイクについて知っておくべきすべてのこと！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの再出現は公衆衛生への深刻な脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクが高く、旅行制限が既に実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月25日配信で、DRC北東部イトゥリ州でのエボラアウトブレイクについて報道。紛争による国内避難民と金鉱採掘作業者の大規模な移動人口が感染拡大リスクを高めている。米国が旅行制限を実施済み。WHOが地域内の人口移動が伝播リスクを増加させることを指摘している。ただし、確認症例数・死亡数、実験室確認の詳細、確定的な感染源、確認された輸入感染例は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola ở CHDC Congo diễn biến phức tạp, hơn 900 ca nghi nhiễm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo develops in a complex manner, with more than 900 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo escalates, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed infections, centered in Ituri province in eastern DRC. The virus is Bundibugyo strain, for which no vaccine or approved targeted treatment exists. The World Health Organization warns the national-scale risk is very high as cases rise rapidly; officials fear silent transmission for about two months before formal detection on May 15. The outbreak has spread beyond Ituri to Nam Kivu, including a confirmed case in Nam Kivu who had traveled from Kisangani before death. Uganda reports additional infections linked to the Congo outbreak. Response efforts face armed conflict, shortages of PPE, medicine, transport, and community mistrust; some Ebola treatment centers have been attacked. WHO continues coordinating with the DRC government and partners to strengthen surveillance, contact tracing, and border controls to limit cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染症の流行が複雑に進展、900人以上の疑似症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大リスク、高い死亡率、ワクチン未承認株、複数国での確認により、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダも記載されているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは「関連感染」（DRC由来）として言及されており、主要な発生地はDRCのイトゥリ州およびナム・キブ州。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。本イベントはBundibugyo株という治療法・ワクチン未承認株による大規模流行であり、武装紛争による対応阻害、越境拡大リスク、高い死亡率が懸念される。WHO警告による国家規模リスク評価が「非常に高い」とされている。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: رصد أكثر من 900 إصابة مشتبه بها بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Dr Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced on social media that intensified Ebola surveillance in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has detected more than 900 suspected cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The WHO has not updated the total deaths, but says the outbreak poses a very high risk within the DRC, while global risk remains low. Congolese authorities report 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths, with earlier figures showing over 700 suspected cases and more than 170 suspected deaths, predominantly in Ituri province, the outbreak's main focus. The article notes ongoing monitoring, laboratory confirmation, and potential for imported/exported cases, though no specifics on international spread are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い患者900人以上を検出
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模疑い患者集団（900人以上、確認患者101人）がDRCで検出され、IHR基準3項目に該当。WHOが高リスク評価を発表しており、国際的な懸念も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と感染力を持つ一類感染症。DRCのイトゥリ州を主要な発生地とする大規模疫学について、WHOが公式に発表している。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。記事では国際的拡散リスクが低いと述べられているが、輸入/輸出ケースの可能性が言及されており、国際的懸念は高い。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ alarm verip risk seviyesini "Çok Yüksek"e çıkardı! Ölümcül virüs kontrolden çıktı
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO sounded the alarm and raised the risk level to 'Very High'! The deadly virus got out of control.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-25, the WHO raised the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to a Very High global risk, as infections surge in Ituri and North Kivu in the eastern country. The crisis is intensified by conflict, a collapsing health system, misinformation, and about 2 million people displaced. WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed; at least 177 deaths are estimated. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for this specific Ebola variant. The outbreak’s high transmission is driven by cultural funeral practices and direct contact with the deceased, complicating containment. In Ituri’s Bunia, protests and hospital tensions led to arson of two tents after families tried to retrieve bodies from Rwampara Hospital; authorities restricted gatherings and banned mourning tents. Doctors urge radical measures: avoid touching suspected patients, cease hugging, and avoid contact with dead animals.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告を発し、リスクレベルを「非常に高い」に引き上げた！致命的なウイルスが制御不能になった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で900件以上の疑い例、177人以上の死亡が報告され、WHOが全球的リスクを「非常に高い」に評価。国際的な懸念と支援必要性が明確。
triage.notes: WHOが全球リスクを『Very High』に公式認定。ワクチン・治療法未確認の特定エボラ変異体。紛争、医療体制崩壊、約200万人の避難民が複雑化要因。コンゴ東部イトゥリ・北キブ地域で急速に感染拡大中。文化的な埋葬慣行と死体との直接接触が高い伝播を引き起こしており、抑制が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Một dịch bệnh đã khiến hơn 500 trẻ tử vong ở Bangladesh đang bị bỏ quên?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A disease that has killed more than 500 children in Bangladesh is being neglected?
article.articleSummary: Bangladesh faces a devastating measles outbreak since mid-March, with over 60,000 suspected cases and 528 deaths, mostly children under five, straining hospitals and highlighting systemic gaps. By early April, WHO was alerted to a rapid rise, with nearly 20,000 suspected cases across 58 of 64 districts and more than 150 deaths; daily fatalities fluctuated, including 17 on May 4. This is the largest outbreak in decades, with overcrowding and high out-of-pocket costs for families. The government launched a large-scale measles vaccination campaign on April 5, targeting about 18 million children, plus efforts to identify missed children, establish hospital isolation wards, and provide vitamin A. Some parents and experts advocate school closures and a public-health emergency. Health authorities caution that improvements may take weeks. Separately, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola suspected cases exceed 900, with 101 confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: バングラデシュで500人以上の子どもが死亡した感染症が忘れられている？
triage.triage_reason: 麻しん大流行による多数の死亡（528人、過去数十年で最大規模）、複数の疾患（麻しんとエボラ）の同時発生報告、国際的な懸念（WHO通知済み）、および社会的・政治的関心の高さが複数のIHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事見出しと要旨より、主要な発生地はバングラデシュ（60,000以上の疑似症例、528人死亡、過去数十年で最大規模の麻しん流行）。WHOは既に早期4月に通知を受けている。記事では別にコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑似症例900人以上、確認症例101人について言及されている。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。ただし、Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはDRCと Bangladesh が列挙されており、DRC（203312）は対象国リストに含まれるが、記事の主題はバングラデシュの麻しん流行であり、エボラについては補足的言及に過ぎない。したがってDRCも verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak grows to 900 suspected cases - WHO  --  RT Africa
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has grown to about 900 suspected cases with 101 confirmed infections, WHO reports. Kinshasa declared the epidemic on May 15; two days later the Bundibugyo strain detected in DR Congo and Uganda was designated a public health emergency of international concern, but not a pandemic. Violence and mass displacement in Ituri province—the epicenter—complicate containment, with nearly 5 million affected and substantial humanitarian need. WHO notes contact tracing and early detection are severely hindered as response teams work in insecure, hard-to-reach areas. Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain identified in 2007 and likely carried by fruit bats, has no approved vaccine. British researchers are fast-tracking an experimental vaccine, with trials possible within months but unknown effectiveness. WHO has raised domestic risk to very high; international risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の患者数が900人に増加 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱(Bundibugyo株)の発生は、WHOにより国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されており、深刻な影響、予想外の展開、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクすべてが存在する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでもBundibugyo株が検出されたと言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが実際の流行の主体であり、WHOによる国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、フルリスク評価(RRA)への進行が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS aumenta a más de 900 casos sospechosos y más de 100 muertos los afectados por el brote de ébola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO raises the number to over 900 suspected cases and over 100 deaths among those affected by the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases and over 100 confirmed with 119 deaths under suspicion have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, corroborating local authorities’ figures. The Ituri Province is the outbreak epicenter, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, noted as rare with no approved vaccines or antibody therapies. Authorities indicate the virus may have circulated undetected for months before recognition. The U.S. CDC Africa agency cites higher deaths under suspicion—204—across the DRC and Uganda, though Uganda is less affected. Ongoing conflict in Ituri compounds the crisis: nearly five million residents, about one in four in need of humanitarian aid, and one in five displaced. Violence hampers contact tracing and public trust, underscoring the need for a comprehensive health services package to strengthen Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行で疑い患者900人以上、死亡者100人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo株で予防法なし、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当（異常/稀な株、重症度高・死亡率高、紛争による継続的曝露リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染性高、管理能力限定）。国際支援の必要性も明確。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaは稀な株で、承認されたワクチンや抗体療法がない。イツリ州での紛争により接触者追跡と公衆衛生対応が著しく阻害されている。ウガンダでも確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、DRCのみを検証位置に含める。

article.articleHeadline: लौट आया वो खतरनाक वायरस, 11000 लोगों की ली थी जान, फिर आए 101 पॉजिटिव केस
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: That dangerous virus has returned, having claimed the lives of 11,000 people, and 101 positive cases were reported.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola has caused about 11,000 deaths and 101 laboratory-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with over 900 suspected infections. The outbreak concentrates in Ituri Province, a ~5 million-strong population, where ongoing violence and insecurity hinder health workers, delay case finding, and complicate contact tracing. WHO warns that continued conflict undermines health responses and trust in aid agencies. On May 16, the DRC–Uganda Ebola outbreak was declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; on May 22, the WHO raised the national risk level in DRC to very high. Ebola spills over from wildlife—bats and some non-human primates—into humans, then transmits via blood, body fluids, or contaminated objects. The 2014–2016 outbreak killed over 11,000 people and had more than 28,000 suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: その危険なウイルスが戻ってきた。11,000人の命を奪い、101人の陽性例が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生への影響（101確定例、900疑い例、11,000人の死亡歴）、異常/予想外（再出現）、国際的拡大リスク（DRC-ウガンダ国際関心事項宣言）の3基準に該当。WPRO基準でも重症度が極めて高く、国際支援が必要とされている。PHEICとWHOのリスク引き上げにより社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の国際関心事項宣言（PHEIC）は2026年5月16日。DRC内Ituri州が主要流行地。ウガンダはBluedot発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの実際の流行の詳細が明記されていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ該当。情報は非常に充実しており、IHR・WPROs基準両方で極めて強いシグナル。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Gates Foundation commits $15m to combat Ebola outbreak in DRC, Uganda - Healthwise
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts a $15 million emergency funding from the Gates Foundation to bolster regional coordination, rapid deployment, surveillance, diagnostics, and frontline operations via Africa CDC and WHO partners. Funding breakdown: $5 million to Africa CDC for cross-border surveillance and regional coordination; $5 million to WHO Regional Office for Africa for frontline operations; $5 million to WHO for emergency procurement, diagnostics, and logistics. WHO declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern amid spread of a rare Bundibugyo strain with no approved vaccine or treatment. Reports indicate more than 390 suspected cases and at least 100 deaths; Nigeria has no confirmed cases per the NCDC. Emphasis on rapid detection, health worker protection, and coordinated action under the Joint Emergency Action Plan between Africa CDC and WHO AFRO. As of 25 May 2026, ongoing regional coordination is prioritized.

triage.headline_ja: ゲイツ財団、DRCとウガンダのエボラ出血熱流行対策に1,500万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱の国際的PHEICに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目（重症度、長期曝露、流行易感性、管理可能性）に該当し、高い社会・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのBundibugyo株エボラ出血熱流行について述べられているが、対象国リストではDRC（GeoNames ID 203312）のみに該当するため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国外のため除外。ナイジェリアは確認症例なしと記載。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、100人以上の死亡、ワクチン・治療法なしの希少株という点で極めて重大。

article.articleHeadline: Криза в Конго: кількість підозрюваних випадків Еболи перевищила 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Crisis in Congo: the number of suspected Ebola cases has exceeded 900.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is in the grip of an Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine exists. The epidemiological situation has reached high risk, with 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths reported, concentrated in Ituri Province near Bunia, where medical systems are overwhelmed and staff are fleeing. Despite the WHO assessing a low global spillover risk, internal conditions are dire, especially in refugee camps around Bunia. Widespread distrust of international aid, attacks on health facilities, and burial-practice restrictions have hampered response. Authorities have banned gatherings over 50 people and mandated military/police protection for humanitarian activities at cemeteries. Ongoing conflict between rebel groups and government forces leaves portions of territory outside official control, undermining surveillance. Western funding reductions further strain the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの危機：エボラ疑い患者数が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラアウトブレイク、900例以上の疑い患者、119名の死亡、医療システムの崩壊、国際対応能力の低下が確認され、フルRRAを実施する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチンが未承認の危険な株系統。医療施設への攻撃、国際援助への不信、埋葬慣行の制限、反政府勢力による領土支配など、対応を阻害する要因が複数存在。WHO の低い世界的拡大リスク評価に反して、地域的状況は極めて深刻。西側資金削減による対応能力の低下も懸念要因。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: ارتفاع إصابات فيروس الايبولا لـ101 حالة مؤكدة و900 مشتبه بها - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Ebola virus infections rise to 101 confirmed cases and 900 suspected - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, Ebola virus disease infections have risen to 101 confirmed cases and about 900 suspected cases, per WHO. Ituri, hosting nearly 5 million people amid ongoing conflict, faces severe humanitarian needs: about one in four residents require aid and one in five are internally displaced. Violence is driving people, including health and humanitarian workers, to flee, severely hampering Ebola contact tracing and early infection detection necessary for supportive care. WHO and partners remain deployed across Ituri, including the most insecure and hard-to-reach areas. Beyond Ebola, communities face maternal, newborn and child health, acute malnutrition with complications, mental health, wound care, support for survivors of sexual violence, provision of medical supplies, routine vaccination, and community health services. Delivering a comprehensive health package is essential to meet urgent needs and build trust for the response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：エボラウイルス感染者数が101例（確認例）と900例（疑い例）に増加 - ザ・セブンス・デイ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラウイルスのアウトブレイクは高優先度シグナルである。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最重大な感染症脅威の一つ。イトゥリ州での101例の確認例と900例の疑い例、約500万人の人口、進行中の紛争、医療従事者の逃亡、接触者追跡の困難さなど、複数の悪化要因が存在。WHOおよびパートナーが既に対応を展開中。国際的支援と監視が緊急に必要。

article.articleHeadline: Risques de propagation, nouvelle souche: tout comprendre à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread risks, new strain: everything you need to know about the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, Mongbwalu) and neighboring Uganda is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global risk remains low. Key concerns include delayed detection, frontline health worker deaths, intensive cross-border movement, and the rarity of this strain. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces; incubation is 2–21 days and patients are usually not contagious until symptoms appear. Uganda has confirmed two cases: one patient from DRC who died after treatment in Uganda, and a second case imported from DRC. In DRC, the first confirmed case (April 24) was a healthcare worker in Mongbwalu; initial Zaïre test was negative; Bundibugyo later confirmed after Kinshasa analyses. Alert raised May 5; field teams deployed May 12. Funeral rites contributed to early spread.

triage.headline_ja: 感染拡大のリスク、新株：エボラ出血熱の流行について知っておくべきすべてのこと
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な流行で、WHO Public Health Emergency of International Concern（PHEIC）が宣言され、DRCとウガンダで確認された。IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行性、長期曝露）するため、フルリスク評価（RRA）対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。WHOがPHEIC宣言を行い、Bundibugyo株という治療法・ワクチンがない株での流行、複数国での確認、医療従事者の死亡、国境越境移動などが報告されており、リスク評価の優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Znanstvenici su otkrili odakle je krenula epidemija ebole? Isto se dogodilo prije 10 godina, umrlo je 11.000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have discovered where the Ebola outbreak started? The same thing happened 10 years ago; 11,000 people died.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with more than 170 deaths and 750 suspected cases. Three Red Cross volunteers died in DRC, likely from Ebola, after contracting the virus March 27 while working on a non‑epidemic project in Ituri; a nurse in Ituri died April 20. Cases are also in North and South Kivu; Uganda has five infections after three new cases. On Friday, WHO raised national risk to very high (regional high, global low); the agency had already declared an international health emergency for DR Congo and Uganda on May 17. Africa CDC warns ten more countries at risk: Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. Bundibugyo, identified in 2007 in Uganda, has a 30–50% fatality rate; there is no vaccine or effective therapy; fruit bats are reservoirs. The 2014–2016 outbreak killed about 11,300.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者がエボラ出血熱の流行の発生源を発見 10年前に同じことが起きた。当時は11,000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱による170人以上の死亡、複数国での確認、国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み、高い致死率（30-50%）により重大な公衆衛生上の影響あり。
triage.notes: DRCが主要な発生地域（Ituri及びKivu州）。ザンビアはアフリカCDC警告対象10ヶ国に含まれている。ウガンダについても確認例5件が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOは2026年5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola may have killed over 200 people in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo has killed over 200 people so far, 210 suspected deaths as of May 23, and over 900 suspected cases across 11 health zones in three provinces, centered in Ituri on the Ugandan border. Violence, mistrust and overwhelmed surveillance hinder containment, with health workers able to follow up only about 20% of identified contacts in a day. Attacks on treatment centers and unrest, including a hospital storm in Mongbwalu and tents burned in Ituri, disrupt response. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or antibody treatments. The WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Uganda has five confirmed cases linked to the outbreak. American infected was evacuated to Germany; high-risk contacts were moved to Germany and the Czech Republic. Ten African countries are at risk due to cross-border transmission and mobility.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが200人以上を殺害した可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で200人以上の死亡、国際的拡大（ウガンダ確認例、欧州への輸入例）、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR附属書2の対象疾患。記事サマリーでウガンダの確認例、アメリカ感染者のドイツ搬送、高リスク接触者のドイツ・チェコ共和国への移動が言及されているが、これらは二次的な国際的広がりであり、主要な発生地はDRC（Ituri州）。ウガンダは地域的な関連があるが、記事の主題はDRCの流行。Bundibugyo型で承認されたワクチンなし、対応が困難な状況下での大規模流行という極度のリスク。

article.articleHeadline: Над 900 случаи на ебола во Конго - 24info.mk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 900 Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Congo reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases: 904 suspected, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The ministry revised probable deaths to 119, down from 204, with 10 Ebola deaths confirmed by lab tests. The outbreak remains active in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. Five confirmed cases have been reported in neighboring Uganda linked to the eastern Congo outbreak; Uganda did not publish data on suspected cases. The World Health Organization warns the true case count is likely higher, noting weeks of underreporting and ongoing investigations of unexplained deaths. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola is highly transmissible through close contact with bodily fluids, not via respiratory droplets.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱が900例以上に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は高い死亡率、複数国での確認例、国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に追加しない。DRCでの発生が主要な懸念。Bundibugyo株でのワクチン・特異的治療なし、週単位の過小報告の可能性、WHOによる注視あり。複数省での広がり確認。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola: 204 décès recensés sur 867 cas suspects
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: 204 deaths recorded out of 867 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reports 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces (as of May 25, 2026). Previously, WHO logged 177 deaths from 750 suspected cases. The outbreak is caused by Ebola virus species Bundibugyo; there is currently no vaccine or specific treatment, with case fatality up to 50%. WHO raised the national risk to “very high” due to rapid spread and a likely broader reach than confirmed cases. WHO has deployed 22 international experts and released $3.9 million in emergency funds; the UN has pledged $60 million to accelerate response in DRC and the region. Health ministers of Uganda, DRC and South Sudan adopted a cross-border action plan in Kampala to coordinate the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ: 867件の疑い患者のうち204人の死亡が記録されている
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多数死亡（204人）が報告され、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的な広がりのリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。WHO が国家リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げており、国際的な支援体制が既に構築されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス Bundibugyo 種によるアウトブレイク。現在ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がなく、致死率は最大 50%。WHO が 22 名の国際専門家を派遣し、390 万ドルの緊急資金を拠出。ウガンダ、DRC、南スーダンの保健大臣がカンパラで国境を越えた行動計画を採択。記事では発生地域として Uganda、Sudan が記載されているが、サマリーではこれらの国での発生そのものは報告されておらず、調整活動と被害の可能性のみ記載されているため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo - Ärztin Dörnemann: Ebola-Ausbruch durch falsche Testung und Probleme im Gesundheitssystem
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo — Dr. Dörnemann: Ebola outbreak caused by faulty testing and problems in the healthcare system.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo may be longer-standing, according to pediatrician Dr. Jenny Dörnemann of University Hospital Dresden. She told Deutschlandfunk that inadequate on-site testing may have allowed undetected spread, and that early suspicion of Ebola did not specifically target the Bundibugyo strain, potentially yielding false-negative results. Ongoing diagnostic challenges are compounded by armed conflict in the region, limiting access to health facilities. Fear keeps many people from seeking care, further hindering surveillance and outbreak control. Bundibugyo-type Ebola is highlighted as the circulating strain. The article emphasizes laboratory confirmation gaps and the impact of weakened healthcare infrastructure on detection and response as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 — ドルネマン医師：エボラ流行は不正確な検査と医療制度の問題が原因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目が該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当し、対象国DRCでの確認事例であるため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の継続的な流行。診断困難、不正確な検査、武装紛争による医療アクセス障害、サーベイランス機能の低下が報告されている。ドイツ人医師の見解として国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Screening Begins at Pune Airport Amid Global Outbreak Alert
article.articleSummary: Ebola screening began at Pune International Airport, Maharashtra, amid a fresh central Africa outbreak alert. Screening started Friday for passengers arriving from or transiting through high-risk countries; Pune has no direct flights from Ebola-affected countries, though connecting routes require surveillance. Information, education and communication activities have been launched for airport staff and travelers. Passengers with symptoms or relevant travel history are identified for further medical analysis. So far, 23 travellers with links to affected countries have been tracked in Maharashtra—1 in Pune and 22 in Mumbai—and all tests have been negative. Monitoring targets Democratic Republic of Congo, Uganda and South Sudan, via the metropolitan surveillance unit. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids; early detection and isolation are crucial to prevent transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱スクリーニングがプネ空港で開始、世界的アウトブレイクアラートの中
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク警報に対応した国際的なスクリーニング開始。IHR基準で異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限のリスク該当。対象国インドで能動的なスクリーニング体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで報告されたDRC、Uganda、South Sudanはアウトブレイク発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。インドはプネ・ムンバイで能動的スクリーニング体制を展開中であり、接触者追跡（23名追跡、全検査陰性）が行われている。中央アフリカでのエボラ流行を受けた国際的な対応イベントとして評価。

article.articleHeadline: Аларм од СЗО: Смртоносната ебола се шири - стотици жртви!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm from WHO: The deadly Ebola is spreading — hundreds of victims!
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Suspected cases exceed 900, with more than 200 deaths reported. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or proven treatment. The case fatality rate is around 50%, though some historical strains have reached 90%. Local authorities declared the outbreak in mid-May and activated additional health measures, but challenges persist due to limited resources and the risk of spread to other regions. The international community is monitoring closely, and rapid, coordinated response is deemed crucial to prevent a larger health crisis.

triage.headline_ja: WHO警告：致命的なエボラが拡大—数百人の犠牲者！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響・予想外性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式の国際保健緊急事態宣言、高い死亡率、国際的懸念が明確に示されている。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC（国際保健緊急事態）が公式に宣言されている。疑い例900件超、死亡200人超、致死率約50%。ワクチンなし、治療法なし。地域資源の制限と他地域への拡大リスクが懸念される。即座のフル Risk Assessment（RRA）が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Minister Muraleedharan Warns Action in Sabarimala Gold Case, Updates on Ebola Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kerala Devaswoms Minister K Muraleedharan said SIT findings on the Sabarimala gold loss case will guide action and that no culprit will be spared, irrespective of party. On Ebola, there are no cases in India, with screening at airports and seaports being expanded and plans to cover major railway stations in Kerala. Isolation wards operate at Government medical colleges in Thiruvananthapuram, Kochi, Kozhikode and Kannur; travellers from abroad should seek care for fever, cough or blood-tinged diarrhoea. Bundibugyo Ebola virus (BDBV) is cited: infection can begin with mild symptoms in days 1–2, worsen by day 4, and death may follow around day 12; there is no widely approved vaccine or specific treatment. Transmission occurs from wild animals and via contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated surfaces. Kerala will boost doctors and add a second medical college in Thiruvananthapuram and a new one at Haripad (Alappuzha).

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州大臣ムラリーダラン、サバリマラ金事件の行動を警告、エボラ対策の最新情報
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラ確定例はなく、準備段階（予防的スクリーニング・準備）の報道。ただしBDBV（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）言及と国家レベルの対応構築があり、今後の展開を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はサバリマラ金事件が主要報道でエボラは副次的内容。インドでは現在エボラ確定例なし。ただしケーラ州における空港・港湾・鉄道駅でのスクリーニング拡大、複数医療機関での隔離病棟設置、医療体制強化計画が進行中。BDBV言及により流行リスク認識あり。確定例発生時は即座にPICKUPへ昇格する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă internațională: o tulpină rară de Ebola se răspândește necontrolat, iar experții se tem de o pandemie severă
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International alert: a rare strain of Ebola is spreading uncontrollably, and experts fear a severe pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak confirmed in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda in May 2026, prompting WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The Bundibugyo strain, rarer than other Ebola types, has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. As of May 24, 2026, Congo’s Ituri, Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu provinces reported cases, with Uganda’s Kampala accounting for five linked to Congo. ECDC on May 22 cited >650 suspected cases and ~160 deaths in Congo, with 64 confirmed; Reuters noted >900 suspected and 101 confirmed. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood, secretions or fluids; risk is higher for caregivers, unprotected healthcare workers, and funeral attendees. Response emphasizes rapid detection, isolation, PPE, contact tracing, and community engagement; vaccination strategies for Bundibugyo remain unproven. EU risk is very low but monitoring continues; CDC has health alerts and traveler screening (Dulles, then Atlanta). Incubation up to 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: 国際警報：エボラの稀な株が制御不能に拡大、専門家が深刻なパンデミックを懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、ブンディブギョ型エボラの新興アウトブレイク（650以上の疑い例、160人以上の死亡）がDRC・ウガンダで報告されており、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した米国内の複数地点（アトランタ、ダレス等）はスクリーニング拠点であり、実際のエボラ発生地ではない。記事サマリーに基づき、DRCのイトゥリ州、ノールキブ州、スキブ州およびウガンダのカンパラで確定されたアウトブレイクが主題である。WHO声明あり。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法なし。

article.articleHeadline: Zweithöchste Alarmstufe: WHO zählt mehr als 900 Ebola-Verdachtsfälle im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second-highest alert level: WHO counts more than 900 Ebola suspected cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province continues, with WHO reporting over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections; the DRC health ministry cites 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases as of the latest update. The outbreak began on May 15 in a conflict-affected area, and the virus may have circulated undetected for months. Transmission is via direct contact with bodily fluids, incubation up to three weeks, and the current Bundibugyo variant has no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy. Response is hampered by insecurity, mistrust, and misinformation, including demonstrations that burned treatment tents amid safe-burial disputes. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), the second-highest alert level; Africa CDC warns of regional risk, with Uganda reporting cases.

triage.headline_ja: 第2最高警戒レベル：WHO、コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHO によるPHEIC宣言、200件以上の死亡、複数国への拡大リスク、ワクチン未承認ウイルス株、地域的な治安悪化による対応困難。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）で、ウガンダも症例報告されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRCの大規模アウトブレイク。PHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo株（ワクチン未承認）、死亡例204件、200以上の疑い例。治安悪化と地域社会の不信が対応を阻害。地域的な国境を越えた拡大リスク明確。

article.articleHeadline: За неделю втрое увеличилось количество предполагаемых случаев эболы в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over the past week, the number of suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has tripled.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a surge in suspected Ebola virus disease cases, with numbers tripling over the past week in Ituri Province. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus called the situation deeply troubling. In Rwampara, Ituri, tents and medical supplies were set ablaze near a hospital as clinicians attempted to establish an Ebola treatment center. The crowd protested after being denied permission to retrieve the body of a local resident who died in hospital. Bodies of those who die from Ebola must be buried under strict infection-control protocols to prevent further spread. Authorities are pursuing case confirmation, monitoring, and containment measures, while engaging communities to address fears and improve adherence to burial and infection-control practices.

triage.headline_ja: 過去1週間でコンゴの疑い患者数が3倍に増加—エボラの急増
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは最高レベルの感染症であり、DRCでの症例の急速な増加は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクを示唆。WHO事務局長が懸念を表明し、社会政治的関心も高い。IHR基準3つ以上該当、WPRO基準全て該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域にRwanda（ルワンダ）も含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（イツリ州）の症例急増であり、ルワンダでの発生は記載されていない。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。エボラの1週間での3倍増加は緊急の公衆衛生対応を要するシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الاشتباه بأكثر من 900 حالة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 25 May 2026, with 101 confirmed infections. Health authorities have intensified screening at the Modjibala checkpoint near Bunia, focusing on travelers from the Mongbwalo mining town believed to be the outbreak’s focal point. Ebola is a deadly viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with body fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The outbreak began on 15 May 2026 and is linked to the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. A prior update reported 204 deaths across three provinces among 867 suspected cases. Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa over the past half-century.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い症例900件以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例101件、疑い症例900件以上という深刻な公衆衛生影響、出血熱による高い致死性（過去半世紀でアフリカで15,000人以上の死亡）、国際的な感染拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確に認識される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラによる発生。ワクチン・治療法未承認の懸念あり。Bunia近郊Modjibala検問所でスクリーニング強化中。2026年5月15日発症開始。初期報告では867疑い症例204死亡。
