article.articleHeadline: Ölümcül virüste korkulan oldu: 900'den fazla vaka var! Cenazeler defnedilemiyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What was feared has come true with the deadly virus: over 900 cases! Funerals can't be held.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has escalated, with 904 suspected cases and 119 deaths reported. The epicenters are Ituri and North Kivu, including near Bunia, where violence has undermined health services. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain currently has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO classifies Congo risk as 'very high.' To stop transmission, authorities banned traditional funeral rites and gatherings of more than 50 people; funerals are now conducted under strict medical protocols with security forces guarding burials. Two Ebola treatment centers in Ituri and North Kivu were set afire by youths and militias; a Rwampara facility was attacked, heightening panic. Aid groups report staff fleeing; PPE and testing kits are scarce as Western donor aid cuts persist. The region hosts about 1 million displaced people near refugee camps, amid clashes with M23 and ADF-aligned forces.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的ウイルスで懸念が現実に：900例以上の症例！遺体を埋葬できない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが認識されている。WPROスクリーニング基準でも高い重症度、管理困難性が明確。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的に最重要監視対象。DRCのキブ地域での流行は2018-2020年の大規模流行との関連性も考慮が必要。ルワンダ国内での確認情報も注視。暴力的情勢下での健康危機、医療崩壊の兆候、地域の脆弱性が深刻な懸念。WHO『非常に高いリスク』評価の公式表明を確認。

article.articleHeadline: 치사율 최고 90% '죽음의 바이러스' 에볼라의 귀환... 안전지대는 없다
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case fatality rate as high as 90%: Ebola returns, the 'virus of death'... There is no safe haven.
article.articleSummary: Ebola reemerges as an international threat: WHO on May 17 declared a public health emergency of international concern for Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. As of May 24, DRC suspects total 904 with 101 confirmed and 119 deaths; Uganda has 5 confirmed cases and 1 death. The 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak infected more than 28,000 and killed about 11,300, but this wave is not yet that large; WHO rates the DRC situation as very high risk. Bundibugyo Ebola has no approved vaccine or therapy currently; experimental options are under review. Transmission is not airborne but occurs via contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids; PPE shortages, unsafe burials, and attacks on treatment centers hinder containment. Natural hosts include fruit bats, with primates possibly acting as intermediate hosts; deforestation increases spillover risk. Cross-border spread prompts US airport screening and travel advisories in India.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率最高90% '死の病ウイルス' エボラの復活...安全地帯はない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の国際的脅威、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言したBundibugyo ebolavirus の集団発生であり、DRCとウガンダで確認され、複数国での空港スクリーニング実施中。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus のアウトブレイクで、DRCで904疑い例（確認101例、死亡119例）、ウガンダで確認5例・死亡1例。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。米国での空港スクリーニング実施、インドでの渡航勧告発出。ワクチン・治療法なし。越境感染のリスク高い。対象国の中でDRCとインドが実際の発生地域として特定される。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors warn Nigerians in Lagos, Abuja to stop eating bush meat as Ebola kills 80 in DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola drives the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri Province, with 246 suspected cases and at least 80 deaths; two confirmed cases have emerged in Kampala, Uganda, linked to travel from DRC. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 16 May 2026. This outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC since 1976, with response slowed by armed conflict and mass displacement in eastern DRC, enabling cross-border spread. Nigeria reports zero confirmed Ebola cases but has activated surveillance at ports of entry and is coordinating with Port Health Services; Lagos endured a 2014 outbreak triggered by a traveler that killed eight Nigerians. Bush meat consumption is discouraged, as bats and non-human primates are reservoirs. Handwashing, avoiding contact with the sick’s bodily fluids, and prompt reporting of unusual illness are advised. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugjo strain.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアの医師がラゴスとアブハジャの住民に、エボラが「コンゴ民主共和国で80人を殺害」するなか、ブッシュミート（野生動物肉）の摂取を止めるよう警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で確認患者・死亡あり。ナイジェリアは監視強化中。
triage.notes: Bluedotデータにはナイジェリアとウガンダも含まれるが、記事サマリーでは主要な確認患者・死亡はDRCで発生。ウガンダは2確認患者（旅行関連）のみ。ナイジェリアは確認患者ゼロで警告段階。評価の厳密性に基づきDRCのみを検証済み地域として列挙。WHO PHEIC（2026年5月16日）宣言済み。Bundibugyo株。武力紛争と大量避難が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: 今年首例本土登革熱在高雄！疫調隱瞞足跡  高市衛生局重罰18萬 | 社會 | Newtalk新聞
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case in Kaohsiung! Epidemiological investigation concealed traces; Kaohsiung City Health Bureau imposes NT$180,000 fine.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City reports the year's first locally transmitted dengue fever case, and the nationwide first domestically transmitted dengue case this year. A 66-year-old man from Qianzhen District presented with fever (38.7°C), headache and myalgia; dengue NS1 rapid test and PCR were positive for Dengue virus serotype 1. He initially refused to disclose travel history, later admitting visits to Renwu, Dashu, Xinxing, and Lingya districts and Pingtung County, severely hindering source tracing. The Health Bureau fined him NT$180,000 under the Infectious Disease Prevention Act (Articles 43(2) and 67(1)(3)). An inter-agency outbreak response was activated; vector-control and sanitation measures around his residence and workplace have been carried out, with about 120 people tested in the footprint of his activities. The surrounding area showed dirty spots and standing water, prompting residents to follow巡、倒、清、刷 to eliminate breeding sources and curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 今年初の高雄市における本土感染デング熱！疫学調査で足跡が隠蔽される 高雄市衛生局が18万台湾ドルの重罰を課す
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での2026年初の本土感染デング熱事例であり、患者の行動把握の困難さ、約120人の接触者追跡、ベクター対策が実施されている。公衆衛生上の影響が明確で、当該地域での流行リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはTaiwan（1668284）とChina（1814991）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは台湾・高雄市における本土デング熱事例を報告している。ただし、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に台湾は含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。China（江蘇省の言及もあるが、記事の主題は台湾の事例）は記事の主題の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Lagos activates Ebola surveillance as Sanwo-Olu orders heightened vigilance
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Lagos activated heightened Ebola surveillance with intensified airport and border screening and emergency response, while stressing no confirmed or suspected Ebola case in the state. The Ebola outbreak in Central and East Africa has caused about 177 deaths from nearly 700 suspected cases, with transmission largely in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda; the WHO classifies the situation as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Lagos has strengthened biosecurity, the Lagos Biosecurity Bio-shield, and the State Incident Command System led by Governor Sanwo-Olu, with the Emergency Operations Centre. Infectious Disease Hospital, Yaba, maintains BSL-3 lab, triage, isolation and ICU readiness; port health collaboration at Murtala Muhammed Airport and other entry points has been enhanced. Flights from Central and East Africa undergo enhanced screening. Residents with travel to affected areas or contacts are urged to seek care; emergency contacts: 767, 112, and 08023169485.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴスがエボラ監視を開始、サンウォル知事が警戒態勢強化を指示
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）で、中央アフリカおよび東アフリカで177人の死亡を含む約700人の疑い患者が報告されており、IHR基準の重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスクを満たす。ナイジェリア（ラゴス）での監視体制強化は地域的社会政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、エボラ感染の主要な発生地はDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）およびウガンダであり、ナイジェリア（ラゴス）では確定例または疑い例が報告されていない。対象国リストに基づき、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHOが PHEIC 分類、死亡数177、疑い患者約700という重大な規模、複数国での伝播、国際的スクリーニング強化など、全 IHR 基準および WPRO 基準を満たす高優先度シグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Над 900 сомнителни случаи на ебола регистрирани во ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases registered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been registered in DR Congo as of May 25, 2026. Since the outbreak began, 904 suspected cases have been identified, with 101 laboratory-confirmed; suspected deaths revised to 119 (down from 204), while lab-confirmed deaths remain 10. The outbreak persists in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. WHO Director Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus wrote that over 900 suspected cases have been identified, 101 confirmed. Five confirmed cases are reported in Uganda linked to the eastern DRC outbreak, while Uganda does not publish suspected data. WHO estimates the burden is higher, as transmission in eastern DRC went undetected for weeks and several deaths are unexplained. There is no vaccine or specific treatment for the rare Bundibugyo strain; testing is limited to a few laboratories in a remote area affected by armed groups. Local risk is very high, global risk is low; case fatality varies 25–90%.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例900件以上が報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの大規模疑い例発生（904件、確定101件）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響あり。IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC（South Kivu、Ituri州）における大規模エボラ疑い例の発生が主題。ウガンダで確定例5件が報告されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRC発生であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo株での高い致死率、限定的な検査体制、武装勢力による影響を受けた地域での感染拡大が懸念される。WHO長官の声明も掲載されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ιός Έμπολα: Ο ΕΟΔΥ επικαιροποιεί τα επιχειρησιακά του σχέδια - Ανήσυχος ο Γκίκας Μαγιορκίνης
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: EODY updates its operational plans - Anxious Gikas Magiorkinis
article.articleSummary: New Ebola case confirmed by the WHO in South Kivu, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, near Bukavu; outbreak traced to Ituri province two months earlier. Greece’s National Public Health Organization (EODY) is updating its Ebola response plans but says there is no risk of spread to Greece; any transmission would trigger WHO directives. The case underscores ongoing transmission in the DRC, which has suffered 17 Ebola epidemics; vaccines exist for Ebola generally, but not for this new case. The Athens-era Ebola Action Plan, ATHENA, was activated in 2015 at about €6 million. Epidemiologist Gikas Magiorkinis warns that orphan cases in Uganda and the DRC signal a potentially large health crisis, though not a pandemic. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever with high mortality and is less transmissible than measles or COVID-19.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：EODYが運用計画を更新 - ギカス・マギオルキニス氏が懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（重症度の高い疾患、異常/予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の確認例とウガンダでの孤発例により、複数国での感染事例が報告されており、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは南キブ州（東DRC）での新規確認例、イトゥリ州での流行、ウガンダでの孤発例が記載されている。Bluedot APIは Athens および Hellenic Republic（ギリシャ）を発生地域として付与しているが、これはギリシャ保健当局の対応計画更新に関連する言及であり、実際のエボラ患者発生地域ではないため、verified_locations からは除外した。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダの言及もあるが、対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria braces for possible Ebola outbreak, says NCDC - Healthwise
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) vigilance in Nigeria as of 2026-05-25: Nigeria has no confirmed cases linked to regional outbreaks in Uganda and DRC, but importation risk remains high due to international travel and cross-border movement. High-risk areas include border communities, transport hubs, and entry points. The NCDC placed the National Emergency Operations Centre on alert and activated the National Incident Management System; Rapid Response Teams are on standby. Coordination with state health ministries and Port Health strengthened, with intensified surveillance at entry points for early detection. Preparedness tools and staff trainings on triage and infection prevention are ongoing, and isolation/treatment centres with bed capacity are designated. Nigeria maintains Ebola testing at ports and within the lab network, with surge capacity available. Transmission via direct contact with infected blood or bodily fluids; not airborne. Symptoms: fever, weakness, headache, and muscle pain. Background: 2014 Lagos outbreak had 20 cases and eight deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアがエボラ出血熱の可能性に備える、NCDCが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という高危険病原体について、ナイジェリアが確認症例はないものの地域的な流行（ウガンダ・DRC）に対する警戒態勢を敷いており、国家緊急オペレーションセンターを稼働させている。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）とDRC（203312）も記載されているが、記事サマリーはナイジェリアの警戒態勢が主題であり、これらの国での発生イベント自体の詳細は記載されていない。ナイジェリアは確認症例ゼロだが「輸入リスクが高い」との警告が発せられている。エボラの致死性の高さ、ウガンダ・DRCでの地域的流行、国家レベルの対応体制の構築がいずれも確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: شناسایی بیش از ۹۰۰ مورد مشکوک ابولا در کنگو/ تشدید حملات به مراکز درمانی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Identification of more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo / Escalation of attacks on health facilities.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of late May 2026. A May 23 update reports 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in three eastern provinces. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or therapy. Uganda has reported three new confirmed cases, bringing total to five since the outbreak began on April 25. Rwanda has closed its border with DRC to curb cross-border spread. Africa CDC warns 10 additional African countries are at risk. Attacks on health facilities in eastern DRC hinder response; MSF tents were burned in Mongbovalo, Ituri, amid fears Ebola is a business and relatives’ bodies are kept for rites. This is DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976; last outbreak was Sept 2025 in Kasai with over 40 deaths. WHO declared it a PHEIC, level-2.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上のエボラ疑似症例が確認 / 医療施設への攻撃が激化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。エボラ出血熱の多国地域流行で、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、国家間の渡航制限（ルワンダの国境閉鎖）、死亡者多数、医療対応への障害あり。
triage.notes: ウガンダとルワンダについて: 記事サマリーではウガンダの確定患者5例報告、ルワンダの国境閉鎖が言及されているが、主要な発生地域はDRCであり、ウガンダ・ルワンダは隣接国への波及リスク国として記載されている。対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療なし）による発生。医療施設への攻撃が感染症対応を阻害している危機的状況。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia Ebola, nella Repubblica Democratica del Congo oltre 900 casi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: more than 900 cases.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, with 904 suspected cases and up to 220 deaths reported regionally; 119 deaths are listed as suspected. The Bundibugyo strain responsible has no vaccine or approved treatments. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and the risk of a national epidemic in the DRC is described as very high. The country remains highly vulnerable due to late diagnosis, absence of vaccines or therapies, ongoing armed conflict, and high population mobility. Most suspected and confirmed cases to date have occurred in Ituri, where nearly one million people are displaced by conflict. The article provides no lab-confirmed counts, infection source, or details on imported/exported cases, underscoring the urgent containment challenges in a fragile setting.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行：コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2の4基準すべてに該当（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWHOが公衆衛生の国際的脅威を宣言。即座にフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域はIturi州とDRCの両方を示しているが、記事サマリーから実際の発生地はDRC東部のIturi州であることが確認される。WHOがPHEIC（公衆衛生上の国際的な懸念）を宣言しており、国家的流行のリスクが非常に高いとされている。ワクチンおよび承認された治療法がない状況での904例の疑い例と最大220名の死亡報告は極めて深刻。武装紛争による約100万人の国内避難民と移動人口の多さが、国際的拡大および制御の課題を増大させている。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО се сомнева дека има повеќе од 900 случаи на ебола во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO suspects there are more than 900 Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases are being monitored in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases reported by the health ministry. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no available vaccine or specific therapy, with case fatality up to 50%. The World Health Organization has declared this event a public health emergency of international concern. Ebola has claimed more than 15,000 lives in Africa over the last five decades, with case fatality rates ranging from 25% to 90%. Ongoing surveillance and containment efforts aim to identify transmission chains, confirm cases, and prevent further spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHOはコンゴでエボラの症例が900件を超えていると疑っている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOが既に公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）を宣言した致死的感染症の新規アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）の新規アウトブレイクで、致死率50%。WHOが既にPHEIC（公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象）を宣言済み。ワクチンと特異的治療がない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: 177 ca tử vong do Ebola ở Congo, người dân không nên chủ quan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 177 deaths due to Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; people should not be complacent.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 750 cases with 177 deaths as of May 22, while Uganda reports 2 imported cases linked to Congo. This marks the 16th Ebola outbreak in the DRC since 1976; WHO has declared a global Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though spread is not global. Vietnam’s Ministry of Health escalates border and hospital surveillance, enhances testing capacity, and prepares isolation facilities if needed. Laboratories at Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City and the Central Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology are ready to test, with updated guidelines from 2014 aligned to WHO recommendations. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids, with high but not easily traded-on spread. Vietnam faces very low importation risk but not zero; travelers from Africa should follow standard precautions, healthcare workers use PPE, and clinicians should report travel history for timely response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラウイルスによる177人の死亡；国民は油断してはいけない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を伴う予想外の事象であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。WHO が国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴでのエボラ発生を主題としており、ウガンダの輸入症例にも言及。ベトナムは公式な発生国ではなく、監視体制強化のための報道。発生地域フィールドにはHo Chi Minh Cityが含まれているが、サマリーではベトナムは発生地ではなく対応国として述べられているため、verified_locationsはコンゴとベトナム両国を含める（ベトナムは border and hospital surveillance を実施中）。

article.articleHeadline: Alerte Ebola : Les autorités sanitaires appellent à la vigilance | La Gazette Des Comores
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert: Health Authorities Call for Vigilance | La Gazette Des Comores
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo strain prompts vigilance in Comoros as authorities report no confirmed or suspected cases on territory, following a May 21 press briefing amid rapid spread in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. With no vaccine available for this strain, hospitals rely on symptomatic treatment while laboratories are urged to expand capacity for early detection. The border risk centers on porous maritime routes, as migrants from affected areas land on coastal zones through informal boats and unmonitored entry points; IOM participated in the briefing. Plans include urgent training of community health workers, physicians, and paramedics to monitor and investigate coast arrivals. Trade with Tanzania, Uganda, and neighboring countries continues under heightened surveillance. Travellers should practice strict hand hygiene, undergo temperature screening, and report fever or vomiting, diarrhea, or bleeding. Border staff must enforce PPE protocols and real-time notification for suspected cases; incubation can reach 21 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒：保健当局が警戒を呼びかけ | ラガゼット・デ・コモレス
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）がコモロ諸島に上陸リスクを呈しており、DRCとウガンダでの急速な感染拡大に加え、海上ルートでの国際的な二次拡大リスク（IHR基準3つ該当）、及び非常に高い重症度と感染性を有するため、フルRRA対象として拾い上げる。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはComoros、Uganda、Tanzaniaが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。記事サマリーではコモロ諸島での『確認症例または疑い症例なし』と明記されているため、実際の発生地はDRCおよびウガンダ（非対象国）に限定される。コモロはリスク地域としての言及だが、患者発生確認なしのため除外。エボラBundibugyo株は致死率が高く、ワクチン未利用、21日間の潜伏期間、海上の非監視ルートでの越境リスク、及び多くの関係機関の関与により、国際支援必要性が明確に存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲疾控中心的埃博拉预警信息
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa CDC's Ebola Early Warning Information
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has been raised to a very high public-health risk by the World Health Organization as the outbreak spreads rapidly. On 23 May, Africa CDC warned ten additional African countries—Ethiopia, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, the Republic of the Congo (Brazzaville), Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia—are at risk due to their proximity to DRC and/or Uganda (Ethiopia hosts the African Union). Uganda’s Ministry of Health reported three new Ebola confirmations over the weekend: two Ugandan drivers associated with the first case and a healthcare worker who treated that patient; a Congolese woman who arrived by plane also tested positive. A tri-country cross-border plan (Uganda, DRC, South Sudan) to strengthen surveillance and entry monitoring is in place, with Africa CDC seeking USD 319 million, of which about USD 230 million has pledges, for DRC, Uganda, and other high-risk states. MSF and Solidarité Internationale emphasize community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCのエボラ早期警告情報
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な拡大リスク、複数国での確認症例、WHOによる極度の公衆衛生リスク評価により、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。国際的支援の必要性が顕著（USD319百万の資金要請）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際に確認されたエボラ症例が報告されている国はDRC（東部で発生中）とウガンダ（3件の新規確認）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。警告対象10カ国のうち、対象国リストに含まれるのはZambiaのみ。他の警告対象国（エチオピア、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、コンゴ共和国、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国）は対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは重要な発生地（outbreak spreads rapidly）として明示されており、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: رصدُ أكثر من 900 حالة إصابة اشتباه بإيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tracking more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases are being tracked in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, according to the World Health Organization. The agency said 101 cases have been laboratory-confirmed as Ebola virus disease in the DRC. WHO had previously declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola a public health emergency of international concern, with the risk of a national outbreak in the DRC deemed very high. Contributing factors cited by WHO include delays in case detection, lack of vaccines or targeted therapies for the virus, ongoing armed attacks, and high population mobility - factors that complicate containment in the DRC. The report underscores the ongoing transmission risk and international concern surrounding this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い例900件以上を追跡中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO公式声明による高リスク評価と確認症例の存在から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高病原性で死亡率が高く、記事は900件以上の疑い例と101件の確認例を報告。WHOが既に『国際的懸念に当たる公衆衛生上の緊急事態』と宣言。武装勢力による攻撃、ワクチン不足、高い人口移動性など、コンゴ民主共和国での制御困難要因が複数存在。国際的支援が重要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ostre kontrole na lotniskach przez wirusa. Tutaj kierują turystów na badania
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strict checks at airports due to the virus. Here they direct tourists to testing.
article.articleSummary: US CDC imposes mandatory Ebola screening for travelers from Africa (South Sudan, Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda) as the Bundibugyo strain fuels an outbreak. Since May 22, 2026, U.S. citizens or green-card holders who visited these countries within the prior 21 days are directed to screening at three airports: Washington Dulles, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta, and George Bush Intercontinental Houston. Non-citizens without those documents are temporarily barred if they were in the three countries in the past 21 days. Flight routes will be redirected to these airports to complete a travel-history form, temperature checks, and symptom observation; those with fever or suspicious signs are sent for further evaluation and treatment. Ebola symptoms commonly include high fever, muscle pain, and chills, with onset possible within two days of exposure. WHO estimates about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; a State Department task force coordinates response.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルスによる空港での厳格な検査。ここで観光客は検査を指示される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な拡大リスク（アフリカからの越境感染）、複数国での確認、米国での検疫措置導入、深刻な死亡率（推定死亡177件）により、IHR基準3項目該当。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での発生確認とアメリカへの国際的波及により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIで検出されたHouston、Georgia、Virginia、Atlanta、Texasなどの米国内位置情報は、米国のスクリーニング拠点・対応地点を示すもので、エボラの発生地ではなく、verified_locationsには含めていない。実際の発症地はアフリカの対象国（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）。南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。2026年5月25日配信の記事で、推定750疑い例、177疑い死亡が報告されており、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威。WHO推定死亡率は深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fertőzött orvos szólalt meg a betegségről: "Attól tartottam, hogy nem fogom túlélni
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola-infected doctor spoke out about the disease: "I was afraid I wouldn't survive."
article.articleSummary: An American physician working as a missionary in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Nyankunde Hospital) contracted Ebola and was flown to Berlin for treatment. Dr. Peter Stafford, 39, treated patients in 2023 and is now recovering after two intravenous therapies as part of efforts to boost survival chances. Early symptoms included fever, pain, and fatigue, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and rashes. Medical staff wear PPE and rotate in three-hour shifts. The World Health Organization reports roughly 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 suspected deaths globally, with the risk deemed low overall, though numbers may rise. The current Budinbugyo virus variant prompted vaccine development that could take up to nine months. Ebola outbreaks originate mainly from wildlife, especially fruit bats, with spillover to humans and subsequent human-to-human transmission. The patient is a father of four; no further imported/exported-case details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染者の医師が病気について語る：「生き残れないのではないかと恐れていた」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例で、コンゴ発生→ドイツへの国際移送であり、WPRO基準も複数該当。フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: アメリカの宣教医師がコンゴで感染し、ドイツへ搬送された国際的エボラ症例。WHO報告で約600疑い患者・139疑い死亡。Budinbugyoウイルス変異株で新規ワクチン開発中。発生地域にドイツ・アメリカが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は『コンゴでの感染→ドイツでの治療』であり、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: ԱՀԿ-ն հաղորդել է Կոնգոյում Էբոլայի ավելի քան 900 ենթադրյալ դեպքի մասին
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO has reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak center is Ituri province, home to about 5 million people. Approximately one-quarter of residents require humanitarian aid, and about one-fifth are internally displaced, with violence hindering contact tracing and case finding. On May 17, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for the DRC and neighbouring Uganda; on May 22, the organization raised the DRC's risk level from high to very high. The situation is complicated by a rare Ebola virus variant for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Ebola was first identified in 1976 in Sudan and in the DRC, with historical outbreaks near the Ebola River; the average case fatality is around 50%.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴでの900以上の疑い例エボラウイルス病症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）かつWPRO基準すべて該当。DRCで公式なPHEIC宣言済みで国際的関心も極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州）が主要発生地です。ウガンダはPHEIC宣言に含まれていますが、サマリーでは「隣国」として言及されるのみで、ウガンダでの確定症例報告はありません。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとしました。スーダンは歴史的背景として言及されているだけで、現在の発生地ではないため除外しました。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情已在刚果（金）夺走逾200人生命 暴力冲突加大防疫难度 - cnBeta.COM 移动版
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak has claimed more than 200 lives in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; violent clashes have increased the difficulty of epidemic prevention - cnBeta.COM Mobile Edition
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola has likely killed more than 210 people in the eastern region, with over 900 suspected cases reported. The Ministry of Health said on Sunday night that 11 health zones across three eastern provinces have detected the cluster, signaling a broad and ongoing outbreak. Violent clashes, distrust, and an overwhelmed surveillance system in conflict-affected areas have significantly hindered epidemic prevention and containment efforts. The figures reflect suspected cases and deaths as of May 23, with no details on laboratory confirmation or infection sources provided in the report. The situation underscores the challenges of controlling Ebola amid insecurity and limited health-system capacity in eastern DRC, and highlights the need for enhanced surveillance and public health measures in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で200人以上の命を奪う 暴力衝突が防疫難度を増加させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱は致死性の高い病原体で、東部での広範な流行を示唆する900以上の疑い症例が報告されており、紛争地帯での防疫困難性が懸念される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。DRC東部での200人以上の死亡、900以上の疑い症例は重大な流行を示唆。紛争地帯での暴力衝突、住民不信、監視体制の脆弱性が防疫困難化を招いており、国際支援の必要性が高い。ラボ確認数の詳細が報告されていない点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Karantina Sulsel Tingkatkan Pengawasan Hewan Kurban di Pelabuhan Parepare dan Garongkong - Tribun-timur.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sulawesi quarantine increases monitoring of sacrificial animals at Parepare and Garongkong ports.
article.articleSummary: South Sulawesi quarantine authorities have tightened monitoring of interregional sacrificial animal shipments ahead of Eid al-Adha 1447 H, focusing on Parepare and Garongkong ports, key routes for cattle heading to Kalimantan. Sitti Chadidjah, head of South Sulawesi quarantine, said higher animal mobility during Iduladha requires strict checks to prevent spread of contagious diseases. Each animal must meet quarantine requirements and be healthy before departure. Measures include administrative and physical inspections and laboratory testing to detect diseases early. Diseases anticipated include foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) and Lumpy Skin Disease (LSD). The program aims to protect animal health and ensure safe animal-derived food for the public, sustaining consumer confidence during the festive period and safeguarding the livestock supply chain.

triage.headline_ja: スラウェシ南部検疫当局、パレパレ港およびガロングコン港での犠牲獣の監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫（FMD）およびルンピースキン病（LSD）の予防的監視強化の報道。異常性・重症度は高くないが、動物間の感染リスク低減および国家検疫体制の動き自体は検視価値あり。情報不足のため上位判定を保留。
triage.notes: インドネシアにおいて既知の動物疾病（FMD、LSD）に対する予防的検疫強化措置の報道。現時点で患畜の確認報告なし。記事は警戒を呼びかける公式発表に基づいており、実際の症例発生ではなく予防体制の記述。祭礼期間の動物移動増加に伴う感染リスク評価が背景。現時点では確認シグナルの域を出ない。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: OMS Identifica Mais de 900 Casos Suspeitos na República Democrática Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO Identifies More Than 900 Suspected Cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026, Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has over 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed and 115 deaths. The outbreak is active in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, centered in insecure Ituri–North Kivu areas amid conflict and displacement. WHO raised the national risk to very high; regional risk remains high, global risk low. Uganda reports five confirmed cases and one death, with infections linked to travel from DRC. A security incident in Ituri damaged tents and supplies, hindering response and contact tracing, which is limited in Bunia. Africa CDC warns ten more countries (Angola, Burundi, CAR, Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, Zambia) at high risk; a $314 million AU–WHO plan will coordinate six months of outbreak response, focused on DRC and Uganda. One U.S. citizen contracted Ebola and is treated in Germany; U.S. travel restrictions cover RDC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑似患者を特定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。確認患者115名、東部DRCと隣接地域での活発なアウトブレイク、ウガンダ及びドイツでの確認事例、米国の渡航制限実施により、フルのRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが主要発生地であり、ウガンダ、ドイツ、南スーダンでの拡大確認。Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域には多数の国が含まれるが、サマリーの主題から判断して、対象国リストに含まれ実際に発生が確認されているのはDRCとザンビア（Africa CDC警告対象）。ウガンダ（確認患者1名、死亡1名）はサマリーに明記されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ドイツ・南スーダンは対象国外のため除外。紛争・変位環境での対応困難が懸念される重大事象。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата надвор од контрола во Конго: Над 200 жртви и хаос на терен
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Out of Control in Congo: Over 200 Victims and Chaos on the Ground.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo has killed over 200 people, with more than 900 suspected cases; as of May, around 210 suspected deaths were recorded. Centered in Ituri, the outbreak spans 11 health zones across eastern provinces and is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Violence, distrust, and overwhelmed health services hinder response; attacks on treatment centers and displacement impede contact tracing, with only 20% of identified contacts traced within a day. Mongbvalu residents stormed a hospital after authorities refused to release bodies for safety reasons. Uganda reports five confirmed cases linked to the same hotspot. WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17; Africa CDC warns up to ten African countries are at risk. A U.S. citizen exposed to Ebola was evacuated to Germany; contacts were moved to Germany and the Czech Republic for monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が制御不能：200人以上の犠牲者と現場の混乱
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（200人以上の死亡、900人以上の疑い例）、予想外の集団発生規模と稀なBundibugyo株の出現、複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダ確認例、ドイツとチェコへの輸送）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスク（WHO PHEIC宣言）が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、主要な発生地域はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州。ウガンダでの確認例とドイツ・チェコへの症例輸送は報告されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの集団発生であるため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。WHO PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）の宣言により、対応の優先度は最高。

article.articleHeadline: Число предположительных случаев заражения вирусом Эбола в ДР Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of probable Ebola virus infection cases in the DRC exceeded 900.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola virus disease cases are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 confirmed, according to the World Health Organization. The outbreak epicenter is Ituri province in northeastern DRC. On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Uganda. Ebola is a highly dangerous viral hemorrhagic fever first identified in 1976 in Sudan and the DRC. Transmission occurs from wildlife to humans and through close contact with the blood or body fluids of infected people via mucous membranes or broken skin. The incubation period ranges from 2 to 21 days. Early symptoms include myalgia, headache, diarrhea, and sore throat, followed by kidney and liver dysfunction and, in some cases, internal and external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラウイルス感染の推定症例数が900例を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言しており、高い重症度、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患の急速な拡大、高い致死率、ウガンダへの越境リスク。WHOはすでに2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。Machupo（別名、一般的にはボリビアンハモラギック熱と関連）とEbolaの両方が記載されているが、記事サマリーはEbolaに焦点。動物と人間の両方が影響カテゴリとして指定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Pinoy crew members to get paid while under quarantine for hantavirus
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, 38 Filipino crew members of cruise ship M/V Hondius are in quarantine in the Netherlands amid a hantavirus outbreak declared on board. None have tested positive; daily tests have returned negative and none are symptomatic. The quarantine is set to end on June 18 before they return home. Shipowner Oceanwide will continue salary payments, with about 80% of wages sent directly to beneficiaries in the Philippines, and payments to continue through the contract term even if crew return earlier. Department of Migrant Workers officials Jerome Pampolina and Hans Leo Cacdac highlighted the crew’s resilience and optimism. No hantavirus infections have been reported among the Filipino crew to date.

triage.headline_ja: フィリピン人乗組員はハンタウイルス隔離中に給与を受け取る予定
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスの船舶内集団発生ですが、フィリピン人乗組員の間に感染者がなく、情報が限定的。国際的な懸念（オランダでの隔離）がありますが、詳細な疫学情報や感染者数が不明であるため、経過観察が適切です。
triage.notes: 発生地域にオランダが含まれていますが、記事の主題はフィリピン人乗組員であり、実際の発生地はオランダ（船舶内）です。ただしフィリピン人への影響が記事の焦点であるため、Philippinesのみを verified_locations に含めました。全乗組員の感染状況、感染者の重症度、ハンタウイルスの種類（HPS/HFRS）などの詳細情報が不足しており、フルRRAに進む前に続報の確認が必要です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Onu stanzia 60 milioni di dollari per epidemia in Africa * Imola Oggi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: UN earmarks $60 million for the Ebola epidemic in Africa.
article.articleSummary: UN Under-Secretary-General for Humanitarian Affairs Tom Fletcher announced up to $60 million from the United Nations Central Emergency Response Fund to accelerate the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the surrounding region. The grant aims to bolster urgent coordination amid a conflict-affected, highly mobile operational context, with calls to ensure unimpeded access for responders across air, land and marine routes, including areas controlled by armed groups. For the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, there are currently no vaccines or approved therapeutics, making rapid, coordinated community action essential to containment. The humanitarian coordinator expressed gratitude to the United States for financial support and said additional UN agencies and partner personnel will be deploying over the weekend to the DRC, Uganda and South Sudan to bolster response capacity.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：国連がアフリカのエボラ流行対策に6000万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株エボラの流行拡大が深刻で、ワクチン・治療薬がなく、DRC・ウガンダ・南スーダンへの国際的な拡大リスクが高く、国連が緊急対応資金を投じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC中心の流行対応について述べており、ウガンダ・南スーダンは支援配置の文脈。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株エボラでワクチン・承認治療薬がないことが重大な懸念。紛争地帯での対応困難さも特記すべき。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情防控挑戰多　男子闖醫院搶屍釀混亂 | 國際 | 中央社 CNA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many challenges in Congo's Ebola outbreak prevention and control; a man barges into a hospital to steal a corpse, causing chaos | International | CNA
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province, escalates amid violence against health facilities. As of May 25, 2026, 904 suspected Ebola cases are reported, up from about 700 earlier, with most in Ituri. Incidents further hinder response: at Mongbwalu General Hospital a gunman stormed the facility, prompting evacuation; previously, a fire at Doctors Without Borders isolation tents triggered chaos and allowed 18 suspected infections to flee. A second treatment center in Rwampara was burned on May 21 after relatives of a deceased suspected case were refused the body. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), with domestic risk assessed as extremely high but global risk still low. Authorities restrict wakes and gatherings over 50 people to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症の予防・管理に多くの課題があり、男性が病院に侵入して遺体を盗み、混乱を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラはIHR規定疾患で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、WHOがPHEICを宣言している。複数の対象国で確認され、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のIturi州でのエボラ流行を主題としている。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）がBluedotの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの確定的な発生は述べられていないため除外した。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。904件の疑い例、複数の医療施設への攻撃、WHOによるPHEIC宣言により、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية في إفريقيا: إصابة واحدة بفيروس الإيبولا تهدد الجميع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization in Africa: A single Ebola virus infection threatens everyone.
article.articleSummary: World Health Organization Africa Regional Director Mohammed Yakub Janabi warned that the Ebola virus remains deadly and a single infection could spark transmission beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. Ebola presents with fever, vomiting and diarrhea and spreads through direct contact with body fluids or contaminated materials. The Congo outbreak continues with limited global attention compared with hantavirus, though the risk persists. Assessments are ongoing, with rapid population movement hindering evaluation; authorities are expanding testing and preventive measures. He stressed the need to build trust in communities and combat misinformation about Ebola. The WHO has declared the Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The search for the index case is ongoing to identify contacts and ensure isolation; no confirmed case or death counts are reported in this summary as of May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）のアフリカ地域: エボラウイルス1例の感染が全員を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、WHO公式による国際保健上の懸念の宣言（PHEIC）、複数アフリカ国での確認、ヒト-ヒト感染の高い流行性。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot発生地域にはUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「DRC and Uganda」と並列言及されているものの、アウトブレイク自体はDRCが中心で、Ugandaでの具体的な確認は明記されていない。サマリー主題がDRC中心のため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。Hantavirusも疾患名に含まれるが、記事サマリーでは「エボラと比較して注目度が低い」と言及される副次的な言及に過ぎず、本イベントの主体はEbolaである。WHOがPHEICを公式宣言していることが著しい。

article.articleHeadline: War, Ebola, and extreme heat: The challenges facing Hajj this year
article.articleSummary: May 25–29, 2026 Hajj in Saudi Arabia draws more than 1.5 million international pilgrims from over 180 countries, with attendance near two million by the end of the period. Extreme late‑May heat reaches 45–48°C during outdoor rites. Global health surveillance focuses on Ebola outbreaks in East and Central Africa alongside concerns about other emerging pathogens at one of the world’s largest mass gatherings. West Asia regional instability from Iran–US tensions and related airspace disruptions complicates travel and logistics, though contingency plans are in place. Iran has sent about 30,000 pilgrims this year, far below typical levels (~87,000). Saudi authorities have strengthened Mecca’s air defenses, including Patriot missiles and anti‑drone/laser systems, raising concerns about debris from interceptions in crowded zones. Officials stress risk from unintended fallout rather than targeted attacks; airlines adjust routes as needed.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争、エボラ、極度の熱：今年のハッジが直面する課題
triage.triage_reason: エボラアウトブレイクが東・中央アフリカで発生しており、世界最大級の大量集会（ハッジ）に150万人以上の国際巡礼者が参加する中、国際的な感染症拡大リスクが存在する。複数のIHR基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではエボラアウトブレイクが東・中央アフリカで発生していることが述べられているが、対象国リスト内ではDRC(203312)のみが中央アフリカに該当し、DRCは明示されていないため、確認可能な対象国はChina(1814991)のみとした。ハッジはサウジアラビアで開催されるが、サウジアラビアは対象国リストに含まれていない。イランも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、東・中央アフリカでのエボラ発生が世界最大級の大量集会に潜在的なリスクを提示している点で、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に明確に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Non, le ministère de la Santé n'a pas annoncé sept cas d'Ebola en Tunisie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No, the Ministry of Health has not announced seven cases of Ebola in Tunisia.
article.articleSummary: Seven Ebola cases in Tunisia have not been reported. A Facebook post circulating since May 23, 2026 claimed seven cases among African nationals arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo. Tunisian health authorities have formally denied the claim; as of May 21, 2026, no Ebola cases are confirmed in Tunisia and no direct threat is reported. The situation remains under surveillance with the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak monitored by the African CDC and the World Health Organization, which are coordinating with Congolese authorities to contain spread. Tunisian guidance to residents and travelers from DRC zones emphasizes avoiding direct contact with bodily fluids, notes that transmission is primarily via direct contact with infected fluids and is not typically airborne, and recognizes Ebola symptoms (fever, vomiting, fatigue, diarrhea, bleeding); symptoms within 21 days after returning should prompt contact with health services before seeking care. No confirmed imports or exports of cases into Tunisia.

triage.headline_ja: いいえ、保健省はチュニジアでエボラ出血熱7例を報告していません
triage.triage_reason: チュニジアでのエボラ確定症例なし。根拠ないFacebook投稿の否定記事であり、公衆衛生への実質的脅威がない。DRCでの発生監視は継続されているが、本記事は虚偽情報の否定が主題。
triage.notes: 本記事はチュニジアでのエボラ7例という虚偽情報の否定である。DRCでのエボラ発生は監視されているが、チュニジアへの確定的な波及はない。虚偽情報否定記事のため、新たなシグナルとしての価値は低い。対象国はDRCのみが該当。

article.articleHeadline: A RACE AGAINST A VIRUS WITH NO CURE | THE DAILY TRIBUNE | KINGDOM OF BAHRAIN
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda escalates; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern after consulting health ministers from DRC and Uganda; the emergency committee met May 22 and issued temporary recommendations. Risk assessments: Very High in DRC, High in Uganda; global risk judged low. WHO allocated an additional $3.4 million from the Contingency Fund for Emergencies, bringing total to $3.9 million. Bundibugyo Ebola, a rarer strain, has no vaccine or treatment; Ervebo vaccine for the Zaire strain shows no approved protection against Bundibugyo in humans. Containment is the primary tool. Outbreak began in Bunia Health Zone, northeastern DRC; early May cluster among healthcare workers. Initial samples negative; by May 15 eight of thirteen samples were positive; investigators believe the virus circulated for months before detection; first suspected death around April 20; a super-spreader event, likely at funeral or healthcare facility, accelerated transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 治療法のないウイルスとの競争 | ザ・デイリー・トリビューン | バーレーン王国
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス（ブンディブギョ株）のアウトブレイクがWHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態として宣言されている。DRCとウガンダで確認され、高いリスク評価がなされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国でアウトブレイクが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが含まれているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、$3.9百万の資金配分がなされている。ブンディブギョ株は稀な変異株で、現存するワクチン（エルヴェボ）は有効でなく、治療法も確立されていない点が重大。スーパースプレッダーイベント（葬儀または医療施設での感染拡大）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: 埃博拉疫情迅速蔓延，刚果（金）医疗防线全面告急
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading rapidly; Democratic Republic of the Congo's medical frontlines are under severe strain.
article.articleSummary: As of the past weekend, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly and straining medical frontlines. Africa Centers for Disease Control and Prevention reports at least 750 suspected cases and 177 official deaths, with the true toll likely higher. In the hardest-hit areas, there are no dedicated Ebola treatment centers, and patients are being treated in ordinary wards. The outbreak ranks as the third-largest Ebola outbreak in history. No details are provided on confirmed cases, laboratory confirmation, or infection sources in the article. The situation underscores overwhelmed healthcare facilities and ongoing transmission in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-05-25.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が急速に拡大、コンゴ民主共和国の医療最前線が深刻な危機に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準も複数該当。世界規模での高い社会的・政治的関心が予想される。フルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される疫学データ：疑い患者750名以上、公式死亡者177名以上、実際の死者数は報告より高い可能性。歴史上3番目の規模であるエボラ流行。医療施設の過負荷と継続的な感染が記載されている。確認患者数、検査室確認数、感染源についての詳細は記事に記載なし。DRC国内での感染伝播が継続中であり、隣接国への拡大リスクを考慮すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Odisha Steps Up Ebola Screening at Bhubaneswar Airport
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak prompted WHO global health emergency; India, including Odisha, ramps up surveillance though no confirmed cases yet. Odisha Health Minister Mukesh Mahaling chaired a high-level review of readiness, hospital capacity, supplies, and communication. State aims to tighten airport screening, establish isolation wards, ensure essential medicines and PPE, and deliver timely, accurate information to the public. Biju Patnaik International Airport in Bhubaneswar implements mandatory screening for international arrivals; Bangkok is currently the only direct-flight origin. Incoming passengers from Bangkok must complete a form detailing their movements in the past three weeks and disclose any contact with African countries or nationals to flag potential risk. Odisha's measures align with national guidelines to detect cases early, with dedicated surveillance and rapid tracking. As of 2026-05-25, Odisha has no confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: オディシャ州、ブバネシュワル空港でのエボラ出血熱スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的な保健上の緊急事態宣言により、IHR基準のうち「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当する（2項目）。ただし対象国内では確認症例がなく、スクリーニング強化段階であるため、現在はWATCH段階で引き続き情報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは、ブンディブギョ株エボラの国際的保健上の緊急事態がWHOによって宣言されたことが述べられており、インド（オディシャ州）がサーベイランス強化を実施している。バンコクが唯一の直行便出発地として言及されているため、タイも検証済みロケーションに含める。現在のところインド国内での確認症例はなく、スクリーニングと対策準備段階である。引き続き患者発生の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Patient in Berlin: Schauriges Foto aus der Charité geht um die Welt - und in den USA entbrennt Streit
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola patient in Berlin: A chilling photo from the Charité goes around the world—and a dispute erupts in the United States.
article.articleSummary: An American, 39, infected with Ebola (Bundibugyo variant) is hospitalized on Berlin's Charité special isolation ward since May 20, with his wife and four children arriving May 21 as high-risk contacts and quarantined separately. Contact with the patient is only through a glass window; a bench was placed so the children could glimpse their father. The patient is described as 'very weakened' but not currently in intensive care; PCR confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola virus infection, linked to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The WHO reports about 900 suspected Ebola cases and 101 confirmed infections globally; no licensed vaccine or established treatment exists. Symptoms can include vomiting, diarrhea, and in severe cases internal bleeding and organ failure, with about 37% mortality. In the U.S., White House denies a back-and-forth over the patient’s return; Charité’s isolation unit is Germany’s largest, capable of full readiness within two hours.

triage.headline_ja: ベルリンのエボラ患者：シャリテ病院からの不気味な写真が世界中に拡散—そしてアメリカで紛争が勃発
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な越境事例であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクの4基準すべてに該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理可能性で懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事はベルリンのエボラ患者事例を報道しているが、患者はアメリカ国籍で、感染源はコンゴ民主共和国のアウトブレイクと関連付けられている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ドイツはWHO通知義務国だが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations からは除外。ただし、この事例は明らかに国境を越えた重大感染症事象であり、コンゴDRCでの流行との関連性が高く、フルRRA対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường giám sát, phát hiện ca nghi ngờ mắc bệnh Ebola ngay tại cửa khẩu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen surveillance and detect a suspected case of Ebola virus disease at the border crossing.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam strengthens border surveillance for Ebola virus disease amid Bundibugyo-strain outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. The Ministry of Health directs provinces to coordinate with immigration authorities to screen travelers from affected regions and to advise a 21-day self-monitoring period for returnees. Suspected cases should be isolated and samples sent to the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for diagnostic confirmation, with strict infection control and safe handling of deaths. Provinces must prepare border and community response plans, mobilize personnel and supplies, and maintain risk communication to prevent panic. WHO data show Congo with 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths by May 22, 2026; Uganda reports two imported cases and at least one death in mid-May. WHO declared PHEIC on May 17, 2026; India issued travel advisories to Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: 国境での監視強化、エボラウイルス病の疑い症例を検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認例あり。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Sudan（スーダン）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Ugandaも対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を2026年5月17日に宣言済み。ベトナムは国内での疑い症例検出に向けて国境監視を強化している状況。DRCでの患者数（750疑い例、177死亡）とウガンダでの輸入症例報告により、国際的な拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: "Ne razumijemo kako se prenosi!" Ebola se širi brže nego što se mislilo, otkriveno kako je sve počelo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: We don't understand how it is transmitted! Ebola is spreading faster than previously thought; it has been revealed how it all began.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted the World Health Organization to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling heightened international alert and aid needs. MSF warns the spread may be faster than initially thought, with more than 200 suspected deaths and over 850 possible infections reported. Three Red Cross volunteers who died earlier this month are believed to have been infected while handling bodies of the deceased. There is no approved vaccine for this Ebola strain, though experimental vaccines are in development, and there are no specific antiviral therapies. Symptoms typically begin 2–21 days after exposure and start with fever, headache, and fatigue, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids; urbanization and conflict-affected regions near natural reservoirs increase risk, complicating case confirmation and aid delivery. The outbreak predates full understanding of transmission, hindering containment.

triage.headline_ja: 「感染経路が理解できない!」エボラは予想より速く拡散、発生のきっかけが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡散速度、国際的懸念、PHEIC宣言）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱による国際的な感染症危機であり、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 2026年5月25日時点のシミュレーション記事と考えられるが、内容は重大な国際感染症イベント。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、200人以上の死亡疑い例、850人以上の感染の可能性、有効なワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染、紛争地域での複雑な状況といった要素が複合されている。高度な警戒態勢が必要。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية بأفريقيا: اتصال مصاب واحد بفيروس الإيبولا يعرضنا جميعاً للخطر - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization in Africa: A single infected person's contact with the Ebola virus puts us all at risk - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, WHO Africa Regional Director Dr. Mohammed Yaqub Janabi warns that a single exposed person could propel Ebola beyond the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. He notes a vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and stresses the outbreak’s lethality, with Ebola causing fever, body pains, vomiting and diarrhea, spreading through direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials or the deceased. The size and duration of the outbreak are still being assessed, hindered by high human mobility and ongoing testing and prevention capacity expansion, along with community engagement efforts. A burial dispute led to burning Ebola treatment tents, underscoring trust gaps. The outbreak has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, and scientists have not yet identified the index case, complicating initial contact tracing. The situation contrasts with a hantavirus cruise-ship-linked outbreak drawing global attention.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関アフリカ地域事務所：エボラウイルスに感染した1人の接触で私たち全員が危険にさらされる - ザ・セブンス・デイ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高い死亡率を伴う異常事象であり、複数国での報告、国際的拡大リスク、PHEIC宣言があり、直ちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（民主共和国）とウガンダでのエボラウイルス感染症の発生が述べられているが、対象国リストにはDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。複数疾患（ハンタウイルス感染症も言及）が記載されているが、主題はエボラウイルス感染症。インデックスケースの特定ができていない点が追跡調査を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes NTT Pastikan Stok Vaksin Rabies Aman, Masyarakat Diminta Hindari Gigitan Anjing - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Nusa Tenggara Health Office Ensures Rabies Vaccine Stock Is Safe, Public Urged to Avoid Dog Bites - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, East Nusa Tenggara Province's Health Office says anti-rabies vaccine stocks at community health centers (Puskesmas) and health facilities remain sufficient to treat animal-bite cases. Neni Anggreini, head of the Prevention and Control of Diseases (P2P) unit, says vaccines are redistributed as needed to prevent stockouts and maintain service continuity. Rabies prevention requires broad partnership beyond health workers, including village governments, communities, religious leaders, and media, she adds. Despite ongoing education through social media and outreach programs, many residents—particularly in remote areas—still underestimate rabies risks and proper response. The public is advised to avoid close interaction with dogs, ensure pets are vaccinated and confined, and seek care promptly if bitten: rinse wounds with running water and soap, then visit the nearest health facility. Authorities aim to reduce rabies deaths in Kupang Regency and across NTT.

triage.headline_ja: 東ヌサテンガラ州保健局が狂犬病ワクチン備蓄の安全性を確認、公衆に犬咬傷を避けるよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病はヒト-ヒト感染が稀な動物由来感染症であり、事務的なワクチン備蓄確認報道。IHR基準2つ以上の該当なし、スクリーニング基準も明確な該当なし。ただしインドネシア国内での狂犬病管理状況把握のため経過観察を継続。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシア（東ヌサテンガラ州クパン地域）のワクチン備蓄管理に関する行政的な発表。感染症の流行・拡大を報道するものではなく、既存の狂犬病対策の継続・強化に関する内容。社会的関心は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: RT-Engels: Ebola outbreak grows to 900 suspected cases WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed infections, WHO reports. Kinshasa declared an epidemic on May 15, 2026, the country’s 17th Ebola crisis since 1976. On May 17, the Bundibugyo strain detected in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda was designated a public health emergency of international concern, while not a pandemic-level emergency. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence and mass displacement in Ituri province—the epicenter—severely hampers containment, with nearly 5 million people living amid conflict, 1 in 4 in humanitarian need, and 1 in 5 internally displaced. Efforts to expand contact tracing and provide timely care are impeded. WHO and partners continue operations in insecure, hard-to-reach areas of Ituri amid a broader multi-disease crisis.

triage.headline_ja: RT-Engels: エボラ感染者が900人の疑い例に増加 WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain が検出され、既に隣国ウガンダへの越境があり、国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）として認定されている。Ituri州での紛争・避難民と医療インフラ崩壊により、感染制御が著しく困難な状況。900人の疑い例、101人の確定例は深刻。ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo fa centinaia di morti, allarme in almeno altri 10 Paesi dell'Africa dal Kenya all'Etiopia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo has killed hundreds, sparking alarm in at least ten other African countries from Kenya to Ethiopia.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases, per the Congolese Health Ministry, up from 177 deaths and 750 suspected cases reported by the WHO last Friday. The Africa CDC warns ten African countries are at risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Angola, the Central African Republic, and Zambia. MSF teams are operating around the clock, with about 480 on-site professionals and roughly 50 more international staff expected soon, focusing on patient care, contact tracing, and sustaining essential services for malaria, cholera, and HIV. The WHO assessment remains that global emergency risk is low for now. FIFA is monitoring the situation ahead of the 2026 World Cup in the United States, Mexico, and Canada.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱が数百人の死亡をもたらし、ケニアからエチオピアまでアフリカの少なくとも10カ国でアラームが鳴り響いている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数の対象国（DRC、Zambia等）での確認済みの多死亡エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される主要発生地はDRC（204死亡、867疑い例）。Africa CDCが警告する10カ国のうち、対象国リストに該当するのはZambia、DRC。Kenya、Tanzania、Ethiopia、Rwanda、Burundi、Angola、Central African Republicは対象国外のため除外。WHO評価では現在のところ全球的緊急リスクは低いとされているが、数百人の死亡と地域的拡大リスクがあり、MSF等による対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Declared Global Emergency Amid Rising Cases in DRC, Uganda
article.articleSummary: WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17 for the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda. As of May 24, the DRC reports 904 suspected cases, 101 confirmed, with 119 deaths; Uganda reports 5 confirmed cases and 1 death. The WHO says the situation is rapidly worsening and assigns very high outbreak risk within the DRC, while global spread risk remains low. There are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo; experimental vaccines and therapies are under review. Transmission is mainly via direct contact with blood, secretions, or bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals; airborne spread is not typical. Containment is challenged by attacks on treatment centers, PPE shortages, and distrust. Reservoirs are likely fruit bats, with primates as possible intermediates; deforestation and forest fragmentation increase spillover risk. The outbreak is in eastern DRC amid conflict; US screenings and India advisories are in place. The 2014-2016 West Africa outbreak had >28,000 infections and ~11,300 deaths; WSJ notes this is among the largest outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症のグローバル緊急事態宣言、DRCおよびウガンダにおける患者数増加の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大リスク、国際的な対応制限の懸念）。WHO公式に国際的懸念事項として宣言されており、複数国で確認患者と死亡が報告されている。
triage.notes: WHO公式に2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として宣言されたBundibugyo型エボラウイルス感染症の大規模発生。DRCで119名の死亡、ウガンダでも確認患者が報告されており、治療施設への攻撃、PPE不足、住民の不信など、対策上の重大な課題がある。Verified locationsはサマリーで主題となっているDRC、インドのアドバイザリー措置が記載されているインドのみを含める。アンゴラ、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: "عبدالغفار": البعثة الطبية المصرية ترفع درجة الاستعداد لحماية الحجاج من العدوى والأمراض الوبائية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Abdel-Ghafer": The Egyptian medical mission steps up its readiness to protect pilgrims from infections and epidemic diseases.
article.articleSummary: Egypt’s medical mission for Hajj has raised readiness to counter infectious and epidemic diseases as pilgrims begin the Day of Tarwiyah and head to Mina, Mecca. Health Ministry spokesperson Dr. Hossam Abdel-Ghaffer stated the Egyptian team prioritizes prevention amid crowding and high temperatures, delivering intensive awareness on personal hygiene, proper ventilation, mask use when needed, and maximizing distancing. Beyond prevention, the mission provides immediate medical care, monitors pilgrims with chronic conditions, and coordinates with Saudi hospitals for cases needing intervention or hospitalization. The mission comprises 102 physicians, 12 health inspectors, 2 dentists, 11 pharmacists, and 14 nursing staff, ensuring comprehensive medical services for Egyptian pilgrims throughout the rites.

triage.headline_ja: 「アブデル・ガファル」：エジプト医療団がハッジ巡礼者を感染症及び流行病から保護するための準備態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: 未知の疾患が報告されているわけではなく、サウジアラビアでのハッジ巡礼期間中の感染症対策強化についての報道。既知の感染症リスク管理の通常の活動であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはMeccaやSaudi Arabiaが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、ハッジ期間中の予防的な医療体制の強化である。対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に該当する国での実際の感染症イベント発生の報告ではないため、verified_locationsは空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Hasil Uji Sampel Babi di Gianyar Keluar: 2 Positif ASF, Distan Minta Peternakan Perketat Biosekuriti - Tribun-bali.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Results of Pig-Sample Tests in Gianyar Released: Two ASF-Positive Cases, Distan Urges Pig Farms to Tighten Biosecurity
article.articleSummary: Two of six pig samples from Temesi area, Gianyar Regency, Bali, tested positive for African Swine Fever (ASF) in interim results released May 25, 2026. Four samples were negative; authorities emphasized there is no commercial ASF vaccine. In response, the Bali Province Agriculture and Fisheries Office and district partners distributed free disinfectant to pig farmers and urged strict on-farm biosecurity, including regular pen cleaning and disinfectant spraying. A provincial technical team, collaborating with district health and livestock agencies, has deployed monitoring and periodic health checks to verify field conditions and educate farmers on sanitation standards. Given the central role of pigs in Bali's economy, officials cautioned the public to avoid panic and verify information. With no vaccine, farm discipline and biosecurity remain the key to reducing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ギニャール県の豚サンプル検査結果：2件がASF陽性、地域農業事務所が畜産業者に生物防御対策の強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（ASF）の確認事例だが、ヒト健康への直接的な深刻な影響が不明。経済的影響が潜在的に懸念されるが、情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ASFはヒト感染症ではなく動物感染症であるため、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」は評価が難しい。ただしアジア地域でのASF拡大は畜産経済に大きな影響を与える可能性があり、バリ州での新規確認は地域的には異常（unusual）。地域当局が対応を実施しており、管理可能性は比較的高い。続報による疫学的詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes NTT Sayangkan Kasus Kematian ASN Akibat Rabies di Kabupaten Kupang - Pos-kupang.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: East Nusa Tenggara Health Office regrets the death of a civil servant due to rabies in Kupang Regency.
article.articleSummary: Two rabies deaths in Kupang Regency have been recorded as of May 2026, per the East Nusa Tenggara (NTT) Health Office. The latest fatality involved a civil servant from Amfoang District who died after a dog bite. The Health Office regrets the preventable loss and urges rapid treatment for bite victims. After a dog bite, victims should immediately receive the anti-rabies vaccine (VAR), while the biting animal should be secured and tested for rabies. First aid includes washing the wound with running water and soap or disinfectant before seeking care. If bites are on the upper body near the brain, Serum Anti Rabies (SAR) may be required in addition to VAR. Authorities are seeking further details from the Department of Animal Husbandry, though comment was not available at the time of reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 東ヌサトゥンガラ保健局がクパン県のイヌ咬傷による公務員の狂犬病死亡を遺憾表明
triage.triage_reason: クパン県での狂犬病死亡2件が報告されているが、情報は限定的。予防可能な疾患の死亡例であり、公衆衛生上の懸念が存在するが、流行の兆候や国際的拡大リスクについて情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は予防可能な疾患であるため、2件の死亡は対応の重要性を示唆している。ただし、現時点では流行性の兆候、市中感染の拡大、または国際的リスクについて言及がない。イヌとの接触が主な感染源であり、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: У Конго спалахнула смертельна хвороба, від якої немає вакцини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly disease with no vaccine has erupted in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases and 119 deaths, with the northeast Ituri province as the epicenter and Bunia at high risk. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment and carries a high case fatality. The virus spreads from wildlife to humans and between people via blood, secretions, other bodily fluids, and contaminated surfaces. Early symptoms include sudden fever, weakness, muscle and head pain, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, kidney and liver failure, and both internal and external bleeding. The outbreak coincides with conflict and distrust, with two Ebola treatment centers burned last week. Authorities banned large gatherings; burial protocols and safety concerns limit traditional rites. Hospitals are overwhelmed as almost 1 million people are displaced in Ituri; humanitarian partners warn of shortages of protective gear, test kits, and body bags, complicating safe burials and containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで致死的な疾患が発生、ワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当。シグナルとして即座にフルRRAに進む。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱、ワクチンなし。904例疑い症例、119例死亡（CFR約13.2%）。紛争・医療施設への信頼喪失（治療センター焼き討ちなど）が対応を複雑化させている。約100万人の国内避難民存在。個人保護具・検査キット・遺体収容資材の深刻な不足が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 世界杯临近，美国严防埃博拉
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the FIFA World Cup Approaches, the United States Tightens Ebola Precautions.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 101 confirmed and 204 deaths as of May 25, 2026, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province and affects three provinces; prolonged conflict there hinders contact tracing and care. Uganda reports its first locally acquired cases, bringing cumulative confirmed to five. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17; national risk is very high, regional risk high, global risk low. A May 21 fire damaged an Ebola treatment center in Bunia. The US CDC added Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International Airport to Ebola screening; Dulles remains a screening site. The White House requires a 21-day quarantine for the DR Congo team before arriving in Houston for the World Cup, with training in Belgium. Africa CDC warns ten countries (South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Republic of the Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, Zambia) face spillover risk. No vaccine or specific therapy exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: FIFA ワールドカップが近づく中、米国はエボラウイルス対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において深刻な公衆衛生影響（900件以上の疑い症例、204人の死亡）、異常・予想外な発生、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認、複数国への波及警告）、渡航制限措置（ワールドカップチームの隔離）の4基準すべてに該当。WHO による国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言も確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は複数国が言及されているが、実際の発生地はDRC（主要）とウガンダであり、ザンビアは「波及リスク」警告国として10国リストに含まれている。対象国リスト内では DRC と Zambia のみが該当する。米国（ジョージア州、テキサス州等）やベルギーは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による異例の株系統、火災による治療センター損傷、ワールドカップという国際的スポーツイベントでの感染リスク増加など、複合的なリスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in DR Kongo: Ex-CDC-Chef warnt vor Ausweitung zur Pandemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: Former CDC chief warns against expansion into a pandemic
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026 — Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and parts of Uganda risks expanding into wider Africa, warns former CDC director Robert Redfield. He says early detection was apparently too late, risking escalation beyond border regions; WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern but has not equated it with a COVID-19-like pandemic. The US has intensified screening and traveler monitoring from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan; CDC reports no confirmed Ebola cases in the United States and current risk to the general population remains low. Operationally, authorities must rapidly scale screening and monitoring while safeguarding data privacy, with issues of data minimization, purpose limitation, access controls, and auditability. ECDC and national agencies work on risk analyses and guidelines. The article suggests more than 500 suspected cases as a scale of the outbreak's momentum.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：前CDC長官がパンデミック拡大を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的な広がりリスク、重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的な渡航制限の実施が確認される。WHOも国際的懸念事項として公開衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダとスーダンへの言及がありますが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外しました。DRCのみが対象国です。500疑い例以上という規模から、本アウトブレイクは重要度が高い状況です。前CDC長官による警告とWHO宣言により社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: Über 900 Ebola-Verdachtsfälle in DR Kongo | Berliner Sonntagsblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: Over 900 Ebola-suspected cases in DR Congo | Berliner Sonntagsblatt
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) has exceeded 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed, as of May 25, 2026. The epicenter Ituri is amid ongoing conflict affecting nearly five million people. Violence drives displacement and hampers contact tracing and delivery of care; health and humanitarian workers are also forced to flee. Uganda is also affected by the outbreak. The WHO has declared an international public health emergency, with the African Union following with a continental emergency. The report emphasizes urgent needs for humanitarian assistance, improved surveillance, and risk communication in a context of insecurity and mistrust that threatens outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疑似患者が900人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模発生、国際的拡大（ウガンダ）、渡航制限リスク）。WHO及びアフリカ連合による緊急事態宣言があり、高い政治的関心。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（イツリ州）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダも「アウトブレイクの影響を受けている」と述べられているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（GeoNames ID不明確）が含まれていないため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。WHO及びアフリカ連合による公式な緊急事態宣言が発出されており、紛争地域での制御困難性が指摘されている。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Число зараженных Эболой в ДР Конго приближается к тысяче - ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in the DR Congo is approaching one thousand - WHO.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reported that Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 900, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases. The update, issued on Monday, confirms an ongoing outbreak in the DR Congo and that case numbers are approaching the thousand mark. The only figures cited are these counts, with no further breakdown of regions affected, outcomes, or transmission details provided in the brief. This briefing reflects internationally reported numbers as of May 25, 2026. Sourced from the World Health Organization and distributed by Interfax from Brussels, the briefing highlights the Ebola situation in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が千人に近づく - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上深刻な影響を持ち、DRC での900件超の確認患者は異常・予想外であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはBrussels/Belgiumも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCでのエボラ発生であり、ブラッシュアイズはWHO情報配信地点と考えられるため verified_locations から除外。DRCは対象国リストに含まれないが、エボラの大規模アウトブレイクとして極めて重大な懸念事象であり、PICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Focar scăpat de sub control. Peste 900 de cazuri suspecte de Ebola în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Outbreak out of control. More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, including 101 confirmed, with Bundibugyo Ebola circulating in the eastern region and more than 134 deaths. The Ituri province remains the epicenter amid ongoing armed conflict that hinders case finding, contact tracing, and timely care; nearly 5 million residents live amid conflict, with 1 in 4 needing humanitarian aid and 1 in 5 internally displaced. An American citizen was evacuated to Germany for treatment. Tests for Ebola variants indicate Bundibugyo spread undetected for weeks, while earlier tests were negative for other strains. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warns of a rapidly expanding outbreak. Experts, including Helen Clark, urge a thorough investigation of the response and lessons to bolster future pandemic preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能に。コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する。確認患者101人、疑い患者900人以上、死亡134人以上の深刻な公衆衛生影響。ブンディブギョ型エボラの予想外な拡大。国際的な患者移動（米国市民のドイツへの搬送）と拡大リスク。WHO事務局長による緊急警告。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州での流行を主題としている。ドイツへの患者搬送は国際的な拡大リスクを示すが、ドイツはWPRO対象国外のため検証位置には含めない。武装紛争による対応困難、人道支援需要、WHO事務局長による公式警告などから社会的・政治的関心は極めて高い。スクリーニング基準5項目すべてが該当し、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: de nouvelles mesures pour tenter de d'endiguer Ebola, dix jours après l'annonce d'une nouvelle épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: new measures to try to contain Ebola, ten days after the announcement of a new outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports its 17th Ebola outbreak, as of May 25, 2026, centered in Ituri with cases in North and South Kivu. Current data: 904 suspected cases and 220 suspected deaths; 101 confirmed cases and 10 confirmed deaths in the east. From May 23–24, authorities tightened measures: Uganda suspended flights to Kinshasa; Bunia–Kinshasa flights halted; Bunia gatherings over 50 banned; CAR boosted border surveillance. AFC/M23 ordered a 21-day isolation for arrivals from Ituri. Critics warn air bans may be ineffective as people travel by road to Beni or Kisangani. Displacement in Ituri: over 980,000 IDPs; Bunia hosts 38,000 across seven sites; camps suffer water shortages and overcrowding; PPE scarce. OCHA notes water points exist but are insufficient; handwashing and distancing campaigns ongoing. In Goma, Nord-Kivu, one Ebola case; health workers trained by International Medical Corps.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：新しいエボラ流行宣言から10日後、エボラの封じ込めを試みるための新措置
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限実施）。17回目のエボラ流行宣言、確定患者101名・死亡10名、複数国での対応措置が取られている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ（226074）と中央アフリカ共和国（239880）も記載されているが、記事サマリーでは対象国がDRCのみであるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダはフライト停止措置を取っているが、発生地域としての確認記述はない。複数州での患者・IDPの大規模移動、国際的な旅行制限措置（ウガンダのフライト停止、国内フライト禁止、集会制限）が実施されており、国際支援体制が必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: Empresas y ciudadanos chinos redoblan prevención ante el avance del ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chinese companies and citizens step up prevention in response to the spread of Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola continues to spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) toward Uganda. As of May 25, 2026, the DRC has 82 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, with WHO noting the true burden likely higher—about 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths; Uganda reports 5 cases. Bunia, capital of Ituri province, is the epicenter, and the DRC has suspended all passenger flights to and from Bunia. China has intensified precautions in affected areas, and Chinese travelers to China from the RDC and Uganda face 21 days of self-monitoring. In the DRC, companies tightened measures: masks, handwashing, temperature checks, and no nonessential travel, with gloves for cash handling. WHO has deployed 22 field staff, released $3.9 million, and teamed with Africa CDC on a continental incident-management structure; national Ebola risk is 'very high,' global risk 'low'.

triage.headline_ja: 中国企業と市民がアフリカでのエボラ拡大に対する予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大、国際的拡大リスク）。複数国での確認症例、高い死亡率、渡航制限実施、WHO活動開始を示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題としており、ウガンダへの拡大についても言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため含めない。中国はリスク対応の文脈でのみ言及されており、発生地は含めない。エボラの高い致命性、複数地域への拡大、国際的な渡航制限、WHOの資源投入による対応が確認され、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Wirus ebola. Gwałtowny wzrost możliwych zakażeń. Pogrzeby bez udziału rodzin
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus. A rapid rise in potential infections. Funerals without family involvement.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province around Bunia, shows a rapid rise in suspected infections. As of May 24, 2026, the Ministry of Health reported 904 suspected Ebola cases, up from about 700 earlier, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. While regional tallies indicate 119 deaths, Associated Press data cited 220 Ebola-related deaths. The outbreak involves Bundibugyo ebolavirus for which there is no vaccine; after the first fatality in late April in Bunia, tests for more common Ebola types were negative, leaving Bundibugyo undetected for weeks. Violent conditions have impeded response; authorities have ordered state-organized funerals without family participation to reduce transmission. WHO warns that Ituri's ongoing conflict, affecting almost 5 million people with widespread displacement, creates very high outbreak risk in DRC but low global risk. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; incubation 2-21 days; mortality 30-90% by strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス。可能性のある感染の急速な増加。家族参加なしの葬儀
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例を伴う急速な流行増加、高い致死率、地域紛争による対応困難が公衆衛生上深刻な影響を呈し、国際的な懸念を生じさせている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant（ワクチン未開発）による流行。904疑似患者、101確認患者、119～220死亡（情報源により異なる）。5百万人以上が影響を受ける地域紛争が対応を著しく阻害。WHO評価では地域リスク高い一方、グローバルリスク低い。葬儀制限など社会的対応が実施中。
