article.articleHeadline: GIS wydał pilny komunikat po doniesieniach o Eboli. Wiadomo, co z Polską
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: GIS issued an urgent communiqué after reports of Ebola. It is known what this means for Poland.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Poland's Chief Sanitary Inspectorate (GIS) issued an urgent communiqué after Ebola reports, with outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Sudan, and Uganda. Ebola transmits via direct contact with bodily fluids and is not airborne; mortality for some strains can reach 50–90%, underscoring rapid identification and isolation to limit international spread. Eight hantavirus infections and three deaths were reported aboard MV Hondius, from Argentina to the Netherlands; Poland reports no cases of that variant, with four people under surveillance. Captain Jan Dobrogowski will quarantine on return if well; otherwise, home quarantine applies. Poland's surveillance, diagnostics, and isolation procedures remain ready, with coordination among infectious-disease units. No travel restrictions; travelers should monitor MSZ updates and seek care if fever or weakness develops.

triage.headline_ja: GISがエボラの報告後に緊急通達を発出。ポーランドへの影響が判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラとハンタウイルスの同時報告、複数国での確認、国家レベルの対応実施により、フルRRA対象
triage.notes: 記事サマリーにはスーダン、ウガンダ、オランダ、アルゼンチン、ポーランドが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラの活発な流行地はDRCであり、他国はいずれも対象国外。ハンタウイルスは船舶（MV Hondius）での確定例だが、陸上での患者発生ではなく、対象国に限定される実際の感染症イベント発生地はDRCのみと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Вонреден сообраќај во СЗО: Прогласена меѓународна тревога поради смртоносниот сој на Ебола! - Навалица
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency alert at the WHO: An international alarm has been declared due to the deadly Ebola strain! - Rush.
article.articleSummary: On 25 May 2026, the World Health Organization declared an international health emergency over a deadly Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The outbreak, driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, has surpassed 900 suspected cases in Africa’s market and social epicenters, with 204 deaths confirmed. There is no licensed vaccine or definitive cure for this strain, and current case fatality is about 50%, with worst-case estimates up to 90% if cross-border transmission continues. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus urged rapid international response as local authorities had already declared an epidemic in mid-May. The report emphasizes the risk of regional spillover despite intensified containment measures, underscoring the urgent need for international cooperation and enhanced surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: WHO緊急警告：致命的なエボラ株による国際的警戒が宣言された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で懸念あり。致命的なブンディブギョエボラウイルス株による大規模アウトブレイク（900疑い症例、204死亡、致死率50-90%）で、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言しており、国際的対応が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが主要な発生地として明記されている。ブンディブギョエボラウイルス株は致死率が高く、ワクチンや確実な治療法がない点が重大。跨境感染リスクと地域的蔓延の危険性が指摘されており、WHO事務局長による緊急対応要請は国際的な関心が極めて高いことを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: AfDB meets under Ebola's cloud as Africa hunts for development cash at home
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo has prompted heightened concern for attendance at the African Development Bank’s annual meeting in Congo Republic, with the outbreak spreading to Uganda and more than 170 suspected deaths reported; Congo Republic reports no cases and WHO guidelines allow attendance. The event occurs as overseas aid to poorer countries fell to $174.3 billion last year, led by the U.S., highlighting funding pressures for Africa’s development needs. AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah promotes the New African Financial Architecture for Development (NAFAD) to close a roughly $400 billion annual financing gap by pooling Africa’s estimated $4 trillion in institutional capital (pensions, sovereign wealth funds, savings). Critics note Sub-Saharan savings around 18% and advocate leveraging domestic capital to attract foreign investment and de-risk projects. No attendance restrictions are in place per WHO guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影を背に、アフリカが国内開発資金を求めてアフリカ開発銀行会合を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の流行がコンゴ民主共和国からウガンダに拡大し、170人以上の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を複数満たし、フルRRA評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事ではコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行とウガンダへの拡大が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。アフリカ開発銀行年次総会がコンゴ共和国（対象国外）で開催予定であるため、この会場には含めない。記事の主題は複数国での流行であるが、対象国に限定するとDRCのみ該当。170人以上の死亡報告は重症度の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: már több mint 900 ebolagyanús esetre bukkantak a Kongói DK-ban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri Province is battling an Ebola Virus Disease outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths as of May 25, 2026, the outbreak first reported on May 15, 2026. The conflict-affected region, housing nearly five million amid ongoing violence, hampers contact tracing and early detection, complicating containment. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, increasing reliance on outbreak response measures. Violence extends to healthcare settings: a eastern hospital was attacked, and protesters burned relief tents after authorities did not hand over the body of an Ebola-related death to the family of a local footballer, Eli Munongo Wangu, per outbreak protocols. All new cases remain under investigation, highlighting the need for effective outbreak management in a fragile security context.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上のエボラ疑似患者が報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は最重要感染症であり、204人の死亡、紛争地域での流行拡大リスク、医療施設への暴力など重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV)による地域流行で、867件の疑似患者と204人の死亡が報告されている。Ituri州の紛争影響地域での発生により、接触者追跡と早期検出が困難化している。医療施設への暴力や社会不安が対応を複雑化させている。ワクチンと標的治療がないため、アウトブレイク対応に大きく依存している。

article.articleHeadline: SA scientists help African countries against deadly Ebola
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda faces limited diagnostics and no licensed vaccines or approved treatments for this strain. As of 25 May 2026, the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May amid fears of regional spread across Central and East Africa. Stellenbosch University researchers are providing epidemiological investigations, genomic surveillance, and diagnostics/therapeutics development through the Biomedical Research Institute, collaborating with the DRC’s Institut National de Recherche Biomédicale and the Africa CDC Emergency Consultative Group. Diagnostic systems often fail to reliably detect Bundibugyo, delaying isolation and contact tracing as samples are referred to specialized labs. Mortality for Bundibugjo Ebola can reach 40–50%, especially where healthcare is weak and treatment is delayed. Cross-border transmission risk exists due to regional trade and movement; NICD reports no confirmed cases in South Africa, and no current evidence of importation linked to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: SA scientists help African countries against deadly Ebola
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC and Uganda with WHO PHEIC declaration (17 May 2026)、高い死亡率（40-50%）、地域内拡大リスク、国際的関心と支援ニーズが明確。
triage.notes: 発生地域に複数国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC と Uganda での Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak である。対象国リストに DRC のみ含まれるため verified_locations は DRC のみ。Uganda は対象国リストに含まれていない。South Africa への言及は「確認症例なし」の否定的文脈であり、発生地ではない。WHO PHEIC 宣言（2026年5月17日）によりシグナル性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak stirs fears of Covid-style trade curbs in East Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda driven by Bundibugyo strain. As of May 21, 2026, at least 139 deaths and over 600 suspected cases across DRC and Uganda; Uganda confirms two cases, including one death, both Congolese nationals who crossed into Uganda. In response, Uganda suspends flights and other public transport to DRC for four weeks, suspends Semliki River ferry services, and halts cross-border road transport; all flights between the two countries to be suspended within 48 hours. Rwanda partly blocks the Congo border. WHO and Africa CDC advised against border closures. The border shutdowns threaten Northern Corridor trade, with Kenya and Tanzania heightening traveler screening and South Sudan struggling to police borders. The East African Community urges strengthened surveillance and a coordinated framework; Ugandan President Museveni criticizes media coverage, claiming Ebola is easier to contain than Covid-19 due to direct contact.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、東アフリカでのコロナ型の貿易制限への懸念をかき立てる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的発生、複数国での拡大、渡航・貿易制限実施）。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、急速な対応が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストに含まれるのはDRCのみが対象国。記事サマリーではDRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、南スーダンが言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）による600超の疑い例、139名の死亡、複数国への拡大という極めて重大な状況。ウガンダとルワンダの国境封鎖、フライト停止等の大規模な貿易制限が既に実施されている。WHO/Africa CDCの勧告に反した措置が取られており、地域的な政治的緊張も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mandatory 21-days quarantine, strict screening: Thailand issues fresh airport advisory amid massive Ebola outbreak in Africa
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes mandatory 21-day quarantine and pandemic-style screening for travelers from Ebola-affected Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda amid the 2026 outbreak. As of 22 May 2026, eight arrivals from Uganda and two from Congo were asymptomatic but quarantined. The World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola a public health emergency of global concern on 17 May, noting no approved vaccine or treatment. Across Africa the outbreak has over 900 active cases and about 119 deaths. Thailand classed Congo and Uganda as Ebola-affected zones, with a technical committee recommending quarantine for asymptomatic entrants from the two nations. India has tightened airport screening and quarantine for travelers from the affected region, and urged avoidance of Uganda, Congo and South Sudan. Ebola transmits via body fluids, not airborne, with a high fatality rate around 90%; safe burial practices are critical.

triage.headline_ja: タイが新たな空港勧告を発令：アフリカでのエボラ大規模流行に伴い、21日間の強制隔離と厳密なスクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）はWHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言しており、IHR基準2つ以上（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク）に該当。複数国での検出、死亡事例、高い致命率（約90%）があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはスーダンとウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は対象国内での検出状況（DRC、タイ、インド）に限定されているため、スーダンとウガンダは除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）により緊急性が高い。Bundibugyo株は承認済みワクチンや治療法がない。

article.articleHeadline: India advises against travel to DRC, Uganda, South Sudan amid Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: India advises all citizens to avoid non-essential travel to the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan amid the Ebola outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026, and an Emergency Committee meeting on May 22. Africa CDC designates it a public health emergency of continental security. The Bundibugyo strain causes severe viral hemorrhagic fever with a high mortality rate; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments. India reports no confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola cases. Authorities emphasize containment and surveillance as the primary defense. WHO recommends heightened surveillance at entry points, assessing travellers from affected areas, and discouraging travel to DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan. South Sudan, including Juba, is considered high risk due to shared borders with affected countries.

triage.headline_ja: インド、エボラ出血熱の流行に伴いDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの渡航を勧告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）に該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済みの新型エボラ（Bundibugyo株）アウトブレイク。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）、Bundibugyo株による新規アウトブレイク。インドがDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンへの渡航勧告を発出。サマリーでは South Sudan、Uganda に言及があるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず。DRC（203312）と India（1269750）のみ検証済み。Africa CDC が大陸規模の公衆衛生上の危機と指定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak 2026: What is Bundibugyo strain - Can it trigger the next pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in 2026 driven by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV) in Ituri Province, DRC, with over 900 suspected cases and more than 119 associated deaths as of 18 May 2026; cases have been confirmed in Uganda, including Kampala. WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). BDBV is a rarer Ebola strain, with a case fatality around 25–50%; no approved strain-specific therapy. Vaccines developed for the Zaire strain (Ervebo; Zabdeno/Mvabea) exist, but efficacy against Bundibugyo is unknown, and use is focused on high-risk individuals. Transmission requires direct contact with blood or body fluids, not airborne; safe burial practices are critical. Symptoms begin with fever, headache, GI symptoms, progressing to haemorrhagic manifestations. No pandemic is expected due to non-airborne spread, but Ituri’s humanitarian crisis and displacement complicate containment; international agencies are responding. Cross-border spread to Uganda underscores vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：ブンディブギョ株とは何か—次のパンデミックを引き起こす可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の株系統、国際的拡大リスク、WHO PHEIC宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）での確認事例あり。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの確認事例が「ケース」レベルで言及されており、主要な発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州）であると判断。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、900超の疑い事例、119名以上の死亡、稀な株系統、ワクチン効果の不確実性などから極めて高リスク。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго вспыхнула смертельная болезнь, от которой нет вакцины
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly disease has broken out in Congo, for which there is no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 900 suspected cases as of May 25, 2026, with 904 suspected and 119 deaths reported. The epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast; Bunia area hosts large IDP camps, raising risk of broader spread. The Ebola virus strain Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; mortality can reach about 90%. Transmission occurs from wildlife exposure and person-to-person via blood, secretions, infected fluids, and contaminated surfaces. Early symptoms include fever, marked weakness, muscle and headache; progression includes vomiting, diarrhea, kidney and liver failure, and both internal and external bleeding. Authorities restricted mass gatherings and funerals, with some burials performed by humanitarian workers under armed escort due to security concerns. Two Ebola treatment centers in the east were burned amid distrust and safety protocols. Nearly 1 million people have been displaced in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで致命的な病気が発生、ワクチンがない
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（904疑似例、119死亡）でIHR基準4つすべてに該当。致死率90%、ワクチンなし、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス亜型Bundibugyo、IDP キャンプでの拡大リスク、治療施設への不信感による焼き討ち事件、約100万人の避難民。セキュリティ情勢も懸念。フルRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: الاشتباه في أكثر من 900 حالة إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of 2026-05-25. Health authorities intensified border screening at the Modjibala checkpoint near Bunia, focusing on travelers from Mongbwalu, a mining town believed to be the outbreak’s epicenter, where the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola virus is involved. Measures include handwashing and temperature checks for vehicles and pedestrians crossing the Bunia–Mongbwalu corridor. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said surveillance has been ramped up in response to the outbreak, but the report provides no update on deaths. The situation reflects ongoing Ebola transmission in eastern DRC, with multiple suspected and confirmed cases, underscoring the need for continued laboratory confirmation and epidemiologic tracking.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス感染が900件以上の疑い例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルスの大規模な疑い例群が確認され、確定症例も報告されている。即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク。2026年5月25日現在で900件以上の疑い例（うち101件が検査確認済み）が東部DRC（Bunia、Mongbwalu地域）で報告されている。採鉱町Mongbwaluが震源地と推定され、越境拡大リスクが懸念される。WHOも監視体制を強化している。即刻のリスク評価と対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: L'OMS eleva a més de 900 el nombre de casos sospitosos d'Ebola a la RDC, amb més de 200 morts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the number of suspected Ebola cases in the DRC to over 900, with more than 200 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surged to more than 900 suspected or confirmed cases, with 204 deaths as of May 25, 2026. The epidemic, identified on May 15 and caused by the Bundibugyo variant, prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. A health worker disinfects a Bunia market in Ituri province, illustrating frontline response. The outbreak's epicenter is Ituri, including Bunia, with rapid spread challenging health systems. The neighboring Uganda has reported three new cases and five confirmed positives. The report notes the difficulty of controlling the response and provides no further laboratory confirmation details beyond the counts.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ疑い患者数を900人以上に引き上げ、200人以上の死亡者
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の大規模流行で、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。直ちにフルRRAに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。WHO PHEIC宣言済み。DRCが主要な感染国。ウガンダでも3例の新規確認と5例の確定例が報告されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCの流行にあるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo変異体による流行で、Ituri州（Bunia市が中心）が流行の中心地。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS eleva a más de 900 los casos sospechosos de ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the number of suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to more than 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, and 204 probable deaths reported as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no vaccines or approved antibody therapies. Violence and insecurity in Ituri hinder response efforts, displacing residents (about one-quarter needing humanitarian aid and one-fifth internally displaced) and complicating contact tracing and early case detection. The WHO and partners maintain presence across Ituri, including inaccessible areas, while warning of additional health threats facing residents. The virus is believed to have circulated undetected for months before recognition. Authorities stress the need for a comprehensive package of health services to sustain the response and build community trust in Ebola control measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主共和国コンゴのエボラ疑い患者数を900人以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo strain、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Wpro基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病の確認事例と複数の死亡報告があり、即座なRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による確認事例と204人の確定死亡例が報告されている。暴力と不安定性が対応を阻害し、検査未実施の潜在患者が数ヶ月間未検出であった可能性。WHO及びパートナーによる継続的な現場対応がある。即座のフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Сборная ДР Конго сыграет на ЧМ-2026 несмотря на вспышку Эболы: "Все игроки и большинство персонала живут и тренируются в Европе. Делегации рекомендовано готовиться к турниру"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo national team will play in the 2026 World Cup despite Ebola outbreak: "All players and most staff live and train in Europe. Delegations are advised to prepare for the tournament".
article.articleSummary: Despite an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the DR Congo national football team will compete in the 2026 FIFA World Cup. FECOFA canceled the Kinshasa training camp to align with outbreak precautions. An FECOFA–FIFA videoconference, with White House World Cup task force representative Andrew Giuliani, indicated the squad, staff, and supporters are expected to travel to the tournament; most players and much of the personnel live and train in Europe, reducing infection risk. To comply with U.S. safety requirements, Kinshasa preparations were halted, and staff who had flown to Belgium on May 20 will remain in Europe for at least 21 days before heading to the United States for the World Cup. FECOFA stated players and coaching staff adhered to sanitary measures mandated by American authorities, and delegations should prepare for the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行にもかかわらずコンゴ民主共和国代表は2026年ワールドカップに出場：「全選手と大多数のスタッフはヨーロッパで生活・訓練。代表団はトーナメント準備を進めるよう勧告」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の流行は言及されているが、本記事の主眼はサッカーのワールドカップ出場についてであり、感染症のヨーロッパ蔓延リスク、国内の流行拡大、重症者の大量発生などの公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は記述されていない。むしろスタッフの隔離措置により感染リスクを軽減している点が強調されている。
triage.notes: 記事は限定的なエボラ熱言及に基づくもので、実質的には大型スポーツイベント対応の記事。Kinshasa訓練キャンプのキャンセルと21日間の隔離措置により、選手・スタッフの感染リスクは低減されている。感染症の公衆衛生的危機を示す具体的なデータ（症例数、死亡者数、流行の進展)は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Andhra Pradesh Declares Ebola Alert Amid Rising Cases In Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Andhra Pradesh declares an Ebola alert as cases rise in Africa, following advisories by the World Health Organization and the central government. The state Health Department is screening passengers from Ebola-affected countries at Visakhapatnam, Tirupati and Vijayawada airports, with airport authorities and district medical teams coordinating to identify and monitor suspected cases. Symptomatic travellers who recently arrived from Congo, Uganda or South Sudan must inform health officials within three weeks of exposure. The government has established 15-bed isolation wards in teaching hospitals serving international airports and has stocked PPE kits and diagnostic testing kits for emergency use. Training sessions and virtual meetings are underway for all health workers, including ANMs and ASHA workers. Enhanced monitoring is being arranged for road travellers as well. Public advisories urge avoiding non-essential travel to the affected countries until further notice, underscoring readiness to handle Ebola emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: アンドラプラデシュ州、アフリカにおけるエボラ患者数の増加に伴いエボラアラートを宣言
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるエボラへの予防的警戒体制の宣言であり、現在のところインド国内での確認患者はない。アフリカでの発生を背景とした警戒・準備段階であるため、情報の続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数のアフリカ地域（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン）を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーの主題はインド・アンドラプラデシュ州における予防的警戒体制の宣言であり、インド国内での確認患者報告はない。記事は「アフリカにおける患者数の増加に伴い」と述べており、アフリカでの発生が背景にあるが、イベントの主要な発生地はインド（予防的対応）である。IHR基準は3項目以上該当するが、現在のところ実際の患者確認がなく、対応は予防・準備段階であるため、WATCH判定とした。続報でインド国内での患者確認があれば直ちにPICKUPに昇格させるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка лихорадки Эбола не помешает ДР Конго принять участие в ЧМ-2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak will not prevent DR Congo from participating in the 2026 FIFA World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo began in late April. By mid-May, WHO had declared a global public health emergency, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections reported. Despite the outbreak, FIFA and FECOFA approved entry to the United States for DR Congo’s squad and coaching staff to participate in the 2026 FIFA World Cup, confirming compliance with U.S. sanitary measures. Most players and much of the coaching staff reside in Europe, reducing apparent exposure risk; technical staff who left Kinshasa for a training camp in Belgium on May 20 will stay in Europe at least 21 days before departing for the U.S. for the tournament, which requires a 21-day quarantine for entry. Group K matches: Portugal on June 17 in Houston; Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara, Mexico; Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta. World Cup 2026 runs June 11–July 19 across USA, Canada, and Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行はコンゴ民主共和国の2026年FIFAワールドカップ参加を妨げない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：WHO緊急宣言・900疑い例以上・101確定例、異常性：新規アウトブレイク、国際的拡大リスク：複数国への選手配置）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当（重症度、異常性、流行可能性）。社会政治的関心も高い（国際スポーツイベントとの関連）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月時点で報告されたアウトブレイクであり、4月下旬より開始。WHO緊急宣言済み。複数国（ベルギー、ポルトガル、コロンビア、ウズベキスタン、USA等）への国際的な移動が関連している。ワールドカップ開催国（USA、カナダ、メキシコ）への選手派遣と検疫措置の関連から、国際的な保健上の課題として認識されている。記事で言及されている他国（USA、メキシコ、ベルギー、ポルトガル、コロンビア、ウズベキスタン、カナダ）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCのみ対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda hosts regional Ebola meeting as cross-border risks rise
article.articleSummary: Uganda is leading a regional Ebola preparedness effort as officials from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo and South Sudan meet in Kampala on May 22–23 to coordinate a cross-border response to the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola Virus Disease. Organized by Africa CDC with the WHO and UNICEF, the meeting aims to strengthen cross-border preparedness, improve response coordination, and align political leadership while finalising a joint regional plan to guide fundraising and harmonise strategies across affected and high-risk countries. The gathering reflects concerns about cross-border transmission in a region with porous frontiers and heavy population movement. Uganda reports one confirmed Ebola patient under treatment at Mulago isolation unit, with 127 health workers and identified contacts under quarantine. Authorities are intensifying contact tracing, laboratory testing and public awareness, and President Museveni discussed the response with Africa CDC, endorsing a plan for a continental Ebola Incident Management Support Team in Kampala.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが越境リスクの増加に対応するため地域エボラ会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確定患者発生、複数国にわたる地域的流行準備体制の構築、越境リスクの懸念があり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は3国の越境対応（ウガンダ、DRC、南スーダン）を述べているが、対象国リストに南スーダン（スーダン）が含まれていないため除外。ウガンダの確定患者1名、127名の接触者隔離、アフリカCDC・WHO・UNICEFによる地域的調整体制構築は重大なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : des femmes sensibilisées aux mesures préventives contre Ebola pour protéger les familles  - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: women made aware of Ebola preventive measures to protect their families - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, 25 May 2026 — Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo strain are reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda, with the World Health Organization declaring an International Health Emergency on 17 May 2026. The ACP report notes heightened global health risk yet no pandemic. In Kinshasa, a sensitization session for women and young members of an association urged adherence to preventive measures: regular handwashing with soap and water, avoiding contact with persons with symptoms, strict compliance with health authorities’ guidelines, and prompt reporting of suspected cases. Women were urged to serve as guardians of households and communities. The WHO cites aggravating factors including insecurity in eastern DRC, a humanitarian crisis, urban density in affected areas, and widespread informal medical networks that complicate disease surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：エボラウイルス感染症の予防措置について女性を啓発し家族を保護する - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の多国間アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）でWHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準で公衆衛生への深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・国際支援の必要性が明確に該当し、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCとウガンダの両国でのエボラアウトブレイク言及がされているが、対象国リストにウガンダ（GeoNames ID不在）が含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。記事の主体はキンシャサ（DRC首都）での啓発活動。2026年5月17日のWHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言は重大な信号。

article.articleHeadline: ВОЗ сообщила о 101 подтвержденном случае Эболы в ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO reports 101 confirmed Ebola cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports 101 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases among over 900 suspected infections after expanded outbreak surveillance, with the epicenter in Ituri Province where active population movement fuels transmission. The World Health Organization notes that insecurity and violence hinder medical response, prompting departures of patients, clinicians, and humanitarian workers from high-risk areas. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, one of the Ebola virus species. The WHO has declared the DRC–Uganda outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though the global risk is assessed as low. Vaccine development for the new strain could take up to nine months, and no vaccine is yet available for mass use. Ongoing surveillance and response efforts face access and safety challenges due to instability.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病の確認患者101例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の懸念事項として宣言した重大なエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC-ウガンダアウトブレイクと記載されているが、主な詳細と患者数はDRCに集中。ウガンダはスクリーンショット段階では患者数や詳細が記載されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（新規ワクチン開発は最大9ヶ月要）、治安悪化による対応困難が特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Diez factores que facilitan la veloz propagación actual del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ten factors that facilitate the current rapid spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting the World Health Organization to declare a public health emergency of international concern. By mid‑May, suspected cases and deaths were alarmingly high, suggesting weeks of undetected circulation. The acceleration is linked to several interrelated factors: initial symptoms mimic malaria, and rapid tests were calibrated for Ebola Zaire, yielding false negatives for Bundibugyo; Mongbwalu in Ituri is a key mining epicenter, with large-scale mining hubs across Ituri and in North and South Kivu that drive massive mobility of miners, merchants, and transporters, with cross‑border links to Uganda and South Sudan. Overcrowded, water‑ and sanitation‑poor camps, plus deforestation from mining, increase human–animal contact and local transmission. Ongoing conflict and armed militias hinder contact tracing and aid delivery; distrust and conspiracy theories prompt hiding of patients. Funeral rites involving washing and handling corpses remain high‑risk practices.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大を促進する10の要因
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo型がコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大し、WHOが国際的懸念事項に該当する公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダンへの越境感染の可能性）と深刻な影響が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで特定された発生地域：コンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州Mongbwalu、South Kivu州）。越境感染リスク言及地（ウガンダ、南スーダン）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Ebola Bundibugyo型の急速拡大、検査不正確性、採鉱活動による住民流動性増加、紛争による対応困難、葬儀習慣など複合要因により管理可能性が低い。

article.articleHeadline: رصدُ أكثر من 900 حالة إصابة اشتباه بإيبولا في الكونجو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monitoring more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reported that the Democratic Republic of the Congo is monitoring more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak concerns the rare Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus and has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC). The WHO warned that the risk of a national-scale outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is very high. Contributing factors include delayed case detection and the absence of vaccines or specific therapies for this strain, ongoing armed conflict, and high population mobility, all of which hinder surveillance and response. The update underscores the need for intensified surveillance, infection control, and coordinated public health actions to curb transmission and prevent further international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 民主共和国コンゴでエボラ出血熱の疑い患者900人以上を監視中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO公開の PHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言、高い死亡リスク、国際的拡大懸念、ワクチン/治療法の不在が確認されるため、即座にフルRRA対象とすべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain（希少株）、PHEIC宣言済み、101件の確認症例、900件以上の疑い患者、武力紛争による対応阻害、高い人口移動性により国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: ФИФА разрешила сборной ДР Конго сыграть на ЧМ, несмотря на вспышку Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA allowed the Democratic Republic of the Congo national team to play in the World Cup, despite an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: FIFA confirmed that the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) national team and coaching staff followed sanitary measures amid an Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak and may travel to the United States for the 2026 World Cup. In a May 23 videoconference, FECOFA said all selected players and most coaches live in Europe, minimizing infection risk; technical staff who left Kinshasa for Belgium on May 20 will remain in Europe for at least 21 days before joining the team in the U.S. U.S. authorities had mandated a 21-day quarantine before entry amid the Ebola outbreak. A new EVD outbreak began in the DRC in late April; WHO declared it a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. Over 900 suspected EVD cases and 101 confirmed infections have been reported. Congo is in Group K, facing Portugal (June 17, Houston), Colombia (June 23, Guadalajara), and Uzbekistan (June 27, Atlanta). World Cup runs June 11–July 19, 2026, across the United States, Canada and Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: FIFAはエボラ出血熱の発生にもかかわらずコンゴ民主共和国代表チームが2026年ワールドカップでプレイすることを許可
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のIHR基準3項目該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）、かつDRCでの活動中のアウトブレイク確認により、シグナルとして適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（2026年4月下旬発生、5月17日WHO公式宣言）であり、米国・メキシコ・カナダは国際スポーツイベント参加国としてのコンテキストのみで記載されている。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。101件の確認感染例と900件以上の疑い例報告あり、継続的なアウトブレイク状況と国際的な旅行制限措置（21日隔離）が実施されている点で、WPRスクリーニング基準全5項目が該当。

article.articleHeadline: مستشار رئيس الجمهورية: مصر خالية من الإيبولا وتشديد الرصد ورفع الجاهزية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Advisor to the President: Egypt is Ebola-free, intensified surveillance and heightened readiness - Youm7
article.articleSummary: Egypt is Ebola-free with no confirmed cases, but sustained surveillance at airports, seaports, and land borders. Dr. Mohamed Awad Taj El-Din, advisor for health and preventive affairs, emphasizes Ebola’s high danger and transmission via direct contact with infected blood, secretions, or body fluids, risking rapid spread without precautions. Outbreaks remain in Africa, notably the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, with rising suspected cases and case-fatality rates of 40–50%. Unsafe handling of corpses and breaking isolation practices contribute to spread. Egypt has a vigilant surveillance and isolation-plan framework; no domestic infections reported. No specific treatment exists; vaccines are under development. Prevention hinges on hygiene and avoiding contaminated surfaces. For Hajj/Umrah, pilgrims should avoid crowding, wear masks, and get meningitis and seasonal influenza vaccines at least 15 days before travel. Egypt continues cooperation with African nations on epidemic control.

triage.headline_ja: 大統領顧問：エジプトはエボラ出血熱から無感染、監視強化と警戒態勢引上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR通知基準を満たす極めて重篤な疾患だが、本記事はエジプト国内での感染確認がないことを強調しており、実際の発生イベントではなく予防対応の発表である。DRC・ウガンダでの流行は言及されているが主題ではなく、情報が限定的なため監視継続が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが提供した発生地域にはエジプト(357994)が含まれているが、記事サマリーではエジプト国内で確認感染例がなく、予防監視体制の強化発表が主題である。実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダであり、これらが対象国リストに該当するため verified_locations に含める。エジプトは対象国リスト外のため除外。エボラ出血熱の重篤性とIHR通知基準への該当は明確だが、エジプトでの『実際の発生イベント』ではないため、続報を注視する段階が適切と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Mais de 900 casos suspeitos ou confirmados na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: More than 900 suspected or confirmed cases in DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province. As of May 25, 2026, 204 probable deaths have been reported since the outbreak was declared on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence and displacement hinder response activities, with about one in four people in Ituri needing humanitarian aid and one in five displaced. Angola is among ten African countries at risk, alongside DR Congo and Uganda, according to Africa CDC. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC, including M23 rebels with alleged Rwanda backing, undermines control and contact tracing. The current outbreak involves a new Ebola strain (Bundibugyo) for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment; 30-50% case fatality rate per WHO. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, hemorrhages, vomiting, diarrhea, and weakness. Containment relies on prevention and rapid case detection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑い例または確定例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ワクチン・治療法なしの新規エボラ株（ブンディブギョ）による急速な感染拡大（204死亡報告）で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、10ヶ国への地域的脅威を示唆。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda、Rwanda、Angolaが列挙されているが、記事サマリーではこれらの国での確定的な感染例の報告はなく、「リスク国」または「隣接国」として言及されているのみ。したがってverified_locationsはDRC（対象国GeoNames ID 203312）のみとする。同地域での紛争・被害者移動、ワクチン・治療法不在、30-50%の致命率といった要因から、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Südamerikanischer Bodenpilz befällt Katzen - und anschließend auch Menschen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South American soil fungus infects cats—and subsequently humans as well.
article.articleSummary: Sporotrichosis, caused by the soil fungus Sporothrix brasiliensis, can be transmitted from cats to humans. Documented first in 2007, it circulates mainly in Brazil and other South American countries. A 2022 Uruguayan study found human cases across the country, with up to 35 people in some states. The fungus resides in open wounds of infected cats, enabling skin infection that begins as a non-painful red bump and may develop into multiple lesions as it spreads under the skin. Older people, children, and immunocompromised individuals are most at risk; joints or lungs are rarely affected. Antibiotics do not help; itraconazole is the preferred antifungal treatment. In Brazil, 2011–2022 recorded over 13,000 human cases. As of 2026-05-25, Europe’s risk is very low—three UK cases in 2022 likely from an imported Brazilian house cat; no confirmed German or neighboring-country cases in 2023. Travelers with a cat-contact rash in South America should consider this.

triage.headline_ja: 南米の土壌真菌が猫に感染し、その後人間にも感染する
triage.triage_reason: スポロトリコーシスは南米（ブラジル、ウルグアイ）で風土病的に流行しており、ブラジルで過去10年以上にわたり13,000件以上の人間感染例が報告されている。しかし現在のEurope地域での発生リスクは極めて低く、対象地域内では確認されていない状況のため、フルRRA前段階での監視継続が適切。
triage.notes: Sporotrichosis（スポロトリコーシス）は南米の風土病であり、ブラジルとウルグアイで記録されている。記事では2022年時点でウルグアイで複数州で最大35人の感染例が報告されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはブラジルのみ。European cases（UK 3例、ドイツ・隣接国で確認なし）は監視対象であるが、現在のリスクは低い。猫との接触がある旅行者への警告的報告性質。

article.articleHeadline: غيبريسوس: رصد أكثر من 900 حالة مشتبه بها بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديموقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ghebreyesus: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been detected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed, as of May 25, 2026. Ituri Province is the outbreak’s hotspot, home to about 5 million people amid ongoing conflict. About 25% of residents need humanitarian assistance, and one-fifth are internally displaced. Violence is driving people to flee, including health and humanitarian workers, severely hampering contact tracing and early detection. Ongoing insecurity and fear fuel mistrust within communities, complicating surveillance and reporting. The response has intensified monitoring, but no death toll is reported in the article. The situation shows how conflict-related displacement and attacks hamper Ebola response and risk further spread in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ゲブレイエスス事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例900件以上が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。確認例101例を含む900件以上の疑い例、紛争地域での流行拡大リスク、国際的懸念の高さから、フルRRAが必要なシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州での大規模エボラ流行。900件以上の疑い例と101件の確認例、進行中の武力紛争、大量の避難民、医療従事者の不足、接触追跡の困難性など、複数のリスク要因が重複。歴史的エボラ大流行（西アフリカ2014-2016）との比較可能性あり。WHOトップの言及により国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: African Development Bank Meeting Opens Under Ebola Shadow as Africa Seeks New Funding Model
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Central Africa casts a shadow over the African Development Bank's meeting in the Republic of the Congo on 2026-05-25. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports the outbreak has spread into Uganda with more than 170 suspected deaths; the Republic of the Congo reports no confirmed cases. WHO guidance says there are no Congo Republic restrictions, but regional transmission risk could affect attendance and investor participation. The outbreak underscores health crises' disruption to Africa's economy amid tightening overseas aid, as aid from wealthy nations fell sharply last year with the United States leading cuts to concessional lending to the AfDB. AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah promotes the New African Financial Architecture for Development (NAFAD) to mobilize domestic capital and close an estimated $400 billion development financing gap, arguing Africa's $4 trillion in savings remains fragmented. Critics warn capital cannot be redirected quickly; substantial international investment remains needed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影でアフリカ開発銀行会議が開幕、アフリカが新たな資金調達モデルを模索
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも4つ該当。死亡例を含む複数国での確認例があり、地域的な感染拡大が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づくと、エボラの発生は民主共和国（DRC）が中心であり、ウガンダへの拡大も報告されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。コンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）は確認例なしと記載されているため除外。アメリカはニュース配信地として記載されているだけで実際の発生地ではない。社会経済的な影響（開発銀行会議への影響）も報告されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: द्वन्द्वग्रस्त कंगोमा इबोलाले गहिरियो संकट, शंकास्पद केस ९ सय नाघ्यो
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in war-torn Congo faces grave crisis; suspected cases have surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a grave crisis as suspected cases exceed 900, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections as of 2026-05-25. The outbreak centers in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, spreading from rural Ituri to Bunia and Goma, while neighboring Uganda reports five cases and two deaths. The WHO notes Congo's outbreak carries a 'very high' risk domestically and Africa-wide is 'high,' though global risk remains low. Local misinformation persists; cocoa seller Helen Akilimali masks up publicly to counter belief that Ebola is not real, though some customers do not wear masks. The agency previously reported at least 177 deaths linked to Ebola in this outbreak. No symptom specifics or exact transmission pathways are detailed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 紛争地コンゴでエボラが危機深刻化、疑い例が900超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の多地域同時流行で国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの確認例）が明確であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と渡航制限リスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの確認例（5例、死亡2例）も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRC東部の流行。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に指定。紛争地域での流行という管理困難性と、国内ミスインフォメーション（エボラは実在しないという信念）が対策を複雑化。WHO評価で「国内は非常に高いリスク」「アフリカ全体は高リスク」と明示。

article.articleHeadline: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情高風險 男子持槍搶屍醫院大混亂 - 國際 - 自由時報電子報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High-Risk Ebola Outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Armed Man Robs Corpses, Hospital in Chaos
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in northeast Ituri Province, with 904 suspected cases reported by the Congolese Ministry of Communications, concentrated around Mongbwalu and other Ituri sites. The health crisis is marked by violence at facilities: on 23 May, a young man with a gun forced entry at Mongbwalu General Hospital demanding relatives' bodies, prompting evacuation. This followed arson of isolation tents and the 21 May torching of a Rwampara treatment center after families were refused custody. In the past week, three attacks on health facilities hampered containment; 18 suspected infections escaped Mongbwalu. WHO has elevated the outbreak to a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC); Congo risk is extremely high, global risk remains low. Authorities urge government-only handling of bodies and ban gatherings over 50; no confirmed death counts are reported.

triage.headline_ja: 民主剛果伊波拉疫情高風險 男子持槍搶屍醫院大混亂
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のPHEIC宣言、904例の疑似症例、暴力による医療施設の混乱、および国際的懸念の高まり。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大事象。
triage.notes: WHOがPHEIC宣言を発出済み。医療施設への暴力的行為（銃撃、放火）が流行対策を著しく阻害。ルワンダも同じ地域に隣接しているが、記事サマリーではDRC中心の記述であり、ルワンダでの発生確認は明記されていないため除外。グローバルリスク評価は低いが、DRC内リスクは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Naučnici otkrili uzrok smrtonosnog virusa: Sumnja na veći broj zaraženih, prethodni talas ubio 11.000 ljudi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scientists have identified the cause of the deadly virus: Suspicions about a larger number of infected people; the previous wave killed 11,000 people.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugjo Ebola virus strain drives the current outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with cases from Ituri to North and South Kivu and spillover in Uganda. Infections total five; deaths exceed 170 with 750 suspected in the DRC. Three Red Cross volunteers died in Ituri around March 27, marking among the first fatalities. The outbreak went unrecognized at first; Ituri has been circulating undetected for about two months. There is no vaccine or proven treatment for Bundibugjo; case fatality rate around 30-50%. WHO raised national risk to very high in the DRC and declared Ebola a PHEIC for DRC and Uganda; neighboring risk countries include Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, Republic of Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia. Modelling suggests over 900 cases, possibly more than 1,000. Fruit bats are suspected reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: 科学者が致命的なウイルスの原因を特定：感染者がさらに多いと疑われており、前回の波で11,000人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugjo株）の集団発生で、死亡170人超、疑い例750人、モデリングでは900〜1,000人以上の症例を予測。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。DRCおよびウガンダに対する国家リスクを最高度に引き上げた。
triage.notes: 記事では複数の隣接国がリスク国として列挙されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCおよびウガンダ（ウガンダはスピルオーバー例5件、死亡0）のエボラ集団発生。対象国リストに含まれるのはZambiaのみ。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、国家リスクを最高度に設定済み。果実コウモリがリザーバーと疑われている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo | Asemiehet rynnivät ebolasairaalaan vaatimaan kuolleita sukulaisiaan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo | Armed men storm an Ebola hospital to demand the bodies of their dead relatives.
article.articleSummary: Armed men attacked an Ebola treatment facility in Mongbwalu village, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, as violence surrounding the outbreak continued. The Sunday assault was the third attack on Ebola health care in the past week; gunfire forced staff to evacuate patients. The assailants demanded the bodies of two deceased relatives, and it was unclear whether anyone was injured. Because Ebola can spread via cadavers, such incidents complicate transmission control and safe burial efforts. On Friday, unidentified individuals set fire to an MSF camp tent where patients were treated, with about 18 potentially exposed fleeing the scene. Mongbwalu is experiencing a Bundibugyo virus variant outbreak, for which there is no approved vaccine or effective treatment. The African CDC chief called for restoring trust with local communities. The WHO reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases in DRC, about 100 confirmed; the health ministry lists more than 200 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ | 武装した男たちがエボラ病院に襲撃し、死亡した親族の遺体を要求
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、高病原性・異常な暴力的対応、国際的拡大リスク、貿易制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つ全て該当し、シグナルの定義を満たす。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョウウイルス）の変種による流行であり、ワクチンおよび有効な治療法が存在しない。複数の医療施設への攻撃（1週間に3件）により感染制御と安全埋葬が著しく阻害されている。遺体経由の感染リスクが高まっている。WHO報告では900件以上の疑い患者、約100件確認、200人以上の死亡。地域社会との信頼喪失が深刻な懸念材料。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）の実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế kích hoạt giám sát dịch Ebola, tăng cường ngăn dịch xâm nhập
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health activates Ebola outbreak surveillance, strengthens measures to prevent the disease from entering the country.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Ministry of Health activated Ebola outbreak surveillance and tightened measures to prevent entry. Despite low risk, authorities ordered intensified border, community surveillance to detect suspected cases, and to monitor travelers from affected regions for 21 days. Hospitals must isolate suspected cases and send specimens to the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for confirmation; enforce infection control and PPE; ensure proper burial of fatalities. Local agencies should train staff, rehearse border and community response, and maintain personnel, medicines, reagents, and equipment. The MoH asked Pasteur Institute and the Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology to monitor global Ebola developments and boost testing and biosafety. WHO notes Bundibugyo Ebola in Congo and Uganda; by May 22 about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths; two imported Ugandan cases; May 17 PHEIC; risk very high for affected countries, high in Africa, low globally including Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がエボラ出血熱の発生監視を活性化、国への侵入を防ぐための対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで予防的監視体制が構築されているが、同国では症例確認なし。DRC・ウガンダでの流行は重大だが、記事の主題はベトナムの準備・防止措置であり、現在のベトナムでのリスク評価は低い。IHR基準は満たさないが、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・流行可能性・管理可能性）に該当し、進展監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は主にベトナムの予防的対応について述べているが、サマリー内ではDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo Ebola流行（750疑似症例、177死亡）が背景として言及されている。WHOはアフリカでのリスク評価を『非常に高い』としているが、ベトナムを含むグローバルリスクは『低い』と評価。現時点でベトナムでの確定症例報告なし。Ho Chi Minh Cityは記事源URLの発行地であり、疾患発生地ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: WHO warns as Congo Ebola outbreak surpasses 900 suspected cases
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), with 101 confirmed infections in Ituri province, the outbreak's current center. More than 200 deaths among 867 suspected cases have been tallied in the latest official counts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed the rising numbers as the outbreak extends in eastern Congo. The WHO has raised the public health risk from high to very high. Ituri, home to about 5 million people, remains the epicenter amid conflict-affected conditions; approximately a quarter of Ituri's residents require humanitarian aid and about 20% are displaced. The update signals a sharp escalation in infections linked to the outbreak, underscoring strained healthcare systems across affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが警告 コンゴのエボラ疫病が900件の疑い患者を超過
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患の確認症例と多数の死亡、国際的懸念の高まり、地域紛争下での蔓延リスク、WHO公衆衛生リスク評価の引き上げから、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患（確認症例101、疑い症例900超）の活発な流行。Ituri州を中心にした地理的拡大。WHO公衆衛生リスク評価が「高」から「非常に高い」に引き上げられたことは、国際的懸念の最高レベルを示唆する。紛争の影響と人道的危機が蔓延拡大の要因。

article.articleHeadline: بیش از ۹۰۰ مورد مشکوک به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-25, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed infections. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, home to about five million people, and has expanded to three provinces. Health authorities report failures in tracing contacts of exposed individuals, undermining containment efforts. The situation signals ongoing transmission and highlights surveillance, testing, and public health response gaps in the affected regions. Ituri’s large population and the spread to multiple provinces suggest escalating challenges for outbreak control and resource allocation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス疾患の疑い例が900件以上報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は国際的に重大な懸念であり、複数州への拡大と接触者追跡の失敗が報告されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患は IHR 附属書 2 における指定感染症であり、自動的に高リスクと判定される。記事から以下の懸念事項が確認される：(1) 確認症例 101 件を含む疑い例 900 件以上、(2) イツリ州約 500 万人を含む複数州への拡大、(3) 接触者追跡失敗による継続的感染、(4) 防疫・検査・公衆衛生対応のギャップ。発生地域は DRC（GeoNames ID: 203312）のイツリ州であり、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。即時フルリスク評価（RRA）推奨。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática do Congo tem mais de 900 casos suspeitos de ebola, afirma OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo has more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed, as of May 24, 2026, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever transmitted by direct contact with infected bodily fluids, potentially causing severe bleeding and multi-organ failure. A prior DR Congo Health Ministry update reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces, though Tedros did not provide updated mortality figures in the latest post. The report highlights intensified surveillance in response to the outbreak, with no details on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例900例以上、WHO報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。Bundibugyo Ebola virus による確認例101例、疑い例900例超、死亡204例という深刻な公衆衛生影響。ワクチン・承認治療なし。国際拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: UK hospital staff 'drowning' due to hantavirus patients isolating after cruise
article.articleSummary: Britons aboard the hantavirus-stricken MV Hondius are isolating in a dedicated block on the grounds of Arrowe Park Hospital in Wirral, Merseyside, fueling staff claims that resources are being diverted to this national hantavirus response. A&E personnel report severe overcrowding—up to 95 patients in the waiting room at times, with patients in corridors and back of ambulances—while managers and matrons are redeployed to support the isolation project. The Wirral University Teaching Hospital Trust says there is no prioritisation of the hantavirus initiative and that all services have continued to operate normally; daily staff safety briefings and welfare reviews are conducted, and ambulance handovers have remained under an hour in May. The isolation site forms part of a nationally led hantavirus response and is linked to preventing further spread, with the block previously used to house Wuhan returnees during the Covid-19 pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: 英国病院スタッフがハンタウイルス患者の隔離対応で『溺れている』状態に クルーズ船帰港後
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルス感染症の集団事例がMV Hondius号で発生し、英国の医療システムに重大な負荷をもたらしている。国家レベルの対応が実施されており、異常・予想外の事態として医療資源の逼迫を招いている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はMV Hondius号でのハンタウイルス感染集団発生であり、患者がWhiston（英国）のArrowe Park Hospital に隔離されている。発生地域にはWuhan（中国）が含まれるが、記事サマリーではWuhan返還者を受け入れた過去の施設利用について言及されており、現在の事例の発生地は船舶と英国である。しかし、ハンタウイルス感染の起源地が中国（Wuhan）に関連している可能性があり、対象国リストに基づきChinaを verified_locations に含める。英国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Région Sud/Port de Rumonge : Peur panique de contamination par le virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Southern Region/Port of Rumonge: Panic over Ebola virus contamination
article.articleSummary: Port of Rumonge, Burundi, faces panic over Ebola virus disease following confirmation of the disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo. No containment infrastructure is in place: two nurses assigned to screen entrants lack an appropriate triage area, and the port buildings for Ebola surveillance were washed away by rising Lake Tanganyika waters, complicating monitoring. Local merchants and port workers express fear and highlight insufficient equipment, few informative campaigns, and limited handwashing facilities—only one faucet for hundreds of daily passersby. Latrines have been destroyed; sanitation and cross-border movement have increased, raising transmission risk. The Rumonge communal risk management platform is on alert; authorities urge reporting of symptoms and evacuation of suspects to nearest health facility. Population advised to observe hygiene, avoid bush meat, and refrain from touching dead animals or bodies without protection.

triage.headline_ja: 南部地域/ルモンジュ港：エボラウイルスによる汚染への恐慌
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。ブルンジのルモンジュ港で確認されたエボラウイルスは、対象国DRCでの確定例と隣接し、国際的には限定的だが地域的に深刻な脅威。脆弱なインフラと国境を越えた移動リスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはブルンジのルモンジュ港でのパニックと脆弱なインフラを記述しているが、実際のエボラ確定例はDRCで確認されたものである。Bluedot APIが列挙したCaliforniaはこのイベントの対象ではなく、ブルンジは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。国際的拡大リスクは隣接するブルンジへの波及リスク、および港での国境越え活動の増加に起因。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases cross 900 in DR Congo, WHO warns - The Sun Nigeria
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surpassed 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed infections, WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said on May 25, 2026, after the government declared the outbreak on May 15. The surge centers on the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In a previous situation report, DR Congo reported 204 deaths across three provinces and 867 suspected infections; current figures show more than 900 suspected and 101 confirmed. Ebola is transmitted by direct contact with infected bodily fluids and can cause intense bleeding, multiple organ failure, and death if not contained. The renewed outbreak is unfolding in insecure, humanitarian-challenge areas, hampering contact tracing and treatment access. triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。確認患者101名、疑い患者900名超、死亡204名の深刻な公衆衛生影響。ワクチンなし（Bundibugyo株）で管理困難。

article.articleHeadline: الوباء ينتشر بسرعة.. 900 إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The epidemic is spreading rapidly... 900 cases of Ebola virus infection in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, with about 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed cases reported by the WHO as of May 25, 2026. There is no vaccine available for the current Congo strain. The surge in transmission raises cross-border concerns to neighboring countries, notably Uganda and South Sudan, and officials warn that actual cases may be higher due to limited testing and healthcare capacity. Primary symptoms include fever, vomiting, and severe diarrhea, progressing to dehydration and shock. Transmission is predominantly human-to-human, and the virus can persist after death, enabling infection through contact with the deceased or their belongings. No specific infection source is identified in the report; emphasis is on surveillance, testing, and border vigilance to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症が急速に拡大..コンゴでエボラウイルス感染者900人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ・南スーダンへの懸念），渡航制限リスクが明確。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認症例101例、疑い例900例という重大な数値。記事では「ウガンダ・南スーダンへの懸念」が述べられているが、サマリー上では感染症イベント自体がコンゴで発生・拡大している状況が主題であり、ウガンダ・南スーダンは隣接国への波及懸念のコンテキストのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。発生地域フィールドに含まれるウガンダ・スーダンについては、記事サマリーで『確認されている』ではなく『懸念されている』との文脈であるため、現時点では除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : la Fondation Gates débloque 15 millions de dollars pour soutenir la riposte en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the Gates Foundation releases $15 million to support the Ebola response in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Gates Foundation announced a $15 million emergency package to bolster the Ebola response in Africa amid the Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The funds are divided into three equal tranches: $5 million to Africa CDC for regional coordination, rapid deployment, and cross-border surveillance; $5 million to WHO AFRO for frontline operational support to affected countries; and $5 million to WHO HQ for rapid procurement, diagnostics, and emergency logistics for essential response products. The Foundation stresses the need for a coordinated regional response, noting that no country or institution can stop an outbreak alone. It also reiterates that there is currently no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, prioritizing rapid case detection, stringent public health measures, frontline protection, and a unified, rapid response. The Gates Foundation also supports CEPI and the Joint Emergency Action Plan (JEAP) to enhance coordination.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ゲイツ財団がアフリカでの対応を支援するため1500万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョ株エボラの流行が複数国で発生しており、国際的拡大リスク、国境を越えた感染リスク、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響が明らかであり、フルRRA実施の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの言及がありますが、Bluedot APIの発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダ（id: 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。ただしサマリーの記述から複数国での流行が示唆される点は重大。ブンディブギョ株エボラはワクチン・治療法がなく、国際的な支援体制が既に構築されている。

article.articleHeadline: Virus gori od hantavirusa kosi sve redom! SZO se hitno oglasila dramatičnom porukom: Stotine slučajeva, širi se jezivom brzinom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virus deadlier than hantavirus is mowing everyone down! WHO urgently issues a dramatic message: Hundreds of cases, spreading at a terrifying rate.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. As of 25 May 2026, DRC reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, concentrated in eastern regions, notably Ituri, with cross-border transmission to Uganda; Uganda has two confirmed cases and one death as of 21 May. The WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Transmission occurs via blood, bodily fluids, or infected tissue, with high risk from unsafe burials, informal caregiving, and delayed detection. Health workers face shortages of protective gear amid conflict, displacement, and distrust, complicating isolation, contact tracing, and safe burials. The Bundibugyo strain lacks the same vaccines or therapies available for previous Zaire Ebola strains, necessitating rapid international response. The outbreak is not pandemic, but requires urgent action to prevent further spread across borders.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスより危険なウイルスが猛威！WHOが緊急声明：数百の症例、恐ろしい速さで拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の多国間アウトブレイク。IHR基準4つすべて該当し、WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国でないため verified_locations に含めない。記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国が主要な発生地で、確認例900超、死亡101例（疑い例含む）、またはウガンダ2確認例との記載だが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo株は既存ワクチン・治療薬が未対応であり、特に懸念。WHOの国際保健上の緊急事態（PHEIC）宣言により、社会政治的関心も最大。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde 900'den fazla şüpheli Ebola vakasının görüldüğü bildirildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed, have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, the outbreak's epicenter amid ongoing conflict affecting about 5 million people and displacing one in five. The outbreak was declared on May 15 after 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported in Ituri; the World Health Organization followed with a May 17 declaration of a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The current outbreak is linked to a rare Bundibugyo Ebola variant, for which there is no approved treatment or vaccine. Ebola causes hemorrhagic fever; historical outbreaks show high mortality. Authorities warn that insecurity and population displacement impede surveillance, contact tracing, and provision of care, hindering control efforts in Ituri and across eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で900例以上の疑似エボラウイルス患者が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模なアウトブレイク（900例超、確定例101例、死亡65例）がDRCで報告され、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として認識される。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（稀な株）で治療法・ワクチンなし。イトゥリ州での紛争が約500万人に影響し、サーベイランス・接触者追跡・医療提供を阻害している。5月15日のアウトブレイク宣言時点では246例疑似例、65死亡。

article.articleHeadline: Dsö: Kongo Demokratik Cumhuriyeti'nde 900'ün Üzerinde Şüpheli Ebola Vakası Tespit Edildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: The World Health Organization reports over 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in DRC as of May 25, 2026, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak center is Ituri Province, where millions live amid ongoing conflict. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence drives people to flee, impeding contact tracing of Ebola-exposed individuals and timely provision of supportive care. The security situation and fear are fueling distrust between communities, and continue to hinder outbreak response. About 5 million people in Ituri face insecurity, with roughly one in four needing humanitarian aid and one in five displaced domestically. Laboratory confirmation stands at 101, with no explicit infection source disclosed in the article.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上のエボラ疑い患者が特定されたと報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の大規模発生（900件以上の疑い患者、101件確定）であり、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。重症感染症、異常事態、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）でのエボラ発生を明確に主題としており、イツリ州は同国内の地域。対象国リストに DRC (203312) が含まれるため verified_locations に含める。紛争地域での保健危機であり、連絡先追跡困難、住民流出、コミュニティ間の不信が対応を阻害している。WHOの懸念表明により国際的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mondial 2026 : la RDC rassure la FIFA face à Ebola et sur la santé des Léopards
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: DR Congo reassures FIFA amid Ebola concerns and the Leopards' health.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reassures FIFA amid Ebola concerns as Leopards prepare for World Cup 2026. An Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province was declared an international health emergency by the WHO on May 15. The WHO reports approximately 600 suspected cases and 139 suspected deaths, with global spread risk deemed low. On May 23, FECOFA and FIFA confirmed the Leopards and coaching staff comply with U.S. health entry requirements; all players are based in Europe and left Kinshasa on May 20 to satisfy the 21-day isolation window before entering the United States. Kinshasa regrouping was canceled; training will be held in Belgium. U.S. rules require a bubble and isolation for new arrivals, with potential impact if symptomatic. Some Congolese supporters face visa refusals due to Ebola-related restrictions, with FIFA considering refunds. The Leopards open Group K against Portugal on June 17 in Houston, their first World Cup match since 1974.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026：エボラウイルスへの懸念とレオパード（コンゴ代表）の健康状況についてコンゴ民主共和国がFIFAを安心させる
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラアウトブレイク（600疑い例、139死亡）が国際的保健上の懸念として報告されているが、記事の主題はワールドカップ2026の準備状況であり、疾患制御の進捗や国際的な感染拡大リスクについての具体的な新情報が不足しており、WHO既報の内容の繰り返しである。
triage.notes: 発生地域にHouston(米国)、Belgium、Portugualが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri Province）のエボラアウトブレイクであり、米国・ベルギー・ポルトガルは選手の移動先または試合開催地に過ぎず、感染症イベントの発生地ではない。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみとした。IHR基準は2つ該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するが、本記事は既知のアウトブレイク（5月15日WHO宣言済み）と既に報道されている内容をスポーツイベント絡みで再報道した二次情報であり、新規シグナルとしての価値が限定的。続報で疾患の流行状況に新たな変化があるか注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: " Alerte générale " : un hôpital accueillant des patients d'Ebola pris d'assaut par des proches de victimes en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: General alert: a hospital receiving Ebola patients overrun by relatives of victims in the DRC
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, Mongbwalu General Hospital was attacked Sunday by relatives seeking the bodies of two relatives, marking the third such assault on health facilities in a week. The hospital is treating Ebola patients linked to the Bundibugyo virus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment; case fatality can approach 50%. Transmission occurs through contact with fluids from the sick (blood, vomit, stool), especially among healthcare and funeral workers lacking appropriate protection. Dr. Richard Lokudu, hospital medical director, said gunfire forced evacuation of patients and staff as the facility went on high alert. Resource-poor settings hamstring outbreak response, with more than 900 people now suspected to have Ebola in DRC. The latest ministry tally reported 867 suspected cases and 204 deaths; the WHO has declared an international health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: 「一般警報」：エボラ患者を受け入れている病院がコンゴ民主共和国で犠牲者の親族に襲撃される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病で公衆衛生への深刻な影響（867疑い例、204死亡、致死率50%に近い）、異常/予想外のイベント（病院襲撃、患者避難）、国際的拡大リスク（WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言）、渡航・貿易制限リスク。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス、ワクチンなし。医療従事者および葬儀従事者間での感染リスク高い。病院襲撃により感染制御が著しく阻害されている。WHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言済み。資源不足の地域での対応が課題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak: Over 900 Suspected Cases, India Issues Travel Advisory; 10 Major Updates
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and Nord-Kivu) and Uganda on 15 May 2026, with WHO declaring a health emergency of international concern on 16 May. The surge is driven by the Bundibugyo strain; no approved vaccines or specific treatments exist. By 24 May, WHO and CDC counts exceed 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed cases, with 119 suspected deaths and 10 confirmed deaths in DRC; Uganda reports 5 confirmed cases and 1 death. The epicenter remains Ituri, with transmission spreading to Sud-Kivu Province, signaling community transmission. On 23 May, Uganda added three laboratory-verified cases, bringing total to five. WHO risk assessment: very high nationally, high regionally, low. India issued traveler advisories for arrivals from Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; no cases in India, but airport screening and quarantine readiness are in place. Domestic measures: Andhra Pradesh and Tamil Nadu have heightened screening and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク：900件超の疑い患者、インドが渡航勧告を発出；10項目の主要な更新
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルスの国際的なアウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダで101確定例、119疑い死亡）、WHOが国際保健上の公衆衛生上の脅威を宣言、複数国への拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施がある。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にインドのAndhra PradeshとTamil Naduが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「インドには症例がない」と明記されており、インドは渡航勧告の発出国として列挙。DRC（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）がエボラウイルス病の実際の発生地域。ウガンダも確定例があるが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOが国際的保健上の脅威を宣言し、複数国へのリスク拡大と強力な社会政治的関心があることから、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Cronaca. Ebola in Congo: per l'esperto Rezza il rischio Europa è concreto ma gestibile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News. Ebola in Congo: according to expert Rezza, the risk to Europe is real but manageable.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda exceed 1,000 confirmed cases, centered in Ituri with MSF intensifying care and contact tracing alongside about 480 local staff; fifty international specialists are expected to join them. Three Red Cross volunteers died in Mongwalu after handling cadavers later found infected with the Bundibugyo strain. The WHO has raised Congo’s public-health risk from high to very high and warned of potential spread to about ten neighboring African states. The challenge includes maintaining essential medical services amid concurrent cholera, HIV, malaria, and measles outbreaks. In Europe, epidemiologist Gianni Rezza considers the continent at real but manageable risk, noting that spread would require intercontinental hubs or an asymptomatic carrier, with rapid isolation limiting danger.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース。コンゴのエボラ：専門家リッツァ氏によると、ヨーロッパへのリスクは現実的だが管理可能
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模集団発生、複数国への国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また、1,000件超の確認症例と複数の並行流行により、WPRO基準も複数該当。世界的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）での確認にも言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。複数の疾患（エボラ、コレラ、HIV、マラリア、麻疹）が同時進行しており、複合的なアウトブレイク状況。WHO が公衆衛生リスクを「高」から「極めて高」に引き上げ、約10の隣接アフリカ諸国への拡大リスクを警告している。国際的な対応体制（MSF、WHO、赤十字）が強化されている。

article.articleHeadline: OMS eleva a más de 900 los casos sospechosos o confirmados de ébola en la RDC - Mundo - ABC Color
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the number of suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC to over 900.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: The WHO reports the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected or confirmed cases, centered in Ituri province. Government figures indicate 204 deaths are probable. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence in Ituri is forcing people to flee, including health workers and humanitarian staff, severely hindering contact tracing and early detection of infections. About one in four residents in the affected area needs humanitarian assistance, and roughly one in five are internally displaced, complicating the response. The outbreak was declared on May 15, and transmission continues amid security challenges that limit access for responders. The EU and United States have urged warring parties in the DRC to permit a more effective Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、DRCのエボラ疑い例または確認例を900例以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。900例超の疑い例・確認例、204死亡、複雑な治安状況下での流行拡大。国際的な支援呼びかけあり。
triage.notes: 記事は明確にDRCでのエボラ流行を報告している。Ituri州が中心地。発生地域フィールドに米国が含まれているが、記事サマリー上では米国でのイベント発生は記述されていないため除外（米国は国際的懸念表明の主体として登場のみ）。900例超の急速な増加、204死亡、治安悪化による人口移動とヒト-ヒト感染リスク上昇、WHO緊急事態宣言後の継続流行など、重大な懸念事項が複数存在。

article.articleHeadline: مخاوف من احتمال تفشّي الإيبولا في الولايات المتحدة مع اقتراب كأس العالم
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Concerns about the possibility of an Ebola outbreak in the United States as the World Cup approaches.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus remains highly lethal, with mortality up to 90% in some strains. Symptoms include fever, diarrhea, vomiting, and potential progression to internal or external bleeding. With millions traveling to the United States for the World Cup, import risk rises due to a 21‑day incubation that hinders detection; a single case could trigger broad public-health actions and intensive contact tracing. The CDC is coordinating with FIFA to ensure safety and screening before June 11. The CDC raised Level 3 travel warnings for the Democratic Republic of Congo, restricting entry for recent travelers. In DRC, about 600 suspected cases and 139 deaths; this is the 17th outbreak, the third caused by Bundibugyo, a strain with no approved vaccine, unlike Zaire. Vaccines may offer partial protection; rapid mRNA approaches could take 3–6 months but may be less adaptable. Emphasis on surveillance, supply chains, and rapid response due to global connectivity.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップが近づく中、米国でのエボラ出血熱流行の可能性に関する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という高致死性疾患の国際的拡大リスク、米国への輸入リスク、World Cup開催に伴う国際的な人的移動増加により、シグナルレベルのリスク評価を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの現在のエボラ流行（第17回発生、Bundibugyo株、600疑似患者、139死亡）と米国へのリスク輸入について論じている。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。CDCとFIFAの調整、Level 3旅行警告、mRNA型ワクチン開発等の対応状況も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: 79岁丧偶大爷嫖娼从不戴套：年纪大不怀孕，怎料查出艾滋_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 79-year-old widowed man who pays for sex with prostitutes never uses a condom: too old to father a child, who would have thought he'd be diagnosed with HIV
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, China—A 79-year-old widower diagnosed with HIV after years of unprotected sex with women in their 50s–60s highlights a dangerous belief: old age means no risk. He had chronic COPD with recurrent infections; HIV screening was prompted by unusual inflammation, leading to diagnosis. The case mirrors a rising public health issue: elderly HIV infections are increasing in China. In Guangdong in 2024, about 20% of new HIV cases were 60 years and older; projections suggest seniors could account for roughly one-third of national infections by 2035. Shenzhen data for 2023 show nearly 200 new cases among those over 50 in the first 10 months, with men >70% and 99% sexually transmitted. Root causes include lack of protection and the view that older adults needn’t worry. China provides free first-line ART, annual HIV screening, and viral-load subsidies; treatment success exceeds 95% with proper adherence.

triage.headline_ja: 79歳の死別した男性が売春婦と性交渉の際にコンドームを使用しない：年齢が高いため妊娠しないと考えていたが、HIVと診断される
triage.triage_reason: 中国における高齢者のHIV感染増加という公衆衛生課題を報告した事例報告であるが、単一の症例に基づく記事であり、IHR基準に直接該当する新規の流行・集団発症ではなく、既知の傾向を示す報告である。情報不足が多く、引き続き経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 広州および深圳での単一事例報告に基づく記事。中国国内では既知のHIV感染増加傾向（特に高齢者）が背景にあるが、新規流行や国際的懸念を示す明確なシグナルではない。中国政府はART無料提供、年1回のスクリーニング、ウイルス量検査補助金などの対応策を実施している。公衆の関心は高い可能性があるが、公式なWHO通知基準や国家間の渡航・貿易制限リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: de nouvelles mesures pour tenter d'endiguer Ebola, dix jours après l'annonce d'une nouvelle épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: new measures to stem Ebola, ten days after the announcement of a new Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DRC authorities tighten measures to stem 17th Ebola outbreak, suspending air links between Bunia (Ituri) and Kinshasa to curb spread. The government says travel restrictions will lower transmission risk, but humanitarian actors warn they may slow the response and hinder access. Uganda’s national airline has suspended flights to Kinshasa since Sunday. Some say isolating Bunia by air is less effective while Beni (North Kivu) and Kisangani (Tshopo) remain reachable by road. In Bunia, gatherings of more than 50 people and funeral vigils are banned, though Sunday religious gatherings were reported. OCHA says Ituri hosts over 980,000 internally displaced people, with Bunia housing more than 38,000 across seven sites, including Kigonze and ISP, where conditions are overcrowded and water and hygiene facilities are scarce. In Goma, North Kivu, one Ebola case has been reported; International Medical Corps trains health workers to protect staff, with Virunga hospital isolation center providing PPE training.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：新しいエボラ出血熱流行宣言から10日後、エボラを抑制するための新しい措置
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は高い公衆衛生影響と国際拡大リスクを有し、IHR基準3項目以上該当。DRC内で複数地域における確認症例と流行対応の実施から、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 17番目のエボラ出血熱流行。複数地域（イツリ州ブニア、キンシャサ、北キブ州ゴマなど）で感染確認。内部避難民98万人以上が影響を受ける高リスク環境。航空便の運休など渡航制限実施中。ウガンダでも影響が及んでおり、国境を越えた拡大リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola casts cloud over AfDB meeting
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Uganda, with more than 170 suspected deaths; the Republic of Congo reports no confirmed cases and says there are no attendance restrictions for the AfDB annual meeting, per WHO guidelines. The gathering unfolds as overseas aid to poorer nations fell about 25% last year to $174.3 billion, led by the United States. AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah promotes the New African Financial Architecture for Development (Nafad) to raise development finance mainly from Africa’s own resources, arguing the continent has roughly $4 trillion in institutional capital that could fund infrastructure, energy, climate adaptation, and jobs. Critics note domestic savings in Sub-Saharan Africa (~18%) are too low to meet needs, suggesting capital should be leveraged to catalyze foreign investment and de-risk projects, while maintaining focus on development gaps and financing reform.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフDB会議に悪影響を及ぼす
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な地域間拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）が確認され、複数のIHR基準を満たす。150人以上の疑い死亡例があり、国際会議への影響も生じている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイクを明記しているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとなる。これはウガンダが対象国リストに含まれていないためである。アメリカ合衆国も発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリー上では援助額の文脈で言及されており、疾病発生地ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia di Ebola, l'Oms: in Congo oltre 900 casi sospetti e 204 morti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak, WHO: in the Congo over 900 suspected cases and 204 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no vaccines or specific treatments currently available. As of 2026-05-25, the WHO reports over 900 suspected cases identified, with 101 confirmed. The Congolese Health Ministry lists 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. Authorities officially declared the outbreak on May 15, and the WHO has activated an International Health Emergency alert. Bundibugyo Ebola can yield a case fatality up to about 50%.
