Historically, Ebola in Africa has caused more than 15,000 deaths over the past 50 years, with mortality rates ranging from 25% to 90% depending on the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、WHO：コンゴで900件以上の疑い例と204人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は最重症の感染症であり、高い死亡率（50%）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性を示す。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最重症感染症として分類される。Bundibugyo株による流行で、900件以上の疑い例、204人の死亡が報告されている。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がないことが課題。WHOが国際保健緊急事態アラートを発動済み。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Число зараженных Эболой в ДР Конго приближается к тысяче
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with Ebola in DR Congo approaches one thousand.
article.articleSummary: Cases of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 900, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, the World Health Organization reported on May 25, 2026. The outbreak is centered in the eastern province of Ituri, where ongoing violence and insecurity complicate response efforts. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said conflict-driven displacement forces people—including medical and humanitarian workers—to flee homes, hindering contact tracing, early case detection, and delivery of care. The situation highlights the challenge of expanding surveillance and outbreak control amid armed conflict, with limited ability to identify transmission chains and provide timely treatment. No details on imported or exported cases are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が1000人に近づいている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、900件超の確認症例、国際的拡大リスク、対応困難性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で肯定的。重大な感染症イベント。
triage.notes: 2026年5月の報告で、イトゥリ州を中心とした大規模なエボラ流行。武装紛争による人道的障害が対応を著しく阻害。WHO事務局長による公式声明あり。国際的なRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: War risks, 48°C heat, Ebola fears: What makes Hajj 2026 so complicated and why Saudi Arabia is on high alert- Moneycontrol.com
article.articleSummary: More than 1.5 million Muslims have arrived in Saudi Arabia for Hajj 2026 (May 25–29), with pilgrims from over 180 countries, including around 30,000 Iranians (well below pre-conflict levels). The event unfolds amid elevated security and public-health concerns: regional tensions involving Iran and the Strait of Hormuz raise disruption risks, and Saudi authorities have bolstered defenses with Patriot missiles, anti-drone tech, and layered interception—though debris from intercepts could threaten dense crowds. Extreme heat dominates Mecca, Mina, and Arafat, with daytime temperatures of 45–48°C and rituals demanding up to ~20 km of outdoor movement; cooling measures include misting systems, shaded pathways, water distribution, and expanded medical facilities (34 specialised centers and mobile units). Global health surveillance intensifies due to mass gathering and ongoing Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa, with WHO monitoring and heightened infectious-disease vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: 戦争リスク、48°C の熱、エボラ熱への懸念：2026年ハッジが複雑である理由とサウジアラビアが高度な警戒態勢にある理由
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の実際の発生がアフリカで継続中であり、ハッジという150万人規模の国際的な大規模集会での感染リスク懸念が述べられているが、現時点でハッジ自体でのエボラ確定症例や具体的な患者報告がなく、リスク評価段階にとどまる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はサウジアラビアのハッジ2026であり、エボラ熱はアフリカでの継続的な流行として言及されているが、ハッジ開催地（サウジアラビア、メッカ）での実際の発症は報告されていない。フィリピンは記事で具体的に言及されておらず、Bluedot APIの地域抽出に誤りが見られる可能性がある。アフリカでのエボラ流行とハッジという大規模集会の重複による国際的な感染拡大リスクが懸念される。今後の情報追跡が必要。

article.articleHeadline: AfDB meets under Ebola' s cloud as Africa hunts for development cash at home - BusinessWorld Online
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo risks dampening attendance at the African Development Bank’s annual meeting in Congo Republic, amid shrinking aid flows. As of 25 May 2026, the DRC outbreak has spread to Uganda with more than 170 suspected deaths; Congo Republic has reported no cases. World Health Organization guidelines currently allow the meeting to proceed with no travel restrictions. AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah promotes the New African Financial Architecture for Development (NAFAD) to mobilize Africa’s own resources, aiming to pool about $4 trillion of institutional capital (pensions, sovereign wealth funds, savings) to finance viable projects. Critics note Sub-Saharan Africa’s savings rate (~18%) may be insufficient, urging derisking and guarantees to catalyze foreign investment for infrastructure, energy, climate adaptation, and job creation, addressing a roughly $400 billion annual development financing gap.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影を背に、アフリカは自前で開発資金を探す中、AfDBが会合 - ビジネスワールド・オンライン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外性、国際拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当。DRCとウガンダでの多数の死亡者報告とウガンダへの越境拡大が確認されている。
triage.notes: DRCで発生したエボラが隣国ウガンダに拡大し、170名以上の疑い死亡者が報告されている。WHOは現在会合開催を認めており渡航制限はないが、出席者の不安が経済会合に影響を及ぼす可能性がある。2026年5月25日時点でのアクティブな越境感染事例。対象国はDRCのみ対象リストに含まれるが、ウガンダへの拡大は確認済みのため両国を記載。

article.articleHeadline: Hoaks! Video tikus terinfeksi hantavirus sengaja disebar truk di jalan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hoax! Video of hantavirus-infected rats deliberately spread by trucks on the road.
article.articleSummary: Published May 25, 2026 (Jakarta) reports that a Facebook post alleging that a truck deliberately spread hantavirus infected rats on a highway is false. The clip shows large rats emerging from a moving semi-trailer, and the accompanying narration links it to deliberate release and hantavirus spread. ANTARA notes no official government or health authority has confirmed such an operation, and AI detection tools estimate about an 82 percent probability the video is AI generated. Hantavirus can be transmitted to humans through contact with rodent urine, droppings, or saliva, or by bites or scratches, but there is no evidence that the video depicts intentional dissemination. The piece concludes the claim is misinformation or hoax.

triage.headline_ja: デマ！ハンタウイルス感染ネズミが意図的にトラックで道路にばら撒かれたというビデオ
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はハンタウイルス感染の実際のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、AIで生成されたデマビデオの検証・否定である。実際の感染症イベントではなく、誤情報の是正記事のため、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンタウイルスに関する誤情報（デマビデオ）の検証・否定が主題であり、実際の感染症イベントの報告ではない。インドネシア保健当局による公式確認がないことが明記されており、実際の公衆衛生上の脅威は検出されていない。したがって感染症シグナルとしてはピックアップ対象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026/Ebola: Toutes les dispositions sont prises pour une participation sécurisée rassure la Fécofa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026/Ebola: All measures have been taken to ensure a secure participation, says Fécofa.
article.articleSummary: Fécofa, amid World Cup 2026 preparations, coordinated with FIFA on health safeguards for the Democratic Republic of the Congo (RDC) national team in response to strict US Ebola guidance. A large portion of the delegation, including players, reportedly does not reside in Congo, with no additional measures expected. A small staff contingent from Kinshasa currently in Belgium will spend over 21 days in Europe under close surveillance to ensure smooth entry to the United States. The entire RDC delegation will comply with health instructions issued by US authorities. Supporters who had tickets but are denied US access will be reimbursed by FIFA. The Leopards will meet Denmark (June 3, Liège, Belgium) and Chile (June 9, Marbella, Spain) as preparatory fixtures ahead of the World Cup kickoff on June 11.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ/エボラ：安全な参加のためのすべての対策が講じられていると確保される（フェコファ）
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規発生や地域流行ではなく、予定されたワールドカップ2026参加に伴う予防的健康対策についての報道。DRCの公式なエボラ流行状況に関する新情報はなく、既存の流行に対する参加準備の話題である。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数の欧米国（スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク、米国、チリ）を発生地域として列挙しているが、記事サマリーはスポーツイベント参加に関する予防的健康ガイダンスについての記事である。新規のエボラウイルス検出や流行拡大ではない。対象国はDRCのみが該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Gunungkidul Gencarkan Pelacakan TBC Targetkan 1.000 Kasus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gunungkidul Regency Health Office Intensifies TB Contact Tracing, Targets 1,000 Cases
article.articleSummary: Active Case Finding Tuberculosis (ACF TB) program in Gunungkidul Regency, Indonesia, has identified 205 new tuberculosis cases as of mid-May 2026. Initiated in April and ongoing through year-end, the effort spans 30 health centers (puskesmas) across Gunungkidul with a target to detect about 1,000 new TB cases. The program screens close contacts of known TB patients, especially household members, to detect latent or active TB early. Early detection allows prompt treatment and reduces transmission. Health Office head Wanda Abrar notes active screening is effective at uncovering undiagnosed cases, while Ismono emphasizes intensified, annually recurring surveillance to curb spread. TB remains curable when patients adhere to prescribed regimens. Public health messaging also promotes clean living and healthy lifestyles to prevent infectious diseases.

triage.headline_ja: グヌンクドゥル県保健所が結核接触者追跡を強化、1,000症例を目標
triage.triage_reason: 結核の定期的なケースファインディング・接触者追跡プログラムであり、異常な発生や公衆衛生危機を示唆する証拠がない。国内の通常の疾患管理活動である。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドネシア・グヌンクドゥル県での結核のActive Case Finding（ACF）プログラムを報じたもの。2026年4月開始の定期的なケースファインディング活動であり、新規患者205名の検出は予想範囲内。国内保健当局による通常の疾病サーベイランス活動であり、シグナルレベルの懸念はない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Ebola, BKK perketat pengawasan di Bandara Internasional Belitung - ANTARA News Bangka Belitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Ebola, BKK Tightens Surveillance at Belitung International Airport - ANTARA News Bangka Belitung.
article.articleSummary: Ebola surveillance tightened at H.A.S. Hanandjoeddin International Airport in Tanjung Pandan, Belitung Regency, Belitung Islands, Indonesia, as authorities respond to the World Health Organization's global emergency declaration for Ebola linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Bangka Belitung Health quarantine authority (BKK) Class II Pangkalpinang intensified screening of travelers from abroad at the international airport and port, focusing on passengers from Singapore. Measures include thermal scanning to detect fever; travelers with body temperature above 38°C are subject to further assessment and possible management at a designated referral hospital. The effort involves cross-sector collaboration to prevent importation of Ebola into the region. No confirmed Ebola cases are reported in the article; the emphasis is on prevention amid international travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の予防対策、ベリット国際空港での監視を強化 - ANTARA News バンカ・ブリトゥン
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はWHOが国際的に緊急事態宣言を発出した高リスク感染症であり、DRCでの発生に対応した国境検疫強化という予防的対応が報道されている。IHR基準の国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが該当し、また社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアでの予防的監視強化の報道であり、DRCでの発生がトリガーとなっている。シンガポール発の旅客に焦点を当てた検疫強化は、国際的な拡大リスク対応を示唆しており、複数対象国が関連している。

article.articleHeadline: SC refuses to entertain NGO's plea seeking clarification on euthanasia of rabid dogs
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk management in India: The Supreme Court refused on May 19–25 to entertain an NGO plea seeking clarification on euthanasia of dogs under its recent direction. The bench said it cannot alter its order amid public statements by Punjab Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann about eliminating stray dogs. The NGO Animals Are People Too argues the directive allowing euthanasia of rabid, incurably ill, or dangerous/aggressive dogs must be strictly implemented under the Animal Birth Control Rules 2023, with expert verification. It seeks clarity that no dog be labeled aggressive without examination by a committee including a government veterinary doctor, an NGO representative, and a local authority member. The Court suggested the NGO approach the Punjab and Haryana High Court, which oversees local monitoring. The May 19 order permits euthanasia to curb threats to human safety, subject to the Prevention of Cruelty to Animals Act and related laws.

triage.headline_ja: 最高裁判所が狂犬病犬の安楽死に関する説明を求めるNGOの請願を却下
triage.triage_reason: インドにおける狂犬病リスク管理の行政・法的対応についての報道。公衆衛生への直接的な影響は明確ではなく、むしろ動物管理政策の司法判断が主体。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はインドの狂犬病対策における最高裁判所の行政判断（野犬の安楽死に関する法的枠組み）を報道しており、発生する感染症イベントそのものではなく、その管理・政策面での動向である。人間への狂犬病発症ケースの報告や流行状況には言及されていない。公共の関心と政府当局の関心は存在するが、国際的な感染症危機管理の観点からは限定的。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola Cases Pass 1,000, Nigeria Tightens Airport Screening - The News Chronicle
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak exceeds 1,000 cases: as of May 24, 904 suspected and 101 confirmed across three provinces and 11 health zones, with at least 10 deaths (CDC). Ituri Province remains the epicenter amid violence and displacement, with about 922,000 internally displaced. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo strain; first suspected case was April 24 in a health worker who died. Surveillance and screening continue. On May 16, WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; national risk in DRC is ‘very high,’ regional ‘high,’ global ‘low.’ Uganda reports five cases and one death. Nigeria, while reporting no cases, has tightened airport screening at Murtala Muhammed International Airport, including temperature checks, health monitoring, and QR code health declarations for arrivals from DRC and Uganda; NCDC urges vigilance. Authorities warn against bush meat; Nigeria’s 2014 Lagos outbreak killed eight and was contained by isolation, tracing, and monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ患者数が1,000人を超える、ナイジェリアが空港スクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRコンゴでエボラ患者数が1,000人超に達し、複数国での確認、WHO PHEICの発出、アフリカ域内での地域的リスク評価「高」により国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRコンゴでのエボラ流行を主題としており、ウガンダでの5症例1死亡、ナイジェリアでのスクリーニング強化は対象国リストの関連事象としてDRC発の国際的影響として記述されている。Bluedot APIが付与した「Nigeria」や「Uganda」はスクリーニング・影響の観点で言及されているが、記事の主体的なイベント発生地は明確にDRコンゴである。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: OMS eleva a más de 900 casos sospechosos o confirmados de ébola en la RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises to more than 900 suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: WHO reports more than 900 suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province, where one in four people requires humanitarian assistance and one in five is internally displaced. Violence is driving people to flee, including health and humanitarian workers, severely hindering contact tracing and early identification of infections. About 204 probable deaths have been recorded to date since the outbreak was declared on May 15. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, WHO Director-General, highlighted the challenges in scaling up surveillance and response due to security concerns in Ituri. Ongoing efforts aim to expand tracing and provide support to affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラウイルスの疑い例または確認例が900例以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの大規模発生（900例以上、確認例101例、死亡204例）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクがあり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。治安悪化による対応困難も重症度を高める。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年5月25日時点のデータに基づくシナリオであるが、評価対象として扱う。イトゥリ州での発生が中心で、治安悪化が監視と対応を著しく阻害している。WHO事務局長による懸念表明あり。

article.articleHeadline: Escapan 18 pacientes sospechosos de ébola en Congo en pleno brote de una cepa sin vacuna
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 18 suspected Ebola patients escape in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid an outbreak of a strain for which there is no vaccine.
article.articleSummary: 18 suspected Ebola patients escape from a MSF-managed treatment tent in Mongbwalu, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid an outbreak of Bundibugyo ebolavirus—the strain with no approved vaccine. The outbreak continues in Ituri, with more than 900 suspected or confirmed cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, and about 204 probable deaths to date. Early diagnosis was delayed because regional labs primarily had reagents for the Zaire strain, hindering timely containment. Attacks on health facilities worsen containment: a treatment center was burned in Rwampara after relatives demanded a body, a practice restricted due to contagion risk. Widespread distrust, burial restrictions, and armed violence complicate contact tracing and sample transport. MSF, Red Cross, and WHO are scaling up the response, but containment hinges on community cooperation to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の疑い患者18名が逃走 ワクチンのない株による流行中
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるエボラ出血熱の流行で、900件以上の疑い例・確定例と204人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）を満たす。治療施設からの患者逃走、医療施設への攻撃、コミュニティの不信により封じ込めが著しく困難な状況が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（Ituri州Mongbwalu）でのエボラ流行が主題。Rwandaはサマリーに直接言及されていないため除外。Bundibugyo株はZaire株とは異なり、ワクチン対策が限定的である点が特に懸念される。医療施設への攻撃と患者逃走による二次感染リスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Thailand Umumkan Karantina Ebola, Bahkan untuk Pendatang Tanpa Gejala
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Thailand Announces Ebola Quarantine, Even for Asymptomatic Arrivals.
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes quarantine for all arrivals from Ebola-affected Congo and Uganda after the WHO declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Thailand's Department of Disease Control recommends strict quarantine for entrants from the two countries. Officials say Congo's outbreak is worsening and global surveillance is tightening for high-risk travelers. WHO data as of May 17 reported more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in Congo, with at least 101 laboratory-confirmed. By May 22, Thailand had eight arrivals from Uganda and two from Congo, all asymptomatic but quarantined. In Congo, three IFRC volunteers—Ajiko Chandiru Viviane, Sezabo Katanabo, Alikana Udumusi Augustin—died after suspected Ebola exposure while handling corpses in Ituri province, with deaths on May 5, 15, and 16. Funeral practices and unprotected handling drive transmission; field teams conduct door-to-door education to counter misinformation.

triage.headline_ja: タイがエボラ隔離を発表、無症状の入国者にも対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo strain）の国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態により、複数国への国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航制限も実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴでのエボラ発生（Ituri州）とウガンダからの患者をタイが隔離する対応を報じている。Bundibugyo Ebola株はワクチン・治療法がなく、WHOが5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。コンゴでの確認症例は101例以上、死亡者を含む。タイはWPRO地域の対象国。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de más de 900 casos sospechosos de ébola en la R. D. del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province. Laboratory confirmation stands at 101 cases among the suspected total. The latest official balance cites over 200 deaths linked to Ebola among 867 suspected cases, signaling a worrying acceleration amid fragile health services. WHO has raised the public health risk for the outbreak from high to very high. Approximately a quarter of Ituri’s five million residents require humanitarian assistance, and about 20% have been displaced by the outbreak and related crisis. Ituri remains the epicenter with ongoing transmission and strain on health systems.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疑い例900件以上を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。WHOが公衆衛生リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げた大規模エボラ流行。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高い致死率と国際的な懸念を引き起こす指定感染症。WHOが公衆衛生リスクを最高レベルに引き上げた点、200人超の死亡者、脆弱な保健システムの状況が深刻。人道支援の必要性も高い。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: San sẻ nỗi lo mùa muỗi và bệnh do côn trùng cùng bà con miền Tây
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sharing the worry of mosquito season and insect-borne diseases with the people of the Mekong Delta
article.articleSummary: ARS (Earth Corporation Vietnam) launched a public outreach campaign in the Mekong Delta during the rainy season, distributing mosquito prevention products and giving guidance at traditional markets across western provinces. Facing heightened risk of mosquito-borne diseases, including dengue, with about 32,000 dengue cases reported region-wide by mid-April 2026, the initiative aims to empower households to prevent infestation and transmission. ARS staff engaged vendors, sharing methods to keep living spaces clean, eliminate larval habitats, and use products correctly. The campaign highlights a low-smoke mosquito coil providing up to 8 hours of protection and ARS insect sprays to rapidly control pests. The effort emphasizes proactive disease prevention in collaboration with local authorities, expanding ARS's community reach across the Mekong Delta region.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊の季節と昆虫媒介疾病についてメコンデルタ地域の人々と懸念を共有
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱の既知の流行状況であり、公衆衛生キャンペーンの報道。IHR基準は2つ以上該当する可能性があるが、記事の性質が予防啓発活動であり、新規の異常事象ではないため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年4月中旬時点で同地域のデング熱患者が約32,000例報告されていると言及。企業による予防啓発キャンペーンの報道であり、新規感染症の発生ではなく、既知流行への対応。スクリーニング基準では複数該当するが、異常/予想外性がなく、公式な地域流行への対応であることから、WATCH段階の継続監視が適切。

article.articleHeadline: WHO cảnh báo khẩn về Ebola , Bộ Y tế tăng cường phòng chống dịch xâm nhập 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO issues urgent warning about Ebola; Ministry of Health strengthens prevention and control of imported diseases in 2026.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda triggers urgent warning from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health to strengthen prevention and control of imported diseases in 2026. By 22 May 2026, Congo reported 750 suspected Ebola cases and 177 deaths; four health workers died by 5 May, with confirmations by 15 May. Uganda reported two imported cases from Congo on 15–16 May, including one death; epidemiological links are not yet determined. On 17 May, WHO declared Ebola in Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; by 22 May, the risk assessment rated Vietnam as very low globally, but very high for countries with active cases in Africa. Vietnam urges enhanced border and healthcare surveillance, immediate isolation and testing of suspected cases at the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City, strict infection control, 21-day traveler monitoring, rapid-response readiness, and public communication to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: WHO がエボラについて緊急警告を発出；保健省は 2026 年の輸入感染症の予防管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。また WPRO スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、WHO が PHEIC を宣言した進行中の多国間エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: Bluedot API が Ho Chi Minh City（ベトナム）と DRC、Uganda を報告。記事サマリーによると、主たるアウトブレイク地域は DRC とウガンダ（対象国外）であり、ベトナムは「輸入リスク予防」の対象国。対象国リストに基づき DRC と Vietnam のみを verified_locations に含める。WHO は 2026年5月17日に PHEIC 宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus DBD tinggi, Dinkes Riau keluarkan SE tingkatkan waspada Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: High Dengue Fever Cases, Riau Provincial Health Office Issues Circular to Heighten Vigilance Against Dengue.
article.articleSummary: Riau Province faces ongoing dengue fever activity. By April, 1,682 dengue cases were reported across 12 districts, with 12 fatalities. In 2025, the province recorded 4,618 confirmed dengue cases and 35 deaths. Through week 17 of 2026, the Early Warning and Response System (SKDR) tallies 2,321 suspected dengue cases. In response, the Riau Health Office (Dinkes) issued a circular to district health offices to heighten vigilance and control, including year-round vector control (3M plus) in endemic villages and strengthened community outreach. Labs emphasize availability of dengue rapid diagnostic tests (RDTs); febrile patients ≥38°C for >2 days should receive dengue RDTs (including DBD Combo). Hematocrit, Hb, leukocytes, and platelets should be checked; if severe arthralgia or rash, add Chikungunya RDT. Watch for warning signs between days 3–7 when fever declines.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数が多い、リアウ州保健局がデング熱警戒強化の通知を発出
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア・リアウ州でのデング熱・チクングニア熱の継続的な流行を示しており、2025年に4,618件の確認患者と35名の死亡が報告されている。WPRO基準の異常性、重症度、管理可能性の複数項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: リアウ州でのデング熱の継続的な流行が確認されている。2025年に4,618件の患者と35名の死亡が報告され、2026年第17週までに2,321件の疑い患者が記録されている。州保健局が公式な警戒通知を発出し、3M+ベクトル制御やRDT検査の強化などの対応を実施している。デング熱とチクングニア熱の複合流行の可能性も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: RDC tem mais de 900 casos suspeitos de ebola, afirma OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC has more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, WHO says.
article.articleSummary: As of May 24, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is reporting more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The update, posted on social media, notes intensified surveillance in the Ebola response amid the DRC's protracted conflict. The numbers illustrate the ongoing outbreak and the challenges of rapid detection and verification in a conflict-affected setting, as authorities expand testing to distinguish suspected from confirmed cases. The brief does not specify affected districts or other clinical details. The figures underscore ongoing outbreak activity and the breadth of surveillance necessary to manage the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラの疑い患者が900例以上、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された集団発生であり、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。疑い患者900例以上、確認患者101例、紛争地での感染拡大リスク、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR検査対象疾患。DRCは紛争影響下にあり対応管理の困難性が指摘されている。WHO事務局長による公式発表であり、信頼度が高い。WHOのサイト上での投稿が記事ソース。

article.articleHeadline: Người dân trở về từ vùng dịch Ebola được khuyến cáo tự theo dõi sức khỏe 21 ngày
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: People returning from Ebola-affected regions are advised to self-monitor their health for 21 days.
article.articleSummary: An emergency directive from Vietnam’s Ministry of Health strengthens border and community Ebola surveillance amid Congo-Uganda outbreak. Travelers returning from Ebola-affected regions are advised to self-monitor for 21 days; suspected cases should be isolated and samples sent to the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for testing. Local authorities must build response plans at border points and communities, ensuring personnel, supplies, drugs, and equipment. WHO reports Congo and Uganda face a complex outbreak: as of May 22, 2026, about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths in Congo—17th Ebola outbreak since 1976; in Uganda, 2 imported cases from Congo on May 15–16, with one death, linked to Bundibugyo. On May 17, WHO declared the event a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Vietnam’s risk remains low; avoid panic, minimize contact with suspected cases, practice hand hygiene, and seek care if symptoms appear after travel.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱流行地から帰国した人々は21日間の自己健康管理が勧告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）、WHO PHEIC宣言済み、ベトナムの公式対応と監視体制強化を記載。対象国ベトナムでの実際の感染症対応イベント。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月25日付け。DRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行（17次爆発、2026年5月22日時点で疑い例750例・死亡177例）に対応して、ベトナムが流行地からの帰国者に21日間の自己監視と国境・コミュニティ監視を強化する公式指示を発出。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ベトナム自体の感染例報告はないが、国際的エボラ流行への公式対応と監視体制構築は重大な感染症事象。Bluedot API が Ho Chi Minh City を発生地域に含めているのは、保健施設・検査機関の所在地であり、感染症イベント自体の発生地ではないが、ベトナムの公式対応が焦点のため Vietnam は verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Понадобились трупы: вооруженные люди ворвались в больницу в Конго с требованием отдать тела умерших от Эболы :: Новости - RuFox
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They needed corpses: armed men stormed a hospital in the Congo demanding the bodies of those who died of Ebola :: News - RuFox
article.articleSummary: Armed men stormed a hospital in Mongbvalu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on Sunday evening, demanding the bodies of people who died of Ebola. Gazeta.Ru reports the attackers were seeking the corpses of two relatives previously infected with Ebola. Gunfire erupted inside the facility, and staff and patients were evacuated. No injuries or fatalities have been reported at the hospital so far. This is not the first attack on a Congo medical facility; previously, a group set fire to a hospital after being refused the bodies of Ebola victims’ relatives. Locals oppose a directive that Ebola victims’ bodies be buried by specialized services, prompting protests from bereaved families. The article provides no official confirmation of infection sources, case counts, or broader outbreak status, focusing instead on the assault and burial-dispute context.

triage.headline_ja: 遺体が必要だった：武装した男たちがコンゴの病院に突入し、エボラで亡くなった者の遺体の引き渡しを要求 :: ニュース - RuFox
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例が存在し、医療施設への武装攻撃により感染制御が阻害されるリスクがあるが、現在の流行規模・感染者数等の詳細情報が記事に記載されていないため、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の重点は武装攻撃と埋葬紛争にあり、エボラの流行規模、感染者数、医療対応体制の機能状況等については記載されていない。Mongbvalu地域での医療施設へのアクセス阻害は感染制御上の懸念要因となる。続報で流行状況の詳細が明らかになることを注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Antigua and Barbuda cancels inaugural Air Peace flight from Nigeria over Ebola concerns - WIC News
article.articleSummary: Antigua and Barbuda cancels the inaugural Air Peace flight from Lagos, Nigeria due to Ebola concerns amid outbreaks in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo. Prime Minister Gaston Browne said the government took a conservative approach to minimize public health risks, rerouting the maiden landing to Barbados while monitoring evolving conditions. About 25 passengers bound for Antigua will instead travel via LIAT from Barbados, with health screenings arranged before departure or on arrival. Enhanced surveillance at ports of entry remains in place, and Antigua and Barbuda has reactivated its Infectious Disease Centre to enable isolation and contact tracing if needed. Officials emphasize there is no confirmed Ebola case locally, and authorities will continue to monitor regional updates while maintaining Africa-Caribbean ties.

triage.headline_ja: アンティグア・バーブーダ、エボラ懸念によりナイジェリアからの就航便をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発症国（ウガンダ、DRC）からの輸送規制が実施された事例であり、IHR基準の渡航制限リスクに該当する可能性がある。ただし、カリブ海地域での地域的な予防措置であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響や国際的拡大リスクの具体的根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから確認される実際の発症国はウガンダおよびDRCである。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。ナイジェリア（Lagos State）は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリーでは『ウガンダとDRCでの発症の懸念によるナイジェリアからの便キャンセル』であり、ナイジェリアでの確認事例なし。アンティグア・バーブーダ、スペイン、バルバドスはいずれも対象国外のため除外。本件は渡航制限の実施例であり、引き続き発生地域での展開を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Число предположительных случаев заражения вирусом Эбола в ДРК превысило 900 -- глава ВОЗ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola virus infections in the DRC has surpassed 900 — WHO chief.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) prompts expanded surveillance, with more than 900 suspected infections identified, including 101 laboratory-confirmed cases. As of May 25, 2026, Ituri’s population of about 5 million faces severe humanitarian needs, with roughly 25% requiring assistance and 20% internally displaced. Violence is forcing people, including health and humanitarian workers, to flee, significantly hindering contact tracing and early detection of infections. WHO Director‑General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, posting on X, emphasized that delivering a comprehensive package of medical services is crucial not only to address urgent health needs but also to build trust essential for an effective Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラウイルス感染の疑い例数が900を超える — WHO事務局長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模アウトブレイク（確定例101例、疑い例900例以上）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク、および社会政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最高リスク疾患の一つ。確定例101例、疑い例900例以上という大規模なアウトブレイク。5百万人の人口を抱えるイツリ州で、25%が人道支援の対象、20%が国内避難民である状況。暴力による保健・人道支援従事者の逃亡は接触者追跡と早期検出を大幅に阻害。WHO事務局長が直接言及し、国際的な医療サービスパッケージの提供が必須とされている点で高い関心度を示唆。フルのRRA実施が急務。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Aumentan en Congo ataques contra centros de tratamiento del ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: Attacks on Ebola treatment centers are increasing in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreaks in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo are intensifying as authorities enforce restrictions on traditional funeral rites to curb transmission from infectious corpses. As of May 25, 2026, Congolese authorities report more than 900 suspected Ebola cases nationwide and about 120 deaths. A third attack this week targeted Ebola treatment facilities when armed youths stormed the General Hospital Monbgwalu in eastern DRC to demand the bodies of two relatives who died from Ebola. The government has ordered that funerals of suspected Bundibugyo virus victims be managed by the state, given the high contagion risk associated with corpse handling and gatherings. The Bundibugyo strain remains the focal lineage, and security risks around care centers hinder outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ治療センターへの攻撃が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900人以上の疑い例、120人の死亡）、伝統的葬儀慣行による持続的感染リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染性、治療施設への暴力攻撃による制御困難が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は東部DRCでのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイクの激化を報告。900人以上の疑い例と120人の死亡、複数回の治療施設への武装攻撃、Bundibugyo株による継続的感染リスク、埋葬儀式管理による感染制御困難が複合的に存在。国家的危機対応段階と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Experts agree on the dangers of the ebola breakout: "We are at greater risk because the CDC is undermined
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda triggers stark warnings from former CDC leaders that the world faces a dangerous crisis with weakened defenses. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17, 2026. CDC reports hundreds of suspected and probable cases; detection lag is noted, with the outbreak not recognized until after 100 cases, compared with typical detection at five to ten. Experts warn potential spread to Tanzania, South Sudan, and Rwanda. Vin Gupta highlights reduced international health capacity as US agencies, USAID, PEPFAR, and the military step back, and insufficient diagnostic tests in eastern Congo. Tom Frieden warns that U.S. risk rises as CDC is undermined and withdrawal from WHO continues. As of May 25, no U.S. cases, but enhanced screening for travelers from affected countries is in place.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行の危険性について専門家が合意：「CDCが弱体化しているため、私たちはより大きなリスクにさらされている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱という致死率の高い感染症の多国間にわたる流行。WHOが国際的懸念事項としての公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ流行が「Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda」で発生していると明記されている。しかし対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Tanzania、Rwanda、South Sudanへの潜在的な拡大の警告が述べられているが、実際の発生地ではなく、記事の主題は現在のDRCとウガンダでの流行であるため含めない。Bundibugyo株のような特定の情報、ワクチンなしという治療困難性、検出遅延（100症例後の認識）が述べられており、重症度と管理可能性の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: منظمة الصحة العالمية: أكثر من 900 إصابة مشتبه بها بإيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of May 25, 2026: more than 900 suspected cases have been reported, including 101 confirmed. There is no update on the number of deaths in this release. The outbreak began on May 15 and involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment currently available. Ebola is a viral disease spread through direct contact with body fluids and can cause severe hemorrhagic fever and organ failure. In a previous update, the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ministry of Health reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces. Ebola has caused more than 15,000 deaths across Africa over the past 50 years. Ongoing surveillance and response efforts are being intensified in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ熱の疑い患者900人以上
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ熱の大規模集団発生で、ワクチンや承認済み治療法がない株による深刻な脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ熱集団発生（2026年5月15日開始）。900人以上の疑い患者（確認例101人）、204人の死亡報告あり。ワクチンと承認済み治療法がない株であり、直接接触による感染拡大リスク高。DRCの3州に波及。国際的対応と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak grows to 900 suspected cases - WHO
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has expanded to more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. Kinshasa declared the epidemic on May 15, and two days later the Bundibugyo strain detected in the DR Congo and neighboring Uganda was declared a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), though not a pandemic-level emergency. The epicenter is Ituri province, where violence and mass displacement hinder contact tracing and early case detection. About 5 million people live in conflict zones; 1 in 4 need humanitarian aid, and 1 in 5 are internally displaced. The Bundibugyo virus is a rare Ebola strain identified in Uganda in 2007, with ~one-third fatality; no approved vaccine. British researchers are pursuing an experimental vaccine with trials possible within months, though effectiveness remains unknown. WHO raised the national risk to very high, while international risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の発生が900例以上の疑い患者に拡大 - WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、国際的な懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として既に宣言されており、隣国ウガンダでの検出により国際的拡大リスクが顕著である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）が主要な発生地であり、ウガンダでの検出についても言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCでの発生である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。既にPHEIC宣言済みであり、ワクチン未承認の稀なBundibugyo株による大規模発生であることから、即座のピックアップが適切である。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de Ébola en Congo Supera los 900 Casos; Violencia Complica Atención Sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo surpasses 900 cases; violence complicates healthcare.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo surpasses 900 suspected and confirmed cases, with at least 101 laboratory-confirmed; hundreds more under medical investigation. The epicenter is Ituri Province, among the most conflict-affected and humanitarian crisis areas in the country. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence and displacement hinder containment efforts. About 25% of people in the region require urgent humanitarian aid, and about 20% have been internally displaced due to violence, complicating medical operations and contact tracing. The agency stresses that rapid detection of infected individuals is essential to isolate cases, provide treatment, and prevent wider spread. International health authorities maintain continuous surveillance over what is described as one of the most complex outbreaks in eastern Congo, driven by insecurity and instability that impede healthcare access and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ爆発が900例を超える；暴力が医療提供を複雑化させている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスによる公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、および大量の疑い例・確定例が認められ、紛争・暴力による対応困難性が明記されている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの一種であり、高い致死率と国際的懸念を有する病原体。Ituri Provinceの紛争地帯における流行は、接触者追跡や医療アクセス困難によるコントロール上の複雑性を増す。WHO及び国際保健機関による継続的監視が報告されており、国際支援が必須と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Timnas Kongo Bersikeras Tampil di Piala Dunia di Tengah Wabah Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo national team insists on playing in the World Cup amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team will not alter World Cup preparations despite an Ebola outbreak in the country. U.S. officials require a 21-day quarantine “bubble” in Belgium before departure to Houston to prevent cross-border spread during the tournament. WHO has raised the Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak to 'very high' risk and declared it an international health emergency, with neighboring Uganda affected; nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths reported. The squad, led by coach Sébastien Desabre and largely Europe-based, continues a European warm-up—June 3 vs Denmark in Liège and June 9 vs Chile in Cádiz—before basing in Houston for World Cup Group K, opening June 17 vs Portugal, then Colombia on June 23 in Guadalajara and Uzbekistan on June 27 in Atlanta. A Kinshasa farewell trip was canceled, and no players are arriving directly from DR Congo."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表、エボラ流行の中でもワールドカップ出場を主張
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な多発生事例であり、WHOが「非常に高いリスク」と評価し国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言。対象国のDRCで近750件の疑い患者と177死亡が報告され、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認されている。IHR基準3項目以上に該当し、複数国での国際的措置（隔離、検疫ハブの設置）が実施されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは米国、スペイン、ベルギー、メキシコなど多数の国を発生地域として報告しているが、サマリー分析では実際の感染発生地はDRC（キンシャサが主要発生地）とウガンダ（隣接国での確認）に限定される。米国、ベルギー等は隔離・検疫措置の実施国であり、ウイルス発生地ではない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため含めない。WHO宣言のため非常に高い優先度のシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak grows to 900 suspected cases  WHO
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s Ebola outbreak has grown to more than 900 suspected cases, with 101 confirmed infections. Kinshasa declared the epidemic on May 15, marking the country's 17th Ebola crisis since 1976. Two days later, the Bundibugyo strain detected in DR Congo and Uganda was declared a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic-level emergency. Violence and displacement in Ituri, the epicenter, severely hinder contact tracing and early case finding; nearly 5 million people live amid conflict, with 1 in 4 needing humanitarian aid and 1 in 5 internally displaced. The Bundibugyo virus is rare, first identified in Uganda in 2007, killing about a third; no approved vaccine exists. British scientists are fast-tracking an experimental vaccine based on Covid-19 tech, potentially entering trials within months. The WHO has raised the DR Congo risk to very high; international risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱の流行が900件の疑い例に拡大 WHO
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が全て該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのシグナル案件。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス・ブンディブギョ株。900件の疑い例、101件の確認例。キンシャサが5月15日に流行宣言。5月17日にWHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。Ituri州の紛争・避難民（500万人以上）により接触者追跡が困難。ワクチンなし、実験的ワクチン開発中。Ugandaも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上はUgandaでの症例報告は限定的（Bundibugyo株の検出が2007年）であり、現在の流行はDR Congoが主体のため、verified_locationsはDRC（203312）のみ。

article.articleHeadline: l'ebola vola: dal congo il contagio si allarga ad altri dieci paesi africani!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola takes off: from the Congo the contagion is spreading to ten other African countries!
article.articleSummary: Ebola takes off in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spillover risk to ten other African countries. Africa CDC identifies South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo (DRC), Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia as currently at risk. Global risk remains low according to the WHO, but experts warn against complacency as the outbreak expands. In the DRC, official figures show rising casualties: over 200 deaths among 867 suspected cases, with 204 deaths reported across three provinces as of the latest update. The report does not provide symptom details or laboratory confirmation information, nor infection sources or exported/imported-case data. The situation underscores rapid geographic spread and the need for continued public health vigilance and containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス拡大：コンゴからアフリカの10カ国への感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスはIHRのリストアップ対象疾患であり、DRCでの発生と複数アフリカ諸国への拡大リスク、200名以上の死亡が報告されており、国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事は10カ国のリスク警告を述べているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC、ザンビアの2カ国のみ。南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、タンザニア、エチオピア、ブルンジ、アンゴラ、中央アフリカ共和国はリスク国として言及されているが、対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCでの公式死亡数200人以上、867疑似症例という深刻な状況が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Covid Naik Lagi di Singapura, Thailand-Malaysia Siap Siaga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Rises Again in Singapore, Thailand and Malaysia on High Alert.
article.articleSummary: Singapore reports 12,700 COVID-19 cases in the 10–16 May 2026 week, up from 8,000 the prior week, with average daily hospitalizations rising from 56 to 73 and about one ICU case per day. The NB.1.8.1 lineage accounts for most local sequences; authorities say seasonal waves are expected but there is no evidence the circulating variants are more transmissible or severe. In Thailand, NB.1.8.1 is also dominant; as of 23 May 2026 Thailand has 3,642 cumulative cases and one death this year. NB.1.8.1 carries spike mutations and may be more transmissible and immune-evading, but not proven to cause more severe illness. In Malaysia, 9,682 cases were reported as of 19 May, down 12.6% year-on-year and up 0.7% from 18 May, with no deaths; most cases are mild. Vaccination is advised for high-risk groups and is available nationwide; border screening is intensified.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19がシンガポール、タイ、マレーシアで再び増加、タイとマレーシアが警戒態勢に
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19の東南アジアでの流行増加を報告しているが、現在のところ重症化証拠がなく、対象国（タイ）のみで情報が限定的である。既知の流行病に関する通常の経過報告と評価される。
triage.notes: シンガポール（1880251）とマレーシア（1733045）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。タイのみが対象国。当地では既にNB.1.8.1系統が流行しており、季節的な波として予想される状況。医療体制が機能しており、外部支援の必要性は現時点では示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا ينتشر في الكونغو الديمقراطية.. وفاة أكثر من 200 شخص ورصد 900 حالة مشتبه بها
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... More than 200 people have died and 900 suspected cases have been detected.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed at least 204 people, according to the latest figures released by the Ministry of Health. The update indicates an ongoing outbreak with substantial case-finding activity. More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been detected in the DRC, of which 101 are laboratory-confirmed. These numbers were reported by the Ministry on Saturday and summarized the following day by World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The report emphasizes laboratory confirmation in a portion of the suspected cases, underscoring active surveillance and diagnostic efforts. The article does not provide details on the infection source, transmission chains, or any imported/exported cases. The figures reflect a rapidly evolving situation requiring intensified public health measures across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で拡大...200人以上の死亡者と900の疑い症例が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模な流行で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響があり、WHO事務局長が言及するなど高度な社会的・政治的関心がある。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体の一つ。204人の死亡、900の疑い症例（101確認症例）は深刻な流行を示す。DRCの保健省とWHO事務局長による公式声明があり、国際的な関心が極めて高い。フルRRA実施急務。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola salgını hastaneleri felç etti: 900'den fazla şüpheli vaka
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak paralyzed hospitals: more than 900 suspected cases.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ituri Province is overwhelming hospitals and clinics. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant has no approved treatment or vaccine. The World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected cases and 101 confirmed cases; the outbreak was officially declared on May 15, with the international public health emergency declared on May 17. Ituri, home to about 5 million people amid ongoing armed conflict, faces severe humanitarian needs: roughly one in five residents are displaced and a quarter require aid. Frontline health workers in PPE are at high risk, and insecurity hampers contact tracing and early detection. In Ituri, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths have been reported in connection with the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が病院を麻痺させる：900件以上の疑い症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。深刻な公衆衛生への影響（900+疑い症例、101確認症例、65死亡）、予想外の病原体変異体（Bundibugyo型）、国際的拡大リスク、治療・ワクチン未承認による国際的関心と渡航制限の可能性。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは承認された治療法やワクチンが無い。武装紛争下の地域での発生により、感染対策の実施が困難。WHO が5月17日に国際的公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）已确诊101例埃博拉病例！防疫要点速了解→
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo has confirmed 101 Ebola cases! Quick guide to the key points of epidemic prevention →
article.articleSummary: DR Congo has confirmed 101 Ebola virus disease cases, with over 900 suspected infections, in a latest outbreak centered in Ituri Province’s Bunia. Bunia airport has suspended all passenger flights. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stated that 101 cases are laboratory-confirmed, and the WHO has raised the national risk to very high and the regional risk to high. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; other species include Zaire, Sudan, Tai Forest, Reston, and Bombali, with Bundibugyo linked to the current DR Congo and Uganda context. Transmission sources are infected patients and wildlife; humans acquire infection via contact with blood, body fluids, secretions, excretions, or contaminated materials. Incubation: 2–21 days (usually 8–10). Early symptoms: fever, fatigue, headache, myalgia, sore throat, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding; high fatality risk. No specific therapy; vaccine exists only for Zaire ebolavirus. Preventive guidance: avoid risk areas, minimize contact with animals and infected persons, practice hygiene, and 21-day post-travel monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ病例101例を確診！防疫の重点をすばやく理解する→
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体による確定症例101例・疑い症例900例以上の大規模発生。国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの報告）、渡航制限（空港便停止）があり、WHO が国家リスクを「非常に高い」に引き上げている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則上の最高リスク病原体であり、確定症例数が多く、ウガンダへの越境リスクも言及されている。WHO が地域リスクを『高い』に指定し、空港便停止などの措置が取られている点から、国際支援と監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ quan vết xước nhỏ, nhiều người nguy kịch vì uốn ván
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Neglecting a minor scratch leaves many people in critical condition due to tetanus.
article.articleSummary: Tetanus outbreaks in Vietnam are reported after minor wounds, with many patients admitted to Bach Mai Hospital and the Institute of Tropical Medicine in Hanoi in critical condition. Previously healthy adults develop injuries such as metal splinters, cuts at work, or muddy debris, then delay vaccination, assuming wounds are trivial. When tetanus symptoms appear—difficulty speaking, lockjaw, dysphagia, chest tightness, and generalized muscle rigidity—the illness is often life-threatening. Many patients require tracheostomy, mechanical ventilation, and prolonged dialysis, with complications including autonomic dysfunction, hypotension, septic shock, and severe pneumonia. Clostridium tetani toxin attacks the nervous system; no specific antidote exists, so care is largely supportive. Clinicians urge immediate wound cleaning, routine adult tetanus boosters, and, if indicated, tetanus immune globulin or vaccine, especially for high-risk workers in construction, metalwork, and farming.

triage.headline_ja: 小さな傷を軽く見る、破傷風で多くの人が危機的状況に
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの破傷風集団発生が報告されており、複数の患者が重症化（集中治療室入院、人工呼吸器管理）しているため、WPROスクリーニング基準を満たす。ただし国際的拡大リスクや特異な公衆衛生上の新規性が限定的であるため、続報を注視して情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 破傷風は予防可能な疾患であり、報告された事例の重症化は医療アクセスおよび予防接種実施の遅延による二次的要因と考えられる。集団発生の規模（患者数）、死亡数、発症期間についての具体的データが不足しているため、後続の詳細情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnam urges Ebola travelers to monitor health for 21 days
article.articleSummary: Vietnam issued an urgent directive to monitor Ebola for 21 days, heightening surveillance at borders, communities, and health facilities and reviewing arrivals from outbreak areas with self-monitoring guidance. Suspected cases must be isolated, and samples sent to the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or the Pasteur Institute in Ho Chi Minh City for testing. Local authorities should ready outbreak-response plans and reinforce rapid-response teams as needed. The WHO reports Congo (DRC) and Uganda Ebola outbreaks intensifying. By May 22, Congo had 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths in its 17th epidemic; Uganda logged two imported Bundibugyo-strain cases (May 15–16) with one death and no epidemiological link. On May 17, WHO declared PHEIC. Global risk remains low, including in Vietnam, though scale may be larger due to delayed detection. Public should avoid direct contact with suspected patients or fluids and seek care promptly, reporting travel history if symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナム、エボラ患者との接触者に21日間の健康監視を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ流行が既に公衆衛生的に深刻（死亡者あり、WHOがPHEIC宣言）であり、ベトナムを含む複数国での監視強化は国際的拡大リスクとWHO通知事例に相当。
triage.notes: DRCでは750例の疑い例と177名の死亡が報告されており（第17次流行）、ウガンダでも2例の輸入事例と1名の死亡がある。WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を宣言。ベトナムの現在のリスクは低いとされているが、国境監視と検査体制の強化が講じられている。Ho Chi Minh City は検査機関所在地として記載されているが、発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: СЗО: Вистинскиот број заразени со ебола во Конго е многу поголем - Нова Македонија
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The true number of people infected with Ebola in Congo is much larger - Nova Makedonija
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with 904 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed, as the epidemic progresses; 119 suspected deaths and 10 confirmed deaths. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The World Health Organization warns the true number of infections is likely much higher due to weeks of undetected spread. In neighboring Uganda, five laboratory-confirmed cases are linked to the Congolese outbreak. Control remains especially challenging because there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain driving the current spread. The epicenter lies in a remote, hard-to-reach region affected by armed-group activity, with only a few laboratories capable of testing for the virus. Global risk is low, but regional risk is high; Ebola has claimed over 15,000 lives in Africa in the last 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：コンゴのエボラ感染者の実数ははるかに多い
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の進行中の多国間流行で、深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの波及確認）、予想外の高い実感染者数、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの波及確認（5例）されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内の複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で同時多発的に発生している進行中の流行。ワクチン・特異的治療がない Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株による流行で管理困難。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường giám sát, phát hiện ca nghi ngờ mắc bệnh Ebola ngay tại cửa khẩu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthen surveillance to detect suspected Ebola cases at the border crossing.
article.articleSummary: May 25, 2026: Vietnam's Ministry of Health issued an urgent directive to strengthen Ebola surveillance at the Huu Nghi International Border Gate, along border communities, and in health facilities to prevent entry of Bundibugyo Ebola. Officials will screen returning travelers, require 21-day self-monitoring, and advise contact with health services if symptoms appear. Suspected cases should be isolated and samples sent to the National Institute of Hygiene and Epidemiology or Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City for testing; facilities must enforce infection control and safe burial practices. Provinces should prepare border/community response plans, stock essential supplies, and maintain rapid-response teams. The Bundibugyo outbreaks in the Congo and Uganda have grown; by May 22, 2026, Congo reported about 750 suspected cases and 177 deaths; Uganda had two imported cases with one death. On May 17, WHO declared PHEIC; global risk remains very high for affected regions, low elsewhere, including Vietnam.

triage.headline_ja: 国境検問所でエボラ疑い患者を検出するための監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な拡大リスク、WHO PHEICの宣言、複数国での急速な患者数増加、ベトナムの予防的措置実施が確認される。IHR基準3項目該当、WPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。コンゴ民主共和国で約750の疑い患者と177名の死亡、ウガンダで2名の輸入症例（1死亡）が報告されている。Bundibugyo Ebola virus（EBOVの亜種）の急速な拡大が特徴。ベトナムは国境での監視体制強化、入国者の21日間自己隔離、検査体制整備など予防措置を実施中。対象国リストに含まれないウガンダも発生地として挙げられているが、記事の主題は越境リスクとベトナムの対応であるため、verified_locationsにはベトナムと発生源のコンゴのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: الصحة العالمية: خطر إيبولا على سكان الكوكب لا يزال منخفضا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: The risk of Ebola to the world's population remains low.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk to the global population remains low, according to a World Health Organization source from its Russian office. The current outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda and has been designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling elevated international attention but not an immediate global threat. As of October 2025, 131 deaths have been recorded in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The situation is described as worrisome and unfolding in complex conditions, with ongoing transmission and response challenges in the affected regions. While cross-border concerns exist, the article emphasizes that the global population remains at low risk. Monitoring and international coordination continue in light of the PHEIC designation.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：エボラウイルスの地球規模での危険性は引き続き低い
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生がPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）として指定されており、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当。対象国のDRC及び国際的な監視体制が確立されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの言及はあるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ロシアは地理的位置情報のみで実際の発生地ではないため除外。DRCでの131名の死亡報告、PHEIC指定、継続的な国際調整が確認されている。ただしWHO源は「グローバルリスク低い」と評価しているが、シグナルトリアージ段階ではPHEIC指定と実死亡報告に基づきPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: مع اقتراب كأس العالم: مخاوف من احتمال تفشّي الإيبولا في الولايات المتحدة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the World Cup approaches: concerns about the possibility of an Ebola outbreak in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) poses a heightened risk of importation into the United States as millions attend the World Cup, say health experts. Ebola, a deadly virus causing high fever, vomiting, diarrhea and fatigue, can progress to severe complications; incubation can extend up to 21 days without symptoms, complicating early detection. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) is coordinating with FIFA to implement safety and screening measures ahead of the tournament, while travel advisories are being intensified for the Democratic Republic of Congo amid a renewed outbreak there. Experts emphasize that risk management goes beyond vaccination and requires strengthened surveillance systems, rigorous case and contact tracing, and rapid outbreak response, particularly given heightened global travel and connectivity.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ開幕が近づく中：米国でのエボラウイルス流行の可能性に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も4つ以上該当し、高い重症度と流行可能性を示唆。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが米国を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーから判断すると、実際のエボラ発生地はDRCであり、米国への輸入リスクについての懸念記事である。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみを記載。米国はDRC対象国リストに非該当のため除外。DRCでの再燃爆発の報告とワールドカップ時期の国際的な移動増加により、国際的拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026: "Il n'y a pas d'inquiétude à avoir", la RD Congo a pris "toutes les dispositions" concernant l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026: 'There is no need to worry,' DR Congo has taken 'all necessary measures' regarding the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo’s football federation, after talks with FIFA, says it has taken all measures to comply with the health protocol set by the United States amid an Ebola outbreak in the country. The World Cup–bound squad and much of the technical staff operate largely in Europe, and the U.S. has imposed a three-week confinement for the group before arriving at their base camp in Houston for the tournament starting June 11. The federation announced the team will hold its camp in Belgium rather than Kinshasa. Technical staff who left Kinshasa on May 20 will spend at least 21 days in Europe before travelling to the United States. The World Health Organization defines the Ebola epidemic risk in DR Congo as “very high” since the 17th outbreak began on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026：「心配する必要はない」、コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ流行に対する「すべての対策」を実施
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行（WHOリスク評価「非常に高い」）であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）を複数満たす。国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に関連した国際保健関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ流行は5月15日に開始された第17回アウトブレイク。ワールドカップ2026開催に伴い、多くの参加国・スタッフが関与。米国が3週間の隔離措置を実施。WHO評価リスク「非常に高い」。ベルギーでの事前キャンプ実施など国際的な対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: DRC's Ebola battle strained by insecurity, funding cuts, mistrust
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri Province near Bunia, also involving North Kivu and South Kivu with suspected cases in Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain is a rare form with no approved vaccine or treatment. As of 2026-05-25, the Congolese ministry reports 904 suspected Ebola cases, mostly in Ituri, up from more than 700, and 119 suspected deaths per the ministry, though regional tallies list about 220 deaths. The outbreak is ongoing and has sparked attacks on Ebola treatment centers in Mongbwalu and arson at health centers, reflecting insecurity, displacement near 1 million people, weak governance, and aid cuts. Aid groups report shortages of PPE, testing kits, and body bags; burial restrictions limit wakes and large gatherings. Control is shared by government and rebel authorities with aid agencies amid mistrust.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ対策、不安定性、資金削減、不信により困難に
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in DRC with 904 suspected cases and 119+ deaths, involving multiple provinces (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) and suspected cases in Uganda. Meets IHR criteria for serious public health impact, unusual/unexpected event, and international spread risk; also meets multiple WPRO screening criteria (severity, epidemic-prone, manageability issues).
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EVD strain is rare with no approved vaccine/treatment. Critical operational challenges noted: attacks on treatment centers, PPE/testing kit shortages, displacement of ~1M people, weak governance, and mistrust among stakeholders. Suspected cases reported in Uganda but verified location limited to DRC per summary focus. High risk for international spread and ongoing outbreak with significant control management issues.

article.articleHeadline: El Congo dice que cumple con medidas sanitarias de EEUU para el Mundial tras el brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo says it is complying with U.S. health measures for the World Cup after the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Despite an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Leopards are complying with the United States' 21-day entry isolation for the World Cup. The outbreak, declared May 15 and linked to the Bundibugyo strain, has prompted over 900 suspected cases and about 204 probable deaths, with Ituri province identified as the epicenter. FECOFA and FIFA confirmed players and staff have met health requirements; most players train in Europe, and Kinshasa training was canceled to honor the measures. The squad will spend at least 21 days in Europe before traveling to the United States. Pre-tournament friendlies scheduled: June 3 in Liège, Belgium vs Denmark, and June 9 in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain vs Chile. The World Cup runs June 11–July 19 across the United States, Mexico, and Canada.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱流行後、ワールドカップ向けの米国保健措置への遵守を表明
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（疑い症例900件以上、死亡204件程度）がDRC（対象国）で発生しており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を満たし、国際的スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連で国際的拡大リスクと国際支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: 記事ではDRC内のイツリ州が流行の震源地と明記されている。2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ出血熱流行（Bundibugyo strain）で、疑い症例900件以上、死亡204件程度が報告されている。国際的スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）との関連で国際的な懸念が高い。ベルギー、スペインなど発症地域外への旅行に関連する追加の地理的参照はありますが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCにのみ限定されています。

article.articleHeadline: WHO waarschuwt voor ebola-uitbraak in Congo en Oeganda: meer dan 200 doden - Newsmonkey
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of an Ebola outbreak in Congo and Uganda: more than 200 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreaks a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC), urging intensified international cooperation. In the DRC, roughly 900 people may have contracted Ebola, with 101 laboratory-confirmed cases and 204 deaths reported by the Ministry of Health, centered in Ituri Province. The outbreak has also reached Uganda, with confirmed infections there. In Ituri, funerals for Ebola deaths are restricted to specialized teams to curb transmission during traditional rites. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the situation as highly alarming, noting that violence and regional instability hinder response efforts and complicate containment. The PHEIC designation emphasizes the need for urgent global support and coordinated measures to halt further spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがコンゴとウガンダのエボラ発生を警告：200人以上の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言済みのエボラアウトブレイク。DRCおよびウガンダで確認された複数国間での感染拡大と国際的な協力体制の構築が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダ双方の感染が記述されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダ（1605651ではなく226074）は対象国外のため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言、200人以上の死亡、複数国への拡大、地域不安定性による対応困難など、すべてのリスク指標が極めて高い。フルRRA実施必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya Sağlık Örgütü: Kongo'da 900'den Fazla Şüpheli Ebola Vakası Tespit Edildi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected in Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, more than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province, where ongoing conflict leaves about 5 million people in precarious conditions and where roughly one in four needs humanitarian aid and one in five are internally displaced. These circumstances substantially hinder Ebola contact tracing and early detection, complicating containment. The figures reflect intensified surveillance and testing, underscoring ongoing transmission within the Democratic Republic of the Congo and the need for robust outbreak response in a crisis setting.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関：コンゴで900件以上のエボラ疑い症例が検出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明確。エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則上の報告対象疾患。
triage.notes: エボラ病は国際公衆衛生上の最重要感染症。900件以上の疑い症例、101件の確定患者、紛争地域での大規模人道危機による封じ込め困難性、継続的な感染伝播が報告されている。DRC内での流行継続が明確。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Why The 2026 Ebola Outbreak Is A Cause of Concern: A Senior Doctor Tells Times Now Digital
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, the Ebola outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, described as the third-largest on record and notably less studied and harder to track. Dr. Rajeev Jayadevan, speaking with Times Now Digital, explains what’s new about this strain and why the outbreak is a cause for concern. He notes Ebola outbreaks date back to the 1970s, but this particular lineage presents greater challenges for surveillance and containment. The interview underscores uncertainties for clinicians and health systems due to limited prior study of Bundibugyo. The piece also flags India as a country to watch, urging vigilance given the global nature of outbreaks, though the article provides no specific local case counts or laboratory confirmations.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラアウトブレイクが懸念事項である理由：シニアドクターがTimes Now Digitalに語る
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の未知の特性と監視・封じ込めの困難さが指摘されており、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目で懸念がある。ただしインドでの確認症例や具体的なローカルデータが記事に明記されていないため、情報不足のため現段階ではWATCH判定。
triage.notes: 記事はインドを懸念対象国として言及しているが、インド国内の確認症例数、入院患者数、死亡者数などの具体的なローカルデータが提供されていない。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの中でも研究が少なく追跡が困難という指摘は重要であり、今後の続報が極めて重要。2026年のシナリオ記事である可能性も否定できない。

article.articleHeadline: KDC'de Ebola alarmı! 900'den fazla şüpheli vaka - Radikal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert in the DRC! More than 900 suspected cases - Radikal
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed, have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri region as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak began with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths, prompting a WHO declaration of an international public health emergency on May 17. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a rare variant with no approved treatment or vaccine. Ongoing conflict in Ituri, home to about 5 million people, hinders surveillance, with roughly one in four residents needing humanitarian assistance and one in five displaced within the country. WHO and partners remain deployed across Ituri, including the most fragile areas, while communities face Ebola and other health threats. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River, with the 2014 West Africa outbreak cited for context.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ警報！900件以上の疑似症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当する極めて重大な感染症イベント。WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言が既に発令されている。
triage.notes: WHO国際公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が2026年5月17日に既に宣言されている。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは治療薬やワクチンが承認されていない稀な変異株。500万人が暮らすIturi地域での紛争による監視の困難性、高い人道支援ニーズ、国内避難民の多さなど複合的リスク要因が存在。Angolaは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのIturi地域が主要な発生地としてのみ記述されているため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: la Centrafrique "a instruit l'ensemble des structures sanitaires et sécuritaires concernées"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the Central African Republic has instructed all relevant health and security authorities.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to trigger regional concern, with Africa CDC estimating 10 countries at high risk, including the Central African Republic (CAR). CAR authorities have strengthened border controls and surveillance to prevent cross-border spread, given CAR’s long border with the DRC and numerous informal crossings. On May 24, Bangui’s Health Ministry outlined three strategic axes: strengthen nationwide epidemiological surveillance, secure high-risk border entry points—with particular focus on Obo, Zemio, and Mboki sub-prefectures near the DRC epicenter—and mobilize communities and institutions for a coordinated national response. Diagnostic capacity is being consolidated at the Institut Pasteur de Bangui with international partners, and reagents are available. In the DRC, more than 900 people are suspected to have Ebola hemorrhagic fever; the outbreak was declared on May 15 and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which has no vaccine or specific treatment and can have up to 50% case fatality. The WHO has issued an international alert.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：中央アフリカ共和国が関係するすべての保健・安全保障機関に指示を出した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際的な拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱の流行宣言、900人超の患者、致命率50%、WHO国際警報発行により、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行を主題とし、中央アフリカ共和国は隣接国として国境管理強化の対応を実施している状況。Bundibugyo ebolavirus、ワクチンなし、致命率最大50%。WHO国際警報発行済み。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に追加。中央アフリカ共和国は対象国リストに未含有のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Muncul 51 Kasus PMK di Boyolali, Vaksinasi Digencarkan - Suara Merdeka Solo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 51 Foot-and-Mouth Disease Cases in Boyolali, Vaccination Drive Intensified
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) cases in Boyolali Regency, Central Java, Indonesia rise to 51 from January–May 2026, with three deaths. As of May 19, 2026, 13,500 vaccine doses have been administered, part of an intensified campaign by Disnakkan Boyolali. FMD has been detected in seven districts, including Mojosongo, Amdong, Wonosegoro, Nogosari, Karanggede and Tamansari, prompting rapid monitoring and response. Authorities tightened livestock movement at markets, distributed leaflets, and launched outreach on Instagram and TikTok to the farming community. The rise is attributed to increased livestock traffic ahead of Idul Adha (Eid al-Adha) with crowded markets and online COD transactions. The 2026 situation is described as more controlled than late 2024/early 2025 outbreaks; a 2022 PMK outbreak involved 452 cases across 16 districts and 151 livestock deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ボヨラリで口蹄疫（FMD）51例が発生、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを強化
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの動物衛生上の重要なシグナル。口蹄疫は農業経済と食糧安全保障に深刻な影響をもたらし、国境を越えた拡大リスクがある。IHR基準に該当し、地域的な流行管理能力についての確認が必要。
triage.notes: 口蹄疫は家畜に対する重要な感染症であり、農業経済に甚大な影響を与える。記事は中央ジャワのボヨラリ県での51例の発生を報告し、2024年後半から2025年初頭のアウトブレイク（452例）と比較している。イード・アル＝アドハに先立つ家畜移動の増加が拡大要因。発生地域に North Korea が含まれているが、記事サマリーではインドネシアのみが主題であるため、verified_locations にはインドネシアのみを記載。当該地域での継続的な監視と、東南アジア域内での感染拡大予防が重要。

article.sourceUrl: https://vietnam.vnanet.vn/japanese/tin-van/エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国が「二重の危機」に直面-447837.html
article.articleHeadline: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国が「二重の危機」に直面
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: the Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a 'double crisis'.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 Ebola suspected cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed positives as of May 24, according to the World Health Organization director Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus while expanding surveillance. Ituri Province, the outbreak’s epicenter with about 5 million residents, sees roughly 25% needing humanitarian aid and 20% internally displaced due to ongoing conflict. Escalating violence is forcing health workers and aid personnel to flee, severely hindering outbreak containment. The Congolese Ministry of Communications reports 904 suspected infections and 119 suspected Ebola-related deaths as of May 24; infections remain concentrated in Ituri but spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, and have crossed the border into Uganda. Authorities emphasize delivering comprehensive medical services to address urgent needs and to restore community trust and improve response effectiveness in this double crisis.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国が「二重の危機」に直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900件超の疑似症例、119死亡）、異常性（大規模流行）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）、渡航制限の可能性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境確認あり。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。記事では DRC が主要な発生地で、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu の各州が言及されている。紛争による人道危機と保健システム崩壊により対応困難な状況が深刻。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo, cresce l'allarme: aumentano i casi e Medici senza frontiere avverte "È una corsa contro il tempo"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, alarm grows: cases are increasing, and Doctors Without Borders warns "It's a race against time."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo worsens, with confirmed cases reaching 1,000 as health authorities warn of a rapidly expanding epidemic. The World Health Organization has raised the national risk level to very high and heightened surveillance for border countries Uganda and South Sudan, amid fears of cross-border spread. The Bundibugyo strain is implicated, and there is currently no approved vaccine for this variant. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) cautions that a timely and intensified response is essential to limit infections and prevent wider transmission. Challenges include logistical hurdles, unstable access to affected areas, and insufficient health infrastructure, complicating contact tracing and patient care. Several cases linked to the Congo outbreak have appeared outside the epicenter, prompting reinforced border controls. International partners are mobilizing emergency supplies and specialized teams, but containment hinges on rapid action to prevent a broader outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱、警戒が高まる：症例が増加、国境なき医師団が「時間との競争」と警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、ウガンダ・スーダンへの越境拡大リスク、確定症例1,000件、ワクチンなし、国際的対応が必要な大規模エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ(226074)とスーダン(366755)が含まれていますが、サマリーでは「ウガンダとスーダン南部に対する越境拡大リスク」「コンゴ集団発生に関連した複数症例が震源地外で報告」と述べられており、主たる発生地はコンゴです。したがって verified_locations にはDRCのみを含めます。対象国リストに非対象国(ウガンダ、スーダン)が含まれるため、DRCのみの記載が適切です。

article.articleHeadline: Глава ВОЗ: число предполагаемых случаев заражения Эболой в ДР Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO chief: the number of suspected Ebola cases in DR Congo has surpassed 900.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola cases, including 101 confirmed, are reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with the outbreak centered in Ituri Province in the northeast and Mongwalu as a focal point. The index patient, a nurse who sought care in Bunia on 24 April, died; his body was transported to Mongwalu, and a damaged coffin amid the journey sparked community rumors of a ‘mystical disease.’ WHO notes rapid spread in Africa and warns of the risk of further transmission and deaths; on 17 May it declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Africa CDC identifies ten Central African states at risk: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo, Burundi, Angola, Central African Republic, and Zambia. On 19 May, WHO planned deployments of epidemiologists and five tonnes of infection prevention and control equipment, though access remains hampered by a collapsed bridge near Mongwalu and security issues complicating tracing.

triage.headline_ja: WHO事務局長：コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染推定患者数が900を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は高い致死率を持つ予想外の大規模アウトブレイク（900人超の疑い患者、101人確定）であり、既にWHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（Ituri州）でのアウトブレイクが主題。アフリカCDCが「リスク下にある」10カ国を特定していますが、これらは潜在的なリスク国であり、実際の確認患者地域ではありません。対象国リスト内で実際に患者が報告されているのはDRC（Ituri州、Bunia市）です。ZambiaはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれていますが、サマリーにおいてZambiaでの実際の患者発生は明記されていません。ただし、Africa CDCが言及した「リスク下にある10カ国」の一部としてZambiaが列挙されているため、予防的観点から含めました。PHEIC宣言済みで、WHO派遣準備中。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC Warns Ebola Outbreak Is a Regional Threat as 10 Countries Face Risk
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DR Congo and Uganda remains a regional threat: 96 confirmed cases and 11 deaths; 867 suspected cases and 204 suspected deaths. Uganda added three new cases, now five total: a driver, a health worker, and a Congolese woman arriving by plane. DR Congo's Bunia lab cannot detect Bundibugyo strain; samples go to Kinshasa for confirmation. At a Kampala meeting, Africa CDC and partners endorsed a unified response—one team, one plan, one budget, one implementation model—under the Incident Management Support Team, with Uganda hosting. Ten at-risk countries border DR Congo or Uganda: South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, Tanzania, Ethiopia, Congo-Brazzaville, Burundi, Angola, CAR, and Zambia. Emphasis on cross-border surveillance, labs, and entry-point infection controls; UNICEF urged continued essential services, UNFPA notes women account for over 60% of infections. Preliminary funding: about $264 million for operations in DR Congo and Uganda, plus $54 million for neighboring preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCが警告：エボラ集団発生は地域的脅威、10カ国がリスク直面
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。対象国DRCとUgandaで確認患者・死亡発生、周辺10カ国への国境越境リスクが明確。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo Ebola(ブンディブギョエボラ)のDRC・ウガンダでの集団発生を主題としており、DRCのBunia/KinshasaとウガンダのKampalaが確認地点。対象国Zambiaは「リスク国」として列挙されているが、実際の患者発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。周辺国への地域的脅威が高く、統一対応計画と318百万ドルの予算配分が決定されている。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള ഭീതി; യാത്രക്കാര്‍ക്കും വിമാനക്കമ്പനികള്‍ക്കും നിര്‍ദ്ദേശങ്ങള്‍ പുറത്തിറക്കി ഒമാന്‍
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola fear; Oman issues guidelines for travelers and airlines.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Oman’s Civil Aviation Authority issued travel and airline guidelines amid Ebola fears linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Issued on May 24 in collaboration with Oman’s Medical Response Division, the directive requires all airlines operating in Oman and travelers to and from Ebola-affected areas to observe enhanced health precautions. It urges avoiding nonessential travel to Ebola-affected regions and stresses adherence to health advisories from local health authorities and the World Health Organization. The measures align with WHO guidance and global health alerts and aim to curb spread via air travel as authorities monitor ongoing Ebola activity in DRC and Uganda. The summary notes vigilance but does not provide local case counts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ恐怖; オマーンが旅行者と航空会社に対して指針を発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ流行に対するオマーンの公的な渡航・運航制限措置であり、国際的な関心と対応が明示されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダのエボラ流行を主題としているが、対象国リストではDRCのみが含まれるため verified_locations にはDRCのみを列挙。オマーン（対象国でない）の渡航指針は二次的な対応。Bundibugyo ebolavirus 変異株の流行により、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的な対応需要が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda detects two new Ebola cases in Kampala health facility; total cases rise to 7
