article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Uganda reports seven confirmed Ebola cases linked to the Bundibugyo strain, with two new cases in a private Kampala health facility—both Ugandan health workers. Three cases previously confirmed on Saturday had raised the total to five: a driver who carried the first patient, a health worker exposed during care, and a Congolese woman who tested positive after travelling back to the Democratic Republic of Congo. Contacts are being closely monitored; infection-control measures in health facilities have been strengthened. The outbreak centers on Bundibugyo Ebola (no vaccine or virus-specific treatment). The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern, and warned the risk of a national epidemic in DRC remains very high. In DRC, nearly 750 suspected cases and 177 suspected deaths have been reported; challenges include delayed detection, violence, and high mobility.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがカンパラの医療施設で新たなエボラ出血熱患者2例を検出；総患者数は7例に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者7例（ウガンダ）と約750疑い例・177疑い死亡（DRC）が報告されており、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。IHR基準4項目全て該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ウガンダとDRCの両国で確認患者・疑い例が報告されている。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスに対するワクチンなし。DRCでは暴力や高い人口移動性により検出遅延のリスクが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Coupe du monde 2026/Ebola: Toutes les dispositions sont prises pour une participation sécurisée rassure la Fécofa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup 2026/Ebola: All measures have been taken to reassure Fécofa of a secure participation.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's national team, the Leopards, has coordinated Ebola-related health measures with FIFA amid strict U.S. government guidance for World Cup participation. The federation notes most players do not reside in Congo; a small portion of staff from Kinshasa currently in Belgium will spend more than 21 days in Europe under close surveillance to ensure smooth entry to the United States. The entire delegation will comply with U.S. health authorities' instructions, while supporters who purchased tickets but are denied U.S. entry will be reimbursed by FIFA. Preparatory matches in Europe against Denmark (June 3, Liège, Belgium) and Chile (June 9, Marbella, Spain) precede the World Cup kicking off June 11.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップ/エボラ：安全な参加のためにすべての措置が講じられていることをフェコファが保証
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発症者の報告がなく、主にコンゴの代表団が国際大会参加時の予防措置を講じている記事。IHR基準は該当せず、社会的関心は限定的だがシグナルとして一部基準に該当する可能性があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは実際のエボラ症例報告ではなく、コンゴがワールドカップ参加時に実施する予防措置について述べている。スペイン・ベルギー・デンマークなどで準備試合が予定されているが、これらの国での感染症イベント発生は報告されていない。発生地域リストに複数国が含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCの対策であり、他国での実際の感染症イベント発生は確認できない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC tem mais de 900 casos suspeitos de ebola, afirma OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC has more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (RDC), including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak, declared May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. The WHO noted no updated death tally from the director; a previous health ministry update counted 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases in three provinces. Ebola is a viral hemorrhagic fever spread by direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and multi-organ failure. Response efforts continue in a conflict-affected RDC amid ongoing surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: DRC has more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, says WHO. (コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例が900件以上 - WHO発表)
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。900件以上の疑い例（確認例101件、死亡204件）を伴う大規模エボラ出血熱の流行であり、ワクチン・承認治療法がない危険な株（Bundibugyo）による。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は最高水準。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は承認ワクチン・治療法がなく、致死率が高い。紛争地域での発生により対応の困難性が増加。WHO事務局長による直接発表で国際的な関心が極めて高い。ただし死亡数の最新値が報告されていないため、リアルタイムの疫学的監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Egyre csak nő az ebola-gyanús esetek száma Kelet-Afrikában
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola cases continues to rise in East Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri Province, where nearly 5 million people live amid ongoing armed conflict; about a quarter of residents need humanitarian aid and roughly one-fifth are internally displaced. Violence has hindered response efforts, including contact tracing and early detection. The DRC’s health ministry counts 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases to date, with the outbreak formally reported on May 15. The circulating virus is a Bundibugyo strain for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted therapy. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated materials, or the bodies of the deceased; the incubation period is 2–10 days. Ebola has persisted in Africa since 1976, most often in the DRC, with the Zaire strain causing 60–70% mortality in 2013.

triage.headline_ja: 東アフリカではエボラウイルス疑い例の数が増加し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株、ワクチンなし、ヒト-ヒト感染、紛争中の地域での拡大という高リスク要因が複合している。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月25日時点でコンゴ民主共和国(DRC)イトゥリ州におけるエボラアウトブレイクを報告している。確認感染者101例、疑い例900例以上、死亡204例。Bundibugyo株はワクチン未開発で、紛争による保健対応の阻害が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: इबोला का हाहाकार: 20 दिनों में 204 मौतें, भारत में अभी तक नया स्ट्रेन नहीं, लेकिन दक्षिण भारत में अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Havoc: 204 Deaths in 20 Days, No New Strain Yet in India, but South India on Alert.
article.articleSummary: 204 deaths in 20 days from the Bundibugyo Ebola strain driving Africa’s outbreak, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda; India reports no cases yet but issues a high-level travel advisory for Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan on 25 May 2026. Travelers arriving from or transiting through these countries must undergo 21 days of self-monitoring and health surveillance, and report fever, extreme weakness, headache, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, sore throat, or bleeding to authorities. Immigration requires full travel history be recorded before airport health officer clearance. In India, no Bundibugyo cases are confirmed; South India remains on alert with intensified airport surveillance in Andhra Pradesh, alongside existing screens in Kerala and Karnataka. Visakhapatnam, Tirupati, and Vijayawada airports screen suspected travelers; quarantining and 15-bed isolation wards are prepared in major hospitals for affected-city patients.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの猛威：20日間で204人が死亡、インドではまだ新しい株は検出されていないが、南インドでアラート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アフリカでの継続的な死亡者数増加とインドでの高度な警戒体制の構築が確認され、シグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはDRC、Uganda、South Sudanなどアフリカ諸国が含まれているが、記事の主題はアフリカでのエボラ流行とそれに対するインドの対応である。インドでの確定症例はまだ報告されていないものの、高度な警戒体制（空港検査の強化、隔離施設の準備）が実施されており、verified_locationsはインド（対象国リストに含まれる1269750）のみとした。アフリカ諸国（DRC、Uganda、Sudan）は本評価の対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS eleva a más de 900 los casos sospechosos o confirmados de ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO raises the number of suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in Congo to more than 900.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected or laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 101 laboratory-confirmed, with 204 probable deaths. The outbreak centers on Ituri Province, notably Bunia, where violence, displacement, and strained health services impede case finding and contact tracing. Ituri hosts about 693,000 residents, with roughly 25% needing humanitarian aid and 20% displaced. Armed groups such as the Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) and Codeco operate near gold mining areas, fueling insecurity and attacks on civilians and aid workers. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain features a 30–50% fatality rate and, per the WHO, there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO Director-General Tedros urged intensified outreach and tracing despite security challenges; this is the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ疑い例および確認例を900件以上に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致死率30～50%）による大規模アウトブレイク、セキュリティ上の制約下での対応困難、WHO総長による緊急呼びかけあり。
triage.notes: 900件超の疑い例・確認例（101件は検査室確認）、204件の死亡報告。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（高い致死率）でワクチン・特異的治療法がない。Ituri州（特にBunia）での武装勢力による暴力と不安定性が対応を著しく阻害。DRC17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Trị siết kiểm dịch ngăn Ebola qua biên giới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Tri tightens border quarantine to prevent Ebola from crossing the border.
article.articleSummary: Quảng Trị Province tightens border quarantine at Lao Bao International Border Gate, La Lay International Border Gate, and Cửa Việt Port to prevent Ebola importation into Vietnam. In response to Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, the Ministry of Health and the Department of Disease Prevention issued urgent directives to strengthen border controls. From May 5–20, 2026, WHO reports about 600 suspected Ebola cases and 139 deaths in Congo and Uganda, with more than 50 confirmed as Bundibugyo Ebola virus. Nguyễn Kim Thành, Director of Quảng Trị CDC, announced intensified medical quarantine and screening at the three gateways, supported by temperature-sensing systems to screen travelers and goods. Dương Văn Tự of the International Health Quarantine Department described continuous, strict procedures and enhanced communications. Ebola is a highly infectious disease with hemorrhagic fever and up to 90% mortality; transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and body fluids or contaminated objects. MoH and WHO urge heightened surveillance to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省、ラオ国境を越えたエボラウイルスの流入を防ぐため国境検疫を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。コンゴおよびウガンダでのエボラ確認事例（600疑い例、139死亡、50例以上確認）、高い致死率（最大90%）、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、複数国での発生と国際的拡大懸念により、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedotで検出されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナム（クアンチ省）は国境対策を強化中であり、直接的な発生地域ではなく隣接する流行地域への対応として掲載。DRCは活動的なエボラ流行中心地として確認。Bundibugyo Ebola virusの検出により病原体の特定が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan health officials report new Ebola virus infections, bringing cases to 7
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports two new Ebola virus disease cases, bringing total to seven linked to the Congo outbreak that Uganda notes began days before Congo declared it on May 15. A 59-year-old Congolese man admitted in Kampala on May 11 died three days later without Ebola diagnosis; two other Congolese nationals seeking care in Uganda later tested positive. First locally acquired infections were confirmed on Saturday—a driver and a health worker exposed to the patient who died May 11—with two more Kampala health workers at a private hospital testing positive by Monday. In Congo, suspected Ebola cases exceed 900, concentrated in Ituri province, amid fear, attacks on treatment centers, and distrust of authorities. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain driving the outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment; the outbreak has been declared a global health emergency.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの保健当局が新たなエボラウイルス感染を報告し、感染例が7例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目全て該当。複数国での感染、重症度高、ワクチン/治療なし、グローバル保健緊急事態宣言済みのため、フルリスク評価が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの新規感染を報告しているが、主たる感染源はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のIturi州であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播・継発感染の状況である。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ（Uganda）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイク、ワクチン・治療法なし、グローバル保健緊急事態宣言済みという極めて高リスクな状況。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 900 casos suspeitos ou confirmados de ébola na RDCongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province exceeds 900 suspected or confirmed cases, with 204 probable deaths reported since the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. As of May 25, 2026, humanitarian needs are acute, with about 25% of the population requiring assistance and 20% displaced. Violence is driving people, including health and humanitarian workers, to flee, severely hindering contact tracing and early case identification. Angola, bordering the DRC, is among Africa CDC’s top 10 at-risk countries for Ebola spread. Ongoing crises in eastern Congo, including the M23 rebel group with alleged Rwandan support, complicate the response. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or other infected fluids, causing fever, muscle pain, weakness, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. The article highlights the region’s history of recurrent Ebola outbreaks and the broader security and humanitarian challenges facing response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ疑い例・確定例が900例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で公衆衛生への重大な影響、国際的拡大リスク（アンゴラ含む隣接国への危険性言及）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはルワンダとアンゴラも含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC（Ituri州）の流行である。アンゴラは「Africa CDC's top 10 at-risk countries」と記述されており、確認例ではなく懸念地域として言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。本件は両WPRO基準とも5つすべて該当し、緊急性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Волонтеры Красного Креста погибли от Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Red Cross volunteers died of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Three Red Cross volunteers in the Democratic Republic of Congo died from Ebola during a new outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus. They contracted the virus while handling bodies before precautions were in place. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus lauded their sacrifice and noted that early detection and timely treatment curb spread. The epicenter is Ituri Province; DRC has 82 confirmed cases and seven deaths, with potential underreporting in the hundreds. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The outbreak has also been detected in neighboring Uganda with new infections. WHO has raised the regional public health risk to very high, though the global risk remains low. Ebola transmission is via close contact with bodily fluids. Travelers should check epidemiological conditions and practice hygiene, reporting illness after travel.

triage.headline_ja: 赤十字のボランティアがエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の新規流行であり、複数国での確認、死亡事例、社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCでの流行が明確に主題となっており、ウガンダでの確認も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による新規流行、ワクチンなし、死亡事例あり、WHO地域リスク「very high」と評価されており、極めて懸念される状況。

article.articleHeadline: 6 Kasus PMK Terdeteksi di Ngaliyan dan Banyumanik Kota Semarang - Tribunjateng.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6 Foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) cases detected in Ngaliyan and Banyumanik, Semarang City - Tribunjateng.com
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-Mouth Disease (FMD) cases detected in Semarang City, Indonesia: six cattle infected this year, with three cases in Ngaliyan and three in Banyumanik. As of May 25, 2026, affected animals show recovery progress. The City Agriculture Office reports ongoing vaccination campaigns, with vaccines available and routinely administered to cattle to curb spread. Infected cattle have been isolated from healthy stock to prevent transmission. One Ngaliyan calf reportedly died, suspected to be PMK-related, and had not yet received vaccination. The report provides no laboratory confirmation details or identified infection sources. The response emphasizes increased farmer awareness, improved recognition and handling of symptoms, and regular vaccination to manage the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: セマラン市のンガリヤンとバニュマニクで口蹄疫（FMD）6症例が検出される
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける口蹄疫の局所的な発生報告。動物疾患であり公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響は限定的だが、畜産業への経済的影響の可能性、国内拡大リスク、および情報不足により経過観察対象とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物疾患（口蹄疫）であり、IHR(2005)の定義上、人への直接的な公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的。ただしインドネシアでの局所的な発生が報告され、畜産業への経済的影響、さらなる国内拡大の可能性があるため注視対象とした。ラボ確認情報および感染源の特定がない点が情報不足。局所的な地域での6症例の報告であり、現時点ではWATCHが適切。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS eleva a más de 900 los casos sospechosos o confirmados de ébola en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO raises the number of suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo to more than 900.
article.articleSummary: On 25 May 2026, the World Health Organization reported that suspected or confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have surpassed 900, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 204 probable deaths. The outbreak, declared on 15 May, is concentrated in Ituri province, the epicenter, where about one in four residents needs humanitarian assistance. The Red Cross confirmed the deaths of three volunteers working to respond to the outbreak. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that violence is driving displacement, including of health and humanitarian workers, and is severely hindering contact tracing and early identification of infections necessary for timely support.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い例・確認例を900例超に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスは重大な公衆衛生上の影響を持ち、DRCでの大規模流行は国際的な懸念事項であり、WHO通知基準を明らかに満たす。
triage.notes: 2026年5月25日時点で確認例101件、疑い例を含む900例超。5月15日に流行宣言。Ituri州が震源地。暴力による医療従事者の避難が制御を困難にしており、国際支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Aggasztó adatok Kongóból: több mint 900-ra nőtt az ebolagyanús megbetegedések száma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming data from Congo: the number of Ebola-suspected cases has risen to over 900.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached three provinces. By May 23, health authorities identified over 900 suspected cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus and Congolese authorities note intensified screening leading to rapid case finding; meanwhile, the Ministry of Health reports at least 204 deaths among suspected cases, though WHO has not released new fatality data. The outbreak was declared on May 15 after detecting the Bundibugyo strain. Ebola is highly lethal, transmitted by direct contact with body fluids, causing severe internal bleeding and organ failure. While vaccines exist for some Ebola strains, there is no approved countermeasure for the current strain. Ongoing armed conflict and security instability in the region hinder humanitarian and health responses and raise concerns about cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴからの懸念すべきデータ：エボラ疑い患者数が900人以上に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラアウトブレイクは公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、国際的拡大リスクと死亡者数の増加が確認されている。
triage.notes: 2026年5月時点でのエボラアウトブレイク。900人以上の疑い患者、101人の確定患者、204人以上の死亡例が報告されている。Bundibugyo株で既知のワクチンが無い可能性がある。武装紛争と治安不安定性が対応を阻害し、越境拡大のリスクが高い。WHO事務局長による重要声明あり。フルRRA実施が緊急。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, Bundibugyo Virus Disease (BVD), a severe Ebola form caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is under observation in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The outbreak underscores cross-border risk and vulnerabilities in communities with active mobility and limited health resources. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected animals, bodily fluids of infected individuals, contaminated surfaces, and unsafe burial practices. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, muscle pains, and occasionally unexplained bleeding. Africa CDC is coordinating with affected Member States, Ministries of Health, regional partners, and international stakeholders to strengthen surveillance and laboratory capacity, risk communication, cross-border coordination, infection prevention and control, and emergency response operations. The Africa CDC webpage serves as the central platform for situation updates, technical guidance, press releases, public health advisories, and response resources related to the Bundibugyo outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス病は重篤度が高く、DRCとウガンダにおける国境を越えた拡大リスク、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威が認識される。アフリカCDCによる調整のもと国際対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダの両国に言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ブンディブギョ株によるエボラウイルス病は高い致死率を示す重篤な病原体であり、国境を越えた感染リスクと医療脆弱性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms two more Ebola cases, taking total to seven
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports two additional lab-confirmed Ebola cases, bringing the national total to seven as of May 25, 2026. The new infections are health workers at a private facility in Kampala; both Ugandans admitted to the designated treatment unit and receiving care. Response teams are tracing all contacts linked to the two patients. Uganda previously confirmed three new cases on Saturday, underscoring ongoing transmission linked to the outbreak centered in neighboring DR Congo’s Ituri province, which borders Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola a public health emergency of international concern (PHEIC). WHO notes more than 900 suspected cases in the outbreak, including 101 laboratory-confirmed cases, highlighting the sustained cross-border transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の2例を追加確認、総数は7例に
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認事例が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告され、国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められ、WHOがPHEICを宣言している。IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はウガンダのエボラ事例確認ですが、発生地の地理的検証により、実際のアウトブレイク中心地はDRC Ituri州で、ウガンダは「隣接国での越境伝播」という文脈で言及されています。対象国リストの観点から、DRCのみが verified_locations に含まれます。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、国際的な懸念は極めて高い。ウガンダが対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locations には含めていません。

article.articleHeadline: 900 casos suspeitos de Ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 900 suspected or confirmed cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, as of 25 May 2026. The Ituri Province is the epicenter of the crisis, where health authorities report substantial challenges in controlling transmission. The World Health Organization, led by Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus, has alerted to difficulties in the response and the need for intensified laboratory confirmation, surveillance, and containment measures. The updated figures reflect ongoing transmission and the urgency of scalable public health actions to curb further spread from the Ituri-focused outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疑似症例が900件を超過
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の集団発生で900件以上の疑似症例と101件の確定症例が報告され、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する。国際的な懸念と公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州がエボラ集団発生の震源地として明記されており、WHOも対応の困難性を指摘している。対象国リスト（WPRO地域）に含まれていないが、グローバルな感染症危機として極めて重要なシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS alerta de más de 900 casos sospechosos de ébola en RDC en medio de una grave crisis humanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO warns of more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC amid a severe humanitarian crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri with reported cases in North Kivu and South Kivu. As of May 23, 2026, the Ministry of Health notes 904 suspected Ebola cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections; 10 Ebola deaths are confirmed, with 119 suspected Ebola-associated deaths. Africa CDC counts 204 probable deaths across DRC and Uganda, though Uganda’s burden is smaller. The epidemic is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there are no vaccines or approved antibody therapies. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is aggravated by ongoing violence and a grave humanitarian crisis that hampers contact tracing and surveillance. About 25% of Ituri’s population needs humanitarian assistance and roughly 20% are internally displaced. WHO and partners maintain a presence across Ituri and advocate a comprehensive health services package to strengthen response and community trust.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、民主共和国コンゴ（DRC）における900例を超えるエボラ疑い患者を警告、深刻な人道危機の中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの多数の確認患者と疑い患者、高い致死率、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、深刻な人道危機により国際的対応が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事中で言及されていますが、サマリーではウガンダの症例数が「より少ない」と明記されており、主要な発生地はDRCです。WPRO基準では対象地域外（ウガンダはAFRO地域）ですが、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めました。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀なストレイン）の存在、ワクチンと承認抗体療法の欠如、24%の致死率（確認患者）、ウガンダへの既知の拡大、人道危機と暴力によるコントロール困難は、全基準で最高度のリスクを示しています。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda meldet zwei neue Ebola-Fälle - WELT
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports two new Ebola cases - WELT
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola cases have been confirmed in Uganda, bringing the East African country's total to seven. The patients are two staff members of a private clinic in Kampala who are currently receiving treatment; all contacts are being monitored and traced. Previously, a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who flew into Kampala developed abdominal symptoms, was treated at a private clinic there, and subsequently tested positive for Ebola. The World Health Organization had, in mid-May, declared a public health emergency of international concern over the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo; at that time there were more than 240 suspected infections. Since then, the tally has grown to more than 900 suspected cases and more than 100 confirmed cases overall. Ongoing outbreaks center on DRC; Uganda reports additional cases in relation to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが新たなエボラ出血熱2件を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ）、WHOによる公衆衛生上の国際的危機宣言済み、深刻な重症度、高い国際的関心。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの患者確認は記事で述べられているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが指数発生源であり、引き続きDRCが主要なエボラ出血熱発生国である。WHOによる国際的公衆衛生緊急事態宣言済みで、アウトブレイク規模は900以上の疑い患者、100以上の確定患者という極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Venezuela refuerza vigilancia en puertos y aeropuertos tras alerta global por brote de ébola | El Estímulo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Venezuela Strengthens Surveillance at Ports and Airports After Global Alert for Ebola Outbreak | El Estímulo
article.articleSummary: On 2026-05-25, Venezuela tightened surveillance at ports and airports after the WHO raised the Ebola risk in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to very high. The Venezuelan Health Ministry updated its Plan for Preparedness and Response and reinforced epidemiological controls at air and seaport terminals to detect imported infections. The WHO reports the DRC outbreak has about 750 suspected cases and at least 177 deaths under epidemiological investigation, with laboratory-confirmed cases substantially fewer. The outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, and the WHO has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. Travelers to affected areas are advised to practice basic precautions, avoid contact with symptomatic individuals, and seek care for fever or malaise. International surveillance continues, including cases linked to Uganda and evacuations of exposed foreigners; global risk remains low but vigilance persists.

triage.headline_ja: ベネズエラ、エボラ熱の世界的なアウトブレイク警告後、港湾空港での監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC宣言済み、複数国での確認、高い死亡率を伴うエボラ熱のアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ熱アウトブレイク（約750疑い例、177死亡、Bundibugyo variant）が主題であり、ベネズエラは監視強化対応国として言及されている。Ugandaはサマリーで言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。DRCのみが対象国リストに該当。WHO PHEIC宣言により、国際的な懸念事項として最高リスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Deux nouveaux cas confirmés d'infection au virus Ebola en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new confirmed cases of Ebola virus infection in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Two more confirmed Ebola virus disease cases in Uganda raise the national total to seven, with one death among the confirmed cases. The two new infections are Ugandan healthcare workers from a private clinic in Kampala, admitted to a dedicated treatment unit and currently under care. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, where the outbreak was declared on May 15, authorities report over 900 suspected infections; the latest health ministry tally records 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with a case fatality up to about 50%. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency of international concern. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the past 50 years, with mortality ranging from 25% to 90%.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでエボラウイルス感染の新規確認症例2件
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。WHOが公衆衛生上の国際的に懸念される事態を宣言し、複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で確認症例と死亡が報告されている。高い致命率（約50%）のBundibugyo株による。
triage.notes: ウガンダはWPRO対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダ両国に言及されているが、対象国はDRCのみ。WHO緊急事態宣言済みで国際的に高い関心。Bundibugyo株はワクチン・特異的治療がなく、致命率が極めて高い点で重大。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola fuori controllo in Congo: il virus arriva anche nel Sud Kivu. Aumentano morti e contagi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in Congo: The virus also reaches South Kivu. Deaths and infections are rising.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks worsen in the Democratic Republic of Congo, now extending to South Kivu with two confirmed cases, including one death, in the Miti-Murhesa health zone, Kabare territory, about 20 km north of Bukavu. The new cluster occurs in a conflict-affected area where armed groups AFC/M23 impede response efforts. Kinshasa is pursuing diplomatic steps to secure safe access for health and humanitarian teams and is pressing to reopen Goma International Airport and improve logistics to South Kivu to accelerate aid delivery and regional coordination. The 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC has already caused 817 infections and 179 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, signaling ongoing cross-province transmission and the need for coordinated, safety-focused response operations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが制御不能：ウイルスも南キブ州に到達。死亡者と感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病の国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威が明確。紛争地域での対応制約により管理可能性も低下している。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。現在までに817例の感染と179人の死亡が報告されている。南キブ州への新規拡大、紛争地域での対応障害、国際空港利用制限による物流の制約が特徴。フルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: África: BAD Reúne-se Sob Ameaça do Ébola e Debate Financiamento Interno no Continente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa: AfDB Meets Under Ebola Threat and Debates Domestic Financing on the Continent.
article.articleSummary: Annual AfDB meeting in the Democratic Republic of Congo proceeds amid an Ebola outbreak that has spread to Uganda with more than 170 suspected deaths. Government says no restrictions per the WHO. Global aid to Africa fell about 25% to $174.3 billion last year, led by the United States, including concessional lending cuts to the AfDB. AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah promotes the New African Financing Architecture for Development (NAFAD) to mobilize Africa’s own resources to close a $400 billion annual development gap, prioritizing energy, food security, climate adaptation, infrastructure and jobs. Proponents cite roughly $4 trillion in internal institutional capital (pensions, sovereign funds, savings schemes), though capital is fragmented. Critics argue savings are insufficient (Sub-Saharan Africa ~18%), urging use of internal capital to catalyze foreign investment with guarantees. Kenya’s William Ruto backs NAFAD.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ：AfDB（アフリカ開発銀行）はエボラ脅威の下で会合を開き、大陸内の国内資金調達を議論
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の発生がDRCからウガンダへ拡大し、170人以上の疑い死亡者が報告されている。IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）の複数該当及びWPRO基準の複数該当により、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda及びKenyaも記載されているが、記事サマリーでは「DRCで始まったアウトブレイクがウガンダに拡大」という言及であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。エボラウイルス病は極めて重大な公衆衛生脅威であり、政治経済フォーラム（AfDB年次会合）が開催地を変更していない点から各政府の認識が示唆される。170人以上の疑い死亡という数字が報告されているため重症度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Країни Африки вводять "ковідні" обмеження через спалах Еболи в Конго | Головне в Україні
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African countries impose COVID restrictions due to Ebola outbreak in Congo | Top stories in Ukraine
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Eastern and Southern African countries tightened Ebola safeguards amid an outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The World Health Organization counted more than 900 suspected Ebola cases with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and at least 177 fatalities. Uganda confirmed three additional cases, bringing its total to five, and temporarily canceled mass events near the border and suspended cross-border transport for four weeks. Neighbouring nations boosted border screening and public campaigns. Rwanda announced that foreigners who have been in Congo in the last 30 days would be barred from entry, while returning Rwandan citizens would be quarantined. Zambia described the threat as 'very high' given its 1,600+ km border with Congo. Hand-washing stations in schools, churches, and markets mirror COVID-19 measures. The U.S. State Department pledged $23 million; experts warn the outbreak could worsen, especially due to a rarely detected strain.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国がコンゴでのエボラアウトブレイク対策として「COVID的」制限を導入
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多国間アウトブレイク（900以上の疑い例、177人の死亡）で、複数の国で国境措置や移動制限が実施されており、IHR基準で「国際拡大リスク」「渡航制限」「重症度」の複数要件を満たす。スクリーニング基準でも「異常/予想外」「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性（国際支援が検討）」が該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、エボラアウトブレイクの主体はコンゴであり、ウガンダとルワンダは対応国であることから、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとザンビアのみ。ウガンダ（非対象国）とルワンダ（非対象国）は除外。稀有株の検出という疫学的懸念も記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak poses massive challenges, warns nurse
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has over 200 suspected deaths and more than 850 suspected cases. Three Red Cross volunteers who died earlier this month are among the first victims, likely infected while handling dead bodies. MSF programme manager Kate White says resources are severely stretched and transport disruptions hinder relief efforts. The WHO has declared a public health emergency of international concern; no approved vaccine or therapeutic exists for this outbreak, though experimental vaccines are in development. The epicenter is in a conflict-affected area with urbanization raising transmission risk of a rare Ebola species for which there is no vaccine. Symptoms include fever, headache, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhoea, possible organ failure and bleeding; incubation is 2–21 days, and transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行が深刻な課題をもたらすと看護師が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当する。エボラの大規模流行であり、既にWHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: WHO公式に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言されている。200人以上の疑い死者、850人以上の疑い症例が確認され、ワクチンや治療薬が利用できない稀なエボラ種が紛争地域で発生している。医療資源の深刻な不足と輸送障害により、RRA実施は緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Уганде заявили о еще двух случаях заражения вирусом Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda reports two more cases of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Two more Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Uganda on May 25, 2026, bringing the two-week total to seven and one death. The two new cases are Ugandan citizens who work in a private medical facility in Kampala; they are hospitalized and receiving specialized care. They had previously treated a Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) citizen who arrived in Uganda and died in Kampala from Ebola. Three additional infections involve people who arrived in Uganda from Ituri Province in the DRC, the current outbreak’s epicenter. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, first identified in Uganda in 2007. In the DRC, the Ministry of Health reports 204 deaths, while the World Health Organization notes more than 900 suspected and 101 confirmed cases in DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス感染のさらに2症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は国際的に重大な懸念であり、フルRRA実施必須。
triage.notes: DRC（Ituri Province）がエボラアウトブレイク震源地で、ウガンダへの越境感染を確認。DRCで204死亡・900+ 疑い例・101確認例が報告されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（2007年ウガンダで初同定）が原因。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCとの越境イベントのため両国を検証地域に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Kórházat rohant le a dühös tömeg: egyre durvább a helyzet a gyilkos járvány gócpontjában, oltóanyag pedig egyáltalán nem létezik - Pénzcentrum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An angry mob stormed a hospital: the situation at the epicenter of the deadly epidemic is increasingly severe, and there is no vaccine at all.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is worsening, centered in Ituri Province in the eastern region amid ongoing armed conflict affecting nearly five million people. The WHO reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The latest government tally lists 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment. Violence complicates response efforts, hindering contact tracing and early detection as health workers and aid staff flee. Earlier this week, protesters burned a relief organization’s tents after authorities did not hand over the body of a local footballer who died with suspected Ebola; later, a hospital in the east was stormed by armed men demanding the release of two bodies. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus stressed the gravity on May 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 怒った群衆が病院に突入：致死的な流行の震源地での状況がますます深刻化し、ワクチンは全くない - ペンツセントルム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例と死亡事例、国際的拡大リスク、ワクチン未入手という公衆衛生上の重大な懸念。スクリーニング基準でも全て該当し、WHO事務局長の声明により国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確認症例101例、死亡204例。Ituri州の東部地域での発生。武装紛争中での暴力的対応、接触者追跡困難、ワクチン・治療薬不在という複数の深刻な要因が重複。WHO事務局長による2026年5月25日の声明あり。国際的なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mai multe centre unde erau tratate persoanlele cu Ebola au fost incendiate. Zeci de bolnavi au fugit din spitale în Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Several centers where Ebola patients were being treated were set on fire. Dozens of patients fled from hospitals in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Three Ebola treatment centers run by Doctors Without Borders in the Democratic Republic of Congo were attacked, with 18 patients fleeing a facility in Mongwabalu. The violence followed a May 21 incident in Rwampara when relatives of a local footballer, who likely died from Ebola, burned a center after doctors refused to hand over the body, spurring concerns about mass funeral rituals spreading the virus. Congolese authorities suspended internal flights from Bunia near the Uganda border amid cross-border risk with Uganda and South Sudan. As of Sunday, 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths were reported; about 349 of 1,745 identified contacts had been traced. WHO regards domestic outbreak risk as very high, global risk as low, with May 17 PHEIC. The outbreak is caused by a rare Bundibugyo strain with ~50% case fatality and no approved vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者の治療センター複数箇所が放火される。コンゴの病院から数十人の患者が逃げ出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、複数国境での拡大懸念があり、シグナルとして強く推奨される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はコンゴでのエボラ発生。複数の医療施設が攻撃され患者が逃げ出すという異常な状況。WHOはすでにPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言。ウガンダ・南スーダンとの国境リスクが存在するが、記事の主題はコンゴの発生事象であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda Confirms Surge in Ebola Cases: Health Officials Report 7 New Infections - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Uganda: Kampala reports 7 confirmed cases, linked to a Congolese outbreak that began days to weeks before Congo's May 15 declaration. A 59-year-old Congolese man hospitalized in Kampala on May 11 died three days later, unaware of infection. Two more Congolese patients diagnosed in Uganda; first local infections confirmed Saturday—a driver and a health worker who had contact with the deceased patient. On Monday, two additional health workers at a private Kampala hospital tested positive. In Congo, suspected Ebola cases exceed 900, centered in Ituri province amid fear, attacks on treatment centers, and mistrust of authorities. The outbreak is a global health emergency. The Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak has no approved vaccine or treatment. Uganda's cases reflect cross-border transmission from Congo, underscoring regional outbreak management challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラ出血熱の急増を確認：保健当局が7件の新規感染報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行性、管理性）。アフリカの多国間エボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが主要な発生地域。コンゴからウガンダへの越境感染と記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国ではないため、リスク評価の対象はDRCに限定。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療法なし、地域不信などの付随リスク要因を記載。

article.articleHeadline: 前主编Global丨外媒：战乱、医疗短缺，刚果金埃博拉疫情持续扩散
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Former Global Editor-in-Chief | Foreign media: War and medical shortages, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, centered in Ituri and North Kivu in the eastern DRC, with Bunia and Goma among affected cities. WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases, 101 confirmed, and at least 177 deaths linked to this outbreak. Uganda has 5 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. WHO has raised the domestic risk to Very High and regional risk to High; global risk remains low, but case numbers are expected to rise as transmission occurs before detection. Fear, misinformation, and conflict-driven displacement—roughly 2 million people—hamper response and strain fragile health systems. Attacks on health facilities and bans on public gatherings and funerals aim to curb transmission from highly infectious cadavers. No approved vaccine or treatment yet; vaccine development will take months. Aid workers cite funding shortfalls; US funding cuts cited by some but denied by officials.

triage.headline_ja: 前主編Global丨外媒：戦乱、医療短缺、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疫情が続く拡散
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクで多数の死亡例、国際的な拡大（ウガンダへの波及）があり、複雑な危機環境にある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は最高危険度の病原体。記事は紛争、医療システムの脆弱性、2百万人の住民移動により対応が阻害されていることを強調。ウガンダでの確認症例（5例、2死亡）もあるが、対象国リストの制限から verified_locations はDRCのみ。WHO評価で域内リスク「High」、家庭内リスク「Very High」と判定されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mondiali, l'ebola mette a rischio la partecipazione del Congo. Perché il ripescaggio dell'Italia è comunque difficile (nonostante il pressing di Zampolli)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Cup, Ebola jeopardizes Congo's participation. Why Italy's repechage is still difficult (despite Zampolli's pressure).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo prompts heightened global concern as the WHO raises the risk level from high to very high. Congo relocated its pre-World Cup training camp from Kinshasa to Belgium, since most players are European-based; U.S. authorities require a 21-day self-isolation for travelers who recently visited Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan, pressuring team logistics and prompting a 'bubble' for players and potentially separate controls for staff from Congo. Mexico issued an epidemiological alert for Congo–Colombia in Zapopan. Despite the outbreak, Congo’s World Cup participation remains unlikely to be jeopardized in the short term; no codified repêchage mechanism exists. Paolo Zampolli suggests Italy could be repicked if Congo is blocked, with FIFA deciding between promoting Italy by FIFA ranking or preserving confederation quotas, which could exclude Italy if Africa retains a slot.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ、エボラがコンゴの参加を危険にさらす。ザンポッリの圧力にもかかわらず、イタリアの救済は依然として難しい
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク（DRC東部）により、WHOがリスクレベルを高リスクから非常に高リスクに引き上げ。複数国での渡航制限・隔離措置の実施、国際的スポーツイベントへの影響が生じており、IHR基準3項目（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域には複数国が含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題は東部DRCのエボラアウトブレイクであり、他国（メキシコ、イタリア、米国、ウガンダ、スーダン等）は流行対応国として言及されているに過ぎない。verified_locationsはDRCのみ。記事は2026年5月25日配信であり、近未来シナリオ。WHOリスク評価の引き上げ、複数国での隔離措置・渡航制限、国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）への影響により、高い社会的・政治的関心を伴っている。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 900 casos suspeitos de Ebola na RDC, diz OMS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the DRC, says WHO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) with more than 900 suspected cases, 101 confirmed, and 204 deaths reported as of May 25, 2026. The outbreak was officially declared May 15, and the WHO elevated national risk to very high, with regional risk high and global risk low. The virus has crossed into Uganda, where five cases are confirmed. A U.S. citizen infected in Congo is being treated at Charité hospital in Berlin. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, a rare variant with no vaccine or specific treatment; mortality is estimated between 30% and 50%. Containment is hampered by violence, population displacement, distrust, and disinformation; protests led to burning of treatment tents amid safe-burial disputes. The outbreak highlights substantial humanitarian needs, with one in four people in Ituri dependent on aid and many internally displaced.

triage.headline_ja: RDCでエボラの疑似症例が900例を超える、WHOが発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの確認された多国間（DRC・ウガンダ）での流行、高い死亡率（30-50%）、国際的な拡大（ウガンダ・ドイツへの輸出例）、WHO による国家リスク「非常に高い」評価により、シグナルとしてピックアップ必須。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが指摘する地域にはドイツ（Berlin）とウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーの検証に基づくと、実際の感染症イベント発生地は DRC（Ituri 州）が主体。ドイツのケースは DRC で感染した米国人の搬送治療事例（二次的）であり、ウガンダへのクロスボーダー流行は確認されているが、評価対象国リストに Uganda が含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC は対象国リスト内であり含める。

article.articleHeadline: Число предположительных случаев Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 900
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has exceeded 900.
article.articleSummary: Suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo exceed 900 as of May 22, with 101 confirmed and more than 200 deaths. The outbreak centers in Ituri Province along the Uganda border, where nearly 5 million people live amid ongoing conflict; about 25% need humanitarian assistance and 20% are displaced, hindering contact tracing and timely case detection. In the past week, at least three attacks on health facilities occurred, including the burning of an MSF Ebola tent in Mongbvalu, causing 18 people with suspected infection to flee and go missing. WHO and partners remain present in Ituri; the Bundibugyo strain has no approved medicines or vaccines. On May 17, WHO declared the outbreak in DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; global risk remains low, but local risk is very high. Common symptoms include fever, weakness, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and organ dysfunction.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ疑い例が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）し、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済み。Bundibugyo株で承認医薬品・ワクチンなし。保健施設への攻撃により接触者追跡が深刻に阻害されている。ウガンダとの国境地域での発生であるが、記事の主題はDRCの状況であるため、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемия от ебола в ДР Конго: Над 900 предполагаеми заразени, 101 потвърдени случая - По света и у нас - БНТ Новини
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Over 900 suspected cases, 101 confirmed cases - World and in our country - BNT News
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo extends across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with over 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. Authorities report 119 suspected deaths, later revised down from 204, of which only 10 have been laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or specific therapy. The epicenter lies in a remote, hard-to-reach area of the DRC amid ongoing conflict with armed separatist groups. In neighboring Uganda, seven confirmed cases have been reported. The World Health Organization assesses the regional risk as very high, but the global risk remains low. Data on suspected cases in Uganda are limited, and containment is challenged by security constraints and the absence of targeted medical countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：900人以上の感染疑い例、101人の確定例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症は高致死率で急速な国際拡大の懸念が高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCでの確定・疑い例が中心。ウガンダでも7人の確定例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを記載。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による高リスク流行で、ワクチン・治療法がないことが重要な懸念。WHO地域リスク評価「very high」。

article.articleHeadline: Первооткрыватель вируса Эбола назвал ненормальной панику вокруг новой вспышки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The discoverer of the Ebola virus called the panic surrounding the new outbreak abnormal.
article.articleSummary: Congolese virologist Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tanfung, who discovered Ebola, criticized the global response to the 17th outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, based in Kinshasa. He told RTS that international alarm appears inflated as World Health Organization estimates exceed 900 suspected cases. He described the reaction as abnormal, attributing the panic to post-COVID-19 fear despite distinct transmission. The situation was compounded by a hantavirus outbreak on the cruise ship Hondius. Muyembe-Tanfung urged international bodies and the public to trust Congolese authorities, noting that countries in the region possess substantial experience in containing haemorrhagic fevers. He expressed confidence the outbreak would be brought under control and predicted full local containment within two to three months. Ebola transmits from wildlife to humans and, if not contained, causes fever, severe headache, muscle spasms, sore throat, kidney and liver failure, and sometimes internal or external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの発見者は新規流行周辺のパニックを異常と呼んだ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスはハイリスク病原体であり、DRCでの複数同時流行（エボラ+ハンタウイルス）は深刻な国際的関心を要する。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラウイルスの第17次流行（キンシャサ発生地）および同時期のハンタウイルス流行（クルーズ船Hondius）が報告されている。WHO推定では900超の疑いケースが存在。複数の高リスク病原体の同時流行は管理可能性の懸念を喚起する。ただし記事は主流行学的詳細（致死率、確定例数、ヒト-ヒト感染の詳細）を欠く。

article.articleHeadline: Attack on Ebola treatment facility in eastern Congo leaves 13 patients missing
article.articleSummary: Attack on Ebola treatment facilities in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo leaves 13 patients missing: In Mongwalu, at Mongwalu General Referral Hospital, MSF-supported tents hosting 28 people suspected of Ebola were attacked by “angry youth”; 13 fled and are unaccounted for. Police opened an investigation on Saturday. This follows a Thursday blaze at a treatment center in nearby Rwampara after relatives were barred from retrieving a body. The outbreak situation: as of May 24, 2026, Congo reports 904 suspected Ebola cases and 119 suspected deaths; Uganda reports five confirmed cases and one death. The incidents underscore rising tensions between communities and health workers, as fear, misinformation and distrust hinder response efforts, including burial practices that keep transmission risk, with authorities often managing burials for suspected victims.

triage.headline_ja: 東部コンゴのエボラ治療施設への攻撃により13人の患者が行方不明に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性に関する懸念が認められる。対象国DRCで発生しており、シグナルとして識別すべき。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが主要な発生地として述べられており、ウガンダは既に5例の確定患者報告あり。治療施設への攻撃により13名の患者が行方不明となり、コミュニティと保健労働者間の対立構図が強調されている。埋葬慣行による二次感染リスク、偽情報と不信感が応答を阻害している状況が、公衆衛生上の深刻な課題を示唆。ルワンダはKigali Provinceで言及されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRC中心であるため、ルワンダは検証対象に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 安徽遭蜱虫咬伤女子离世！遗体不能土葬，穿防护服火化，家属崩溃_手机网易网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anhui Woman Dies After Tick Bite! Body Cannot Be Buried; Cremation in Protective Clothing; Family Devastated
article.articleSummary: An Anhui, China case of Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) caused by a novel bunyavirus highlights tick-borne risk. A 64-year-old rural woman began with fatigue, headache, and low fever in mid-May, delaying care with self-medication and folk remedies. By days four to five she developed persistent high fever, vomiting, diarrhea, severe myalgia, and rapid weight loss, progressing to multi-organ dysfunction. County hospital labs showed thrombocytopenia consistent with SFTS; transfer to a major hospital in Hefei followed, but she died on day seven after onset. No clear bite site was found; the virus can be transmitted via blood and secretions, and remains a risk postmortem. Authorities ordered cremation in protective clothing, prohibiting burial locally to prevent spread. The incident underscores the need for summer tick awareness in Anhui, Jiangsu, Shandong: wear long sleeves/pants, check for ticks, and seek urgent medical care if fever after outdoor exposure.

triage.headline_ja: 安徽で蜱虫咬傷女性が死亡！遺体は土葬禁止、防護服で火葬、遺族が崩壊
triage.triage_reason: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）による死亡例であり、多臓器不全への進展、死後感染リスクに基づく厳格な対応（防護服火葬）が実施された。中国内での地域的警告喚起が行われており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たし、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事は安徽省での64歳女性のSFTS死亡例を主題とし、安徽、江蘇、山東での夏季蜱虫リスク啓発を実施。死後感染リスク対策として防護服火葬を実施した点は異常性が高い。多臓器不全への急速進展と高い致死性がWPRO基準の重症度・流行性を満たす。国際的拡大リスクは現在の情報からは低いが、WPRO域内での監視対象として重要。

article.articleHeadline: China Issues Travel Warning as Ebola Cases Rise in Africa
article.articleSummary: Outbreaks of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda began mid-May 2026, with reported rising case counts. China has issued travel-health warnings and tightened screening guidance for people arriving from parts of Africa in response to these developments. The World Health Organization has classified these outbreaks as a public-health emergency of international concern (PHEIC), the third Ebola outbreak in Africa to reach that level in roughly the past 15 years. The article notes ongoing transmission in DRC and Uganda but does not provide specific case or death counts. The measures emphasize international travel screening to mitigate cross-border spread, without detailing laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or specifics of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がエボラ熱のアフリカでの患者数増加に伴い渡航警告を発出
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ熱は公衆衛生上の影響が極めて深刻で、WHOがPHEIC指定し国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはDRC、ウガンダ、中国が列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ熱の流行である。中国は渡航警告を発出した国（対応国）であり、感染症イベント発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当するため verified_locations に DRC のみを列挙した。ウガンダ（226074）は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOがPHEIC指定しており、WPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Gujarat steps up precautionary measures amid Ebola cases in African countries; No infection reported in India
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks are reported in Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan, while Gujarat and all of India have no reported Ebola infections as of 2026-05-25. Gujarat's government has intensified monitoring and screening of travelers from Ebola-affected countries at Ahmedabad International Airport, active daily from 6 pm to 10 am. Authorities say there is no need for panic and that the health system is prepared under Centre guidelines. To bolster preparedness, a 32-bed apex facility has been designated at Ahmedabad Civil Hospital, a 10-bed facility at Surat Civil Hospital, and a 60-bed isolation ward at SVP Hospital in Ahmedabad for suspected cases. Any traveler showing symptoms or suspicion will be treated and isolated per Government of India protocols. Minister of State for Health Prafull Pansheriya urged calm and emphasized targeted screening for arrivals from affected nations.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ諸国でのエボラ感染拡大を受け、グジャラート州が予防措置を強化。インドで感染報告なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの既知の流行地域（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）でのアウトブレイク報告であり公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準2つ）があるが、インド国内での感染確認がなく、対象国内での実質的な脅威はまだ顕在化していないため。情報が限定的であり、続報の監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの地理的分析：エボラアウトブレイクはDRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンで発生しており、これらは対象国リストに含まれていない。インド（グジャラート州）は予防措置を実施しているが、現在のところ感染報告がなく、対象国内での実質的な発生ではない。したがってverified_locationsはインドのみ。IHR基準は3つ該当するため通常はPICKUPレベルだが、対象国内での実際の発生がないため、準備段階としてWATCHとした。スクリーニング基準では管理可能性が高い（政府の対応が進行中）ため、フルRRAは保留し、続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ、エボラ感染疑い例900件超に - エキサイトニュース
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Over 900 suspected Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 101 cases confirmed on retesting, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus on May 24. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, a rare variant, continuing a pattern of Ebola activity in the country since the initial 1976 discovery near the Ebola River in northern DRC. There are currently no approved vaccines or treatments. WHO has declared the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and raised the national risk assessment from high to very high. The report provides no details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The response underscores the ongoing threat of Ebola in the DRC and the urgent need for containment and international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ感染疑い例900件超に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模疑い例発生（900件超、確認例101件）、WHOにより国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）として宣言、国家リスク評価が『高い』から『非常に高い』に引き上げられ、ワクチン・治療薬なし。DRCでの継続的な流行パターンが示されており、国際的な対応と支援が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な変異株）による新規流行。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国家リスク評価の大幅引き上げ、承認されたワクチン・治療薬の欠如が重大な懸念要因。1976年以来のDRCにおけるエボラの継続的な脅威が示されている。国際的な支援と協調が急務。

article.articleHeadline: WHO raises Ebola threat warning to â€~very highâ€™
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, the World Health Organization raised the threat posed by Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo to 'very high' as the virus spreads. The epidemic is believed to have killed at least 200 people, with experts warning that deaths and cases are likely undercounted and that contagion is reported in main regional hubs, including neighboring Uganda. Fragile health systems, roiling intrastate conflicts, and attacks on treatment facilities have compounded containment challenges. A newly identified Bundibugyo Ebola strain, rarer than the Zaire variant, has exposed gaps in preparedness for variants outside the common form. The assessment highlights limited detection capacity and the scale of disruption in the DRC. International health authorities remain concerned about rapid spread and emphasize enhanced surveillance and response across the region.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、エボラ熱の脅威警告を「非常に高い」に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラ熱の国際的拡大、重症度、流行性が極めて高く、地域的な管理能力の限界が指摘されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリー上では「隣国ウガンダで伝染が報告されている」と地域的な懸念として言及されており、DRCが主要な発生地である。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo Ebola株という稀な亜種の出現は準備態勢の課題を示唆している。WHOが脅威レベルを「非常に高い」に公式に引き上げた点、および200人以上の死亡報告と地域的蔓延の指摘により、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 美国针对埃博拉疫情入境限制影响刚果（金）队世界杯备战
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: US entry restrictions related to the Ebola outbreak affect the DR Congo team's World Cup preparations.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted US travel and entry restrictions affecting DR Congo’s national football team preparing for the 2026 World Cup. The US CDC announced a temporary entry ban for green card holders and non-U.S. citizens who have visited the DRC, Uganda, or South Sudan in the prior 21 days. In response, DR Congo Football Association canceled a planned World Cup training camp in Kinshasa and shifted to Europe, where the squad will train for at least 21 days before heading to the United States. Players and many technical staff are based in Europe and are not believed infected; training staff departed Kinshasa on May 20 to Belgium for camps and will remain in Europe for 21 days before the US. Some DR Congo fans with tickets may face visa hurdles; FIFA is studying refund options. WHO designated the Ebola outbreak as an International Public Health Emergency; national risk is ‘very high’, regional ‘high’, global ‘low’.

triage.headline_ja: 米国のエボラ感染症入境制限がコンゴ民主共和国チームのワールドカップ準備に影響
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WHO公式緊急宣言済み。WPRO基準でも複数該当。国際的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ発生が述べられているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。記事の主題はDRCのワールドカップチームへの影響。WHO緊急宣言済み（regional risk 'high'）。米国・ベルギー・ウガンダはサマリー上で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: بیش از ۹۰۰ مورد مشکوک به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: WHO reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 25 May 2026. So far, 101 cases have been laboratory-confirmed. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, a region with nearly 5 million residents, where about one in four people relies on humanitarian aid, and has spread to three provinces. The report notes that the health system's contact-tracing efforts are failing, complicating containment. No details on symptoms or exact transmission chains are provided. Details on laboratory confirmation methods or infection sources are not specified, and no information about imported or exported cases is provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの疑い例が900例以上報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。確定例101例を含む大規模なエボラ疑い例集団発生で、複数州への拡大、医療体制の接触者追跡機能低下が記載されており、重篤で国際的リスク高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ危険な疾患。イツリ州を中心に3州に拡大した地理的拡散、接触者追跡機能の低下、約500万人が居住する地域での発生という社会的要因が管理を困難にしている。国際的な支援体制が不可欠と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus: CG में इबोला वायरस का अलर्ट, यात्रियों को लेकर गाइडलाइन जारी, जानिए क्या कुछ लिखा है निर्देश में... | Ebola Virus: Ebola virus alert in CG, guidelines issued for travelers, find out what is written in the instructions...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus: Ebola virus alert in Chhattisgarh, guidelines issued for travelers, find out what is written in the instructions...
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, an Ebola virus alert has been issued in Chhattisgarh, India (Raipur), mandating regular traveler health screening and essential management at airports. A nodal officer will be appointed at the airport complex to coordinate screening, promptly inform health authorities of suspected cases, and ensure isolation, referral, and emergency management. Ebola virus disease (EVD), caused by the Bundibugyo strain, is a severe illness with potential fatal outcomes; there is currently no vaccine or specific approved treatment. The government urges strict adherence to guidelines. Reported symptoms include high fever with chills, sore throat and loss of appetite, severe muscle and joint pains, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain. Mortality rates for Ebola are highest in Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：チャッティスガル州でエボラウイルスアラート、旅行者向けガイドライン発行、指示に書かれた内容を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（高致死性病原体）に関するアラート発令であり、IHR基準の「異常/予想外」「国際拡大リスク」に該当。インド国内で公式ガイドライン発行との記載があり、公衆衛生上の深刻な関心事項。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではインド（チャッティスガル州ライプル）でのアラート発令が主題。DRC・ウガンダ・スーダンは致死率データの参照地として言及されているが、現地での発生報告ではなく、インド国内のスクリーニング強化が主要内容。したがって verified_locations はインドのみ。配信日時が2026年5月と未来日付であり、データ品質に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak threatens African economies, World Cup football plans
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) and Uganda. As of late May, hundreds of suspected cases and well over 100 suspected deaths across DRC and Uganda, with figures evolving as surveillance and testing expand. The World Health Organization declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. There is currently no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola; promising candidates are in development but may not be deployable for six to nine months. Uganda has confirmed a limited number of cases linked to infected travellers from DRC; cross-border transmission is being combated with aggressive contact tracing and surveillance. Containment faces challenges from armed conflict, population displacement, and attacks on health facilities, amid mistrust toward authorities. Economic risks are rising, with enhanced airport screening and potential impacts on CAF/FIFA calendars and 2026 World Cup qualifiers if transmission escalates.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がアフリカの経済と World Cup フットボール計画を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また WHO により PHEIC 宣言されており、シグナルとしてピックアップ対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri Province）と Uganda での発生が明記されているが、対象国リストに Uganda は含まれないため、verified_locations は DRC のみとした。DRC は対象国リストに含まれる（203312）。WHO PHEIC 宣言（May 17）、Bundibugyo 株での流行、数百の疑い症例と 100 以上の疑い死亡報告、ワクチンなし、武力紛争や保健施設への攻撃による封じ込めの困難性が記載されており、PICKUP 判定の根拠は十分。

article.articleHeadline:
18:48
                  世卫组织：汉坦病毒疫情已趋于稳定
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: The hantavirus outbreak has stabilized.
article.articleSummary: On May 25, 2026, at the World Health Organization's Executive Board meeting, Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus announced that the hantavirus outbreak has stabilized, recording only one new case over the past two weeks and no new deaths since May 2. The update suggests a slowdown in transmission, though no country-specific data is provided. In contrast, he reported that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading rapidly, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance and response capacity in the region. He urged WHO member states to accelerate finalization of the Pandemic Instrument annex in the coming weeks and months to bolster global preparedness and response.

triage.headline_ja: WHO：ハンタウイルス疫情が安定化している
triage.triage_reason: ハンタウイルスは安定化傾向との報告により IHR 基準該当性は低いが、同時に報告されている DRC でのエボラ迅速拡大に関する警告がある。情報が限定的であり、エボラの地理的・流行学的詳細が不足。
triage.notes: 記事はハンタウイルスの安定化を主題としているが、同時に DRC でのエボラ迅速拡大についても言及している。サマリーではハンタウイルスについて「過去2週間で新規例1例のみ、5月2日以降死亡なし」と報告されており、安定化傾向を示す。一方、エボラについては「迅速に拡大している」との警告があるが、具体的な症例数、死亡数、発生地域の詳細は記事に記載されていない。DRC が対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に記載。フル RRA に進めるには追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Открывший лихорадку Эбола ученый раскритиковал глобальную панику из-за очередной вспышки
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The scientist who discovered Ebola fever criticized the global panic caused by yet another outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Jean-Jacques Muyembe-Tamfum, the virologist who helped discover Ebola, criticizes global panic over a Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak as of May 25, 2026. The World Health Organization updated figures showing the 17th Ebola incident in the DRC with more than 900 suspected cases. He told RTS that fear, amplified after COVID-19, is unwarranted, and noted a hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship Hondius as another driver of alarm. Based on experience, he believes the outbreak can be controlled and localized within two to three months. Ebola virus transmits from wildlife reservoirs to humans and then spreads between people via contact with infected bodily fluids. Early symptoms include high fever, severe headache, muscle and joint pains; progression can lead to liver and kidney failure and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の発見者である科学者が、新たな流行による世界的なパニックを批判
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス第17次流行、900件以上の疑い患者を認識。IHR基準では重症度・予想外性に該当し、国際的関心も高い。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行易感性が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月25日配信の将来日付シナリオ。DRCでのエボラ第17次流行で900件以上の疑い患者が報告されている。同時にハンタウイルス流行（クルーズ船Hondius）も言及されているが、これは背景情報であり主題はDRCのエボラ流行。WHO統計の更新が確認されており、信頼性の高い情報源。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と国際的な懸念レベルが高い点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ: 900'den fazla şüpheli Ebola vakası tespit edildi - ensonhaber.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases detected - ensonhaber.com
article.articleSummary: Ebola has resurfaced in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri province, with intensified surveillance as of May 2026. World Health Organization Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus reported 101 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and more than 900 suspected cases. Ituri, the outbreak’s epicenter, faces ongoing conflict amid which about 5 million people live; roughly one in four needs humanitarian aid and one in five have been displaced within the country. The report notes no death counts, but underscores significant Ebola activity in a conflict-affected setting. The update, posted by WHO on social media, highlights the public health emergency amid broader humanitarian needs in the DRC. }

triage.headline_ja: WHO: 900以上のエボラ疑い患者が検出された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。紛争地域での大規模なエボラ流行は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが極めて高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（特にIturi州）でのエボラ流行を主題としており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。101確認症例と900以上の疑い患者、紛争地域での5百万人の人口、限定された人道支援環境は、伝播リスク・管理困難性・国際的影響の懸念を著しく高める。WHOが公式に発表した情報であり、社会政治的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases have increased rapidly in the DRC, with 10 more countries at high risk - ExBulletin
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, Ebola cases are rising rapidly in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain. Uganda has now confirmed five cases, underscoring cross-border transmission risks. The African Centers for Disease Control says 10 neighboring countries are at high risk. The United States has tightened entry restrictions in response to the spread. The current death toll is a fraction of the 11,000 killed in the worst Ebola outbreak on record, which ended about a decade ago. Health officials worldwide remain concerned about the escalating outbreak and cross-border transmission in the region. No further country-specific case counts are detailed in the report.

triage.headline_ja: DRCでエボラ出血熱の感染が急速に増加、10カ国が高リスク状態 - ExBulletin
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大、越境感染、複数国への波及リスクが確認されたため、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダで確認されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。米国の入境制限は対応措置であり、発生地ではない。Bundibugyo株による珍しい流行で、高い懸念が国際的に広がっている。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda backs Africa-wide Ebola response hub  --  RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Uganda backs Africa-wide Ebola response hub in Kampala as Africa CDC proposes an Incident Management Support Team to coordinate continental surveillance and outbreak response; President Museveni endorses and pledges Kampala’s support. Africa CDC data show DR Congo and Uganda together reporting 744 suspected Ebola cases, including 83 confirmed infections, and 176 deaths among suspected cases as of Friday. WHO reports DR Congo’s outbreak expanding to more than 900 suspected cases nationwide with 101 confirmed infections. DR Congo declared the epidemic on May 15, its 17th Ebola outbreak since 1976, with the Bundibugyo strain detected in DR Congo and neighboring Uganda prompting a public health emergency of international concern. Bundibugyo is a relatively rare strain first identified in Uganda in 2007; there is currently no approved vaccine. International travel restrictions include the US banning non-citizens who recently visited DR Congo, Uganda, or South Sudan; Bahrain and Jordan restricting travelers from affected nations; neighboring African border controls tightened. Russia offers assistance.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがアフリカ全域エボラ対応ハブを支持 - RT Africa
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の広域流行（DRC・ウガンダで744疑い例、83確定例、176死亡）、国際的拡大リスク（複数国での旅行制限実施）、国際的な懸念事項の宣言（PHEIC相当）。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はワクチン未承認の稀な株。DRCは17番目のエボラアウトブレイク宣言（1976年以来）。複数国での旅行制限が実施されており、国際的な懸念は高い。ウガンダの地名は複数列挙されているが、記事の主題はDRCでのアウトブレイク対応とアフリカ全域での連携体制の構築である。ウガンダはハブ設置地およびDRCとの国境接国として言及されているが、主要な発生国はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: ActionAid DRC Rapid Needs Assessment Report - Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) Outbreak Response (May 2026)
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (non-Zaire) outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with ActionAid DRC conducting a rapid needs assessment on May 16–17, 2026 in Ituri Province's Nyankunde, Nizi, and Bunia health zones. Situation Report No. 004 (as of May 16, 2026) recorded 417 alerts, 393 investigated, 8 laboratory-confirmed cases, 105 probable cases, and 72 people in isolation across nine health zones. Nyankunde and Bunia have reported EVD cases, underscoring ongoing transmission. The assessment engaged COPA committees, women's and men's groups, child clubs and community health volunteers to inform humanitarian response. Key findings reveal substantial gaps in community awareness, health system readiness, and school safety, with particular concern for the protection of women and girls, psychosocial impacts on conflict-displaced populations, stigma, and a near-total absence of PPE in schools and community spaces.

triage.headline_ja: ActionAid DRC迅速ニーズ評価報告書 - エボラウイルス病(EVD)の流行対応(2026年5月)
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、予想外の発生、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo Ebolaの確認例および確定例、確定的な人間-人間感染の証拠があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus (非Zaire系統)の発生が公式に宣言されており、2026年5月16日時点で8例の確定例、105例の推定例、72人が隔離中。Nyankunde、Nizi、Buniaの複数健康地区で報告されており、進行中の伝播が示唆されている。ActionAid DRCによる迅速ニーズ評価は5月16-17日に実施。コミュニティ認識の不足、保健システムの準備不足、PPEの欠如など、対応能力に重大な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: La OMS contabiliza más de 900 casos sospechosos de ébola en República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The WHO counts more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been reported in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 100 lab-confirmed and 204 deaths to date, per the WHO. The epicenter is Ituri Province in eastern DRC, bordering Uganda, where funerals and large gatherings have been banned as containment efforts face difficulties. The detected Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Authorities are expanding contact tracing, reinforcing hand hygiene, mask use, and symptomatic care. Ituri is war-affected, with about 5 million residents; around a quarter need humanitarian assistance and one-fifth are internally displaced. Spain’s Health Ministry and the Emergency and Alerts Coordination Center say the risk to Spain is very low; there are no direct Spain–DRC flights, and travelers should consult an International Vaccination Center. If cases arise in Spain, transmission would be very unlikely due to available diagnostics and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが民主共和国コンゴにおけるエボラ疑い症例900件以上を集計
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の大規模発生で、IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo ebolavirus株）の大規模アウトブレイク。DRC東部イツリ州で900件以上の疑い症例、100件の確定症例、204名の死亡が報告。ワクチンおよび特異的治療法がない。紛争地域での対応困難。スペインおよびウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク存在。対象国内ではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Hội thảo tập huấn về công tác giám sát, phòng chống bệnh do vi rút Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Training workshop on the surveillance and prevention of Ebola virus disease.
article.articleSummary: On 25 May 2026, the Department of Disease Prevention, Ministry of Health, organized a training workshop on surveillance and prevention of Ebola virus disease. The event, held in Thanh Hoa province with live-streamed participation via Zoom, gathered health leadership and technical staff from provincial and district facilities, border health quarantine units, and international partners including WHO and the US CDC. In Thanh Hoa, participants joined from Thanh Hoa CDC, Nghi Son District Health Center, and Muong Lat District Health Center. The program updated global Ebola status, outlined surveillance and early case finding, and covered specimen collection, preservation, and transport to domestic labs, as well as the Ebola detection testing process and international response experiences. It underscored border, health facility, and community surveillance for early suspected cases, isolation, epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, outbreak containment, infection control, PPE, and public awareness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染症の監視および予防に関する訓練ワークショップ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の訓練・準備活動であり、実際の患者発生の報告ではない。ただしベトナムでのエボラ対策能力強化を示唆しており、地域の準備状況として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のエボラ患者発生ではなく、ベトナム保健省が実施したエボラ対策の訓練・能力構築ワークショップの報道。WHOおよびUS CDCが国際的パートナーとして参加していることが注記される。イベント性の報道であり、「シグナル」としては該当しないが、地域の感染症対応能力強化の動向として経過観察の価値あり。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo : Ebola, la mise au point de la Fédération pour le Mondial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola, the Federation's clarification for the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola resurgence in the Democratic Republic of Congo centers on the Bundibugyo strain, with about 1,000 suspected cases across three regions and ten potentially affected countries; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. The outbreak is the seventeenth since 1976. Ahead of the World Cup, US authorities require a 21-day sanitary bubble for players and staff before entering the United States. The Congolese Football Federation (Fecofa) issued a clarification noting most players and much of the staff are based in Europe, Kinshasa will not host the squad, and they will assemble in Belgium. Technical staff departed Kinshasa on May 20, 2026, and will spend at least 21 days in Europe before heading to the US for the tournament. A warm-up vs Denmark is planned for June 3 in Liège. Congo is in Group K with Portugal, Uzbekistan, and Colombia; first match is June 17 in Houston vs Portugal.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: エボラ、ワールドカップに向けた連盟の声明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。約1,000人の疑い患者と10カ国への潜在的拡大、ワクチンなし、第17回流行という重要なシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行を主題としており、ワールドカップへの参加に関連した保健当局の措置（21日間の検疫）が記述されている。発生地域にはベルギー、デンマーク、米国等が含まれるが、これらはエボラの実際の発生地ではなく、コンゴ代表団の移動経路や対戦相手の位置を示す。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan health officials report new Ebola virus infections, bringing cases to seven
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms seven Ebola infections as of 2026-05-25, with first local transmission: a driver and a health worker exposed to a Congolese patient who died on May 11. Two more Kampala hospital health workers have tested positive; all patients are in a designated treatment unit. President Museveni urges Ugandans to stop shaking hands and delays a major religious gathering just outside Kampala by June 3. Uganda also suspends public transport and flights with Congo. In Congo, suspected Ebola cases exceed 900 in Ituri province amid a long-running outbreak declared a global health emergency; responses hampered by fear, attacks on centers, and distrust. The Bundibugyo-type Ebola has no approved vaccine or treatment; control relies on contact tracing, isolation, and safe burials. Natural hosts are fruit bats; transmission via bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの保健当局がエボラウイルスの新規感染を報告、感染者数が7例に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。ウガンダとコンゴでの複数国感染、初の地域内感染確認、公式な対応措置（渡航制限、宗教集会の延期）が実施されており、国際的支援が必要な段階。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの初の地域内感染確認、コンゴ国内では既に900例超の疑い例。Bundibugyo型エボラで承認ワクチン/治療なし。大統領による公式な対応措置（握手禁止、宗教集会延期、公共交通・航空便停止）の実施が重大性を示す。WHOへの通知および国際支援要請の段階。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στην Ουγκάντα: Δύο νέα κρούσματα σε δομή υγείας στην Καμπάλα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Uganda: Two new cases in a health facility in Kampala.
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports two more laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in Kampala, bringing the country's total to seven. The two new cases are Ugandan health-care workers at a private facility in Kampala; both were admitted to a dedicated treatment unit and are receiving medical care, with authorities tracing all contacts of the two patients. On Saturday, Ugandan authorities confirmed three additional Ebola cases. The outbreak's epicenter remains the Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which borders Uganda.
