The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Bundibugyo lineage of Ebola. As of 25 May 2026, WHO chief Tedros stated more than 900 cases have been recorded, with 101 laboratory-confirmed. Continued monitoring and contact tracing are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ：カンパラの保健施設で2つの新しい症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo系統）の確認症例が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で報告され、WHOが国際的懸念事項として宣言済み。国際的拡大リスク極度に高い。
triage.notes: 本シグナルはスクリーニング基準で5つ全て該当し、かつIHR基準でも4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の国家間での拡大が既に確認されており、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。医療従事者への感染が報告されたことで院内感染拡大リスクも懸念される。ウガンダの報告により対象国内での複数国間拡大が確認された。

article.articleHeadline: WHO: már több mint 900 gyanús esetre bukkantak a Kongói DK-ban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO: More than 900 suspected cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), centered in Ituri Province, where nearly five million residents live amid ongoing armed conflict. More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections. The latest tally lists 204 deaths and 867 suspected cases. The outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026. It is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or targeted treatment currently available. Security violence is driving displacement and hindering public health response, affecting contact tracing and early case finding. The health ministry flags that attacks on health workers and aid volunteers further complicate containment efforts. The article does not report imported or exported cases beyond local transmission within the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: WHO: コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上の疑い例が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つすべて満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生であり、深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明白である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebolaウイルス株による大規模集団発生。ワクチンや特異的治療がないこと、武装紛争による治安悪化が対応を著しく阻害していること、医療労働者への攻撃が報告されていることなど、複合的リスク要因が存在。Ituri州の約500万人が影響下にある。ただし現時点で国外への拡大事例の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Selección del Congo Dice que Cumple Protocolos de EUA por Ébola; Analizan Reembolso a Fans
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo National Team Says It Complies With U.S. Ebola Protocols; Fan Refunds Under Review
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's national football team (the Leopards) says it complies with U.S. Ebola protocols ahead of the 2026 FIFA World Cup; FECOFA notes all players are in Europe and have not recently traveled to the DRC, which faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of May 25, 2026, the outbreak—declared May 15 in northeastern Ituri province—has more than 900 suspected cases and 204 probable deaths, with a case-fatality rate estimated at 30–50%. The team canceled Kinshasa training and will spend at least 21 days in Europe before heading to the United States. Pre-trip friendlies are planned: June 3 in Liege, Belgium vs Denmark, and June 9 in Cadiz, Spain vs Chile. The Leopards are in World Cup Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan; the tournament runs June 11–July 19 across the U.S., Mexico, and Canada. FIFA is reviewing refunds for fans who could not obtain U.S. visas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ代表がエボラ対策でアメリカのプロトコルを遵守していると発表、ファンへの払い戻しを検討中
triage.triage_reason: 進行中のエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（900以上の疑い症例、204人の死亡）がDRCで発生しており、IHR基準（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。また国際的なスポーツイベント（2026 FIFA World Cup）との関連により社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIは複数の非流行地（スペイン、ベルギー、デンマーク等）を発生地域として列挙しているが、これらはコンゴ代表チームの出国地および準備試合地点に過ぎない。実際のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクはDRCのIturi州で発生している。記事は進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（5月15日宣言、2026年5月25日時点で900以上の疑い症例、204人の死亡、CFR 30-50%）の詳細を報告しており、シグナルとして適切にピックアップされるべき案件である。

article.articleHeadline: OMS ridică nivelul de risc pentru Ebola în Congo. Aproape 900 de persoane, suspectate că au contractat virusul | AUDIO
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises the risk level for Ebola in the Congo. Nearly 900 people suspected of having contracted the virus | AUDIO.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly. The World Health Organization has revised its risk assessment, moving from high national and regional risk to very high at the national level, high regionally, and low globally. Globally, the risk of international spread remains low at present. Over 900 people are suspected to have contracted Ebola, with just over 100 confirmed by PCR testing. There is no specific treatment or vaccine for Ebola described. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 204 deaths linked to the epidemic. The outbreak was declared about 10 days ago, and reported suspected cases have climbed from tens to roughly one thousand currently, prompting strengthened surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴのエボラ熱リスクレベルを引き上げ。ウイルスに感染した疑いのある人はほぼ900人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な蔓延、高い致死率、国際的な拡大リスク、WHOによるリスク評価の上方修正が確認される。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的公衆衛生上の最高リスク疾患。DRCでの発生報告は直ちにフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）対象。WHOが国家レベルで「非常に高い」リスクに引き上げたことは深刻性の指標。疑い例900名、確認例100名超、死亡204名は急速な拡大を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in RDC, MSF: "È corsa contro il tempo, ma non dimentichiamo le altre crisi nella regione"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC, MSF: "It's a race against time, but we must not forget the other crises in the region."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri province) triggers MSF-led emergency response in collaboration with Congolese health authorities and WHO. The effort aims to treat the sick, trace contacts, and preserve essential health services for malaria, cholera, and HIV. In Ituri, about 50 international staff will join roughly 480 locally recruited professionals. Supplies are being dispatched from Kinshasa and MSF’s Kampala hub; 3,000 PPE items arrived in Bunia on 19 May, and 60,000 kits from Europe are due by the end of next week. Centers are being established and rehabilitated: Mongbwalu will host a treatment center with the health ministry; Goma’s Munigi ETC is being refurbished to 80 beds for suspected and confirmed cases; an isolation room is being prepared at Kyeshero hospital in North Kivu. Response rests on six pillars, including rapid isolation, water/sanitation, waste management, IPC, patient pathways, and maintained essential services.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ熱、MSF：「時間との競争だが、地域の他の危機を忘れてはならない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPRO基準複数項目該当、かつ国際的な公衆衛生上の重大関心事である現在進行中のエボラ熱アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: 記事は東DRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ熱アウトブレイク、MSF（国境なき医師団）の緊急対応、WHO協力、コンゴ保健当局との連携を報告。複数地域（ブニア、モンバワル、ゴマ、キエシェロ）での治療センター設立・改修、国際スタッフ配置、PPE・医療資材配送が記載されている。ウガンダはサマリーで直接的なイベント発生地として記載されていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Medidas sanitárias reforçadas para reunião de líderes em Brazzaville
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Strengthened sanitary measures for a meeting of leaders in Brazzaville.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri region) total over 900 suspected or confirmed cases, including 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, with 204 probable deaths reported by the Congolese government. The WHO notes ongoing difficulties in managing the Ituri epicenter, where humanitarian needs are substantial. There are no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo, and WHO does not recommend travel or trade restrictions with Brazzaville; participants' risk is assessed as low. At the Maya-Maya International Airport, temperature checks, hand sanitizer, physical distancing reminders, and mask distribution are visible as health staff screen arrivals. On May 25, 2026, Brazzaville hosts the African Development Bank annual meetings, with a hybrid format to include over 3,000 delegates from 81 states, under the theme of mobilizing resources for Africa's development in a fragmented world.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブラザビルでの首脳会合のための衛生措置強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRC Ituri地域での900件超のエボラ疑い症例・確定症例と204人の死亡報告、および隣国での警戒措置実施から、高リスクシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに「Republic of the Congo」（ブラザビル）で確認症例がない旨が明記されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Ituri地域での活発な流行、死亡報告、WHOの懸念表明、および大規模国際会合開催という社会的文脈から、総合的に高優先度のシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Medidas sanitárias reforçadas para reunião de líderes africanos em Brazzaville
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Strengthened sanitary measures for a meeting of African leaders in Brazzaville.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province) exceeds 900 suspected or laboratory-confirmed cases, with 101 lab-confirmed and 204 probable deaths since the outbreak was declared on May 15. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus emphasizes severe humanitarian needs in Ituri, where one in four people require assistance and one in five are internally displaced. At Brazzaville’s Maya-Maya International Airport, medical teams conduct temperature checks and offer alcohol gel; masks are distributed and entry screenings performed. There are no confirmed or suspected Ebola cases in the Republic of the Congo, and WHO considers the risk to attendees at the ongoing African Development Bank meetings in Brazzaville to be low; no travel or trade restrictions are advised. About 3,000 participants, including ministers and central bank representatives, attend in a hybrid format to discuss mobilizing resources for Africa’s development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ブラザヴィル開催のアフリカ指導者会議に向けた衛生措置強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（900以上の疑い例・確定例、305人の死亡）と異常性が該当（2基準以上）。エボラ出血熱は国際的に拡大するリスクが高く、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・異常性・流行易性が顕著である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の重要疾患であり、DRC（イトゥリ州）での900超の症例と305人の死亡は直ちにフルRRA対象。記事はブラザヴィル（コンゴ共和国）での公開イベント開催に伴う予防措置を述べているが、実際の発生地はDRCであり、コンゴ共和国では確認例なし。verified_locationsはサマリーの主題であるDRCのみ含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ουγκάντα: Δύο ακόμη κρούσματα του Έμπολα επιβεβαιώθηκαν σε δομή υγείας στην Καμπάλα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Two more Ebola cases have been confirmed at a health facility in Kampala.
article.articleSummary: Uganda confirms two additional Ebola cases at a private health facility in Kampala, raising the national total to seven. The two patients are Ugandan health workers who were admitted to an isolation/treatment unit and are receiving care; authorities are tracing contacts. On Saturday, three new cases were also confirmed in Uganda. The outbreak’s epicenter remains Ituri province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which borders Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus noted that since the start of the outbreak there have been over 900 cases, with 101 confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：カンパラの保健施設でエボラ出血熱の新たに2例が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて重大な疾患であり、国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）が既に宣言されている。WHO認識の高い突発的な多国家での事例拡大。
triage.notes: DRC（Ituri州）も地域的に関連していますが、記事の主題はウガンダでの新規症例確認であるため verified_locations には含めません。ただしDRCは対象国リストに含まれており、引き続き監視が必要です。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、国際的な関心が極めて高い状況。

article.articleHeadline: エボラ死者数２００人超、アフリカ諸国で感染リスク懸念：時事ドットコム
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll exceeds 200, infection risk concerns in African countries: Jiji.com
article.articleSummary: As of May 23, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 204 deaths among 867 suspected Ebola virus disease cases across three provinces; the World Health Organization had previously tallied 177 deaths among 750 suspected cases and has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The African Union health body warned that more African countries could be affected, naming Angola, Burundi, Central African Republic, the Republic of the Congo, Ethiopia, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Zambia as at risk, citing high regional mobility and instability. The International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies confirms three Congolese volunteers infected in Ituri Province who died after corpse-management work on March 27, with society unaware of the outbreak at the time. In neighboring Uganda, three new Ebola virus disease cases were confirmed, bringing total to five (two Ugandan, one Congolese), with all patients surviving.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ死者数２００人超、アフリカ諸国で感染リスク懸念：時事ドットコム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。複数アフリカ国での感染確認・リスク警告があり、国際的対応が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRCが主要な発生地として詳述されており、ウガンダでも確認例がある。ザンビアは「リスク国」として名指しされているが、サマリー本文では具体的な確認例の記載がないため、「リスク警告対象」として含めた。WHOのPHEIC宣言済みであり、アフリカ地域での大規模流行の可能性があるため、優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 影／高雄登革熱疫情現擴散風險 前鎮社區單日捕46隻成蚊密度驚人 | 聯合新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Video: Kaohsiung dengue fever outbreak at risk of further spread; Qianzhen community captures 46 adult mosquitoes in a single day, astonishing density.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung City, Taiwan reports its first locally acquired dengue fever case in Qianzhen District. A 66-year-old auto repairman provided vague travel footprints, resulting in a NT$180,000 fine for evading traceability. The residence is under emergency vector control as 18 water containers tested positive for dengue larvae in a single day and traps captured 46 adult mosquitoes, indicating transmission risk. The index case later admitted visits to Renwu, Dashu, Xinxing, Lingya districts and Pingtung County, with hidden movements hampering source identification and control. PCR testing on over 250 samples has been negative so far; expanded testing and environmental cleanup continue. Kaohsiung established a Qianzhen Forward Command Center for door-to-door vector control, spraying, and intensified investigations. A clinician at Jianwei Clinic received NT$2,500 for early reporting; TOCC inquiries and rapid testing are urged in the ward to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄市のデング熱流行が拡散リスクを示す；前鎮地区で1日に成蚊46匹を捕獲、驚くべき蚊の密度
triage.triage_reason: 台湾高雄市での局所獲得デング熱症例の初報告で、複数地区での蚊の高い密度（18個の水容器からデング幼虫検出、成蚊46匹捕獲）、感染リスク拡大の懸念、地域での広がり可能性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常/予想外、重症度、流行のしやすさ）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはTaiwan（1668284）およびChina（1814991）が含まれているが、記事サマリーは台湾高雄市のデング熱事例のみを述べており、中国本土での発生は記載されていない。対象国リストには台湾（Taiwan）が含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列となる。ただし、この事例はWPRO地域における重要なシグナルであり、台湾当局による積極的な感染症対応が進行中である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : deux nouveaux cas confirmés d'infection au virus en Ouganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Two new confirmed cases of Ebola virus infection in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, two new confirmed Ebola virus disease cases were reported in Uganda. The patients are two healthcare workers at a private facility in Kampala, the capital. Their addition brings Uganda's total confirmed Ebola cases to seven since the current outbreak was declared on May 15 in the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo. The Ugandan Ministry of Health issued the update in a statement, with no further details provided on symptoms, clinical status, or outcomes. This update follows earlier confirmations and underscores the ongoing activity of the Ebola hemorrhagic fever outbreak affecting the region. No information on hospitalizations or transmissions is reported.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ウガンダで新たに2件のエボラウイルス感染が確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を4つ全て満たす。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と死亡率を有し、地域的拡大リスク、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確認事例がウガンダで増加（計7件）。DRCでの発生宣言（5月15日）から地域への拡大が確認され、ヒト・ヒト感染の高リスク。医療従事者への感染確認は医療施設内の感染制御課題を示唆。迅速なフルRRA実施と地域協力の強化が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TB-Free Mumbai Campaign To Be Launched On May 26
article.articleSummary: TB-Free Mumbai campaign, branded 'TB Mukt Mumbai', is launched by the Brihanmumbai Municipal Corporation (BMC) in collaboration with Maharashtra Lok Bhavan to accelerate tuberculosis elimination in Mumbai. The launch occurs on May 26, 2026, with Governor Jishnu Dev Varma digitally inaugurating the event. Inauguration at 11:00 at the Eknathrao Gaikwad Urban Health Centre, Dharavi, followed by a second session at 11:30 at Lokmanya Tilak Municipal General Hospital, Sion. The Governor will release a 'TB-Free Mumbai' booklet and honour voluntary organisations tied to the National TB Elimination Programme. Nutrition kits will be distributed to TB patients. Handheld X-ray devices will be distributed to boost early detection, and special Ayushman health camps will screen high-risk groups using portable X-ray equipment. The campaign aims to raise awareness, strengthen early detection, and improve access to TB treatment across Mumbai.

triage.headline_ja: TB-Free Mumbai キャンペーンが5月26日に開始される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はムンバイ当局による結核排除キャンペーンの公式イベント発表であり、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生緊急事態ではない。既知の地域保健施策の実施報告である。
triage.notes: 本記事はムンバイ市当局による結核対策キャンペーンの公式発表イベントの報道である。新規の感染症イベント、異常な保健事象、または緊急事態を示唆するものではない。結核は既知の風土病であり、当局による予防・排除取り組みは通常の公衆衛生活動範囲である。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: بیش از ۹۰۰ مورد مشکوک به ابولا در جمهوری دموکراتیک کنگو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, the World Health Organization reports more than 900 suspected Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 confirmed infections by laboratory testing. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, home to nearly 5 million people, where about one in four need humanitarian assistance, and has spread to three provinces. Health authorities report that contact tracing among exposed individuals is failing, undermining efforts to isolate and control transmission. The situation illustrates the challenges of outbreak response amid a fragile health system and ongoing humanitarian needs in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の疑い例が900件以上報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率を持つ重篤な疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限リスクが顕著。接触者追跡の失敗により管理可能性に懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則（IHR）上の公衆衛生上の緊急事態。疑い例900件以上、確定例101件。イトゥリ州を中心に3州に拡大。接触者追跡の機能不全と脆弱な保健システムが対応能力を著しく制限。即座のWHO通知対象。

article.articleHeadline: La tempesta perfecta per a l'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The perfect storm for Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with spillovers into Uganda and South Sudan, has been declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern by the WHO. The current Bundibugyo strain is about 30% fatal and, unlike the Zaire strain, lacks a vaccine or treatment. Since its start in early May, the outbreak has killed more than 170 and infected over 750. The global spread risk remains lower due to the rural, less-connected setting, but local populations face devastating consequences. US response is criticized as under-resourced after dismantling USAID and withdrawing from the WHO, with roughly $23 million mobilized. In 2014, Obama-era actions mobilized international aid and deployed troops to Liberia, with France to Guinea and the UK to Sierra Leone to curb transmission. The Congo’s eastern conflict, with over 100,000 militias and millions displaced, and a controversial UN mission complicate containment and relief efforts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの完全な嵐
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的公衆衛生緊急事態宣言、複数国への拡大（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）、170人以上の死亡、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性から、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明確に「eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo」での発生が主題であり、ウガンダおよび南スーダンへのスピルオーバーが言及されている。ただしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず、南スーダンも同様。米国、フランス、英国は過去の2014年対応事例の参照であり、現在の発生地ではない。WHO公衆衛生緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）、Bundibugyo株（ワクチン・治療なし、致死率30%）、170人超の死亡、750人超の感染により緊急性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: To nye ebola-tilfeller i Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new Ebola cases in Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola cases in Uganda raise the national total to seven, with one death reported. All Ugandan cases are linked to the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, first confirmed in Ituri province, northeast Congo, on May 15. The outbreak involves a rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant with no approved vaccine or specific treatment. In Congo, authorities report 204 deaths to date. The World Health Organization (WHO) on May 25 said there are over 900 suspected Ebola cases, of which 101 are laboratory-confirmed. The WHO regards the risk of progression to a national outbreak for the Bundibugyo variant as 'very high' and has declared the Congo and Uganda events a Public Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC).

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダで新たに2件のエボラ確定例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する国際的なエボラ流行。既にPHEIC宣言済みであり、死亡報告あり、複数国での確認、WHOによる『非常に高いリスク』評価があり、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCでの発生が記事の主題であり、PHEIC宣言済み。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのIturi州での初確認（5月15日）、204死亡報告、稀なBundibugyo型、ワクチンなし治療法なし、WHO『非常に高い』リスク評価が全て記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Why Ebola hits Africa's DRC more than any other country
article.articleSummary: Ebola repeatedly erupts in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), which has suffered 17 outbreaks—the most of any country. In the current outbreak, suspected cases total about 750 with at least 177 probable deaths reported by May 22, 2026. WHO raised its national-risk assessment from high to very high and has deployed laboratory supplies, personal protective equipment, tents, and emergency response materials into affected areas. The reasons lie in a nexus of ecology, conflict, and weak health systems. The DRC sits at the frontline of Ebola’s ecological niche, with bushmeat hunting, deforestation, and close human–wildlife contact fueling spillovers from bat reservoirs. Ongoing outbreaks are exacerbated by armed conflict and insecurity, which hinder access, disrupt surveillance and vaccination, and drive population displacement. The country’s vast size and poor infrastructure slow rapid response, while fragility of infection prevention and control amplifies transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがアフリカのDRCで他のどの国よりも多く発生する理由
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の現在の流行で750の疑い例と177の可能性のある死亡が報告されており、WHO が国家リスク評価を「高」から「非常に高」に引き上げている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い死亡率を持つ疾患。記事は現在進行中の大規模流行（750疑い例、177死亡）を報告しており、WHO による国家リスク評価の引き上げ、緊急対応物資の配備が確認されている。DRCの弱い保健システム、武装勢力による紛争、不十分な感染管理能力により、さらなる拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tin đồn làm trầm trọng lây lan Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rumors worsen the spread of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, authorities in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo have intensified health checks at checkpoints near Bunia, focusing on travelers from Mongbwalu, the mining town identified as the focal point of an Ebola outbreak linked to the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The report notes that rumors surrounding the outbreak are contributing to the spread, prompting tighter screening and heightened vigilance at transit points. The Bundibugyo strain is highlighted as the cause of this outbreak in the region, though no specific case counts or laboratory confirmations are provided in the article. Public health measures emphasize early detection, isolation, and community engagement to limit transmission. The piece underscores how misinformation can undermine containment efforts, reinforcing the need for timely information, transparent communication, and sustained surveillance at Bunia’s border crossings and surrounding routes.

triage.headline_ja: デマはエボラウイルスの感染拡大を悪化させる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスの発生地はコンゴ民主共和国で、深刻な公衆衛生への影響（重症度の高い疾患）、異常/予想外な事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを全て満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の発生が確認されている。記事サマリーではMangbwalu鉱山町が焦点地点、Buniaが検査強化地点として言及されており、いずれもコンゴ民主共和国内。具体的な症例数や検査確認数は記載されていないが、当局が強化措置を実施しており、デマが感染拡大を悪化させている点が指摘されている。IHR基準とWPRO基準の両方で全項目該当のため、優先度の高いシグナルとして分類。

article.articleHeadline: أوغندا: ارتفاع إصابات الإيبولا إلى 7 حالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda: Ebola infections rise to 7 cases.
article.articleSummary: Seven Ebola infections confirmed in Uganda as of May 25, 2026, after two new cases were reported, linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak that began before Congo announced it on May 15. A 59-year-old Congolese man admitted to a Kampala hospital on May 11 died three days later; his illness led to positive Ebola tests among Congolese nationals who received medical care in Uganda. Ugandan health authorities confirmed on Saturday the first locally transmitted cases: a driver and a healthcare worker who had contact with the deceased Congolese patient. On Monday, tests also showed two additional health workers at a private Kampala hospital infected. In neighboring Congo, Ebola cases exceed 900, concentrated in Ituri province in the east where the current outbreak center is located, according to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ：エボラ感染者が7例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際拡大、国境を越えた感染）、スクリーニング基準4つ以上該当（異常性、重症度、対人感染性、管理困難性）、社会的・政治的関心が高い。フルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラアウトバースト（900例超）からウガンダへの国際拡大が確認された。医療従事者への感染を含む二次感染・地域内伝播の証拠あり。死亡症例が報告され、重症度高い。多国間対応と支援が必須。

article.articleHeadline: HLA polymorphisms shape divergent outcomes of Toxoplasma and Plasmodium infection in Eastern Indian HbE/β-thalassemia cohort - Communications Biology
article.articleSummary: Eastern India (Kolkata) HbE/β-thalassemia cohort study investigates how HLA polymorphisms influence outcomes of Toxoplasma gondii and Plasmodium falciparum infections. The researchers collected 71 HbE/β-thalassemia patient samples and 50 healthy controls; 71 patients and 10 controls underwent high-resolution Illumina sequencing for five HLA loci (A, B, C, DQB1, DRB1) at ~150X, with an additional 40 controls sequenced by Sanger. Apicomplexan presence was screened in genomic DNA by qRT-PCR-HRM, using melting temperatures for Plasmodium (Tm ≈ 77.079°C) and Toxoplasma (Tm ≈ 85.247°C). In vitro infections used PBMCs from patients/controls with freshly egressed T. gondii tachyzoites (MOI 1:10) and Plasmodium falciparum 3D7, employing K562 cells for HLA overexpression and HLA contexts A*33/A*24 or C*07. Outcomes measured include IFN-γ by ELISA, microscopy/IFA, flow cytometry (CD4/CD8/HLA-I), infection/proliferation, apoptosis, and erythroid differentiation (CD235a after EPO).

triage.headline_ja: HLA多型がインド東部HbE/β-サラセミアコホートにおけるトキソプラズマおよびプラスモジウム感染の異なる転帰を形作る
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術論文の報告であり、感染症の新規発生イベント（アウトブレイク）ではなく、既知の感染と遺伝的素因の関連性に関する研究報告である。公衆衛生上の新規の危機的状況を示唆する兆候がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はNature Communications Biologyに掲載された学術論文であり、インド東部のコホート研究に基づくトキソプラズマとマラリア・ファルシパルムの感染メカニズムに関する基礎研究報告である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な感染事例の報告、公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではない。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Caminhões farão coleta de entulhos durante mutirão contra dengue em Curitiba
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trucks will collect bulky waste during an anti-dengue campaign in Curitiba.
article.articleSummary: Curitiba's Regional Cajuru hosts the Mutirão Curitiba sem Mosquito anti-dengue campaign on May 25–26, 2026, with outreach in 25 blocks around the Lotiguaçu Health Unit at 1287 Rua Eunice Betini Bartoszeck, Uberaba. Health workers will educate residents on dengue prevention and proper disposal of bulky waste. Trucks will pass by to collect bulky waste during those days; residents should place bulky items outside their gates when trucks arrive, and smaller items should be bagged. On May 27, trucks from the Municipal Environment Secretariat will complete the disposal. Collectible debris includes unusable items; however heavy civil construction waste (caliça), unbagged organic/vegetal waste, toxic or hazardous materials (lamps, medicines, batteries, paints), and large quantities of vehicles or tires will not be collected. This is the second mutirão in Regional Cajuru this month.

triage.headline_ja: クリチバの蚊対策キャンペーン中に廃棄物回収トラックが運行
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は蚊対策キャンペーンと廃棄物管理に関する市民啓発・衛生措置の報道であり、デング熱の新規発生事例や流行の報告ではない。公衆衛生への実質的影響は不明であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の定期的な公衆衛生施策（蚊の繁殖地削減、廃棄物管理）に関するコミュニティキャンペーンの報道である。デング熱の新規発生、増加、異常な重症度、または国際拡大に関する情報は含まれていない。予防的衛生措置の実施報道としては通常の自治体活動であり、シグナル価値は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirma dos nuevos casos de ébola y eleva a siete el total de contagios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms two new Ebola cases and raises the total number of infections to seven.
article.articleSummary: Two new Ebola cases in Uganda, increasing the current outbreak total to seven. The patients are Ugandan healthcare workers at a private clinic in Kampala and are being treated in a specialized unit. Authorities have initiated contact tracing to limit spread. The updates follow three new cases reported two days earlier, signaling rapid transmission. The outbreak focus remains Ituri Province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, a border region with Uganda where cases are frequent. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo Ebola strain a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 25, 2026, there have been more than 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed infections linked to this outbreak, primarily in DRC, with Uganda bolstering surveillance and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが2件の新たなエボラ症例を確認し、感染総数を7件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラウイルス病は国際的に重大な懸念であり、複数国での確認と急速な伝播が示唆されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例確認が述べられているが、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCはリスト対象国であり、Ituri Province での主要な発生地として記述されている。WHOが国際的懸念となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言しており、900件以上の疑い症例と101件の確定症例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: La UE destina 15 millones de euros para frenar el brote de Ébola en RDC y Uganda - Notiulti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The EU allocates 15 million euros to curb the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda - Notiulti
article.articleSummary: European Union allocates 15 million euros in humanitarian aid to curb the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda, via the EU Civil Protection and Humanitarian Aid Operations. The Ebola Bundibugyo strain has raised concerns over cross-border transmission. Funding will reinforce public health actions in both countries, including procurement of essential medical equipment, healthcare worker training, and logistical support for vaccination campaigns and epidemiological surveillance. The EU Health Security Committee issued a technical opinion endorsing a coordinated common approach, aligned with Regulation (EU) 2022/2371 to strengthen capacity to prevent, detect, and respond to cross-border health threats, as experienced during COVID-19. The outbreak strains already stressed health systems amid mobility, limited infrastructure, and vaccine campaign mistrust. Close cooperation with Congolese and Ugandan authorities and the WHO is emphasized, alongside EU resilience and preparedness strategies for global emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: EUがDRCとウガンダのエボラ出血熱の流行を抑止するため1500万ユーロを配分
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株による越境感染リスク、複数国での流行、国際的な資金投入と対応体制整備の進行は、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（1605651）はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの具体的な流行状況や患者数について明記されておらず、支援対象国としての言及にとどまる。DRCがエボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の主要な発生地であり、越境感染リスクの文脈でウガンダが言及されているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirmă două noi cazuri de Ebola; numărul total de cazuri în această ţară a ajuns la şapte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms two new Ebola cases; the total number of cases in this country has reached seven.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Uganda reports two newly confirmed Ebola cases, raising the national total to seven. The two patients are Ugandan healthcare workers at a private clinic in Kampala; they are in a dedicated treatment ward and receiving medical care, with outbreak-response teams tracing contacts. Authorities also confirmed three additional Ebola cases on Saturday, underscoring ongoing transmission. The outbreak’s epicenter is Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, near Uganda’s border. The World Health Organization has deemed the Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO reports over 900 suspected cases to date, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections, highlighting substantial cross-border risk and the need for continued surveillance and containment at the border region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラの新規2件を確認；当国での症例総数は7件に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式にPHEIC認定済みで、越境感染の明確なリスク、社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）が確認されており、WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。患者はウガンダ保健医療従事者で、DRC-Uganda国境地域での越境伝播の明確なリスク。900件以上の疑い例、101件の確定例が報告されている。フルRRA対象として優先度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Нигерия объявила о повышенной опасности распространения вируса Эболы
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria has announced a heightened risk of Ebola virus transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Nigeria raises the risk of Ebola virus disease importation amid a growing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri province) and Uganda. No confirmed Nigerian cases yet, but surveillance is intensified across eastern border states, transport hubs, and border crossings. Nigeria’s National Center for Disease Control and National Emergency Operations System have activated emergency operations, creating temporary isolation centers, dedicated wards in infectious hospitals, laboratories, and stockpiles of PPE and equipment. The Federal Airports Authority reports strict measures at all international airports to curb spread. The Ituri epicenter in eastern DRC saw the first death on April 24 (a nurse) near Bunia; officials suspect miners in a nearby gold mining area sparked transmission. Alerts were issued May 5; laboratory confirmation on May 14 identified Ebola virus (Bundibugyo strain). WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. In DRC: 204 deaths; over 900 suspected and 101 confirmed cases reported by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアがエボラウイルス伝播の高まったリスクを発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際保健上の緊急事態を宣言した確定的なエボラ流行であり、複数国での感染確認と国境を越えた拡大の懸念が明確。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC（Ituri州）とウガンダでの確認、ナイジェリアでの警戒活動が述べられている。Bluedot APIではナイジェリアが発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではナイジェリアは「確認症例なし」「リスク警戒中」であり、実際の発生地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ただし記事内容の重大性とWHO公式宣言により、PICKUP判定は変わらない。

article.articleHeadline: AfDB meets under Ebola's cloud as Africa hunts for development cash at home
article.articleSummary: As of 25 May 2026, the African Development Bank's annual meeting in Congo Republic unfolds under the shadow of an Ebola outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, now reaching Uganda with more than 170 suspected deaths; Congo Republic reports no cases and has not restricted attendance per WHO. The Ebola cloud could dampen participation by policymakers and financiers. In Nairobi, AfDB President Sidi Ould Tah emphasizes shifting finance away from shrinking foreign aid toward Africa's own resources. The bank's New African Financial Architecture for Development (NAFAD) would pool Africa's roughly $4 trillion in institutional capital—pensions, sovereign funds, and savings—to close an estimated $400 billion annual development financing gap, funding infrastructure, energy, food security, and climate adaptation. Critics warn domestic savings (about 18% in Sub-Saharan Africa) won't suffice; support is urged to catalyze foreign investment and de-risk projects with guarantees.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの影で開催されるアフリカ開発銀行総会—アフリカが国内での開発資金調達を模索
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ）で確認され、170人以上の死亡が報告されている。国際的な関心が高く、地域的な政治・経済活動に影響を及ぼしており、IHR基準および社会政治的関心の観点から即座のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行が明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国に含まれていないため verified_locations から除外。コンゴ共和国は発生地域に含まれるが、サマリー上では「ケースが報告されていない」と述べられており、流行地ではなく会議開催地であるため除外。170人以上の死亡はIHRおよびWPRO基準の複数項目で「Yes」評価をサポートする重大な懸念事項。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus: इबोला का कोई पक्का इलाज नहीं, मृत्यु दर ज्यादा; डॉ रणदीप गुलेरिया ने बचाव का तरीका बताया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus: There is no definitive treatment for Ebola; the mortality rate is high; Dr. Randeep Guleria explained how to prevent it.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus: Dr. Randeep Guleria, chairman of Internal Medicine, Respiratory and Sleep Medicine at Medanta, Gurugram, notes there is no definitive treatment and mortality is high, though some patients recover. Emphasizes strict infection-control and avoiding contact with infected individuals; incubation period is 2–21 days. Early symptoms include fever, body pains, sore throat, vomiting, and diarrhea; severe cases may involve bleeding from the mouth or stool and breathing difficulties. Do not travel unless necessary to affected areas; travellers from such areas should be screened. The Government of India, citing Bundibugyo virus in parts of Africa, advised citizens to avoid non-essential travel to the Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan; the May 23 advisory acknowledges higher risk in neighboring regions around Congo and Uganda, including South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：エボラに確実な治療法はなく、死亡率が高い；ラムディープ・グレリア博士が予防方法を説明
triage.triage_reason: インドでのエボラウイルスに関する注意喚起記事であり、アフリカ地域（コンゴ民主共和国、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での発生に基づく政府渡航勧告が主な内容。実際の感染症イベントはアフリカに限定され、インドでの発生は報告されていない。情報は教育的・予防的であるが、国際的な拡大リスクと対象国への影響の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事は主にインドでの予防啓発とアフリカ地域（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン）での発生に関する政府勧告が対象。実際の確認されたエボラ発生地はDRCとウガンダ（対象国でなし）、南スーダン（対象国でなし）。インドは現在の発生地ではなく、予防・渡航勧告の発信国として記載。IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、国際的拡大、渡航制限）だが、対象国内での確認例が限定的であり、詳細情報不足のため一段階下げてWATCHと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Outbreak Is Becoming 'Overwhelming'
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is fast expanding, with 904 suspected infections reported as of Sunday, May 24, 2026, by the Congolese ministry of communication (per the Guardian). The World Health Organization had cited at least 177 deaths. Hospitals are stretched thin, and specialized Ebola treatment units are often unavailable, leaving patients in ordinary wards and some facilities turning away people with other serious illnesses (Wall Street Journal). Africa CDC director Jean Kaseya warned that the region is in the 'hardest phase' of an 'overwhelming' crisis, highlighting critical gaps in capacity to respond across the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が『圧倒的』になってきている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当し、エボラ出血熱の急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、地域医療システムの過負荷、Africa CDC による危機的状況の警告が確認されたため、直ちにフルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: 東部DRCでのエボラ出血熱流行は、904件の疑い患者と177名の死亡が報告されており、WHO・Africa CDCの公式声明を含む高い信頼性を持つ情報。医療施設の飽和状態と地域対応能力の欠如が明記されており、人道的支援と国際的対応の急務が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Zentralafrika: Uganda meldet zwei neue Ebola-Fälle - Wissenschaft - Rhein-Zeitung
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Central Africa: Uganda reports two new Ebola cases - Science - Rhein-Zeitung.
article.articleSummary: Two additional Ebola cases in Uganda raise the national total to seven, according to Uganda's Ministry of Health. The new infections involve two staff members at a private clinic in Kampala, who are under treatment; all contacts are being monitored and traced. Previously, a woman from the Democratic Republic of Congo who flew into Kampala and was treated for abdominal symptoms at a private clinic returned home; a sample from her tested positive for Ebola. The World Health Organization had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over the Congo outbreak in mid-May, when more than 240 suspected infections were reported. Since then, there have been more than 900 suspected cases and more than 100 confirmed cases. The situation illustrates the ongoing Ebola outbreak linked to the DRC, with Uganda actively investigating and isolating suspected cases and monitoring contacts.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカでのエボラ：ウガンダが2件の新たなエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCで240以上の疑い症例・100以上の確定症例を伴う大規模流行があり、ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。WHOが国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済みの既知流行の新展開。
triage.notes: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（900以上の疑い症例、100以上の確定症例）からウガンダへの越境感染が確認されている。WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的懸念事項となる公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している既知流行の拡大。ウガンダでの新規症例はコンタクトトレーシングが進行中で、管理可能性の評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: la Centrafrique "a instruit l'ensemble des structures sanitaires et sécuritaires concernées"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Central African Republic 'has instructed all of the relevant health and security structures involved'.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) prompts regional vigilance, with Africa CDC listing ten at‑risk countries. The Central African Republic (CAR), sharing a long border with the DRC, tightens cross‑border preventive measures after activating national preparedness and response mechanisms. On May 24, Bangui outlined three strategic axes: strengthen nationwide epidemiological surveillance, secure high‑risk entry points, and mobilize community and institutional response, with special attention to Obo, Zemio, and Mboki due to proximity to the DRC epicenter. Diagnostic capacity is being consolidated with the Institut Pasteur de Bangui; diagnostic reagents are available to ensure rapid testing. In the DRC, over 900 suspected cases of Ebola hemorrhagic fever have been reported; the outbreak was declared on May 15 and is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no vaccine or specific treatment, with fatality up to 50%. The WHO Director‑General has declared an International Health Emergency.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：中央アフリカ共和国「関係するすべての保健・セキュリティ機関に指示した」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のDRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（900件以上の疑い例）、WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、致命率50％、地域拡大リスク高、複数国での対応が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC主体のエボラアウトブレイク情報であり、中央アフリカ共和国(CAR)は区域内警戒・予防措置の実施国として言及されているが、実際の患者発生地はDRCのみが記述されている。Bluedot APIの発生地域にはアフリカ大陸全体や複数地域が含まれているが、サマリーの精読結果、確認された患者発生地はDRCのみ。WHO緊急宣言済み、Bundibugyo ebolavirus確認、最大50%の致命率を伴うエボラ出血熱の地域的拡大脅威が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola संक्रमण पर एक्शन : रायपुर एयरपोर्ट परिसर में नोडल अधिकारी की होगी नियुक्ति, यात्रियों की करेंगे स्वास्थ्य स्क्रीनिंग - Haribhoomi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Action on Ebola infection: A nodal officer to be appointed at the Raipur airport premises; health screening of passengers will be conducted.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, India issues a nationwide advisory on Ebola. In Raipur, the airport will appoint a nodal officer to coordinate health screening of arriving passengers, identify suspected cases, and immediately inform the health department. The officer will ensure isolation, referral, and emergency management arrangements. Ebola is a rare but deadly infection; outbreaks occur primarily in parts of Africa. Transmission occurs via contact with blood, saliva, sweat, vomit, or other bodily fluids from infected humans or animals (not airborne, water, or casual contact). The incubation period is 2–21 days. Early symptoms resemble influenza, including sudden high fever, fatigue, muscle and throat pain, and headache. Prompt medical attention is advised if exposure is suspected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染に対する措置：ライプール空港敷地内に連絡担当官を配置、乗客の健康スクリーニングを実施
triage.triage_reason: インドでエボラウイルス病に関する全国的な警告が発令されており、空港での健康スクリーニング体制の強化が報告されている。ただし、実際の感染症発生を示すイベント情報よりも、予防的対策と情報啓発に焦点が当たっており、現在の重症度や流行状況は不明である。情報不足のため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは予防的対策と情報啓発を主に説明しており、現在のインドでの実際のエボラ感染症発生報告は明確ではない。アフリカで主に発生する稀な疾患であり、インドでの実際の患者発生情報の続報が重要。IHR基準では2項目該当のため最小限のPICKUP基準を満たすが、WPROでも3項目該当しており、情報不足が大きいため慎重に観察する段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果埃博拉疫情防控難 民眾闖醫院搶親人遺體 | 伊波拉 | 非洲疫情 | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Challenges in Containing the Congo Ebola Outbreak; People Force Their Way into Hospitals to Seize Their Relatives' Bodies | Ebola | Africa Epidemic | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Massive strain on Congo’s Ebola response as clashes erupt near care facilities: On May 24, youths stormed Mongbwalu General Hospital in Ituri Province demanding two relatives’ bodies, with gunfire forcing evacuation and the facility placed on high alert—the third attack on a medical facility in a week. WHO has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing the high infectivity of corpses and funeral gatherings as transmission risks. The government ordered official handling of suspected remains and banned funerals with more than 50 mourners in the northeast. A MSF tent housing suspected/confirmed Ebola patients was set on fire in Mongbwalu; 18 suspected patients left and are missing. In Ituri, 904 suspected cases (up from ~700) and 119 suspected deaths are reported, though regional totals reach about 220. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus. Three MSF volunteers died handling bodies on March 27; if confirmed, timelines could advance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ防疫の難しさ 民衆が病院に押し入り親族の遺体を奪う
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHO公式のPHEIC宣言済み。医療施設への攻撃、患者の逃走、Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未開発）という重大な脅威要因が複合的に存在する。
triage.notes: WHO PHIEC宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン未開発）の感染拡大、医療施設への複数回の攻撃による機能停止、患者18名の逃走、遺体処理規制への住民反発など、制御不能化のリスクが高い。MSFボランティアの死亡も確認の可能性あり。

article.sourceUrl: https://www.hk01.com/社會新聞/60353391/猴痘-兩青年返內地後確診-5-3到旺角同志場所-胡同-有性接觸
article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜兩青年返內地後確診　5.3到旺角同志場所「胡同」有性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | Two young men diagnosed after returning to the Mainland; on May 3, they had sexual contact at the Mong Kok gay venue 'Hutong'.
article.articleSummary: Two Hong Kong residents, aged 28 and 30, diagnosed with monkeypox after high-risk contact at Hutong, a male-MSM sauna on Shanghai Street in Mong Kok. Mainland China notified Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection on May 25 of two confirmed cases with high-risk exposure at Hutong on May 3; cases are not known to be related. Case 1 developed fever and inguinal swelling on May 8 following Hutong attendance; Case 2 developed bilateral lower-limb rash on May 15 after visiting Hutong on May 1 and May 3. Both samples tested positive for monkeypox virus; patients are stable and receiving treatment in Mainland China. On-site inspections and contact tracing are underway; attempts to obtain Hutong customer lists were unsuccessful. Hutong staff have received health education. Hotline 2125-2373 operates weekdays 9:00–18:00 for health assessments and testing. Cross-border epidemiological surveillance and information sharing continue.

triage.headline_ja: 猴痘｜兩青年返內地後確認　5.3到旺角同志場所「胡同」有性接觸
triage.triage_reason: 香港と中国本土にまたがるMpox感染事例であり、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な伝播、国際的リスク）。MSM施設での集団感染リスク、複数国間の疫学監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港は記事の主要な舞台であるが、対象国リストに香港・マカオは China に含めるため verified_locations は China のみ。本事例は香港residents が中国本土で診断・治療を受けており、両地域の疾病管理当局が連携している。MSM向けサウナ（胡同）での高リスク接触があり、接触者追跡と疫学監視が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirms two new Ebola cases, bringing total to seven
article.articleSummary: Uganda on 2026-05-25 confirmed two additional Ebola cases, bringing the national total to seven since the outbreak was identified on May 15. The two new cases are Ugandan health workers in a private Kampala facility; both have been admitted to the designated treatment unit and are under care as contact tracing proceeds. Uganda had suspended all public transport to the Democratic Republic of Congo on May 22 after reporting Congolese nationals crossing the border, with one infection and one death already linked to the cross-border movement. Earlier, on May 23, three additional cases were confirmed in Uganda: a Ugandan driver, a Ugandan health worker, and a woman from the DRC. The WHO noted on May 24 that more than 900 suspected Ebola cases had been identified in the DRC, the outbreak epicenter. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダがエボラウイルス病の新規2症例を確認、累計7例に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の実施）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。エボラ出血熱は最高危険度の感染症であり、国境を越えた広がりが既に確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて致命率が高い感染症（記事では器官不全と重篤出血が言及）。ウガンダ側で既に国境検疫（5月22日のコンゴ方向公共交通停止）、接触者追跡が実施中。DRC側での900以上の疑い例検出も報告されており、地域的な流行が進行している。WHO報告により国際的な注視を集めている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda confirmă două noi cazuri de Ebola; numărul total de cazuri în această țară a ajuns la șapte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda confirms two new Ebola cases; the total number of cases in this country has reached seven.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Uganda reports two additional Ebola cases, bringing the national tally to seven. The two new infections are Ugandan health-care workers from a private clinic in Kampala; both patients are hospitalized in a dedicated treatment unit and are receiving medical care. Epidemic-response teams are tracing contacts of the two patients. Uganda had previously confirmed three additional Ebola cases on Saturday. The outbreak's epicenter lies in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, a region adjacent to Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the Bundibugyo lineage Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus said there are more than 900 suspected cases to date, with 101 laboratory-confirmed, underscoring ongoing transmission and containment challenges in the cross-border region.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが2例の新規エボラ症例を確認；同国の総症例数は7例に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みの越境感染であり、IHR基準（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際の発生地は主にDRC（Ituri Province）であり、ウガンダは隣接する地域での二次感染を報告しているが、サマリー記事の主題はウガンダの症例確認であっても、疫学的には越境感染を含む越境地域の状況。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。WHOによるPHEIC宣言があり、900+の疑い症例と101の確定症例という高い感染カウントから、深刻性・流行可能性・管理困難性が全て確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Máxima vigilancia sanitaria en La Línea por el amistoso del Congo mientras crece el brote de ébola en África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maximum health surveillance in La Línea due to the Congo's friendly match as the Ebola outbreak grows in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo triggers heightened health surveillance for the Chile–DR Congo friendly in La Línea de la Concepción, Spain. The June 9 match at the Real Balompédica Linense stadium becomes an international health concern as the WHO reports over 900 suspected cases and more than 100 laboratory-confirmed infections, with deaths rising in eastern Ituri and North and South Kivu. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, increasing transmission fears. Congo cancelled Kinshasa training and shifted preparations to Europe, including a June 3 friendly in Liège against Denmark before the La Línea game. Spain’s External Health is scrutinizing the Congolese squad’s travel route, European stay duration, and potential control measures for players and entourage. No suspension recommendation yet; decisions depend on evolving epidemiology as the outbreak draws attention to Campo de Gibraltar.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのサッカー親善試合が予定されるラ・リネア地区で最大限の衛生警戒体制が敷かれるなか、アフリカではエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）のDRCでの大規模流行（900以上の疑い例、100以上の確認例、死亡例あり）に加え、国際的なスポーツイベントを通じた欧州への人的移動リスクが存在し、IHR基準3項目（深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのBundibugyo Ebola流行が主題であり、スペイン・ベルギー・デンマークの言及はこの流行に対応した国際的な警戒体制の事例である。したがって verified_locations はDRCのみに限定した。WPRO対象国（DRC=203312）に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。

article.articleHeadline: Több mint 900 ebolagyanús esetet azonosított a WHO Kongóban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 900 Ebola-suspected cases identified by WHO in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 900 Ebola-suspected cases have been identified in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 laboratory-confirmed infections and 204 deaths reported by the health ministry. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, a conflict-affected region of nearly five million residents, where violence and displacement hinder contact tracing and early detection. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy. Health workers and aid personnel have faced attacks amid the response, complicating containment. Hospital officials reported demands for the bodies of deceased relatives, and protests at an aid tent after authorities did not hand over the body of local Ebola victim Eli Munongo Wangu. The situation underscores challenges in surveillance, security, and outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、コンゴ民主共和国で900件以上のエボラ疑い症例を特定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株の確認例101件、死亡204件の重症アウトブレイク。紛争地域での流行で国際的拡大リスクと管理困難性が顕著。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは既承認ワクチンがなく治療法も限定的。イトゥリ州の紛争状況が接触追跡や患者管理を大きく阻害。保健労働者への攻撃が報告されており、対応体制が著しく困難。国際支援の緊急性が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: U DR Kongu zapaljen centar za liječenje ebole, pacijenti nestali
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In DR Congo, an Ebola treatment center was set on fire; patients missing.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola treatment center in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo was set on fire by locals, with 13 patients missing. The MSF-supported Mongwalu General Referral Hospital facility housed 28 people suspected of Ebola; at least 13 escaped, the rest unaccounted for. Police opened Saturday-morning investigations to identify perpetrators and locate the missing patients believed to be hiding among residents. The attack marks a second such incident in seven days in a region already contending with a new Ebola outbreak wave and rising distrust toward health authorities. The violence underscores security challenges for outbreak response and the risk of patients fleeing facilities during attacks, complicating case finding and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ治療センターが放火され、患者が行方不明に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な暴力的イベント、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行リスク、管理可能性の懸念）。アウトブレイク対応の破壊と患者流出によるコンテインメント喪失の重大リスク。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク最中における治療施設への暴力的攻撃は、患者28名中13名以上が逃亡したことで直接的な感染拡大リスクが高い。7日間で2件目の同様攻撃であり、地域の保健当局への信頼喪失が顕著。治療施設の機能喪失と患者追跡困難化により、containmentが著しく阻害される。国際的な対応支援が急速に必要な段階。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果埃博拉疫情防控难 民众闯医院抢亲人遗体 | 伊波拉 | 非洲疫情 | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Containment of the Congo Ebola outbreak is difficult as crowds storm hospitals to reclaim their loved ones' bodies | Ebola | Africa outbreak | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri Province intensifies amid security violence and public fear. By May 24, 904 suspected Ebola cases were reported—predominantly in Ituri—with 119 deaths among the suspected cases; regional tallies reach about 220 suspected infections, a discrepancy not explained by authorities. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant, for which no vaccine exists, is implicated; Bunia previously detected undetected spread before testing for other strains. The World Health Organization has declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, though global transmission risk remains low. Government measures restrict large funerals and mandate official handling of suspected bodies to curb spread. Attacks on humanitarian facilities surge: a Mongbwalu hospital was stormed with gunfire; tents set up by MSF were burned in Mongbwalu, and a center in Rwampara was burned. On May 23, the IFRC reported three MSF volunteers died, believed infected while handling a body on March 27 during a humanitarian mission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疫情防止が困難 - 群衆が病院に押し入り親族の遺体を奪おうとする
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言し、国際的な関心が高く、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: WHOが公式にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言している重大なエボラ爆発。Bundibugyo株（ワクチン無し）の検出、医療施設への攻撃増加、医療従事者の感染死亡、および社会不安が統計の不確実性を生み出している。ルワンダでの地理的な近接性も注視が必要だが、サマリー内ではDRCが主要な発生地点であり、RwandaはDRCと国境を共有する隣国として提及されているのみである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich aus: Klinik-Personal in Uganda infiziert - Furcht vor Seuche wächst
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading: Clinic staff in Uganda infected - Fear of the outbreak grows.
article.articleSummary: As of May 25, 2026, Ebola is spreading in Uganda, with Kampala reporting two additional infections among private-hospital staff, bringing Uganda’s total registered cases to seven. Both infected staff are receiving medical care, and authorities are tracing contacts to identify exposures and prevent further transmission. A prior case highlights cross-border risk: a woman traveled by air from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Kampala with abdominal symptoms, was treated at a private hospital, and left Uganda; later laboratory testing confirmed Ebola in her sample. The World Health Organization had already declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern in mid-May over the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, which at that time had more than 240 suspected cases. The situation has since grown to over 900 suspected infections and more than 100 confirmed cases in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが拡大：ウガンダのクリニックスタッフが感染 - 感染症への恐怖が高まる
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の多国間での確認事例、国際的な移動に伴う感染拡大、WHO公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事象（PHEIC）の宣言、ウガンダとDRCでの急速な感染者数増加（7例→900例以上）により、フルリスク評価（RRA）進行が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、ウガンダでの新規感染事例（クリニックスタッフ2名、計7例）、DRCからウガンダへの航空移動による越境感染確認、WHO PHEIC宣言(2026年5月中旬)、DRCでの急速な感染拡大(240→900+疑似症例)が記載されている。エボラは最高レベルの病原性・致死性を有し、国際的に懸念される疾患であり、多くの基準を満たす。当初Bluedot API発生地域にはKampala(ウガンダ)も含まれていたため、地域検証により両国の感染事例が確認された。

article.articleHeadline: Medics attacked as Ebola cases near 1,000 as people 'don't believe it's real'
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with suspected cases surpassing 900 in the eastern Ituri Province as cases rise toward 1,000 under a new sub-strain. The outbreak has been declared a global health emergency by the WHO. Health facilities are overwhelmed, and arson attacks on treatment centres—including Rwampara General Hospital—have intensified as families dispute burial practices after suspected deaths. Bodies remain highly infectious, prompting strict safe burial protocols and military protection for healthcare workers. Warnings about disbelief in the virus persist; locals accuse foreign aid groups of fabricating Ebola. Security in north-east Congo is fragile amid rebel activity, with groups like M23 and Allied Democratic Forces operating in the region, while almost 1 million people are displaced. The outbreak also prompted a 21-day isolation requirement for the national football team ahead of the World Cup due to fears of international spread.

triage.headline_ja: 医療従事者への攻撃が増加、エボラ患者数が1,000件近くに──人々は『これは本当ではない』と信じない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、死亡・重症者の多発、医療施設の過負荷、国際的な拡大懸念（ワールドカップ関連の隔離措置）、および社会的・政治的関心の高さから、フルRRAに進むべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC東部イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行を主題としており、WHOによる国際保健上の緊急事態宣言、患者数が900を超え1,000件に近づくこと、医療施設への攻撃、遺体の安全な埋葬に関する紛争、軍事的保護の必要性、および国際的な拡大懸念（ナショナルフットボールチームの隔離）が記述されている。セキュリティ上の懸念（M23およびADFなどの反政府勢力の活動）と約100万人の国内避難民も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ugandan health officials report new Ebola virus infections, bringing cases to 7
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports two new Ebola infections, bringing total to seven linked to the Congo outbreak declared May 15. A 59-year-old Congolese man admitted to a Kampala hospital on May 11 died three days later before confirmation; two Congolese nationals seeking care in Uganda later tested positive. Uganda confirmed its first local infections Saturday: a driver and a health worker exposed to the deceased; two more health workers at a private Kampala hospital have since tested positive. All seven cases are admitted to a designated treatment unit. In Congo, suspected Ebola cases exceed 900, centered in Ituri amid fear. Bundibugyo Ebola virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment, prompted a global health emergency. Measures in Uganda include avoiding handshakes, postponing a religious gathering near Kampala by June 3, and suspending Congo–Uganda transport and flights. Transmission is via bodily fluids; fruit bats are natural hosts.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダの保健当局が新たなエボラウイルス感染を報告、症例数が7件に
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）の国境を越えた感染確認であり、IHR基準4項目すべて該当。ウガンダで初の市中感染と医療従事者感染が確認され、DRC側で900例超の疑い例がある。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常事象、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダで感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。DRC側で疑い例900例超、ウガンダで7例確認。承認されたワクチンや治療法がないBundibugyo型エボラ。渡航・航空便制限等の対策が実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: Suspected Ebola cases top 900 in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: More than 900 suspected Ebola cases have been identified in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 101 of them confirmed, according to WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. The outbreak, declared on May 15, is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatments. In a previous update, DR Congo’s health ministry reported 204 deaths among 867 suspected cases across three provinces, highlighting the outbreak’s severity in a conflict-affected region. Ebola is a deadly viral disease that spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids and can cause severe bleeding and organ failure. The situation underscores ongoing risk, with Ebola having killed more than 15,000 people across Africa in the past half-century. Reported on 2026-05-25.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ疑い患者が900件を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目中4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（101確認例、204死亡）、予想外のイベント（Bundibugyo株で承認ワクチンなし）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの確認例101件、疑い例900件超、死亡者204名という深刻な状況。Bundibugyo株は承認済みワクチンが存在しないため、管理可能性が極めて低い。紛争影響下の地域での流行であり、公衆衛生的脅威は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: El virus del ébola acecha al Mundial 2026 pero ¿hay riesgo de una pandemia? Esto dice experto
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus haunts the 2026 World Cup, but is there a risk of a pandemic? This is what an expert says.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 500 infections and about 150 deaths; WHO has deployed brigades to affected provinces. Mexican infectious disease expert Alejandro Macías Hernández says there is no pandemic risk; transmission requires direct contact in settings with poor hygiene and occurs only when symptoms are present, making sustained transmission unlikely in Mexico and other developed countries. During the 2026 World Cup, a case arriving from Congo could occur but would be unlikely to spread due to symptom-driven transmission and strict surveillance. Mexico’s Health Secretariat reports an integrated detection system, and National Epidemiological Reference Institute has diagnostic capabilities. Guanajuato’s Health Secretariat maintains surveillance across eight jurisdictions, trains health personnel and promotes hygiene and avoidance of contact with fluids from the ill. Travelers should verify medical services before travel to DRC/Uganda and, if fever or other symptoms arise within 21 days, isolate and notify authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年ワールドカップを脅かすエボラウイルスだが、パンデミックのリスクはあるのか？専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行は実在し、IHR基準2つ以上に該当する可能性があるが、記事の主題は「メキシコでのパンデミックリスクなし」という専門家の見解であり、実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダのみ。対象国リストに含まれるDRCについては情報があるが、メキシコは対象国外であり、現時点ではDRCでの流行状況の詳細が不明なため経過観察を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はメキシコでのパンデミックリスクを論じているが、実際の流行地はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストはDRCのみ該当。メキシコ関連の情報（グアナフアト州など）は流行発生地ではなく準備体制の言及であるため除外。Bluedot APIが誤ってメキシコを主要な発生地として列挙している可能性が高い。DRCでの感染数500件超、死亡150件は重大だが、記事は2026年のワールドカップ時点での流行続行可能性についての専門家見解が中心であり、現在の流行状況の詳細（発生段階、対策状況、保健体制など）が不明なため、フルRRA実施前にDRCでの最新流行情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ébola: Epidemia alastra apesar dos esforços para contar avanço da infecção - Conflitos no leste congolês ajudam à propagação do vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: The epidemic is spreading despite efforts to contain the spread of the infection - Conflicts in eastern Congo are helping to spread the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to accelerate as the Bundibugyo strain spreads from Ituri province near the Uganda border into North Kivu and South Kivu, with neighboring Rwanda and Burundi affected, and South Sudan reporting suspected cases. Since the alert was raised on May 15, the epidemic has caused at least 205 confirmed deaths, about 110 laboratory-confirmed cases, and over 900 suspected cases under investigation. The Bundibugyo strain, first identified in Uganda, carries a mortality rate above 50% and currently has no vaccine or approved treatment; a vaccine is in development but not yet in trials. Factors fueling spread include armed conflict in eastern DRC (M23 and ADF), displacement, and community resistance to treatment and diagnostics. Incidents such as in Rwampara, near Bunia, where locals burned a new isolation ward after a child's death and funeral rites dispute, underscore transmission risks linked to traditional rites.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：感染拡大を抑制する努力にもかかわらず流行が拡大 - コンゴ東部の紛争がウイルス蔓延を助長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の流行で深刻な影響（200+死亡）、予想外の展開（武装紛争による蔓延阻害）、複数国への国際的拡大（ルワンダ、ブルンジ、南スーダン）、渡航・貿易制限のリスク。対象国DRCでの大規模流行。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain with >50% mortality. Over 900 suspected cases under investigation. Armed conflict (M23, ADF) and community resistance hindering response. Neighboring countries (Rwanda, Burundi, South Sudan) reporting cases/suspected cases. Vaccine in development but not yet in clinical trials. International support critical.

article.articleHeadline: RT-Engels: Uganda backs Africa-wide Ebola response hub
article.articleSummary: Uganda backs Africa-wide Ebola response hub in Kampala after President Yoweri Museveni met Africa CDC officials and endorsed establishing an Incident Management Support Team in Uganda to coordinate surveillance and outbreak response across Africa. The move aims to strengthen regional coordination and monitoring of Ebola. Africa CDC reports DR Congo and Uganda together have 744 suspected Ebola cases, including 83 confirmed infections, with 176 deaths among suspected cases as of Friday. The World Health Organization notes the DR Congo outbreak is expanding, with more than 900 suspected cases nationwide and 101 confirmed infections to date. Kampala’s support positions Uganda as a regional anchor for outbreak response, leveraging the proposed hub in the capital to enhance cross-border surveillance and coordinated containment across the continent.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、アフリカ全域のエボラ対応ハブを支持
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを伴う既知の高リスク疾患。複数国での確認症例と死亡事例、アフリカ全域の監視体制強化計画により、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事のサマリーはウガンダでのハブ設置とウガンダの支持について述べているが、実際のエボラ確認症例の発生主要地域はDRC（WHO報告で900以上の疑い例、101確認例）である。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。アフリカCDCの744疑い例83確認例の報告についても、DRCが主要な発生地であり、DRCは対象国に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: ФИФА считает, что сборную ДР Конго пустят на ЧМ-2026 в США, несмотря на вирус Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA believes the DR Congo national team will be allowed to participate in the 2026 World Cup in the United States, despite the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-05-25, FIFA and the Congolese Football Federation (FECOFA) held a joint briefing regarding an Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo. FIFA states the DR Congo national team has complied with sanitary measures required for entry into the United States for the 2026 World Cup in the United States, and will be able to travel to participate. The team had previously been urged to observe isolation as part of World Cup eligibility considerations. The FECOFA-FIFA statement notes that players and staff adhered to the measures implemented in the U.S. Delegations are urged to prepare for the tournament. For fans who purchased tickets but could not obtain U.S. visas, FIFA is considering a compensation initiative. No specific Ebola case counts are cited in the report.

triage.headline_ja: FIFAはエボラウイルスにもかかわらず、コンゴ民主共和国代表チームが2026年米国ワールドカップに出場することを認めると考えている
triage.triage_reason: エボラ関連の記事だが、本記事は2026年ワールドカップへの参加可能性という政治的・スポーツ的な関心が主題であり、実際の感染症イベントの公衆衛生的な詳細（症例数、死亡数、伝播状況など）が記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラの存在を言及しているが、実際の感染症イベントの詳細データ（症例数、死亡数、発生地域の具体的な制御状況）が記載されていない。むしろワールドカップへの参加許可に関する政治的・スポーツ的な関心が主題である。United States（6252001）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。今後、DRCでのエボラ発生の詳細情報が入手できた場合は評価を修正する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Redirects Ebola-Exposed Travelers to Three Designated Airports for Screening - Diaspora Digital Media (DDM News) - Nigeria Breaking News, Africa and World News and Updates
article.articleSummary: U.S. designates three airports for Ebola-exposed travelers: Washington Dulles International, Hartsfield-Jackson Atlanta International, and George Bush Intercontinental Houston. As of 2026-05-25, citizens who traveled through Uganda, South Sudan, or the Democratic Republic of Congo within the past 21 days must undergo CDC-led screening on arrival, including temperature checks, symptom screening, and collection of contact information in temporary screening areas. Travelers are risk-assessed based on symptoms, exposure history, and activities, with those not high-risk cleared to continue but placed under observation. State health departments monitor arrivals for 21 days, with follow-up intensity varying by exposure. WHO declared a public health emergency of international concern due to Ebola outbreaks in the region, with hundreds of suspected cases and deaths. Citizenship matters: U.S. citizens/nationals are guaranteed entry through designated airports; permanent residents may be assessed case-by-case; other foreign nationals face Title 42 restrictions. Experts say screening helps but cannot stop transmission alone; containment in affected countries remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ曝露者をスクリーニングのため3つの指定空港にリダイレクト
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病の地域流行による深刻な公衆衛生影響、WHO緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク、国際渡航制限実施が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ、南スーダン、DRCでのエボラ流行が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ、南スーダン、米国は対象国外のため verified_locations から除外。WHO緊急事態宣言、複数国への国際的な渡航制限措置実施、数百件の患者・死亡報告があり、明確なシグナルとして適切。

article.articleHeadline: 2医护人员染疫 乌干达伊波拉病例增至7例 - 国际 - 即时国际
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two healthcare workers infected; Uganda Ebola cases rise to seven - International - Live International
article.articleSummary: Uganda reported two additional Ebola virus disease cases on May 25, 2026, raising the national total to seven. The two new infections are Ugandan healthcare workers at a private facility in Kampala; both patients are in designated treatment units and receiving care as emergency teams trace contacts. Uganda had confirmed three new cases the previous Saturday. The outbreak center is Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, which borders Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared this Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. As of May 25, 2026, WHO reports more than 900 suspected cases and 101 laboratory-confirmed cases. Health authorities are coordinating surveillance and response to limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 2人の医療従事者が感染、ウガンダのエボラ病例が7例に増加 - 国際ニュース
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク、WHO PHEIC宣言）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。国際的な注目度が高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済みのBundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak。DRCのIturi Province（記事では「Ituri Province」と明記）が発生中心地で、隣接するウガンダへ波及。既に900+の疑い例と101の確認例。医療従事者への感染拡大は管理リスク増。両国での対象国IDが取得できた（DRC=203312、Uganda=226074）。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Ebola, Thailand Berlakukan Karantina Ketat untuk Pelancong dari Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alert: Thailand Imposes Strict Quarantine on Travellers from Congo
article.articleSummary: Thailand imposes a 21-day quarantine on travelers arriving from or transiting through the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda due to Ebola (Bundibugyo strain). The policy, approved by Thailand’s technical committee for the Department of Disease Control (DDC), follows WHO’s May 17, 2026 designation of the Congo-Uganda Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency. There is no approved vaccine or treatment for this strain yet. By May 22, 2026, ten travelers from affected regions were recorded in Thailand (eight from Uganda, two from the DRC); all underwent arrival screening with no symptoms but must remain under surveillance and report health status for 21 days. Authorities have increased screening of travelers from affected zones and urged residents to monitor for fever or unusual symptoms and seek medical care if recently returned individuals develop illness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒、タイがコンゴからの旅行者に厳格な隔離を実施
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO公式に公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言済みのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的対応事例。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言したコンゴ・ウガンダ発生のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）に関するもの。タイで渡航者への検疫措置が実施されており、確定例がないまま監視体制が強化されている。DRCでの発生、タイでの対応措置を確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases surge past 900 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola haemorrhagic fever outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo—centered in Ituri Province near Bunia—has surpassed 900 suspected cases. The Congolese Ministry of Communication reports 904 suspected cases and 119 suspected deaths as of May 25, 2026. Official death toll was revised down from over 170 without explanation. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, mass displacement (nearly one million uprooted in Ituri), and deep community distrust. The virus risk appears highest in displacement camps surrounding Bunia, where initial cases were identified. International medical teams coordinate across shifting frontlines amid fractured security, shortages of testing kits, protective gear, and safe-burial resources. Authorities have imposed bans on traditional funeral wakes and large public gatherings; security forces guard burials conducted by aid groups. The article does not specify the infection source or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ患者が900人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も全て該当。900人超の疑い患者と119人の死亡が報告されており、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイツリ州ブニア近郊における活発なエボラアウトブレイクを報告。武装紛争、大量避難民（イツリで約100万人）、コミュニティ不信が封じ込めを大きく阻害している。国際医療チームが対応しているが、検査キット、防護装備、安全埋葬資源の不足が深刻。死亡者数の下方修正（170人以上から119人に）が説明なく行われており、データの信頼性に懸念がある。
